#### I-B1-4.1 — 4.1 基本型別、資料與翻譯

Owner: **3B1-T1**; definition: `packages/plugin-protocol/src/ui-resource.ts`. Source: B1 §4.1.

```ts
type LocalId = string; // ASCII ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$
type Text = { en: string; "zh-TW"?: string };
type Scalar = string | number | boolean | null;
type ValueSpec =
  | { type: "string"; maxLength: number; nullable: boolean }
  | { type: "number"; min: number; max: number; integer: boolean; nullable: boolean }
  | { type: "boolean"; nullable: boolean }
  | { type: "enum"; values: string[]; nullable: boolean };
type DataSlot = { schema: ValueSpec; initial: Scalar };
type Field = {
  schema: ValueSpec;
  initial: Scalar;
  required: boolean;
  requiredWhen?: Condition;
};
type ValueRef = { scope: "data" | "form"; key: LocalId };
type DisplayValue = { literal: Scalar } | { ref: ValueRef };
type DisplayText = { text: Text } | { ref: { scope: "data"; key: LocalId } };
type PanelResourceV1 = {
  kind: "panel";
  data: Record<LocalId, DataSlot>;
  fields: Record<LocalId, Field>;
  root: LocalId;
  nodes: UiNodeV1[];
};
type StatusResourceV1 = {
  kind: "status";
  text: DisplayText;
  tone: "neutral" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "error";
  data: Record<LocalId, DataSlot>;
  visibleWhen?: Condition;
};
```

#### I-B1-4.3 — 4.3 條件及 actions

Owner: **3B1-T1**; definition: `packages/plugin-protocol/src/ui-resource.ts`. Source: B1 §4.3.

```ts
type Condition =
  | { op: "eq" | "ne"; left: ValueRef; right: Scalar }
  | { op: "lt" | "lte" | "gt" | "gte"; left: ValueRef; right: number }
  | { op: "all" | "any"; items: Condition[] } // 1–8
  | { op: "not"; item: Condition };
type ArgumentBindings = Record<LocalId, DisplayValue>;
type UiAction =
  | { kind: "command"; command: Id; arguments: ArgumentBindings }
  | { kind: "core"; action: "openPanel"; panelId: Id }
  | { kind: "core"; action: "stop"; operation: { scope: "data"; key: LocalId } }
  | { kind: "core"; action: "disconnect"; session: { scope: "data"; key: LocalId } }
  | { kind: "core"; action: "openRecovery" };
```

#### I-B1-6.1 — 6.1 Catalog 與 renderer bridge

Owner: **3B1-T1**; definition: `packages/plugin-protocol/src/ui-types.ts`. Source: B1 §6.1.

```ts
// 新增 host-owned DTO；不是 feature 可寫入的 registration request。
type UiOwner = {
  sourceKey: string;
  pluginId: Id;
  uiResourceGeneration: Counter;
};
type UiCatalogEntry = UiOwner & {
  id: Id;
  kind: "panel" | "status";
  title: Text;
  version: 1;
  resourceDigest: string; // SHA-256，64 lower-case hex
  resourceBytes: number;
  availability: "available" | "unavailable";
  problem?: { code: string; message: string }; // 使用正式共用 error enum
};
type UiCatalogPage = {
  hostEpoch: Handle;
  revision: Counter;
  entries: UiCatalogEntry[];
  nextCursor: Handle | null;
};
type UiBinding = {
  contributionId: Id;
  panelInstance: Handle; // status 亦為 host-issued instance，kind 區分用途
  kind: "panel" | "status";
  uiResourceGeneration: Counter;
  generation: Counter;
  hostEpoch: Handle;
  processEpoch: Handle;
};
type UiStateSnapshot = {
  binding: UiBinding;
  revision: Counter;
  data: Record<LocalId, Scalar>;
  formRevision: Counter;
  form: Record<LocalId, Scalar>;
  valid: boolean;
  visible: boolean;
  locale: "en" | "zh-TW";
};
```

#### I-B1-7.1 — 7.1 新舊路徑

Owner: **3B1-T1**; definition: `packages/plugin-protocol/src/ui-types.ts`. Source: B1 §7.1.

```ts
// 新增；所有 context 欄位由 host 建立。
type CommandInvocation = {
  version: 1;
  invocationId: Handle;
  command: Id;
  arguments: Record<LocalId, Scalar>;
  context: {
    contextRef: Handle | null; // 3A Handle；null 表示未綁 workbench，不是自行宣稱 role／holder
    origin: "panel" | "management";
    locale: "en" | "zh-TW";
    binding?: UiBinding;
    motionScopeRef?: Handle; // 3A DeviceIntentPort 發的 Handle，僅 panel context
    actionRef?: Handle; // host 真實使用者動作；§11.4 的 persistence action port
    form?: { revision: Counter; values: Record<LocalId, Scalar> };
    trigger:
      | { kind: "activate" }
      | { kind: "hold"; phase: "begin" | "end" | "cancel"; gestureRef: Handle };
  };
};
type CommandValue = {
  output: Record<LocalId, Scalar>; // ≤32 keys；非任意 deep JSON
  fieldErrors: { field: LocalId; message: Text }[]; // ≤32
};
// command/invoke result = Result<CommandValue>
```

### C-B1 — host UI ports and table-derived types

Import `ResourceKindV160`, `ResourceErrorDetailFor` from business-result.ts and `PluginErrorCodeV160` from errors.ts for the projected Result below. Import `UiValidationContext` from ui-validation.ts for host resource metadata. AM-14/16/17/19/22/28/31 declarations in T0 are part of this summary and retain their defining modules.

Owner: UI resource/type completions 3B1-T1 in `packages/plugin-protocol/src/ui-resource.ts` / `ui-types.ts`; bridge/catalog ports 3B1-T2 in `packages/plugin-runtime/src/ui-host-ports.ts`; action/core declarations 3B1-T3 in `packages/plugin-runtime/src/core-actions.ts`, implemented by 3B1-T5; renderer ports 3B1-T7 in `apps/desktop/src/renderer/plugin-ui/host-ports.ts`. This is the T0 spelling of B1's prose/table contracts. Shared/preload DTOs only re-export these types.

```ts
// Id is the string output of namespacedIdSchema, not a new ID grammar.
type Id = string;
type BuiltinPolicy = "required" | "optional"; // runtime builtin-launch.ts, B1-T4
// UI's module-local Scalar here is I-B1-4.1, not settings' Scalar.
type UiNodeBase = {
  id: LocalId;
  visibleWhen?: Condition;
  enabledWhen?: Condition;
};
type UiNumberNode = {
  field: LocalId;
  label: Text;
  help?: Text;
  step: number;
  unit?: Text;
};
type UiNodeV1 = UiNodeBase &
  (
    | { type: "group"; label?: Text; help?: Text; layout: "stack" | "row"; children: LocalId[] }
    | { type: "text"; value: DisplayText; emphasis: "normal" | "strong" }
    | { type: "help"; value: DisplayText }
    | { type: "textInput"; field: LocalId; label: Text; help?: Text; placeholder?: Text }
    | ({ type: "number" } & UiNumberNode)
    | ({ type: "range" } & UiNumberNode)
    | {
        type: "choice";
        field: LocalId;
        label: Text;
        help?: Text;
        presentation: "select" | "segmented";
        options: { value: string; label: Text }[];
      }
    | { type: "boolean"; field: LocalId; label: Text; help?: Text }
    | { type: "action"; label: Text; action: UiAction; variant: "normal" | "primary" | "danger" }
    | { type: "holdAction"; label: Text; command: Id; arguments: ArgumentBindings; help?: Text }
    | {
        type: "status";
        text: DisplayText;
        tone: "neutral" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "error";
      }
    | { type: "alert"; text: DisplayText; severity: "info" | "warning" | "error" }
    | { type: "progress"; value: DisplayValue; max: number; label: Text }
    | { type: "keyValue"; rows: { id: LocalId; label: Text; value: DisplayValue; unit?: Text }[] }
  );
type UiRevokeReason =
  | "release"
  | "pointer-cancel"
  | "focus-loss"
  | "hidden"
  | "closed"
  | "form-change"
  | "action-disabled"
  | "heartbeat-expired"
  | "authority-lost"
  | "generation-retired"
  | "resource-replaced"
  | "renderer-gone"
  | "process-gone"
  | "provider-gone"
  | "safe-mode"
  | "shutdown"
  | "overflow";
type UiDetail = {
  kind: "ui";
  reason:
    | "read"
    | "path"
    | "schema"
    | "reference"
    | "cycle"
    | "translation"
    | "limit"
    | "renderer"
    | "version"
    | "negotiation";
  contributionId?: Id;
  fieldPath?: string;
  limit?: keyof typeof UI_LIMITS_V1;
  allowed?: Counter;
  actual?: Counter;
};
type Result<T> = BusinessResult<T, UiDetail | PermissionErrorDetail | ResourceErrorDetailFor<ResourceKindV160>, PluginErrorCodeV160>;
type UiSubscriptionSnapshot = {
  instances: UiBinding[];
  states: UiStateSnapshot[];
  locale: "en" | "zh-TW";
  theme: "light" | "dark";
};
type UiBridgeEvent =
  | { type: "catalog"; hostEpoch: Handle; revision: Counter; owners: UiOwner[] }
  | { type: "state"; binding: UiBinding; revision: Counter }
  | { type: "pulse"; binding: UiBinding; challenge: Handle }
  | { type: "revoked"; binding: UiBinding; reason: UiRevokeReason };
interface PluginUiBridge {
  catalog(input: { cursor?: Handle }): Promise<Result<UiCatalogPage>>;
  resource(input: {
    sourceKey: string;
    id: Id;
    uiResourceGeneration: Counter;
    resourceDigest: string;
  }): Promise<
    Result<{
      owner: UiOwner;
      id: Id;
      version: 1;
      resource: PanelResourceV1 | StatusResourceV1;
      validationContext: UiValidationContext;
      rawBytes: number;
    }>
  >;
  open(input: {
    sourceKey: string;
    id: Id;
    uiResourceGeneration: Counter;
  }): Promise<Result<UiStateSnapshot>>;
  close(input: { binding: UiBinding }): Promise<Result<{ closed: true }>>;
  visibility(input: {
    binding: UiBinding;
    visible: boolean;
    reason: "tab" | "sidebar" | "collapse" | "document" | "window";
  }): Promise<Result<{ accepted: true }>>;
  invoke(input: {
    binding: UiBinding;
    nodeId: LocalId;
    formRevision: Counter;
    form: Record<LocalId, Scalar>;
  }): Promise<Result<CommandValue>>;
  hold(input: {
    binding: UiBinding;
    nodeId: LocalId;
    phase: "begin" | "end" | "cancel";
    inputToken: Handle;
    formRevision: Counter;
    form: Record<LocalId, Scalar>;
  }): Promise<Result<{ gesture: Handle | null }>>;
  pulse(input: {
    binding: UiBinding;
    challenge: Handle;
    gesture: Handle | null;
    inputToken: Handle | null;
  }): Promise<Result<{ accepted: true }>>;
  snapshot(input: { binding: UiBinding }): Promise<Result<UiStateSnapshot>>;
  reportFailure(input: {
    sourceKey: string;
    id: Id;
    uiResourceGeneration: Counter;
    catalogRevision: Counter;
    reason: "validation" | "renderer";
    fieldPath?: string;
  }): Promise<Result<{ accepted: boolean }>>;
  onEvent(listener: (event: UiBridgeEvent) => void): () => void;
}
// Host trust is bound by construction; none of these references come from plugin arguments.
interface CoreRecoveryPort {
  snapshot(input: { cursor?: Handle }): Promise<Result<CoreRecoverySnapshot>>;
  act(input: { itemId: Handle; actionId: Handle }): Promise<Result<CoreRecoverySnapshot>>;
  onChanged(listener: () => void): () => void;
}
type UserPersistenceActionContext = { owner: ResourceOwner; actionRef: Handle };
// Core-only action ledger validation seam; B1-T3 declarations, B1-T5 implementation.
// Minting is deliberately absent from this consumer-facing host port.
type CoreActionTarget =
  | { kind: "device-stop"; faultId: Handle; sessionId: Handle }
  | {
      kind: "device-reconcile";
      faultId: Handle;
      sessionId: Handle;
      identityEvidence: "serial-match" | "user-confirmed-device";
    }
  | { kind: "device-clear"; entryIds: Handle[] }
  | { kind: "device-disconnect"; sessionId: Handle }
  | { kind: "device-current-stop"; sessionId: Handle }
  | { kind: "persistence-retry" | "persistence-discard" | "persistence-export"; recovery: Handle };
interface CoreActionValidationPort {
  claim(action: CoreActionReference, target: CoreActionTarget): boolean;
  isClaimed(action: CoreActionReference, target: CoreActionTarget): boolean;
  complete(action: CoreActionReference): void;
}
interface UserPersistenceActionPort {
  claim(
    context: UserPersistenceActionContext,
    purpose: "storage.export" | "ui.clipboard",
  ): BusinessResult<{ action: Handle }, PermissionErrorDetail | ResourceErrorDetail>;
}
interface UiCatalogPort {
  catalog(input: { cursor?: Handle }): Promise<Result<UiCatalogPage>>;
  resource(
    input: Parameters<PluginUiBridge["resource"]>[0],
  ): ReturnType<PluginUiBridge["resource"]>;
  retire(owner: ResourceOwner): void;
  onEvent(listener: (event: UiBridgeEvent) => void): () => void;
}
interface PluginUiRendererHost {
  start(): Promise<void>;
  setVisibility(
    binding: UiBinding,
    visible: boolean,
    reason: Parameters<PluginUiBridge["visibility"]>[0]["reason"],
  ): Promise<void>;
  dispose(): void;
}
declare function createPluginUiRendererHost(input: {
  bridge: PluginUiBridge;
  recovery: CoreRecoveryPort;
}): PluginUiRendererHost;
```

The device retirement reason table is not duplicated in code elsewhere: B1 §11.4's exact table in the constraints appendix owns it. `UiCatalogPort` is a source/catalog seam; the UI state/subscription service remains a distinct object inside the same B1-T2 write set and is attached by the runtime owner, rather than invented independent stores in main/renderer. `CoreActionReference` is minted only in main; CoreRecoveryPort's renderer input contains option IDs, never caller-authored tokens/scopes. Settings/export/copy claims use the separate feature actionRef ledger.

#### I-B2-8.1 — 8.1 公開 checkpoint／drain 契約

Owner: **3B2-T1 DrainReason/DrainRequest; 3B2-T5 host-only DrainReport**; definition: `packages/plugin-protocol/src/storage.ts`. Source: B2 §8.1.

```ts
type DrainReason =
  | "disable"
  | "reload"
  | "remove"
  | "renderer-crash"
  | "window-destroyed"
  | "shutdown"
  | "update"
  | "safe-mode"
  | "reservation-ended";
type DrainRequest = {
  token: Handle;
  reason: DrainReason;
  remainingMs: number; // 0..10_000；host monotonic deadline 才是權威
  checkpoints: Array<{
    checkpoint: Handle;
    record: RecordMeta;
    reservationEnd?: {
      reservationId: Handle;
      reason: Exclude<ReservationSnapshot["reason"], "active">;
      lastSequence: Counter;
    };
  }>;
  writes: Array<{ write: Handle; id: RecordId; state: "receiving" | "sealed" }>;
};
type DrainReport = {
  state: "saved" | "retryable" | "checkpoint-only" | "uncertain";
  blocker: boolean;
  recovery?: Handle;
  retryAction?: Handle; // core recovery action descriptor ID，不是授權 token；不送插件
  pendingSettings: boolean;
  records: Array<{
    id: RecordId;
    committedRevision: RecordRevision | null; // 新建且尚未提交時為 null
    final: boolean;
    payload: "complete-staging" | "checkpoint-only" | "none";
    expiresAt?: number;
  }>;
  errors: Array<{ code: string; message: string; detail?: PersistenceFailureDetail }>;
};
```

`DrainReport` is host-only and is placed in runtime persistence-participant.ts (B2-T5); only DrainReason/DrainRequest are in protocol storage.ts (B2-T1). PersistenceOwner is the type-only ResourceOwner alias.

#### I-B2-8.2 — 8.2 提供給 3B-1／3A 的 host-only ports

Owner: **3B2-T5**; definition: `packages/plugin-runtime/src/persistence-participant.ts`. Source: B2 §8.2.

```ts
interface PersistenceParticipant {
  // 同步對帳 ended／pending bindings，只封住該 recording target，不 freeze owner。
  endReservation(event: ReservationEnded, deadline: number): DrainOffer | null;
  // 同步關閉普通 admission，擷取已受理工作；可與 broker revocation 同一回合呼叫。
  freeze(
    owner: PersistenceOwner,
    reason: DrainReason,
    deadline: number,
    deviceDrain?: DeviceDrainGrant,
  ): DrainOffer;
  // 以獨立 drain request 喚醒仍健康的原 process；不延長 deadline。
  drain(offer: DrainOffer, dispatch: DrainDispatcher): Promise<DrainReport>;
  // owner 已死亡，不 dispatch；只處理 host 已持有的 ticket，保留 checkpoint。
  ownerLost(owner: PersistenceOwner): Promise<DrainReport>;
  // 接 core recovery snapshot；retry／discard 僅接受可信 UI action，不是 plugin RPC。
  recoverySnapshot(): PersistenceRecoverySnapshot;
  retry(recovery: Handle, action: CoreActionReference): Promise<DrainReport>;
  discard(recovery: Handle, action: CoreActionReference): Promise<DrainReport>;
}
```

### C-B2 — prose-only persistence ports completed for T0

These are explicitly **plan-level host-only signatures**, freezing the concepts in B2 §§4.3, 6.1, 8.2 and 9. They do not widen the public wire table. Owner/type location: B2-T5 `packages/plugin-runtime/src/persistence-participant.ts` for lifecycle projections; B2-T3 `packages/plugin-runtime/src/settings-form-port.ts` for forms; B2-T2 `apps/desktop/src/main/plugins/persistence/filesystem.ts` / `engine-port.ts` for I/O; B2-T5 `host-port.ts` for composition and B2-T4 `record-port.ts` for record service access; B2-T6 `import-sources.ts` for import.

```ts
type PersistenceOwner = ResourceOwner; // type-only alias, not a new owner shape
// DrainReport itself has its sole definition in I-B2-8.1.
type DrainOffer = Readonly<{
  owner: PersistenceOwner;
  reason: DrainReason;
  deadlineMonotonicMs: number;
  token: Handle;
  checkpoints: readonly DrainRequest["checkpoints"][number][];
  writes: readonly DrainRequest["writes"][number][];
  acceptedTickets: readonly Handle[];
}>;
type DrainDispatcher = (
  owner: PersistenceOwner,
  request: DrainRequest,
  signal: AbortSignal,
) => Promise<
  BusinessResult<
    {
      status: "submitted" | "checkpoint-only";
      writes: Handle[];
    },
    PersistenceFailureDetail
  >
>;
type PersistenceRecoverySnapshot = {
  revision: Counter;
  items: Array<{
    id: Handle;
    sourceKey: string;
    pluginId: string;
    recordId: RecordId | null;
    committedRevision: RecordRevision | null;
    state: DrainReport["state"];
    payload: "complete-staging" | "checkpoint-only" | "none";
    expiresAt?: Timestamp;
    actions: Array<{ id: Handle; kind: "retry" | "export" | "discard" }>;
  }>;
};
// Host-only form adapter; public v1 resource/schema remains unchanged.
type SettingsFormBinding = {
  owner: UiOwner;
  scope: CoreWindowScope;
  resourceDigest: Sha256;
};
interface SettingsFormPort {
  open(
    binding: SettingsFormBinding,
    resource: SettingsResourceV1,
    snapshot: SettingsSnapshot,
  ): void;
  replaceSnapshot(binding: SettingsFormBinding, snapshot: SettingsSnapshot): void;
  showFailure(
    binding: SettingsFormBinding,
    error: { code: PluginErrorCode; message: string; detail?: PersistenceFailureDetail },
  ): void;
  dispose(binding: SettingsFormBinding): void;
}
type SettingsDraftState = {
  baseline: SettingsSnapshot;
  draft: Values;
  busyKeys: SettingKey[];
  errors: Array<{ key: SettingKey; message: SettingsText }>;
};
// SettingsControlsPort/SettingsDraftState: B1-T7 host-ports.ts; B2-T3 consumes.
interface SettingsControlsPort {
  render(
    binding: SettingsFormBinding,
    resource: SettingsResourceV1,
    state: SettingsDraftState,
  ): void;
  onChange(
    listener: (
      binding: SettingsFormBinding,
      key: SettingKey,
      value: SettingsScalar,
      phase: "change" | "blur" | "enter" | "reset",
    ) => void,
  ): () => void;
  dispose(binding: SettingsFormBinding): void;
}
// SettingsScalar is the import alias for B2's module-local Scalar.
```

The persistence filesystem implementation is owned by B2-T2. Only the imported lifecycle and settings projections above are consumed by this plan.

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { uiResourceV1Schema, conditionSchema, valueSpecSchema } from "./ui-resource.js";
import { validateUiResource } from "./ui-validation.js";

const context = { pluginId: "test.ui", commands: [], panels: [] };
const panel = () => ({ kind: "panel", data: {}, fields: {}, root: "root", nodes: [
  { id: "root", type: "group", layout: "stack", children: ["body"] },
  { id: "body", type: "text", value: { text: { en: "<b>plain text</b>" } }, emphasis: "normal" },
] });
const validate = (value: unknown) => validateUiResource(value, context,
  new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(value)).length);

describe("U01/U02 strict UI resources", () => {
  it("accepts HTML-looking text as uninterpreted text", () => {
    expect(validate(panel()).ok).toBe(true);
  });
  it.each(["style", "className", "onClick", "version"])("rejects unknown %s", (key) => {
    expect(validate({ ...panel(), [key]: "x" }).ok).toBe(false);
  });
  it("rejects missing en, extra locale, and unknown component", () => {
    const value = panel();
    expect(validate({ ...value, nodes: [value.nodes[0],
      { ...value.nodes[1], value: { text: { "zh-TW": "標籤" } } }] }).ok).toBe(false);
    expect(validate({ ...value, nodes: [value.nodes[0],
      { ...value.nodes[1], value: { text: { en: "ok", fr: "non" } } }] }).ok).toBe(false);
    expect(validate({ ...value, nodes: [value.nodes[0],
      { ...value.nodes[1], type: "iframe" }] }).ok).toBe(false);
  });
  it("rejects cycles, duplicate IDs, shared children and orphans", () => {
    for (const nodes of [
      [{ id: "root", type: "group", layout: "stack", children: ["root"] }],
      [...panel().nodes, panel().nodes[1]],
      [{ ...panel().nodes[0], children: ["body", "body"] }, panel().nodes[1]],
      [...panel().nodes, { ...panel().nodes[1], id: "orphan" }],
    ]) expect(validate({ ...panel(), nodes }).ok).toBe(false);
  });
  it("forbids prototype keys and form references in status", () => {
    const value = JSON.parse('{"kind":"panel","data":{"__proto__":{"schema":{"type":"boolean","nullable":false},"initial":true}},"fields":{},"root":"root","nodes":[]}');
    expect(validate(value).ok).toBe(false);
    expect(uiResourceV1Schema.safeParse({ kind: "status", data: {}, tone: "neutral",
      text: { ref: { scope: "form", key: "field" } } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(uiResourceV1Schema.safeParse({ kind: "status", data: {}, tone: "neutral",
      text: { text: { en: "Ready" } }, action: { kind: "core", action: "openRecovery" } }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  it("unfolds conditions finitely, rejects regex and depth five", () => {
    let condition: unknown = { op: "eq", left: { scope: "data", key: "flag" }, right: true };
    for (let n = 0; n < 3; n++) condition = { op: "not", item: condition };
    expect(conditionSchema.safeParse(condition).success).toBe(true);
    expect(conditionSchema.safeParse({ op: "not", item: condition }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(conditionSchema.safeParse({ op: "regex", left: { scope: "data", key: "flag" }, right: "x" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  it("has no coercion or defaults", () => {
    expect(valueSpecSchema.safeParse({ type: "boolean" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(valueSpecSchema.safeParse({ type: "number", min: 0, max: 1, integer: false, nullable: "false" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

import { z } from "zod";
import { namespacedIdSchema } from "./common.js";
export const localIdSchema = z.string().min(1).max(32).regex(/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$/);

export const valueSpecSchema = z.union([
  z.strictObject({ type: z.literal("string"), maxLength: z.number().int().min(1).max(4000), nullable: z.boolean() }),
  z.strictObject({ type: z.literal("number"), min: z.number(), max: z.number(), integer: z.boolean(), nullable: z.boolean() }),
  z.strictObject({ type: z.literal("boolean"), nullable: z.boolean() }),

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { validateUiResource, validateUiData, evaluateCondition, acceptsValue } from "./ui-validation.js";
import type { PanelResourceV1, Condition } from "./ui-resource.js";
const context = { pluginId: "test.ui", panels: [], commands: [] };

  progress: { schema: { type: "number", min: 0, max: 100, integer: false, nullable: true }, initial: 0 },

  initial: null, required: true } }, nodes: [
  { id: "root", type: "group", layout: "stack", children: ["count", "progress"] },
  { id: "count", type: "range", field: "count", label: { en: "Count" }, step: 1 },
  { id: "progress", type: "progress", value: { ref: { scope: "data", key: "progress" } }, max: 50, label: { en: "Done" } },
] });
const check = (value: unknown, bytes = 1000) => validateUiResource(value, context, bytes);
describe("U01/U02/U03/U05 semantic pass", () => {
  it("checks raw bytes independently of parsed content", () => {
    expect(check(make(), 262144).ok).toBe(true);
    expect(check(make(), 262145)).toMatchObject({ ok: false, error: { code: "PLUGIN_E_UI_RESOURCE", detail: { reason: "limit" } } });
  });
  it("counts Unicode code points and rejects lone surrogates", () => {
    const p = make();
    p.nodes[1] = { ...p.nodes[1]!, label: { en: "😀".repeat(200) } } as typeof p.nodes[number];
    expect(check(p).ok).toBe(true);
    p.nodes[1] = { ...p.nodes[1]!, label: { en: "😀".repeat(201) } } as typeof p.nodes[number];
    expect(check(p).ok).toBe(false);
    p.nodes[1] = { ...p.nodes[1]!, label: { en: "\ud800" } } as typeof p.nodes[number];
    expect(check(p).ok).toBe(false);
  });
  it("checks every branch and exact field-to-input mapping", () => {
    const p = make();
    p.nodes[0]!.visibleWhen = { op: "any", items: [
      { op: "eq", left: { scope: "data", key: "progress" }, right: 0 },
      { op: "eq", left: { scope: "data", key: "missing" }, right: 0 },
    ] };
    expect(check(p).ok).toBe(false);
    const q = make(); q.fields.unused = q.fields.count!;
    expect(check(q).ok).toBe(false);
    const r = make(); r.fields.count!.schema = { type: "boolean", nullable: true };
    expect(check(r).ok).toBe(false);
  });
  it("rejects progress overflow atomically and does not mutate either input", () => {
    const p = make(); const data = { progress: 51 };
    expect(validateUiData(p, data).ok).toBe(false);
    expect(data).toEqual({ progress: 51 });
    expect(p.data.progress!.initial).toBe(0);
    expect(validateUiData(p, { progress: null }).ok).toBe(true);
  });
  it("uses strict scalar equality and false numerical comparisons for invalid draft", () => {
    const condition: Condition = { op: "eq", left: { scope: "form", key: "count" }, right: 0 };
    expect(evaluateCondition(condition, {}, { count: false })).toBe(false);
    expect(evaluateCondition({ ...condition, op: "lt", right: 5 }, {}, { count: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(acceptsValue({ type: "number", min: 0, max: 10, integer: true, nullable: false }, false)).toBe(false);
  });
  it("rejects fractional integer bounds, enum duplicates and unsafe integers", () => {
    for (const schema of [
      { type: "number", min: 0.1, max: 2, integer: true, nullable: true },
      { type: "enum", values: ["a", "a"], nullable: true },
      { type: "number", min: 0, max: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 1, integer: true, nullable: true },
    ]) {
      const p = make(); p.fields.count!.schema = schema as import("./ui-resource.js").ValueSpec;
      expect(check(p).ok).toBe(false);
    }
  });
});

No filesystem, process, DOM or permission calls belong here. Resource failures contain schema paths, never offending values or absolute packaged paths.

import { uiResourceV1Schema, valueSpecSchema, type PanelResourceV1, type StatusResourceV1, type Scalar,

import { UI_LIMITS_V1 as L } from "./ui-limits.js";
export type UiValidationContext = { pluginId: string; commands: readonly ContextCommandDeclaration[]; panels: readonly PanelDeclaration[] };

const own = (value: object, key: string) => Object.hasOwn(value, key);
export const uiBytes = (value: unknown): number => new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(value)).length;
export function uiFailure<T>(reason: UiDetail["reason"], fieldPath?: string,

    }
  }
  return { ok: true, value: structuredClone(data) };
}
export function validateCommandInvocation(value: unknown): Result<CommandInvocation> {
  const parsed = commandInvocationSchema.safeParse(value);
  if (!parsed.success) return uiFailure("schema", "$.invocation");
  const invocation = parsed.data; const c = invocation.context;
  if (uiBytes(invocation) > L.invokeBytes || uiBytes(invocation.arguments) > L.argumentBytes ||
    Object.keys(invocation.arguments).length > 32) return uiFailure("limit", "$.arguments");
  if (!Object.keys(invocation.arguments).every(keyValid)) return uiFailure("schema", "$.arguments");
  if (c.origin === "management" && (c.binding !== undefined || c.form !== undefined || c.motionScopeRef !== undefined ||
      c.trigger.kind !== "activate" || Object.keys(invocation.arguments).length !== 0)) return uiFailure("reference", "$.context");
  if (c.origin === "panel" && (!c.binding || !c.form)) return uiFailure("reference", "$.context");
  if (c.actionRef !== undefined && c.trigger.kind === "hold" && c.trigger.phase !== "begin") return uiFailure("reference", "$.context.actionRef");
  if (c.form && (uiBytes(c.form) > L.formBytes || Object.keys(c.form.values).length > 32 || !Object.keys(c.form.values).every(keyValid))) return uiFailure("limit", "$.context.form");
  const scalars = [...Object.values(invocation.arguments), ...Object.values(c.form?.values ?? {})];
  if (scalars.some((v) => typeof v === "string" && !validString(v, 4000))) return uiFailure("schema", "$.invocation");
  return { ok: true, value: invocation };
}
export function validateCommandValue(value: unknown, invocation: CommandInvocation): Result<CommandValue> {
  const parsed = commandValueSchema.safeParse(value);
  if (!parsed.success) return uiFailure("schema", "$.result");
  const result = parsed.data;
  if (uiBytes(result) > L.resultBytes || Object.keys(result.output).length > 32 || !Object.keys(result.output).every(keyValid)) return uiFailure("limit", "$.result");
  const fields = new Set<string>();
  for (const error of result.fieldErrors) {
    if (!invocation.context.form || !own(invocation.context.form.values, error.field) || fields.has(error.field) ||
      Object.values(error.message).some((s) => !validString(s, 4000, true, true))) return uiFailure("reference", "$.fieldErrors");
    fields.add(error.field);
  }
  if (Object.values(result.output).some((v) => typeof v === "string" && !validString(v, 4000))) return uiFailure("schema", "$.output");
  return { ok: true, value: result };
}

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import { namespacedIdSchema, pluginLocaleSchema } from "./common.js";
import { commonFailureSchemaFor } from "./business-result.js";
import { handleSchema, counterSchema } from "./device-types.js";
import { localIdSchema, uiTextSchema, uiLabelSchema, uiScalarSchema, valueSpecSchema } from "./ui-resource.js";
export const uiResourceDeclarationSchema = z.strictObject({ version: z.number().int().min(1).max(65535), path: z.string().min(1).max(600) });
export const panelDeclarationSchema = z.strictObject({ id: namespacedIdSchema, title: uiLabelSchema,
  location: z.literal("right"), resource: uiResourceDeclarationSchema });
export const statusDeclarationSchema = z.strictObject({ id: namespacedIdSchema, title: uiLabelSchema, resource: uiResourceDeclarationSchema });
export const contextCommandDeclarationSchema = z.strictObject({ id: namespacedIdSchema, title: uiLabelSchema,
  invocation: z.literal("context-v1"), arguments: z.record(localIdSchema, valueSpecSchema) });
export const uiBindingSchema = z.strictObject({ contributionId: namespacedIdSchema, panelInstance: handleSchema,
  kind: z.enum(["panel", "status"]), uiResourceGeneration: counterSchema, generation: counterSchema,
  hostEpoch: handleSchema, processEpoch: handleSchema });
const scalars = z.record(localIdSchema, uiScalarSchema);
export const uiStateSnapshotSchema = z.strictObject({ binding: uiBindingSchema, revision: counterSchema,
  data: scalars, formRevision: counterSchema, form: scalars, valid: z.boolean(), visible: z.boolean(), locale: pluginLocaleSchema });
export const uiSubscriptionSnapshotSchema = z.strictObject({ instances: z.array(uiBindingSchema).max(6),
  states: z.array(uiStateSnapshotSchema).max(1), locale: pluginLocaleSchema, theme: z.enum(["light", "dark"]) });
export const commandInvocationSchema = z.strictObject({
  version: z.literal(1), invocationId: handleSchema, command: namespacedIdSchema, arguments: scalars,
  context: z.strictObject({ contextRef: handleSchema.nullable(), origin: z.enum(["panel", "management"]), locale: pluginLocaleSchema,
    binding: uiBindingSchema.optional(), motionScopeRef: handleSchema.optional(), actionRef: handleSchema.optional(),
    form: z.strictObject({ revision: counterSchema, values: scalars }).optional(),
    trigger: z.union([z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("activate") }),
      z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("hold"), phase: z.enum(["begin", "end", "cancel"]), gestureRef: handleSchema })]),
  }),
});
export const commandValueSchema = z.strictObject({ output: scalars,
  fieldErrors: z.array(z.strictObject({ field: localIdSchema, message: uiTextSchema })).max(32) });
const detailFields = {
  kind: z.literal("ui"), contributionId: namespacedIdSchema.optional(),
  fieldPath: z.string().max(256).regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9_$.[\]-]*$/).optional(),
  limit: z.enum(Object.keys(UI_LIMITS_V1) as [keyof typeof UI_LIMITS_V1, ...(keyof typeof UI_LIMITS_V1)[]]).optional(),
  allowed: counterSchema.optional(), actual: counterSchema.optional(),
};
export const uiResourceDetailSchema = z.strictObject({ ...detailFields,
  reason: z.enum(["read", "path", "schema", "reference", "cycle", "translation", "limit", "renderer"]) });
export const uiVersionDetailSchema = z.strictObject({ ...detailFields, reason: z.enum(["version", "negotiation"]) });
export const uiFailureSchema = z.union([
  z.strictObject({ ok: z.literal(false), error: z.strictObject({ code: z.literal("PLUGIN_E_UI_RESOURCE"),
    message: z.string().max(4000), detail: uiResourceDetailSchema.optional() }) }),
  z.strictObject({ ok: z.literal(false), error: z.strictObject({ code: z.literal("PLUGIN_E_UI_VERSION"),
    message: z.string().max(4000), detail: uiVersionDetailSchema.optional() }) }),
]);
export function uiResultSchema<T>(value: z.ZodType<T>): z.ZodType<Result<T>> {
  return z.union([z.strictObject({ ok: z.literal(true), value }), commonFailureSchemaFor("1.6.0"), uiFailureSchema]);
}
export const uiRevokeReasonSchema = z.enum([
  "release", "pointer-cancel", "focus-loss", "hidden", "closed", "form-change", "action-disabled",
  "heartbeat-expired", "authority-lost", "generation-retired", "resource-replaced", "renderer-gone",
  "process-gone", "provider-gone", "safe-mode", "shutdown", "overflow",
]);
export const uiEventSchema = z.union([
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("ui.instances"), data: z.strictObject({ instances: z.array(uiBindingSchema).max(6) }) }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("ui.visibility"), data: z.strictObject({ binding: uiBindingSchema, visible: z.boolean() }) }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("ui.environment"), data: z.strictObject({ locale: pluginLocaleSchema, theme: z.enum(["light", "dark"]) }) }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("ui.form"), data: z.strictObject({ binding: uiBindingSchema, revision: counterSchema, values: scalars }) }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("ui.state"), data: z.strictObject({ binding: uiBindingSchema, revision: counterSchema }) }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("ui.revoked"), data: z.strictObject({ binding: uiBindingSchema, reason: uiRevokeReasonSchema }) }),
]);

import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { ContextCommands } from "./commands.js";
import type { CommandInvocation } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
const id = (n: number) => `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12, "0")}`;
const call = (n = 1): CommandInvocation => ({ version: 1, invocationId: id(n), command: "test.ui.run", arguments: {},
  context: { contextRef: null, origin: "management", locale: "en", trigger: { kind: "activate" }, actionRef: id(99) } });
describe("U06/U07 B1-RF3 context commands", () => {
  it("deduplicates pending and completed calls without promoting invocationId to actionRef", async () => {
    const commands = new ContextCommands("test.ui"); let release!: () => void;
    const wait = new Promise<void>((r) => { release = r; });
    const handler = vi.fn(async (ctx: import("./commands.js").ContextCommandContext) => { await wait; return { output: { action: ctx.context.actionRef ?? null }, fieldErrors: [] }; });
    commands.registerContext("test.ui.run", {}, handler);
    const signal = new AbortController().signal;
    const a = commands.invoke(call(), signal); const b = commands.invoke(call(), signal);
    release(); expect(await a).toEqual(await b);
    expect(await commands.invoke(call(), signal)).toEqual(await a);
    expect(handler).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(await a).toMatchObject({ ok: true, value: { output: { action: id(99) } } });
    expect(call().invocationId).not.toBe(id(99));
  });
  it("refuses changed payload under the same ID and never invokes a foreign namespace", async () => {
    const commands = new ContextCommands("test.ui"); const handler = vi.fn(async () => ({ output: {}, fieldErrors: [] }));
    commands.registerContext("test.ui.run", {}, handler);
    const signal = new AbortController().signal;
    await commands.invoke(call(), signal);
    await expect(commands.invoke({ ...call(), command: "other.ui.run" }, signal)).rejects.toThrow();
    expect(handler).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
  it("caches sanitized failure and cancellation; late completion cannot replay", async () => {
    const commands = new ContextCommands("test.ui"); const bad = vi.fn(async () => { throw new Error("/private/secret stack"); });
    commands.registerContext("test.ui.run", {}, bad);
    const signal = new AbortController().signal;
    const result = await commands.invoke(call(), signal);
    expect(result).toEqual({ ok: false, error: { code: "PLUGIN_E_COMMAND_FAILED", message: "Command failed." } });
    expect(await commands.invoke(call(), signal)).toEqual(result); expect(bad).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    const stop = new AbortController(); stop.abort();
    expect(await commands.invoke(call(2), stop.signal)).toMatchObject({ ok: false, error: { code: "PLUGIN_E_CANCELLED" } });
    expect(bad).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
  it("bounds pending calls and does not evict pending work", async () => {
    const commands = new ContextCommands("test.ui"); let release!: () => void;
    const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; });
    commands.registerContext("test.ui.run", {}, async () => { await gate; return { output: {}, fieldErrors: [] }; });
    const signal = new AbortController().signal;
    const pending = Array.from({ length: 16 }, (_, n) => commands.invoke(call(n + 1), signal));
    expect(await commands.invoke(call(17), signal)).toMatchObject({ ok: false, error: { code: "PLUGIN_E_RESOURCE_LIMIT" } });
    release(); await Promise.all(pending);
  });
});

import { RpcPeer, createMemoryChannelPair, type UiEventEnvelope, type ResourceOwner } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import { uiEventClientPort, bindEventChannel } from "./events.js";
it("U08 acknowledges bounded enqueue before callback and survives callback failure", async () => {
  const [hostEnd, pluginEnd] = createMemoryChannelPair();
  const host = new RpcPeer(hostEnd); const plugin = new RpcPeer(pluginEnd);
  const subscriptionId = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001";
  const owner: ResourceOwner = { sourceKey: "source", pluginId: "test.ui", generation: 1,
    hostEpoch: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002", processEpoch: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003" };
  const order: string[] = []; let release!: () => void;
  const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; });
  host.handle("ui/subscribe", async () => ({ ok: true, value: { subscriptionId, sequence: 0,
    snapshot: { instances: [], states: [], locale: "en", theme: "light" } } }));
  host.handle("events/ack", async ({ sequence }) => { order.push(`ack:${sequence}`);
    return { ok: true, value: { acknowledged: sequence } }; });
  host.handle("events/unsubscribe", async () => ({ ok: true, value: { removed: true } }));
  bindEventChannel(plugin, owner);
  const ui = new UiClient(plugin.request.bind(plugin), uiEventClientPort(plugin)); ui.markReady();
  try {
    await ui.subscribe({ topics: ["environment"] }, async (event) => {
      order.push(`callback:${event.sequence}`);
      if (event.sequence === 1) { await gate; throw new Error("Callback failure is isolated."); }
    });
    const event = (sequence: number): UiEventEnvelope => ({ version: 1, subscriptionId, owner, sequence,
      delivery: "control", kind: "ui.environment", data: { locale: "en", theme: "dark" } });
    host.notify("events/deliver", event(1));
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(order).toContain("callback:1"));
    expect(order.indexOf("ack:1")).toBeLessThan(order.indexOf("callback:1"));
    host.notify("events/deliver", event(2));
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(order).toContain("ack:2"));
    release(); await vi.waitFor(() => expect(order).toContain("callback:2"));
    expect(order.filter((value) => value === "callback:1")).toHaveLength(1);
    await ui.unsubscribe(subscriptionId);
  } finally { release(); host.close(); plugin.close(); }
});

In H-P JS `events.ts`, import `UiRequestMap`, `UiEventEnvelope`, `Handle`, `Counter`, and `Stage3EventEnvelope` type-only. Generalize the existing inbox slot envelope from `DeviceEvent` to `Stage3EventEnvelope`; validate ingress with the published `eventEnvelopeSchema` and preserve owner binding. Keep one inbox and one notification listener per peer. Add this exact projection:

```ts
export interface UiEventClientPort {
  adopt(input: {subscriptionId: Handle; sequence: Counter;
    snapshot: () => Promise<UiRequestMap["ui/snapshot"]["result"]>;
    listener: (event: UiEventEnvelope) => void | Promise<void>}): void;
  forget(subscriptionId: Handle): void;
}
const uiInboxes = new WeakMap<UiEventClientPort, () => EventInbox>();
export function beginUiSubscription(port: UiEventClientPort): () => void {
  const inbox = uiInboxes.get(port);
  if (!inbox) throw new TypeError("Unknown UI event projection");
  inbox().enable();
  return inbox().beginSubscription();
}
export function uiEventClientPort(peer: RpcPeer): UiEventClientPort {
  const port: UiEventClientPort = {
    adopt({subscriptionId, sequence, snapshot, listener}) {
      const inbox = eventInbox(peer);
      inbox.enable();
      inbox.open(subscriptionId, event => {
        if (event.kind.startsWith("ui.")) {
          const parsed = uiEventEnvelopeSchema.parse(event);
          return listener(parsed);
        }
      }, async () => {
        const result = await snapshot();
        if (!result.ok) throw new Error(result.error.message);
        inbox.reconcile(subscriptionId, result.value.sequence);
      }, sequence);
    },
    forget: subscriptionId => eventInbox(peer).close(subscriptionId),
  };
  // Lookup is deferred until subscription; legacy hosts need no event metadata.
  uiInboxes.set(port, () => eventInbox(peer));
  return port;
}
```

Keep the frozen structural `UiEventEnvelope` type and verify assignment without assertions. Import `uiEventEnvelopeSchema` as a value in JS events.ts. Do not register a second wire notification. Extend the existing inbox `open(id, listener, resync, sequence = 0)` to initialize `last` and a new `watermark` to `sequence` **before** accepting buffered events. Add this method to that same class:

```ts
reconcile(id: Handle, sequence: Counter): void {
  const slot = this.#slots.get(id);
  if (!slot || sequence < slot.watermark) return;
  slot.watermark = sequence;
  slot.last = Math.max(slot.last, sequence);
}
```

In the existing pump, retain the current queue head while awaiting resync. After resync, invoke its callback only if `event.sequence > slot.watermark`; discard each covered head exactly once and decrement its bytes/control count exactly once. Events enqueued while the snapshot is pending remain in the same queue; only those above the returned watermark can invoke callbacks. A callback already running when the snapshot starts finishes once. `close` prevents any subsequent callback and releases all bytes, including early events for that ID. The pump must test slot membership again after every await. ACK is issued only after validation and bounded enqueue and before invoking user code; a throwing or slow callback cannot delay ACK admission. Numeric future ACK rejection remains on the host common ledger.

In JS `ui.ts`, import `beginUiSubscription` from `events.ts`. Use the complete `subscribe` implementation below: acquire `finish` with `beginUiSubscription(this.events)`, then request and adopt inside try, with `finish()` in finally. Preserve the existing return value and early failures. The try body is the existing request, successful `adopt`, and result return, in that order. Do not finish the early-event buffer before adoption.

In Python `_events.py`, keep `_BOUND` and the same inbox instance. Extend `open(id, listener, resync, sequence=0)` with initial last/watermark and implement `reconcile(id, sequence)` and the pump watermark/membership checks with the identical rules. Add:

```python
class _UiEventClientPort:
    def __init__(self, peer):
        self.peer = peer

    def begin(self):
        _BOUND[self.peer].enable()
        return _BOUND[self.peer].begin_subscription()

    def adopt(self, subscription_id, sequence, snapshot, listener):
        inbox = _BOUND[self.peer]
        inbox.enable()
        async def resync():
            result = await snapshot()
            if not result["ok"]:
                raise ValueError(result["error"]["message"])
            inbox.reconcile(subscription_id, result["value"]["sequence"])
        def receive(event):
            if event["kind"].startswith("ui."):
                return listener(event)
        inbox.open(subscription_id, receive, resync, sequence)

    def forget(self, subscription_id):
        _BOUND[self.peer].close(subscription_id)

def ui_event_client_port(peer):
    return _UiEventClientPort(peer)
```

In `_ui.py`, wrap request/adopt/return in `finish = self._events.begin()` with `try/finally: finish()`. The projection's public adopt/forget signature is unchanged; begin is internal early-buffer plumbing. Local facade mocks must provide begin/finish and remain unit tests only.

it.each(["ack", "unsubscribe", "timeout"] as const)("retains terminal control until %s", mode => {
  let now = 0; const delivered: Stage3EventEnvelope[] = [];
  const ledger = new EventLedger(() => now, event => delivered.push(event), () => {});
  const removed: string[] = []; ledger.onRemoved(id => removed.push(id));
  const admitted = ledger.create(owner); if (!admitted.ok) throw new Error("admission failed");
  const id = admitted.value.subscriptionId;
  ledger.publish(owner, id, {kind:"ui.environment",data:{locale:"en",theme:"dark"}}, "control");
  expect(delivered).toEqual([]);
  expect(() => ledger.ack(owner, id, 1)).toThrow();
  ledger.activate(owner, id);
  expect(() => ledger.ack(owner, id, 2)).toThrow();
  ledger.closeAfterControl(owner, id);
  expect(ledger.diagnostics().subscriptions).toBe(1);
  expect(ledger.diagnostics().queuedBytes).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  now = 9999; ledger.sweep(); expect(removed).toEqual([]);
  if (mode === "ack") ledger.ack(owner, id, 1);
  if (mode === "unsubscribe") ledger.unsubscribe(owner, id);
  if (mode === "timeout") { now = 10000; ledger.sweep(); }
  expect(removed).toEqual([id]);
  expect(ledger.diagnostics()).toEqual({subscriptions:0,queuedEvents:0,queuedBytes:0});
  ledger.unsubscribe(owner, id); expect(removed).toEqual([id]);
});

```ts
import { RpcError, RPC_ERRORS, acceptsValue, validValueSpec, validateCommandInvocation, validateCommandValue,
  type CommandInvocation, type CommandValue, type Result, type UiScalar, type ValueSpec } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
export type ContextCommandContext = Readonly<CommandInvocation> & { readonly signal: AbortSignal };
export type ContextCommandHandler = (context: ContextCommandContext) => CommandValue | Promise<CommandValue>;
function freeze<T>(value: T): T {
  if (value && typeof value === "object") { Object.values(value).forEach(freeze); Object.freeze(value); }
  return value;
}
function canonical(value: unknown): string {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.map(canonical).join(",")}]`;
  if (value !== null && typeof value === "object") return `{${Object.entries(value).sort(([a], [b]) => a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0)
    .map(([key, item]) => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${canonical(item)}`).join(",")}}`;
  return JSON.stringify(value);
}
function failure(code: "PLUGIN_E_CANCELLED" | "PLUGIN_E_TIMEOUT" | "PLUGIN_E_COMMAND_FAILED"): Result<CommandValue> {
  return { ok: false, error: { code, message: code === "PLUGIN_E_COMMAND_FAILED" ? "Command failed." : "Command did not complete." } };
}
export class ContextCommands {
  readonly #handlers = new Map<string, { arguments: Record<string, ValueSpec>; handler: ContextCommandHandler }>();
  readonly #pending = new Map<string, { key: string; promise: Promise<Result<CommandValue>> }>();
  readonly #completed = new Map<string, { key: string; value: Result<CommandValue>; at: number }>();
  constructor(readonly pluginId: string, private readonly now: () => number = () => performance.now()) {}
  registerContext(id: string, argumentsSchema: Record<string, ValueSpec>, handler: ContextCommandHandler): void {
    if (!id.startsWith(`${this.pluginId}.`) || this.#handlers.has(id) || Object.keys(argumentsSchema).length > 32 ||
      Object.entries(argumentsSchema).some(([key, value]) => !/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$/.test(key) ||
        ["constructor", "prototype", "__proto__"].includes(key) || !validValueSpec(value))) throw new TypeError("Invalid context command registration.");
    this.#handlers.set(id, { arguments: freeze(structuredClone(argumentsSchema)), handler });
  }
  async invoke(input: CommandInvocation, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<Result<CommandValue>> {
    const checked = validateCommandInvocation(input);
    if (!checked.ok) throw new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.invalidParams, "Invalid command invocation.");
    const invocation = freeze(structuredClone(checked.value));
    const record = this.#handlers.get(invocation.command);
    if (!record || !invocation.command.startsWith(`${this.pluginId}.`)) throw new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.invalidParams, "Unknown context command.");
    if (Object.keys(record.arguments).length !== Object.keys(invocation.arguments).length ||
      Object.keys(record.arguments).some((key) => !Object.hasOwn(invocation.arguments, key) || !acceptsValue(record.arguments[key]!, invocation.arguments[key] as UiScalar)))
      throw new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.invalidParams, "Invalid command arguments.");
    if (invocation.context.binding && !invocation.context.binding.contributionId.startsWith(`${this.pluginId}.`))
      throw new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.invalidParams, "Foreign UI binding.");
    const key = canonical(invocation);
    for (const [id, done] of this.#completed) if (this.now() - done.at >= 30000) this.#completed.delete(id);
    const pending = this.#pending.get(invocation.invocationId); const done = this.#completed.get(invocation.invocationId);
    if (pending || done) {
      if ((pending?.key ?? done!.key) !== key) throw new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.invalidParams, "Invocation ID was reused.");
      return pending ? pending.promise : structuredClone(done!.value);
    }
    if (this.#pending.size >= 16) return { ok: false, error: { code: "PLUGIN_E_RESOURCE_LIMIT", message: "Command queue is full.",
      detail: { kind: "resource", reason: "queue", resource: "rpc", limit: 16 } } };
    let resolve!: (value: Result<CommandValue>) => void;
    const promise = new Promise<Result<CommandValue>>((r) => { resolve = r; });
    this.#pending.set(invocation.invocationId, { key, promise });
    const local = new AbortController(); let finished = false;
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
    const finish = (value: Result<CommandValue>) => {
      if (finished) return; finished = true;
      clearTimeout(timer); signal.removeEventListener("abort", cancel);
      this.#pending.delete(invocation.invocationId);
      this.#completed.set(invocation.invocationId, { key, value: structuredClone(value), at: this.now() });
      while (this.#completed.size > 64) this.#completed.delete(this.#completed.keys().next().value!);
      resolve(value);
    };
    const cancel = () => { local.abort(); finish(failure("PLUGIN_E_CANCELLED")); };
    signal.addEventListener("abort", cancel, { once: true });
    if (signal.aborted) cancel();
    else {
      timer = setTimeout(() => { local.abort(); finish(failure("PLUGIN_E_TIMEOUT")); }, 30000);
      Promise.resolve().then(() => {
        if (local.signal.aborted) return undefined;
        return record.handler({ ...invocation, signal: local.signal });
      }).then((value) => {
        if (finished) return;
        const valid = validateCommandValue(value, invocation);
        finish(valid.ok ? valid : failure("PLUGIN_E_COMMAND_FAILED"));
      }, () => finish(failure("PLUGIN_E_COMMAND_FAILED")));
    }
    return promise;
  }
}
```

Create `packages/plugin-sdk-js/src/ui.ts`. Its event port is a projection of the **one** P150 event client: `adopt` installs only the callback/snapshot provider for a previously issued subscription; sequence validation, bounded enqueue, acknowledge, gaps, callback isolation and tombstones stay with that client. Do not instantiate a second queue/owner registry here. AM-16 defines the interface in JS events.ts; import it here. H-P implements the adapter on the existing per-peer inbox.

```ts
import { type UiRequestMap, type UiEventEnvelope, type Handle, type UiBinding, type UiScalar,
  type Result, type Severity } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
type Query = "ui/instances" | "ui/state" | "ui/patch" | "ui/subscribe" | "ui/snapshot";
import { beginUiSubscription, type UiEventClientPort } from "./events.js";
export interface UiRequestPort {
  <M extends Query>(method: M, params: UiRequestMap[M]["params"], options: { timeoutMs: number; signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<UiRequestMap[M]["result"]>;
  (method: "events/unsubscribe", params: { subscriptionId: Handle }, options: { timeoutMs: number; signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<Result<{ removed: boolean }>>;
  (method: "ui/showMessage", params: { message: string; severity: Severity }, options: { timeoutMs: number }): Promise<null>;
}
export class UiClient {
  #ready = false;
  constructor(private readonly request: UiRequestPort, private readonly events: UiEventClientPort) {}
  markReady(): void { this.#ready = true; }
  retire(): void { this.#ready = false; }
  private check(): void { if (!this.#ready) throw new Error("UI is not ready."); }
  async showMessage(message: string, severity: Severity = "info"): Promise<void> {
    await this.request("ui/showMessage", { message, severity }, { timeoutMs: 10000 });
  }
  async instances(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<UiRequestMap["ui/instances"]["result"]> {
    this.check(); return this.request("ui/instances", {}, { timeoutMs: 5000, ...(signal ? { signal } : {}) });
  }
  async state(binding: UiBinding, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<UiRequestMap["ui/state"]["result"]> {
    this.check(); return this.request("ui/state", { binding }, { timeoutMs: 5000, ...(signal ? { signal } : {}) });
  }
  async patch(binding: UiBinding, baseRevision: number, set: Record<string, UiScalar>, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<UiRequestMap["ui/patch"]["result"]> {
    this.check(); return this.request("ui/patch", { binding, baseRevision, set }, { timeoutMs: 5000, ...(signal ? { signal } : {}) });
  }
  async subscribe(params: UiRequestMap["ui/subscribe"]["params"], listener: (event: UiEventEnvelope) => void | Promise<void>, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<UiRequestMap["ui/subscribe"]["result"]> {
    this.check();
    if (new Set(params.topics).size !== params.topics.length || !params.binding && params.topics.some((t) => t !== "instances" && t !== "environment"))
      throw new TypeError("Invalid UI subscription topics.");
    const finish = beginUiSubscription(this.events);
    try {
      const result = await this.request("ui/subscribe", params, { timeoutMs: 5000, ...(signal ? { signal } : {}) });
      if (result.ok) this.events.adopt({ subscriptionId: result.value.subscriptionId, sequence: result.value.sequence, listener,
        snapshot: () => this.snapshot(result.value.subscriptionId) });
      return result;
    } finally { finish(); }
  }
  async snapshot(subscriptionId: Handle): Promise<UiRequestMap["ui/snapshot"]["result"]> {
    this.check(); return this.request("ui/snapshot", { subscriptionId }, { timeoutMs: 5000 });
  }
  async unsubscribe(subscriptionId: Handle): Promise<Result<{ removed: boolean }>> {
    const result = await this.request("events/unsubscribe", { subscriptionId }, { timeoutMs: 5000 });
    if (result.ok) this.events.forget(subscriptionId);
    return result;
  }
}
```

                "actionRef": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000099",
                "trigger": {"kind": "activate"}}}

class ContextCommandsTests(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_pending_and_completed_dedupe_and_readonly_context(self):
        registry = ContextCommands(lambda: "acme.ui")
        gate = asyncio.Event()
        calls = []
        async def handler(ctx):
            calls.append(ctx.context["actionRef"])
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                ctx.context["actionRef"] = ctx.invocation_id
            await gate.wait()
            return {"output": {}, "fieldErrors": []}
        registry.register("acme.ui.run", {}, handler)
        first = asyncio.create_task(registry.invoke(invocation()))
        second = asyncio.create_task(registry.invoke(invocation()))
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        gate.set()
        self.assertEqual(await first, await second)
        self.assertEqual(await registry.invoke(invocation()), await first)
        self.assertEqual(calls, ["00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000099"])

    async def test_changed_payload_foreign_command_and_sanitized_failure(self):
        registry = ContextCommands(lambda: "acme.ui")
        calls = []
        async def handler(ctx):
            calls.append(ctx)
            raise RuntimeError("/private/path stack")
        registry.register("acme.ui.run", {}, handler)
        result = await registry.invoke(invocation())
        self.assertEqual(result, {"ok": False, "error": {
            "code": "PLUGIN_E_COMMAND_FAILED", "message": "Command failed."}})
        self.assertEqual(await registry.invoke(invocation()), result)
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)
        changed = copy.deepcopy(invocation())
        changed["context"]["locale"] = "zh-TW"
        with self.assertRaises(SchemaError):
            await registry.invoke(changed)
        changed["command"] = "foreign.ui.run"
        with self.assertRaises(SchemaError):
            await registry.invoke(changed)

    async def test_cancel_caches_failure_without_restarting(self):
        registry = ContextCommands(lambda: "acme.ui")
        entered = asyncio.Event()
        calls = []
        async def handler(ctx):
            calls.append(ctx)
            entered.set()
            await asyncio.Event().wait()
        registry.register("acme.ui.run", {}, handler)
        task = asyncio.create_task(registry.invoke(invocation()))
        await entered.wait()
        task.cancel()
        with self.assertRaises(asyncio.CancelledError):
            await task
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        result = await registry.invoke(invocation())
        self.assertEqual(result["error"]["code"], "PLUGIN_E_CANCELLED")
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)
