```python
"""UI v1 semantic validation and a facade over the shared event client."""
import json
import math
import re
from ._schema import Validator, SchemaError


def size(value):
    return len(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8"))


def require(condition):
    if not condition:
        raise SchemaError("Invalid UI value.")


def key_valid(value):
    return bool(re.fullmatch(r"[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}", value)) and value not in {"__proto__", "prototype", "constructor"}


def text_valid(value, maximum=4000, multiline=True, nonempty=False):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) > maximum or (nonempty and not value.strip()):
        return False
    return all(not (0xD800 <= ord(c) <= 0xDFFF or ord(c) == 127 or
                   ord(c) < 32 and not (multiline and c in "\t\n")) for c in value)


def number(value):
    return isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool) and math.isfinite(value)


def safe_integer(value):
    return number(value) and int(value) == value and abs(value) <= 9007199254740991


def valid_spec(spec):
    if spec["type"] == "number":
        return spec["min"] <= spec["max"] and (not spec["integer"] or
            safe_integer(spec["min"]) and safe_integer(spec["max"]))
    if spec["type"] == "enum":
        return len(set(spec["values"])) == len(spec["values"]) and all(text_valid(v, 128, False, True) for v in spec["values"])
    return True


def accepts(spec, value):
    if value is None:
        return spec["nullable"]
    kind = spec["type"]
    if kind == "string":
        return text_valid(value, spec["maxLength"])
    if kind == "boolean":
        return isinstance(value, bool)
    if kind == "enum":
        return isinstance(value, str) and value in spec["values"]
    return number(value) and spec["min"] <= value <= spec["max"] and (not spec["integer"] or safe_integer(value))


def compatible(source, target):
    if source["nullable"] and not target["nullable"]:
        return False
    if source["type"] == "enum" and target["type"] == "string":
        return all(len(value) <= target["maxLength"] for value in source["values"])
    if source["type"] != target["type"]:
        return False
    if source["type"] == "string":
        return source["maxLength"] <= target["maxLength"]
    if source["type"] == "number":
        return source["min"] >= target["min"] and source["max"] <= target["max"] and (not target["integer"] or source["integer"])
    if source["type"] == "enum":
        return set(source["values"]).issubset(target["values"])
    return True


def validate_resource(value, context, raw_bytes, version=1):
    require(version == 1 and safe_integer(raw_bytes) and 0 <= raw_bytes <= 262144)
    Validator.bundled().validate("ui-resource-v1", value)
    data = value["data"]
    fields = value.get("fields", {})
    require(len(data) <= 64 and len(fields) <= 32)
    for record in (data, fields):
        for key, slot in record.items():
            require(key_valid(key) and valid_spec(slot["schema"]) and accepts(slot["schema"], slot["initial"]))

    def text(item, label=False):
        require(all(text_valid(s, 200 if label else 4000, not label, True) for s in item.values()))

    def ref(item):
        record = data if item["scope"] == "data" else fields
        require(item["key"] in record)
        return record[item["key"]]["schema"]

    total = 0
    def condition(item):
        count = 0
        def walk(current, depth):
            nonlocal count, total
            count += 1
            total += 1
            require(depth <= 4 and count <= 32 and total <= 256)
            op = current["op"]
            if op == "not":
                walk(current["item"], depth + 1)
            elif op in ("all", "any"):
                for child in current["items"]:
                    walk(child, depth + 1)
            elif op in ("eq", "ne"):
                spec, right = ref(current["left"]), current["right"]
                expected = "string" if spec["type"] == "enum" else spec["type"]
                require(spec["nullable"] if right is None else
                        text_valid(right) if expected == "string" else
                        number(right) if expected == "number" else isinstance(right, bool))
            else:
                require(ref(current["left"])["type"] == "number")
        walk(item, 1)

    def display(item):
        if "ref" in item:
            ref(item["ref"])

    def display_text(item):
        if "text" in item:
            text(item["text"])
        else:
            require(ref(item["ref"])["type"] == "string")

    def command(command_id, arguments):
        target = next((c for c in context["commands"] if c["id"] == command_id), None)
        require(command_id.startswith(context["pluginId"] + ".") and target is not None)
        require(set(arguments) == set(target["arguments"]) and len(arguments) <= 32 and size(arguments) <= 16384)
        for key, item in arguments.items():
            require(key_valid(key))
            require(accepts(target["arguments"][key], item["literal"]) if "literal" in item else
                    compatible(ref(item["ref"]), target["arguments"][key]))

    if value["kind"] == "status":
        display_text(value["text"])
        if "visibleWhen" in value:
            condition(value["visibleWhen"])
    else:
        nodes = {n["id"]: n for n in value["nodes"]}
        require(len(nodes) == len(value["nodes"]) and nodes.get(value["root"], {}).get("type") == "group")
        visited = set()
        def tree(node_id, depth):
            require(depth <= 8 and node_id in nodes and node_id not in visited)
            visited.add(node_id)
            for child in nodes[node_id].get("children", []):
                tree(child, depth + 1)
        tree(value["root"], 1)
        require(len(visited) == len(nodes))
        used = set()
        for node in nodes.values():
            require(key_valid(node["id"]))
            for key in ("visibleWhen", "enabledWhen"):
                if key in node:
                    condition(node[key])
            for key in ("label", "help", "unit", "placeholder"):
                if key in node:
                    text(node[key], key != "help")
            kind = node["type"]
            if "field" in node:
                key = node["field"]
                require(key in fields and key not in used)
                used.add(key)
                field = fields[key]
                spec = field["schema"]
                expected = {"textInput": "string", "number": "number", "range": "number", "choice": "enum", "boolean": "boolean"}[kind]
                require(spec["type"] == expected)
                if kind == "textInput" and field["initial"] is not None:
                    require(text_valid(field["initial"], 4000, False))
                if kind in ("number", "range"):
                    require(not spec["integer"] or safe_integer(node["step"]))
                    if kind == "range" and field["initial"] is not None:
                        q = (field["initial"] - spec["min"]) / node["step"]
                        require(abs(q - round(q)) <= 1e-9 * max(1, abs(q)))
                if kind == "choice":
                    options = [o["value"] for o in node["options"]]
                    require(len(set(options)) == len(options) and set(options) == set(spec["values"]))
                    require(node["presentation"] != "segmented" or len(options) <= 8)
                    for option in node["options"]:
                        text(option["label"], True)
            if kind in ("text", "help"):
                display_text(node["value"])
            if kind in ("status", "alert"):
                display_text(node["text"])
            if kind == "progress":
                item = node["value"]
                display(item)
                if "ref" in item:
                    require(ref(item["ref"])["type"] == "number")
                    slots = data if item["ref"]["scope"] == "data" else fields
                    initial = slots[item["ref"]["key"]]["initial"]
                    require(initial is None or number(initial) and 0 <= initial <= node["max"])
                else:
                    require(item["literal"] is None or number(item["literal"]) and 0 <= item["literal"] <= node["max"])
            if kind == "keyValue":
                require(len({r["id"] for r in node["rows"]}) == len(node["rows"]))
                for row in node["rows"]:
                    require(key_valid(row["id"]))
                    text(row["label"], True)
                    if "unit" in row:
                        text(row["unit"], True)
                    display(row["value"])
            if kind == "holdAction":
                command(node["command"], node["arguments"])
            if kind == "action":
                action = node["action"]
                if action["kind"] == "command":
                    command(action["command"], action["arguments"])
                elif action["action"] == "openPanel":
                    require(action["panelId"].startswith(context["pluginId"] + ".") and
                            any(p["id"] == action["panelId"] for p in context["panels"]))
                elif action["action"] in ("stop", "disconnect"):
                    spec = ref(action["operation"] if action["action"] == "stop" else action["session"])
                    require(spec["type"] == "string" and spec["nullable"])
        require(used == set(fields))
        for field in fields.values():
            if "requiredWhen" in field:
                condition(field["requiredWhen"])
        require(size({k: f["initial"] for k, f in fields.items()}) <= 16384)
    validate_data(value, {key: slot["initial"] for key, slot in data.items()})
    return value


def validate_data(resource, data):
    require(set(data) == set(resource["data"]))
    require(all(accepts(resource["data"][key]["schema"], value) for key, value in data.items()))
    require(size(data) <= (16384 if resource["kind"] == "status" else 65536))
    for node in resource.get("nodes", []):
        if node["type"] == "progress" and "ref" in node["value"] and node["value"]["ref"]["scope"] == "data":
            value = data[node["value"]["ref"]["key"]]
            require(value is None or number(value) and 0 <= value <= node["max"])
    return data


def validate_invocation(value):
    Validator.bundled().validate("command/invoke.params", value)
    require(size(value) <= 65536 and size(value["arguments"]) <= 16384 and len(value["arguments"]) <= 32)
    require(all(key_valid(key) for key in value["arguments"]))
    context = value["context"]
    if context["origin"] == "management":
        require(not any(key in context for key in ("binding", "form", "motionScopeRef")))
        require(context["trigger"]["kind"] == "activate" and value["arguments"] == {})
    else:
        require("binding" in context and "form" in context)
    if "actionRef" in context and context["trigger"]["kind"] == "hold":
        require(context["trigger"]["phase"] == "begin")
    form = context.get("form", {"values": {}})
    require(len(form["values"]) <= 32 and size(form) <= 16384 and all(key_valid(k) for k in form["values"]))
    require(all(not isinstance(v, str) or text_valid(v) for v in
                list(value["arguments"].values()) + list(form["values"].values())))
    return value


def validate_result(value, invocation):
    Validator.bundled().validate("command/invoke.result", {"ok": True, "value": value})
    require(size(value) <= 16384 and len(value["output"]) <= 32 and all(key_valid(k) for k in value["output"]))
    require(all(not isinstance(v, str) or text_valid(v) for v in value["output"].values()))
    fields = invocation["context"].get("form", {}).get("values", {})
    errors = value["fieldErrors"]
    require(len({e["field"] for e in errors}) == len(errors))
    for error in errors:
        require(error["field"] in fields and all(text_valid(s, nonempty=True) for s in error["message"].values()))
    return value


class Ui:
    def __init__(self, request, events):
        self._request, self._events = request, events
        self._ready = False

    def mark_ready(self):
        self._ready = True

    def retire(self):
        self._ready = False

    def _check(self):
        if not self._ready:
            raise RuntimeError("UI is not ready.")

    async def show_message(self, message, severity="info"):
        await self._request("ui/showMessage", {"message": message, "severity": severity})

    async def instances(self):
        self._check()
        return await self._request("ui/instances", {})

    async def state(self, binding):
        self._check()
        return await self._request("ui/state", {"binding": binding})

    async def patch(self, binding, base_revision, values):
        self._check()
        return await self._request("ui/patch", {"binding": binding, "baseRevision": base_revision, "set": values})

    async def subscribe(self, topics, callback, binding=None):
        self._check()
        require(len(set(topics)) == len(topics) and 1 <= len(topics) <= 5)
        require(binding is not None or set(topics).issubset({"instances", "environment"}))
        params = {"topics": topics}
        if binding is not None:
            params["binding"] = binding
        finish = self._events.begin()
        try:
            result = await self._request("ui/subscribe", params)
            if result["ok"]:
                value = result["value"]
                async def snapshot():
                    return await self.snapshot(value["subscriptionId"])
                self._events.adopt(subscription_id=value["subscriptionId"], sequence=value["sequence"],
                                   snapshot=snapshot, listener=callback)
            return result
        finally:
            finish()

    async def snapshot(self, subscription_id):
        self._check()
        return await self._request("ui/snapshot", {"subscriptionId": subscription_id})

    async def unsubscribe(self, subscription_id):
        result = await self._request("events/unsubscribe", {"subscriptionId": subscription_id})
        if result["ok"]:
            self._events.forget(subscription_id)
        return result
```

Create `sdks/python/kobrixa/_commands.py`:

```python
"""Context commands are immutable per invocation; no global last-context state."""
import asyncio
import copy
import inspect
import json
import time
from collections import OrderedDict
from dataclasses import dataclass
from types import MappingProxyType
from ._schema import SchemaError
from ._ui import accepts, key_valid, valid_spec, validate_invocation, validate_result, require


def freeze(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return MappingProxyType({key: freeze(item) for key, item in value.items()})
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return tuple(freeze(item) for item in value)
    return value


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ContextCommandContext:
    version: int
    invocation_id: str
    command: str
    arguments: object
    context: object


def failure(code):
    return {"ok": False, "error": {"code": code, "message":
            "Command failed." if code == "PLUGIN_E_COMMAND_FAILED" else "Command did not complete."}}


class ContextCommands:
    def __init__(self, plugin_id, clock=time.monotonic):
        self._plugin_id, self._clock = plugin_id, clock
        self._handlers = {}
        self._pending = {}
        self._completed = OrderedDict()

    def register(self, command_id, arguments, handler):
        require(command_id not in self._handlers and len(arguments) <= 32)
        require(all(key_valid(k) and valid_spec(v) for k, v in arguments.items()))
        if not inspect.iscoroutinefunction(handler):
            raise TypeError("Context command handlers must be async functions.")
        self._handlers[command_id] = (copy.deepcopy(arguments), handler)

    async def invoke(self, value):
        value = copy.deepcopy(validate_invocation(value))
        require(value["command"].startswith(self._plugin_id() + ".") and value["command"] in self._handlers)
        binding = value["context"].get("binding")
        require(binding is None or binding["contributionId"].startswith(self._plugin_id() + "."))
        arguments, handler = self._handlers[value["command"]]
        require(set(arguments) == set(value["arguments"]) and
                all(accepts(spec, value["arguments"][key]) for key, spec in arguments.items()))
        key = json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
        invocation_id = value["invocationId"]
        for done_id, done in list(self._completed.items()):
            if self._clock() - done[2] >= 30:
                del self._completed[done_id]
        if invocation_id in self._completed:
            previous_key, result, _ = self._completed[invocation_id]
            require(previous_key == key)
            return copy.deepcopy(result)
        if invocation_id in self._pending:
            previous_key, task = self._pending[invocation_id]
            require(previous_key == key)
            return copy.deepcopy(await asyncio.shield(task))
        if len(self._pending) >= 16:
            return {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "PLUGIN_E_RESOURCE_LIMIT", "message": "Command queue is full.",
                    "detail": {"kind": "resource", "reason": "queue", "resource": "rpc", "limit": 16}}}
        async def execute():
            context = ContextCommandContext(value["version"], invocation_id, value["command"],
                                            freeze(value["arguments"]), freeze(value["context"]))
            child = asyncio.create_task(handler(context))
            def consume(done):
                if not done.cancelled():
                    done.exception()
            child.add_done_callback(consume)
            try:
                done, _ = await asyncio.wait({child}, timeout=30)
                if not done:
                    child.cancel()
                    result = failure("PLUGIN_E_TIMEOUT")
                else:
                    result = {"ok": True, "value": validate_result(child.result(), value)}
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                child.cancel()
                result = failure("PLUGIN_E_CANCELLED")
            except Exception:
                result = failure("PLUGIN_E_COMMAND_FAILED")
            self._completed[invocation_id] = (key, copy.deepcopy(result), self._clock())
            while len(self._completed) > 64:
                self._completed.popitem(last=False)
            self._pending.pop(invocation_id, None)
            return result
        task = asyncio.create_task(execute())
        self._pending[invocation_id] = (key, task)
        try:
            return copy.deepcopy(await asyncio.shield(task))
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(task, return_exceptions=True)
            if invocation_id not in self._completed:
                self._completed[invocation_id] = (key, failure("PLUGIN_E_CANCELLED"), self._clock())
                self._pending.pop(invocation_id, None)
            raise
```

- [ ] **Step 10: Enforce semantic wire limits before dispatch and after response validation.**

Append this complete guard to `ui-validation.ts`. Structural schemas run first; this guard covers facts JSON Schema cannot express. Its result branch receives the original invocation for field-error membership checks.

```ts
export function validUiWire(method: string, phase: "params" | "result", value: unknown, params?: unknown): boolean {
  const methods = new Set(["ui/negotiate", "ui/ready", "ui/instances", "ui/state", "ui/patch", "ui/subscribe", "ui/snapshot", "command/invoke"]);
  if (!methods.has(method)) return true;
  try {
    const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (phase === "params") {
      if (method === "command/invoke") return validateCommandInvocation(value).ok;
      if (method === "ui/patch") {
        const set = item.set as Record<string, Scalar>;
        return uiBytes(item) <= L.patchBytes && Object.keys(set).length >= 1 && Object.keys(set).length <= 64 &&
          Object.keys(set).every(keyValid) && Object.values(set).every((v) => typeof v !== "string" || validString(v, 4000));
      }
      if (method === "ui/subscribe") {
        const topics = item.topics as string[];
        return new Set(topics).size === topics.length && (item.binding !== undefined || topics.every((t) => t === "instances" || t === "environment"));
      }
      return true;
    }
    if (item.ok === false) {
      const error = item.error as { message: string; detail?: unknown };
      return validString(error.message, 2000) && (error.detail === undefined || uiBytes(error.detail) <= L.detailBytes);
    }
    if (method === "command/invoke") {
      const invocation = validateCommandInvocation(params);
      return invocation.ok && validateCommandValue(item.value, invocation.value).ok;
    }
    const result = item.value as Record<string, unknown>;
    const snapshot = method === "ui/state" ? result :
      method === "ui/subscribe" || method === "ui/snapshot" ? result.snapshot as Record<string, unknown> : undefined;
    const stateValid = (state: Record<string, unknown>) => {
      const binding = state.binding as { kind: "panel" | "status" };
      const data = state.data as Record<string, Scalar>; const form = state.form as Record<string, Scalar>;
      return Object.keys(data).length <= 64 && Object.keys(form).length <= 32 &&
        uiBytes(data) <= (binding.kind === "status" ? L.statusDataBytes : L.dataBytes) && uiBytes(form) <= L.formBytes &&
        [...Object.keys(data), ...Object.keys(form)].every(keyValid) &&
        [...Object.values(data), ...Object.values(form)].every((v) => typeof v !== "string" || validString(v, 4000));
    };
    if (snapshot && method === "ui/state") return stateValid(snapshot);
    if (snapshot) return (snapshot.states as Record<string, unknown>[]).every(stateValid);
    return true;
  } catch { return false; }
}
```

```python
def valid_wire(method, phase, value, params=None):
    methods = {"ui/negotiate", "ui/ready", "ui/instances", "ui/state", "ui/patch", "ui/subscribe", "ui/snapshot", "command/invoke"}
    if method not in methods:
        return True
    try:
        if phase == "params":
            if method == "command/invoke":
                validate_invocation(value)
            elif method == "ui/patch":
                require(size(value) <= 65536 and 1 <= len(value["set"]) <= 64)
                require(all(key_valid(k) for k in value["set"]))
                require(all(not isinstance(v, str) or text_valid(v) for v in value["set"].values()))
            elif method == "ui/subscribe":
                topics = value["topics"]
                require(len(set(topics)) == len(topics))
                require("binding" in value or set(topics).issubset({"instances", "environment"}))
            return True
        if not value["ok"]:
            error = value["error"]
            return text_valid(error["message"], 2000) and ("detail" not in error or size(error["detail"]) <= 4096)
        if method == "command/invoke":
            validate_result(value["value"], validate_invocation(params))
            return True
        states = [value["value"]] if method == "ui/state" else value["value"]["snapshot"]["states"] if method in {"ui/subscribe", "ui/snapshot"} else []
        for state in states:
            data, form = state["data"], state["form"]
            require(len(data) <= 64 and len(form) <= 32 and size(form) <= 16384)
            require(size(data) <= (16384 if state["binding"]["kind"] == "status" else 65536))
            require(all(key_valid(k) for k in list(data) + list(form)))
            require(all(not isinstance(v, str) or text_valid(v) for v in list(data.values()) + list(form.values())))
        return True
    except (SchemaError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, UnicodeError):
        return False
```

Append this complete cross-field check to `manifest.ts`; T3 calls it beside the existing declaration-problem functions before admitting a source:

```ts
export function uiDeclarationProblems(manifest: PluginManifest): string[] {
  const problems: string[] = [];
  const contributes = manifest.contributes;
  const panels = contributes?.panels ?? [];
  const status = contributes?.status ?? [];
  const commands = contributes?.commands ?? [];
  const ids = new Set<string>();
  for (const entry of [...panels, ...status, ...commands]) {
    if (!entry.id.startsWith(`${manifest.id}.`) || ids.has(entry.id)) problems.push("Invalid or duplicate UI contribution identity.");
    ids.add(entry.id);
  }
  if (panels.length && !manifest.permissions?.includes("ui.panels")) problems.push("Panels require ui.panels.");
  if (status.length && !manifest.permissions?.includes("ui.status")) problems.push("Status requires ui.status.");
  for (const event of manifest.activationEvents ?? []) {
    if (event.startsWith("onPanel:") && !panels.some((panel) => panel.id === event.slice(8))) problems.push("Panel activation must name a local panel.");
    if (event.startsWith("onCommand:") && !commands.some((command) => command.id === event.slice(10))) problems.push("Command activation must name a local command.");
  }
  for (const entry of [...panels, ...status])
    if (Object.values(entry.title).some((text) => !validString(text, 200, false, true))) problems.push("Invalid UI title.");
  for (const command of commands) if (command.invocation === "context-v1") {
    const checked = contextCommandDeclarationSchema.safeParse(command);
    if (!checked.success) { problems.push("Invalid context command."); continue; }
    if (Object.keys(checked.data.arguments).length > 32 || Object.entries(checked.data.arguments).some(([key, spec]) =>
      ["constructor", "prototype", "__proto__"].includes(key) || !validValueSpec(spec))) problems.push("Invalid context command arguments.");
    if (Object.values(checked.data.title).some((text) => !validString(text, 200, false, true))) problems.push("Invalid command title.");
  }
  return problems;
}
```

```ts
const ui = new UiClient(peer.request.bind(peer), uiEventClientPort(peer));

let pluginContext: PluginContext | undefined;
let negotiated = false;
let readyResult: Promise<import("@kobrixa/plugin-protocol").Result<Record<string, never>>> | undefined;

  negotiated = params.commandEnvelopeVersions.includes(1);

    uiResourceVersions: params.uiResourceVersions.includes(1) ? [1] : [] } };

peer.handle("ui/ready", async () => {

  if (!readyResult) {
    ui.markReady();
    const context = pluginContext;
    readyResult = Promise.resolve().then(() => definition.ready?.(context)).then(
      () => ({ ok: true as const, value: {} }),
      () => { ui.retire(); return uiFailure<Record<string, never>>("negotiation"); },

peer.handle("command/invoke", async (invocation, { signal }) => {
```

```python
def context_command(self, command_id, arguments=None):
    schema = {} if arguments is None else arguments
    def register(handler):
        if command_id in self._commands:
            raise ValueError("Command already registered.")
        self._context_commands.register(command_id, schema, handler)
        return handler
    return register

def ready(self, handler):
    if self._ready_callback is not None or not inspect.iscoroutinefunction(handler):
        raise TypeError("Register exactly one async ready callback.")
    self._ready_callback = handler
    return handler

def deactivate(self, handler):
    if self._deactivate_callback is not None or not inspect.iscoroutinefunction(handler):
        raise TypeError("Register exactly one async deactivate callback.")
    self._deactivate_callback = handler
    return handler

async def _ui_ready(self):
    self.ui.mark_ready()
    try:
        if self._ready_callback is not None:
            await self._ready_callback(CommandContext(self))
        return {"ok": True, "value": {}}
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        self.ui.retire()
        raise
    except Exception:
        self.ui.retire()
        return {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "PLUGIN_E_UI_VERSION", "message": "UI initialization failed.",
                "detail": {"kind": "ui", "reason": "negotiation"}}}
```

```ts
import type { ContextCommandDeclaration, PanelDeclaration, StatusDeclaration } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
export type UiCatalogSource = {
  owner: ResourceOwner;
  eligible: boolean;
  resources: { kind: "packaged"; root: string } | { kind: "builtin"; files: Readonly<Record<string, string>> };
  commands: readonly ContextCommandDeclaration[];
  panels: readonly PanelDeclaration[];
  status: readonly StatusDeclaration[];
};
export const sameUiBinding = (left: UiBinding, right: UiBinding): boolean =>
  left.contributionId === right.contributionId && left.panelInstance === right.panelInstance &&
  left.kind === right.kind && left.uiResourceGeneration === right.uiResourceGeneration &&
  left.generation === right.generation && left.hostEpoch === right.hostEpoch && left.processEpoch === right.processEpoch;
export const sameResourceOwner = (left: ResourceOwner, right: ResourceOwner): boolean =>
  left.sourceKey === right.sourceKey && left.pluginId === right.pluginId && left.generation === right.generation &&
  left.hostEpoch === right.hostEpoch && left.processEpoch === right.processEpoch;
```

Create `packages/plugin-runtime/src/ui-catalog.ts`:

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { UI_LIMITS_V1 as L, uiBytes, uiFailure, resourceFailure, validateUiResource,
  type Handle, type ResourceOwner, type UiOwner, type UiCatalogEntry, type UiCatalogPage,
  type PanelResourceV1, type StatusResourceV1, type Result, type UiValidationContext } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import { readBuiltinJson, readPackagedJson, SourceReadBudget, PackagedResourceError, type PackagedJson } from "./packaged-json-resource.js";
import { sameResourceOwner, type UiBridgeEvent, type UiCatalogPort, type UiCatalogSource, type PluginUiBridge } from "./ui-host-ports.js";
type Resource = PanelResourceV1 | StatusResourceV1;
type Entry = { descriptor: UiCatalogEntry; resource?: Resource };
type Source = { input: UiCatalogSource; owner: UiOwner; token: object; entries: Entry[] };
export type UiCatalogDependencies = {
  beforeDelivery?: (sourceKey: string) => void;
  now?: () => number;
  read?: (source: UiCatalogSource, path: string, limit: number, budget: SourceReadBudget) => Promise<PackagedJson>;
  validate?: (value: unknown, context: UiValidationContext, bytes: number) => Result<Resource>;
};
const pathValid = (value: string) => value.length <= 600 &&
  /^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}\/){0,7}[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}\.json$/.test(value);
const compare = (left: string, right: string) => left < right ? -1 : left > right ? 1 : 0;
export class UiCatalog implements UiCatalogPort {
  #sources = new Map<string, Source>();
  #revision = 0;
  #generation = 0;
  #pass = 0;
  readonly #listeners = new Set<(event: UiBridgeEvent) => void>();
  readonly #cursors = new Map<Handle, { revision: number; offset: number; expires: number }>();
  readonly #now: () => number;
  readonly #read: NonNullable<UiCatalogDependencies["read"]>;
  readonly #validate: NonNullable<UiCatalogDependencies["validate"]>;
  readonly #beforeDelivery: UiCatalogDependencies["beforeDelivery"];
  constructor(readonly hostEpoch: Handle, deps: UiCatalogDependencies = {}) {
    this.#now = deps.now ?? (() => performance.now());
    this.#read = deps.read ?? (async (source, path, limit, budget) => source.resources.kind === "builtin"
      ? readBuiltinJson(source.resources.files, path, limit)
      : readPackagedJson(source.resources.root, path, limit, budget));
    this.#validate = deps.validate ?? validateUiResource;
    this.#beforeDelivery = deps.beforeDelivery;
  }
  #changed(): void {
    if (this.#revision === Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) throw new Error("UI catalog revision exhausted.");
    this.#revision++; this.#cursors.clear();
    const owners = [...this.#sources.values()].map((s) => s.owner);
    const event: UiBridgeEvent = { type: "catalog", hostEpoch: this.hostEpoch, revision: this.#revision, owners };
    for (const listener of this.#listeners) { try { listener(structuredClone(event)); } catch { /* A view cannot prevent retirement. */ } }
  }
  onEvent(listener: (event: UiBridgeEvent) => void): () => void {
    this.#listeners.add(listener); return () => { this.#listeners.delete(listener); };
  }
  declaresUi(owner: ResourceOwner): boolean {
    const source = this.#sources.get(owner.sourceKey)?.input;
    return !!source?.eligible && source.owner.pluginId === owner.pluginId &&
      source.owner.hostEpoch === owner.hostEpoch &&
      (source.panels.length > 0 || source.status.length > 0 || source.commands.length > 0);
  }
  isCurrent(owner: UiOwner): boolean {
    const current = this.#sources.get(owner.sourceKey);
    return current?.owner.pluginId === owner.pluginId && current.owner.uiResourceGeneration === owner.uiResourceGeneration;
  }
  replace(inputs: readonly UiCatalogSource[]): Promise<void> { return this.#replace(inputs, new Map()); }
  async #replace(inputs: readonly UiCatalogSource[], retained: ReadonlyMap<string, Source>): Promise<void> {
    const pass = ++this.#pass;
    const eligible = inputs.filter((s) => s.eligible).sort((a, b) => compare(a.owner.sourceKey, b.owner.sourceKey));
    if (eligible.length > 32 || new Set(eligible.map((s) => s.owner.sourceKey)).size !== eligible.length)
      throw new Error("UI source inventory exceeds the frozen catalog owner limit or contains duplicates.");
    const next = new Map<string, Source>();
    for (const input of eligible) {
      const keep = retained.get(input.owner.sourceKey);
      if (keep) { next.set(input.owner.sourceKey, keep); continue; }
      if (input.owner.hostEpoch !== this.hostEpoch) throw new Error("UI owner belongs to a different host.");
      if (++this.#generation > Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) throw new Error("UI generation exhausted.");
      next.set(input.owner.sourceKey, { input: structuredClone(input), token: {}, owner: { sourceKey: input.owner.sourceKey,
        pluginId: input.owner.pluginId, uiResourceGeneration: this.#generation }, entries: [] });
    }
    // Same-turn invalidation before any file read; late awaits must match both map identity and pass.
    this.#sources = next; this.#changed();
    let hostBytes = [...retained.values()].reduce((sum, source) => sum + source.entries.reduce((bytes, entry) =>
      bytes + (entry.descriptor.availability === "available" ? entry.descriptor.resourceBytes : 0), 0), 0);
    for (const source of next.values()) {
      if (retained.has(source.owner.sourceKey)) continue;
      const token = source.token; const budget = new SourceReadBudget(L.sourceReadMs, this.#now);
      let sourceBytes = 0;
      const declarations = [...source.input.panels.map((d) => ({ ...d, kind: "panel" as const })),
        ...source.input.status.map((d) => ({ ...d, kind: "status" as const }))].sort((a, b) => compare(a.id, b.id));
      for (const declaration of declarations) {
        if (pass !== this.#pass || this.#sources.get(source.owner.sourceKey)?.token !== token) break;
        const descriptor: UiCatalogEntry = { ...source.owner, id: declaration.id, kind: declaration.kind,
          title: structuredClone(declaration.title), version: 1, resourceDigest: "0".repeat(64), resourceBytes: 0, availability: "unavailable" };
        const entry: Entry = { descriptor };
        const quarantine = (code: string, message: string) => { descriptor.problem = { code, message }; };
        if (declaration.resource.version !== 1) quarantine("PLUGIN_E_UI_VERSION", "Unsupported UI resource version.");
        else if (!pathValid(declaration.resource.path)) quarantine("PLUGIN_E_UI_RESOURCE", "Invalid packaged UI resource path.");
        else {
          const allowed = Math.min(L.resourceBytes, L.sourceBytes - sourceBytes, L.hostBytes - hostBytes);
          if (allowed <= 0) quarantine("PLUGIN_E_UI_RESOURCE", "UI resource byte budget exhausted.");
          else try {
            // Reserve the allowed read window, not an unbounded file. Repeated path references run again.
            const parsed = await budget.run(() => this.#read(source.input, declaration.resource.path, allowed, budget));
            if (pass !== this.#pass || this.#sources.get(source.owner.sourceKey)?.token !== token) continue;
            if (parsed.bytes > allowed || parsed.bytes < 0 || !Number.isSafeInteger(parsed.bytes)) throw new PackagedResourceError("Invalid byte accounting.");
            sourceBytes += parsed.bytes;
            descriptor.resourceBytes = parsed.bytes; descriptor.resourceDigest = parsed.digest;
            const validated = this.#validate(parsed.value, { pluginId: source.owner.pluginId,
              commands: source.input.commands, panels: source.input.panels }, parsed.bytes);
            if (!validated.ok) quarantine(validated.error.code, "UI resource validation failed.");
            else if (validated.value.kind !== declaration.kind) quarantine("PLUGIN_E_UI_RESOURCE", "UI contribution kind does not match resource.");
            else if (uiBytes({ owner: source.owner, id: descriptor.id, version: 1, resource: validated.value,
              validationContext: { pluginId: source.owner.pluginId, commands: source.input.commands, panels: source.input.panels }, rawBytes: parsed.bytes }) > L.resourceReplyBytes)
              quarantine("PLUGIN_E_UI_RESOURCE", "UI resource reply exceeds its limit.");
            else { entry.resource = validated.value; descriptor.availability = "available"; hostBytes += parsed.bytes; }
          } catch {
            if (pass !== this.#pass || this.#sources.get(source.owner.sourceKey)?.token !== token) continue;
            quarantine("PLUGIN_E_UI_RESOURCE", "UI resource could not be read within its limits.");
          }
        }
        if (pass === this.#pass && this.#sources.get(source.owner.sourceKey)?.token === token) source.entries.push(entry);
      }
    }
    if (pass === this.#pass) this.#changed();
  }
  async retry(sourceKey: string): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.#sources.has(sourceKey)) return;
    // Keep every unrelated resource generation and its already admitted bytes.
    const retained = new Map(this.#sources); retained.delete(sourceKey);
    await this.#replace([...this.#sources.values()].map((source) => source.input), retained);
  }
  retire(owner: ResourceOwner): void {
    const source = this.#sources.get(owner.sourceKey);
    if (!source || !sameResourceOwner(source.input.owner, owner)) return;
    this.#sources.delete(owner.sourceKey); this.#changed();
  }
  async catalog(input: { cursor?: Handle }): Promise<Result<UiCatalogPage>> {
    const now = this.#now();
    for (const [handle, cursor] of this.#cursors) if (now >= cursor.expires) this.#cursors.delete(handle);
    let offset = 0;
    if (input.cursor !== undefined) {
      const cursor = this.#cursors.get(input.cursor);
      if (!cursor || cursor.revision !== this.#revision || now >= cursor.expires) return resourceFailure("stale");
      offset = cursor.offset;
    }
    const entries = [...this.#sources.values()].flatMap((source) => source.entries.map((entry) => entry.descriptor));
    const selected: UiCatalogEntry[] = [];
    while (offset < entries.length && selected.length < L.catalogEntries) {
      const candidate = entries[offset]!;
      const probe = { hostEpoch: this.hostEpoch, revision: this.#revision, entries: [...selected, candidate], nextCursor: randomUUID() };
      if (uiBytes(probe) > L.catalogBytes) break;
      selected.push(candidate); offset++;
    }
    if (selected.length === 0 && offset < entries.length) return uiFailure("limit", "$", "catalogBytes");
    let nextCursor: Handle | null = null;
    if (offset < entries.length) {
      if (this.#cursors.size >= 256) this.#cursors.delete(this.#cursors.keys().next().value!);
      const cursor = randomUUID(); nextCursor = cursor; this.#cursors.set(cursor, { revision: this.#revision, offset, expires: now + L.cursorMs });
    }
    return { ok: true, value: { hostEpoch: this.hostEpoch, revision: this.#revision,
      entries: structuredClone(selected), nextCursor } };
  }
  async resource(input: Parameters<PluginUiBridge["resource"]>[0]): ReturnType<PluginUiBridge["resource"]> {
    const source = this.#sources.get(input.sourceKey);
    const entry = source?.entries.find((entry) => entry.descriptor.id === input.id);
    if (!source || !entry || source.owner.uiResourceGeneration !== input.uiResourceGeneration ||
      entry.descriptor.resourceDigest !== input.resourceDigest) return resourceFailure("stale");
    if (!entry.resource || entry.descriptor.availability !== "available") return uiFailure("renderer");
    try { this.#beforeDelivery?.(input.sourceKey); } catch { return uiFailure("read"); }
    return { ok: true, value: { owner: structuredClone(source.owner), id: input.id, version: 1, resource: structuredClone(entry.resource),
      validationContext: { pluginId: source.owner.pluginId, commands: structuredClone(source.input.commands), panels: structuredClone(source.input.panels) },
      rawBytes: entry.descriptor.resourceBytes } };
  }
  async reportFailure(input: Parameters<PluginUiBridge["reportFailure"]>[0]): ReturnType<PluginUiBridge["reportFailure"]> {
    const source = this.#sources.get(input.sourceKey);
    if (!source || source.owner.uiResourceGeneration !== input.uiResourceGeneration || input.catalogRevision !== this.#revision)
      return { ok: true, value: { accepted: false } };
    const entry = source.entries.find((entry) => entry.descriptor.id === input.id);
    if (!entry || entry.descriptor.availability === "unavailable") return { ok: true, value: { accepted: false } };
    delete entry.resource; entry.descriptor.availability = "unavailable";
    entry.descriptor.problem = { code: "PLUGIN_E_UI_RESOURCE", message: "UI rendering is unavailable; explicit retry is required." };
    this.#changed(); return { ok: true, value: { accepted: true } };
  }
}
```

```ts
  expect(registry.state(owner, initial.binding)).toMatchObject({ ok: true, value: { formRevision: 0, form: { draft: "kept" } } });
```

Create `packages/plugin-runtime/src/ui-state.ts`:

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { UI_LIMITS_V1 as L, uiBytes, uiFailure, resourceFailure, validateUiData, uiRequestSchemas,
  type Counter, type ResourceOwner, type UiOwner, type UiBinding, type UiStateSnapshot, type UiEvent, type UiRevokeReason,
  type UiScalar, type PanelResourceV1, type StatusResourceV1, type Result, type UiRequestMap } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { CoreWindowScope } from "./core-actions.js";
import type { UiRuntimeAttachment } from "./ui-lifecycle.js";
import { sameResourceOwner, sameUiBinding, type FoundationCounters, type FoundationDiagnostics } from "./ui-host-ports.js";
type Resource = PanelResourceV1 | StatusResourceV1;
type OpenInput = { owner: UiOwner; id: string; scope: CoreWindowScope; resource: Resource;
  activateInitialized: UiRuntimeAttachment["activateInitialized"]; signal?: AbortSignal };
type Live = { owner: ResourceOwner; uiOwner: UiOwner; scope: CoreWindowScope; resource: Resource; state: UiStateSnapshot;
  times: number[]; pending: number };
type Reservation = { owner: UiOwner; id: string; scope: CoreWindowScope; kind: Resource["kind"];
  token: object; promise: Promise<Result<UiStateSnapshot>>; cancel(): void };
const identity = (owner: UiOwner, id: string, scope: CoreWindowScope) => JSON.stringify([scope.hostEpoch, scope.workbenchInstance, owner.sourceKey, id]);
export class UiStateRegistry {
  readonly #live = new Map<string, Live>();
  readonly #opening = new Map<string, Reservation>();
  readonly #listeners = new Set<(owner: ResourceOwner, event: UiEvent) => void>();
  readonly #now: () => number;
  #locale: "en" | "zh-TW" = "en";
  #theme: "light" | "dark" = "light";
  constructor(private readonly deps: { current(owner: UiOwner): boolean; now?: () => number;
    eventCounters?: () => Pick<FoundationCounters, "subscriptions" | "queuedEvents" | "queuedBytes"> }) {
    this.#now = deps.now ?? (() => performance.now());
    stateDiagnostics.set(this, {
      snapshot: () => Object.freeze({ owners: 0, bindings: this.#live.size,
        subscriptions: 0, queuedEvents: 0, queuedBytes: 0, timers: 0, pendingInvocations: 0,
        actionTokens: 0, resourceReaders: 0, workerJobs: 0, ...deps.eventCounters?.() }),
      onEvent: () => () => {},
    });
  }
  onEvent(listener: (owner: ResourceOwner, event: UiEvent) => void): () => void {
    this.#listeners.add(listener); return () => { this.#listeners.delete(listener); };
  }
  #emit(owner: ResourceOwner, event: UiEvent): void {
    for (const listener of this.#listeners) { try { listener(structuredClone(owner), structuredClone(event)); } catch { /* State is authoritative. */ } }
  }
  #find(owner: ResourceOwner, binding: UiBinding): Live | undefined {
    const live = this.#live.get(binding.panelInstance);
    return live && sameResourceOwner(owner, live.owner) && sameUiBinding(binding, live.state.binding) && this.deps.current(live.uiOwner) ? live : undefined;
  }
  initialBindingsReady(owner: ResourceOwner, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
    signal.throwIfAborted();
    const captured = [...this.#opening.values()].filter(opening =>
      opening.owner.sourceKey === owner.sourceKey && opening.owner.pluginId === owner.pluginId &&
      opening.scope.hostEpoch === owner.hostEpoch);
    if (!captured.length) return Promise.resolve();
    return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      const abort = () => {
        for (const opening of captured) opening.cancel();
        signal.removeEventListener("abort", abort); reject(signal.reason);
      };
      signal.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
      if (signal.aborted) { abort(); return; }
      void Promise.all(captured.map(opening => opening.promise)).then(() => {
        signal.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
        if (signal.aborted) reject(signal.reason); else resolve();
      });
    });
  }
  cancelInitialBindings(owner: ResourceOwner): void {
    for (const opening of [...this.#opening.values()]) if (
      opening.owner.sourceKey === owner.sourceKey && opening.owner.pluginId === owner.pluginId &&
      opening.scope.hostEpoch === owner.hostEpoch) opening.cancel();
  }
  executionOwner(binding: UiBinding): ResourceOwner | null {
    const live = this.#live.get(binding.panelInstance);
    return live && sameUiBinding(binding, live.state.binding) && this.deps.current(live.uiOwner)
      ? structuredClone(live.owner) : null;
  }
  instances(owner: ResourceOwner): UiBinding[] {
    return [...this.#live.values()].filter((live) => sameResourceOwner(owner, live.owner) && this.deps.current(live.uiOwner))
      .map((live) => structuredClone(live.state.binding));
  }
  currentStatus(scope: CoreWindowScope): readonly {binding: UiBinding; revision: number}[] {
    return [...this.#live.values()].filter(live => live.state.binding.kind === "status" &&
      live.scope.hostEpoch === scope.hostEpoch && live.scope.workbenchInstance === scope.workbenchInstance &&
      this.deps.current(live.uiOwner)).map(live => ({ binding: structuredClone(live.state.binding), revision: live.state.revision }));
  }
  environment(): { locale: "en" | "zh-TW"; theme: "light" | "dark" } { return { locale: this.#locale, theme: this.#theme }; }
  setEnvironment(locale: "en" | "zh-TW", theme: "light" | "dark"): void {
    this.#locale = locale; this.#theme = theme;
    const owners = new Map<string, ResourceOwner>();
    for (const live of this.#live.values()) { live.state.locale = locale; owners.set(JSON.stringify(live.owner), live.owner); }
    for (const owner of owners.values()) this.#emit(owner, { kind: "ui.environment", data: { locale, theme } });
  }
  async open(input: OpenInput): Promise<Result<UiStateSnapshot>> {
    if (input.signal?.aborted) return resourceFailure("stale");
    if (!this.deps.current(input.owner) || !input.id.startsWith(`${input.owner.pluginId}.`)) return resourceFailure("stale");
    const key = identity(input.owner, input.id, input.scope);
    for (const live of this.#live.values()) if (identity(live.uiOwner, live.state.binding.contributionId, live.scope) === key)
      return this.deps.current(live.uiOwner) ? { ok: true, value: structuredClone(live.state) } : resourceFailure("stale");
    const existing = this.#opening.get(key); if (existing) return existing.promise;
    const kind = input.resource.kind;
    const reservations = [...this.#opening.values()]; const live = [...this.#live.values()];
    const sourceCount = live.filter((v) => v.owner.sourceKey === input.owner.sourceKey && v.resource.kind === kind).length +
      reservations.filter((v) => v.owner.sourceKey === input.owner.sourceKey && v.kind === kind).length;
    const hostCount = live.filter((v) => v.resource.kind === kind).length + reservations.filter((v) => v.kind === kind).length;
    const sourceLimit = kind === "panel" ? L.sourcePanels : L.sourceStatus;
    const hostLimit = kind === "panel" ? L.hostPanels : L.hostStatus;
    if (sourceCount >= sourceLimit || hostCount >= hostLimit) return resourceFailure("quota", sourceCount >= sourceLimit ? sourceLimit : hostLimit);
    let resolve!: (result: Result<UiStateSnapshot>) => void;
    const token = {};
    const abort = () => resolve(resourceFailure("stale"));
    const promise = new Promise<Result<UiStateSnapshot>>((r) => { resolve = (result) => {
      input.signal?.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
      if (this.#opening.get(key)?.token === token) this.#opening.delete(key); r(result);
    }; });
    this.#opening.set(key, { owner: structuredClone(input.owner), id: input.id, scope: input.scope, kind, token, promise, cancel: abort });
    input.signal?.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
    if (input.signal?.aborted) abort();
    // Reservation is installed before calling any activation code, including synchronous callbacks.
    void Promise.resolve().then(() => input.activateInitialized(input.owner.sourceKey, input.signal ?? new AbortController().signal)).then((channel) => {
      if (this.#opening.get(key)?.token !== token || !this.deps.current(input.owner)) return resolve(resourceFailure("stale"));
      const owner = channel.owner;
      if (owner.sourceKey !== input.owner.sourceKey || owner.pluginId !== input.owner.pluginId || owner.hostEpoch !== input.scope.hostEpoch)
        return resolve(resourceFailure("stale"));
      const resource = structuredClone(input.resource);
      const data = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(resource.data).map(([key, slot]) => [key, slot.initial]));
      const dataResult = validateUiData(resource, data); if (!dataResult.ok) return resolve(dataResult);
      const form = resource.kind === "panel" ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(resource.fields).map(([key, field]) => [key, field.initial])) : {};
      const binding: UiBinding = { contributionId: input.id, panelInstance: randomUUID(), kind,
        uiResourceGeneration: input.owner.uiResourceGeneration, generation: owner.generation,
        hostEpoch: owner.hostEpoch, processEpoch: owner.processEpoch };
      const state: UiStateSnapshot = { binding, revision: 0, data, formRevision: 0, form,
        valid: resource.kind === "status" || !Object.values(resource.fields).some((f) => f.required && (f.initial === null || f.initial === "")),
        visible: kind === "status", locale: this.#locale };
      this.#opening.delete(key);
      this.#live.set(binding.panelInstance, { owner: structuredClone(owner), uiOwner: structuredClone(input.owner),
        scope: structuredClone(input.scope), resource, state, times: [], pending: 0 });
      this.#emit(owner, { kind: "ui.instances", data: { instances: this.instances(owner) } });
      resolve({ ok: true, value: structuredClone(state) });
    }, () => resolve(uiFailure("read"))).catch(() => resolve(uiFailure("read"))).finally(() => {
      if (this.#opening.get(key)?.token === token) this.#opening.delete(key);
    });
    return promise;
  }
  state(owner: ResourceOwner, binding: UiBinding): Result<UiStateSnapshot> {
    const live = this.#find(owner, binding); return live ? { ok: true, value: structuredClone(live.state) } : resourceFailure("stale");
  }
  patch(owner: ResourceOwner, input: UiRequestMap["ui/patch"]["params"]): Result<{ revision: number }> {
    if (!uiRequestSchemas["ui/patch"].params.safeParse(input).success) return uiFailure("schema", "$.patch");
    const live = this.#find(owner, input.binding);
    if (!live || input.baseRevision !== live.state.revision) return resourceFailure("stale");
    const keys = Object.keys(input.set);
    if (keys.length < 1 || keys.length > L.patchEntries || uiBytes(input) > L.patchBytes) return uiFailure("limit", "$.patch", "patchBytes");
    if (keys.some((key) => !Object.hasOwn(live.resource.data, key))) return uiFailure("reference", "$.set");
    const now = this.#now(); live.times = live.times.filter((time) => now - time < 1000);
    if (live.times.length >= L.patchesPerSecond) return resourceFailure("rate", L.patchesPerSecond);
    if (live.pending >= L.pendingPatches) return resourceFailure("queue", L.pendingPatches);
    if (live.state.revision === Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) return resourceFailure("quota", Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
    const next = { ...live.state.data, ...input.set };
    const valid = validateUiData(live.resource, next); if (!valid.ok) return valid;
    live.state = { ...live.state, revision: live.state.revision + 1, data: valid.value };
    live.times.push(now); live.pending++;
    return { ok: true, value: { revision: live.state.revision } };
  }
  flush(): void {
    // T3 schedules this on its existing bounded event drain, not a new timer per panel.
    for (const live of this.#live.values()) if (live.pending > 0) {
      live.pending = 0;
      this.#emit(live.owner, { kind: "ui.state", data: { binding: live.state.binding, revision: live.state.revision } });
    }
  }
  setForm(owner: ResourceOwner, binding: UiBinding, revision: number, values: Record<string, UiScalar>, valid: boolean): Result<{ accepted: true }> {
    const live = this.#find(owner, binding);
    if (!live || live.resource.kind !== "panel" || revision !== live.state.formRevision + 1 || !Number.isSafeInteger(revision)) return resourceFailure("stale");
    if (uiBytes(values) > L.formBytes || Object.keys(values).length !== Object.keys(live.resource.fields).length ||
      Object.keys(values).some((key) => !Object.hasOwn(live.resource.kind === "panel" ? live.resource.fields : {}, key))) return uiFailure("schema", "$.form");
    // T5 has validated raw typed draft against the resource before this host-only call.
    live.state = { ...live.state, formRevision: revision, form: structuredClone(values), valid };
    this.#emit(owner, { kind: "ui.form", data: { binding, revision, values: structuredClone(values) } });
    return { ok: true, value: { accepted: true } };
  }
  visibility(owner: ResourceOwner, binding: UiBinding, visible: boolean): Result<{ accepted: true }> {
    const live = this.#find(owner, binding); if (!live) return resourceFailure("stale");
    live.state.visible = visible;
    this.#emit(owner, { kind: "ui.visibility", data: { binding, visible } });
    return { ok: true, value: { accepted: true } };
  }
  #remove(live: Live, reason: UiRevokeReason): void {
    this.#live.delete(live.state.binding.panelInstance); live.pending = 0;
    this.#emit(live.owner, { kind: "ui.revoked", data: { binding: live.state.binding, reason } });
    this.#emit(live.owner, { kind: "ui.instances", data: { instances: this.instances(live.owner) } });
  }
  close(owner: ResourceOwner, binding: UiBinding): Result<{ closed: true }> {
    const live = this.#find(owner, binding); if (!live) return resourceFailure("stale");
    this.#remove(live, "closed"); return { ok: true, value: { closed: true } };
  }
  retireResource(owner: UiOwner, reason: UiRevokeReason): void {
    for (const opening of [...this.#opening.values()]) if (opening.owner.sourceKey === owner.sourceKey &&
      opening.owner.pluginId === owner.pluginId && opening.owner.uiResourceGeneration === owner.uiResourceGeneration) opening.cancel();
    for (const live of [...this.#live.values()]) if (live.uiOwner.sourceKey === owner.sourceKey &&
      live.uiOwner.pluginId === owner.pluginId && live.uiOwner.uiResourceGeneration === owner.uiResourceGeneration) this.#remove(live, reason);
  }
  retireExecution(owner: ResourceOwner, reason: UiRevokeReason): void {
    this.cancelInitialBindings(owner);
    for (const live of [...this.#live.values()]) if (sameResourceOwner(owner, live.owner)) this.#remove(live, reason);
  }
}
export function currentStatusBindings(state: UiStateRegistry, scope: CoreWindowScope): readonly {binding: UiBinding; revision: Counter}[] {
  return state.currentStatus(scope);
}
const stateDiagnostics = new WeakMap<object, FoundationDiagnostics>();
export function diagnosticsFor(instance: object): FoundationDiagnostics {
  const diagnostics = stateDiagnostics.get(instance);
  if (!diagnostics) throw new TypeError("Unknown UI state instance");
  return diagnostics;
}

```

`flush` only publishes accepted revision summaries; it never mutates a renderer draft. T5's synchronous intent revocation precedes `visibility(false)`, `close`, `setForm` and retirement. This class does not claim to revoke device authority itself. `ui.revoked`/visibility/form/environment/instances are control events, while coalesced state revision hints use the data lane. The event service below selects the shared lane.

```ts
import { RpcPeer, createMemoryChannelPair } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { Stage3ChannelContext } from "./ui-lifecycle.js";
function initializedChannel(): Stage3ChannelContext {
  const [channel] = createMemoryChannelPair();
  return { peer: new RpcPeer(channel), owner, requirements: [],
    principal: () => ({ kind: "plugin", owner, authorityContext: null }) };
}
import { expect, it } from "vitest";
import { UiSubscriptions, type UiEventLedgerPort } from "./ui-subscriptions.js";
import { UiStateRegistry } from "./ui-state.js";
import { resourceFailure, type ResourceOwner, type UiEvent, type Result, type UiSubscriptionSnapshot } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
const h = (n: number) => `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12, "0")}`;
const owner: ResourceOwner = { sourceKey: "source", pluginId: "test.ui", generation: 1, hostEpoch: h(1), processEpoch: h(2) };
function sharedLedgerFixture() {
  type Record = { owner: ResourceOwner; sequence: number; acknowledged: number; control: number; bytes: number; terminal: boolean };
  const live = new Map<string, Record>(); const tombstones = new Map<string, ResourceOwner>();
  const sent: { id: string; event: UiEvent; delivery: string }[] = [];
  const removed = new Set<(id: string) => void>(); let next = 100; let deviceSubscriptions = 0;
  const matches = (a: ResourceOwner, b: ResourceOwner) => JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b);
  const find = (caller: ResourceOwner, id: string) => { const value = live.get(id); return value && matches(caller, value.owner) ? value : undefined; };
  const port: UiEventLedgerPort = {
    create(caller) {
      if (live.size + deviceSubscriptions >= 32) return resourceFailure("quota", 32);
      const subscriptionId = h(next++); live.set(subscriptionId, { owner: caller, sequence: 0, acknowledged: 0, control: 0, bytes: 0, terminal: false });
      return { ok: true, value: { subscriptionId, sequence: 0 } };
    },
    owns: (caller, id) => find(caller, id) !== undefined,
    publish(caller, id, event, delivery) {
      const record = find(caller, id); if (!record) return resourceFailure("stale");
      if (record.terminal) return resourceFailure("stale");
      const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(event));
      if (delivery === "control" && (record.control >= 7 || bytes > 16384)) return resourceFailure("queue", 8);
      if (delivery === "telemetry" && record.bytes + bytes > 262144) return resourceFailure("queue", 262144);
      record.sequence++; if (delivery === "control") record.control++; else record.bytes += bytes;
      sent.push({ id, event, delivery }); return { ok: true, value: { accepted: true } };
    },
    resync(caller, id) {
      const record = find(caller, id); if (!record) return resourceFailure("stale");
      if (record.control >= 8) return resourceFailure("queue", 8);
      record.control++; record.sequence++; return { ok: true, value: { accepted: true } };
    },
    snapshot(caller, id, read) {
      const record = find(caller, id); if (!record) return resourceFailure("stale");
      const snapshot = read(); if (!snapshot.ok) return snapshot;
      // State and sequence are read in one synchronous turn. ACK owns retained-byte release.
      return { ok: true, value: { sequence: record.sequence, snapshot: snapshot.value } };
    },
    unsubscribe(caller, id) {
      const record = find(caller, id);
      if (!record) return tombstones.has(id) && matches(tombstones.get(id)!, caller)
        ? { ok: true, value: { removed: false } } : resourceFailure("stale");
      live.delete(id); tombstones.set(id, record.owner); for (const listener of removed) listener(id);
      return { ok: true, value: { removed: true } };
    },
    closeAfterControl(caller, id) {
      const record = find(caller, id); if (!record) return;
      record.terminal = true;
      if (record.acknowledged === record.sequence) port.unsubscribe(caller, id);
    },
    onRemoved(listener) { removed.add(listener); return () => { removed.delete(listener); }; },
  };
  return { port, sent, live, setDevices: (count: number) => { deviceSubscriptions = count; },
    ack(caller: ResourceOwner, id: string, sequence: number) {
      const record = find(caller, id); if (!record) throw new Error("stale");
      if (sequence > record.sequence) throw new Error("invalidParams");
      record.acknowledged = Math.max(record.acknowledged, sequence);
      if (record.terminal && record.acknowledged === record.sequence) port.unsubscribe(caller, id);
      return record.acknowledged;
    } };
}
const setup = () => {
  const ledger = sharedLedgerFixture(); const state = new UiStateRegistry({ current: () => true });
  const revocations: string[] = [];
  const subscriptions = new UiSubscriptions(state, ledger.port, (caller) => revocations.push(caller.sourceKey));
  return { ledger, state, subscriptions, revocations };
};
it("U08 shares the 32-subscription quota with devices and validates topic/binding pairing", () => {
  const { ledger, subscriptions } = setup(); ledger.setDevices(31);
  expect(subscriptions.subscribe(owner, { topics: ["instances", "environment"] }).ok).toBe(true);
  expect(subscriptions.subscribe(owner, { topics: ["instances"] })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, error: { detail: { reason: "quota" } } });
  expect(() => subscriptions.subscribe(owner, { topics: ["state"] })).toThrow("Invalid UI subscription");
  expect(() => subscriptions.subscribe(owner, { topics: ["instances", "instances"] })).toThrow();
  subscriptions.dispose();
});
it("U08 snapshot is a source-private sequence barrier and foreign unsubscribe cannot remove it", () => {
  const { ledger, subscriptions } = setup();
  const result = subscriptions.subscribe(owner, { topics: ["environment"] }); if (!result.ok) throw new Error("subscribe failed");
  const id = result.value.subscriptionId;
  subscriptions.environment(owner, "zh-TW", "dark");
  const snapshot = subscriptions.snapshot(owner, id);
  expect(snapshot).toMatchObject({ ok: true, value: { sequence: 1, snapshot: { states: [], instances: [], locale: "zh-TW", theme: "dark" } } });
  expect(subscriptions.snapshot({ ...owner, sourceKey: "foreign" }, id).ok).toBe(false);
  expect(() => ledger.ack(owner, id, 2)).toThrow("invalidParams");
  expect(ledger.ack(owner, id, 1)).toBe(1); expect(ledger.ack(owner, id, 0)).toBe(1);
  expect(subscriptions.unsubscribe({ ...owner, generation: 2 }, id).ok).toBe(false);
  expect(subscriptions.unsubscribe(owner, id)).toEqual({ ok: true, value: { removed: true } });
  expect(subscriptions.unsubscribe(owner, id)).toEqual({ ok: true, value: { removed: false } });
  expect(subscriptions.unsubscribe({ ...owner, generation: 2 }, id).ok).toBe(false);
  subscriptions.dispose();
});
it("U08 control overflow revokes intent before cancelling and does not consume data capacity", () => {
  const { ledger, subscriptions, revocations } = setup();
  const result = subscriptions.subscribe(owner, { topics: ["environment"] }); if (!result.ok) throw new Error("subscribe failed");
  for (let n = 0; n < 8; n++) subscriptions.environment(owner, n % 2 ? "en" : "zh-TW", "dark");
  expect(ledger.sent).toHaveLength(7);
  expect(ledger.sent.every((event) => event.delivery === "control")).toBe(true);
  expect(revocations).toEqual(["source"]);
  expect(ledger.live.size).toBe(0);
  subscriptions.dispose();
});
it("U08 retire removes domain callbacks and cannot leak delivery into a new owner", () => {
  const { ledger, subscriptions } = setup();
  subscriptions.subscribe(owner, { topics: ["instances"] }); subscriptions.retire(owner);
  expect(ledger.live.size).toBe(0);
  subscriptions.environment({ ...owner, generation: 2 }, "en", "light");
  expect(ledger.sent).toHaveLength(0);
  subscriptions.dispose();
});
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Implement the UI projection over the shared event ledger.**

Modify `packages/plugin-runtime/src/ui-subscriptions.ts` (F scaffold; preserve frozen declarations and defining-module imports). `UiEventLedgerPort` is the required projection frozen by AM-16. Its production adapter delegates to A's existing ledger; this module contains no sequence counter, ack handler, event queue or tombstone cache.

```ts
import { RpcError, RPC_ERRORS, uiRequestSchemas, uiBytes, resourceFailure, uiFailure,
  type Handle, type Counter, type ResourceOwner, type UiBinding, type UiEvent, type UiSubscriptionSnapshot,
  type UiRequestMap, type Result } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import { sameResourceOwner, sameUiBinding } from "./ui-host-ports.js";
import { UiStateRegistry } from "./ui-state.js";
export interface UiEventLedgerPort {
  create(owner: ResourceOwner): Result<{ subscriptionId: Handle; sequence: 0 }>;
  owns(owner: ResourceOwner, subscriptionId: Handle): boolean;
  publish(owner: ResourceOwner, subscriptionId: Handle, event: UiEvent, delivery: "control" | "telemetry"): Result<{ accepted: true }>;
  resync(owner: ResourceOwner, subscriptionId: Handle): Result<{ accepted: true }>;
  snapshot(owner: ResourceOwner, subscriptionId: Handle, read: () => Result<UiSubscriptionSnapshot>): Result<{
    sequence: Counter; snapshot: UiSubscriptionSnapshot;
  }>;
  unsubscribe(owner: ResourceOwner, subscriptionId: Handle): Result<{ removed: boolean }>;
  closeAfterControl(owner: ResourceOwner, subscriptionId: Handle): void;
  onRemoved(listener: (subscriptionId: Handle) => void): () => void;
}
type Subscription = { owner: ResourceOwner; topics: UiRequestMap["ui/subscribe"]["params"]["topics"]; binding?: UiBinding };
export class UiSubscriptions {
  readonly #subscriptions = new Map<Handle, Subscription>();
  readonly #offState: () => void;
  readonly #offRemoved: () => void;
  readonly #environment = new Map<string, { locale: "en" | "zh-TW"; theme: "light" | "dark" }>();
  constructor(private readonly state: UiStateRegistry, private readonly ledger: UiEventLedgerPort,
    private readonly revokeIntent: (owner: ResourceOwner, binding?: UiBinding) => void) {
    this.#offState = state.onEvent((owner, event) => this.#deliver(owner, event));
    this.#offRemoved = ledger.onRemoved((id) => { this.#subscriptions.delete(id); });
  }
  #read(subscription: Subscription): Result<UiSubscriptionSnapshot> {
    const instances = this.state.instances(subscription.owner);
    const environment = this.#environment.get(JSON.stringify(subscription.owner)) ?? this.state.environment();
    if (!subscription.binding) return { ok: true, value: { instances, states: [], ...environment } };
    const state = this.state.state(subscription.owner, subscription.binding);
    if (!state.ok) return state;
    return { ok: true, value: { instances: instances.filter((binding) => sameUiBinding(binding, subscription.binding!)),
      states: [state.value], ...environment } };
  }
  subscribe(owner: ResourceOwner, input: UiRequestMap["ui/subscribe"]["params"]): UiRequestMap["ui/subscribe"]["result"] {
    if (!uiRequestSchemas["ui/subscribe"].params.safeParse(input).success || new Set(input.topics).size !== input.topics.length ||
      !input.binding && input.topics.some((topic) => topic !== "instances" && topic !== "environment"))
      throw new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.invalidParams, "Invalid UI subscription.");
    const subscription: Subscription = { owner: structuredClone(owner), topics: [...input.topics],
      ...(input.binding ? { binding: structuredClone(input.binding) } : {}) };
    const snapshot = this.#read(subscription); if (!snapshot.ok) return snapshot;
    // All operations before return are synchronous. No event can enter between snapshot and admission.
    const admitted = this.ledger.create(owner); if (!admitted.ok) return admitted;
    this.#subscriptions.set(admitted.value.subscriptionId, subscription);
    return { ok: true, value: { ...admitted.value, snapshot: snapshot.value } };
  }
  snapshot(owner: ResourceOwner, subscriptionId: Handle): UiRequestMap["ui/snapshot"]["result"] {
    const subscription = this.#subscriptions.get(subscriptionId);
    if (!subscription || !sameResourceOwner(owner, subscription.owner) || !this.ledger.owns(owner, subscriptionId)) return resourceFailure("stale");
    return this.ledger.snapshot(owner, subscriptionId, () => this.#read(subscription));
  }
  unsubscribe(owner: ResourceOwner, subscriptionId: Handle): Result<{ removed: boolean }> {
    // The shared ledger is authoritative even after this module has removed its callback metadata.
    const result = this.ledger.unsubscribe(owner, subscriptionId);
    if (result.ok) {
      this.#subscriptions.delete(subscriptionId);
      if (![...this.#subscriptions.values()].some((subscription) => sameResourceOwner(owner, subscription.owner)))
        this.#environment.delete(JSON.stringify(owner));
    }
    return result;
  }
  environment(owner: ResourceOwner, locale: "en" | "zh-TW", theme: "light" | "dark"): void {
    if (![...this.#subscriptions.values()].some((subscription) => sameResourceOwner(owner, subscription.owner))) return;
    this.#environment.set(JSON.stringify(owner), { locale, theme });
    this.#deliver(owner, { kind: "ui.environment", data: { locale, theme } });
  }
  #deliver(owner: ResourceOwner, event: UiEvent): void {
    for (const [id, subscription] of [...this.#subscriptions]) {
      if (!sameResourceOwner(owner, subscription.owner) || !this.ledger.owns(owner, id)) continue;
      const topic = event.kind.slice(3) as Subscription["topics"][number];
      if (event.kind !== "ui.revoked" && !subscription.topics.includes(topic)) continue;
      if ("binding" in event.data && (!subscription.binding || !sameUiBinding(event.data.binding, subscription.binding))) continue;
      let selected = event;
      if (event.kind === "ui.instances" && subscription.binding) selected = { kind: "ui.instances", data: {
        instances: event.data.instances.filter((binding) => sameUiBinding(binding, subscription.binding!)),
      } };
      const delivery = selected.kind === "ui.state" ? "telemetry" : "control";
      const result = this.ledger.publish(owner, id, selected, delivery);
      if (!result.ok) {
        if (delivery === "telemetry" && this.ledger.resync(owner, id).ok) continue;
        // Synchronous revoke happens before any callback cleanup or await; safety snapshots live elsewhere.
        this.revokeIntent(owner, subscription.binding);
        this.unsubscribe(owner, id);
      } else if (selected.kind === "ui.revoked") {
        this.ledger.closeAfterControl(owner, id);
      }
    }
  }
  retire(owner: ResourceOwner): void {
    for (const [id, subscription] of [...this.#subscriptions]) if (sameResourceOwner(owner, subscription.owner)) this.unsubscribe(owner, id);
    this.#environment.delete(JSON.stringify(owner));
  }
  dispose(): void {
    this.#offState(); this.#offRemoved();
    for (const [id, subscription] of [...this.#subscriptions]) this.unsubscribe(subscription.owner, id);
    this.#environment.clear();
  }
}
```

T3 invokes `UiSubscriptions.retire(owner)` before the common owner's final ledger teardown. Closing one binding cancels only subscriptions for that binding after its revoke control has been accepted by the shared ledger; it must not retire the source or its device/settings subscriptions. The production `closeAfterControl(owner, subscriptionId)` closes new delivery admission synchronously and retains the already enqueued revoke until its cumulative acknowledgement or original 10-second ack deadline; it does not rearm the deadline. It then performs the common tombstone/onRemoved transition. Clearing the UI callback metadata cannot drop that terminal frame. AM-01/16 requires this continuation on the same A-T2 ledger; P160 verifies it through the actual channel.

```ts
import { currentStatusBindings, diagnosticsFor } from "./ui-state.js";
it("lazy first-open registers initial instances before ready and shares one activation", async () => {
  const registry = new UiStateRegistry({ current: () => true });
  let initialized!: (channel: Stage3ChannelContext) => void;
  const barrier = new Promise<Stage3ChannelContext>(resolve => { initialized = resolve; });
  let activations = 0;
  const input = { owner: uiOwner, id: "test.ui.panel", scope, resource: resource(),
    activateInitialized: () => { activations++; return barrier; } };
  const first = registry.open(input); const second = registry.open(input);
  await Promise.resolve();
  expect(registry.instances(owner)).toEqual([]);
  initialized(initializedChannel());
  const opened = await first;
  expect(opened.ok).toBe(true);
  expect(await second).toEqual(opened);
  expect(activations).toBe(1);
  // R160 initialized callback awaits this open, releases the initial-binding latch,
  // then sends ui/ready. Its ready callback can immediately query this binding.
  expect(registry.instances(owner)).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(diagnosticsFor(registry).snapshot().bindings).toBe(1);
  registry.retireExecution(owner, "process-gone");
  expect(diagnosticsFor(registry).snapshot().bindings).toBe(0);
  expect(() => diagnosticsFor({})).toThrow("Unknown UI state instance");
});
it("replays only live status revisions in the main-derived workbench scope", async () => {
  const registry = new UiStateRegistry({ current: () => true });
  const result = await registry.open({ owner: uiOwner, id: "test.ui.status", scope,
    resource: { kind: "status", data: {}, text: { text: { en: "Ready" } }, tone: "info" },
    activateInitialized: async () => initializedChannel() });
  if (!result.ok) throw new Error("status open failed");
  expect(currentStatusBindings(registry, scope)).toEqual([{ binding: result.value.binding, revision: 0 }]);
  expect(currentStatusBindings(registry, { ...scope, workbenchInstance: h(99) })).toEqual([]);
  registry.close(owner, result.value.binding);
  expect(currentStatusBindings(registry, scope)).toEqual([]);
});
```

No state constructor or open callback waits on `runtime.ready`. Duplicate opens share activation; crash/stale-generation rejects the original open. No-UI sources complete the latch immediately.

Retain the F declarations and existing R150 implementation. Add this factory to ui-lifecycle.ts; it owns UI revocation only, never drain or process teardown.

```ts
import type { UiBinding } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { UiStateRegistry } from "./ui-state.js";
import type { UiSubscriptions } from "./ui-subscriptions.js";
export function createUiLifetimePort(input: {
  catalog: UiCatalogPort;
  states: Pick<UiStateRegistry, "instances" | "retireExecution">;
  subscriptions: Pick<UiSubscriptions, "retire">;
  revoke(owner: ResourceOwner, binding: UiBinding): void;
}): UiCatalogPort {
  return {
    catalog: (value) => input.catalog.catalog(value),
    resource: (value) => input.catalog.resource(value),
    onEvent: (listener) => input.catalog.onEvent(listener),
    retire: (owner) => {
      for (const binding of input.states.instances(owner)) input.revoke(owner, binding);
      input.states.retireExecution(owner, "generation-retired");
      input.subscriptions.retire(owner);
      input.catalog.retire(owner);
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
describe("R160 crash-loop accounting (U13, B1-RF5)", () => {
  it("counts rejected launches, latches failed, and never launches on a timer", async () => {
    let now = 0;
    const launch = vi.fn(async (): Promise<PluginProcess> => { throw new Error("spawn denied"); });
    const subject = new PluginSupervisor(plugin, launch, { locale: "en", onNotice: () => {}, now: () => now });
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      await expect(subject.executeCommand(plugin.commands[0]!)).rejects.toBeDefined();
      now += 1_000;
    }
    expect(subject.state).toBe("failed");
    now += 600_000;
    await expect(subject.executeCommand(plugin.commands[0]!)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "PLUGIN_E_CRASH_LOOP" });
    expect(launch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
  });
  it("uses an exclusive five-minute window and one count per failed handshake", async () => {
    let now = 0;
    const launch = vi.fn(async () => memoryPlugin((peer) => {
      peer.handle("initialize", () => { throw new Error("bad handshake"); });
    }).process);
    const subject = new PluginSupervisor(plugin, launch, { locale: "en", onNotice: () => {}, now: () => now });
    await expect(subject.executeCommand(plugin.commands[0]!)).rejects.toBeDefined();
    now = 300_000;
    await expect(subject.executeCommand(plugin.commands[0]!)).rejects.toBeDefined();
    now++;
    await expect(subject.executeCommand(plugin.commands[0]!)).rejects.toBeDefined();
    expect(subject.state).toBe("idle");
    now++;
    await expect(subject.executeCommand(plugin.commands[0]!)).rejects.toBeDefined();
    expect(subject.state).toBe("failed");
    expect(launch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(4);
  });
  it("normal shutdown does not spend a crash attempt", async () => {
    const h = setup();
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      await h.supervisor.executeCommand("acme.hello.greet");
      await h.supervisor.stop();
      expect(h.supervisor.state).toBe("idle");
    }
  });
  it("uses a total four-second stop bound and keeps unconfirmed exit visible", async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const h = memoryPlugin((peer, control) => ready(peer, control.exit));
    const forceKill = vi.fn();
    const subject = new PluginSupervisor(plugin, async () => ({
      ...h.process, kill: vi.fn(), forceKill, onExit: () => () => {},
    }), { locale: "en", onNotice: () => {} });
    await subject.executeCommand("acme.hello.greet");
    const stopping = subject.stop();
    const rejected = expect(stopping).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "PLUGIN_E_TIMEOUT" });
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(3_999);
    expect(forceKill).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1);
    await rejected;
    expect(forceKill).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});
```

```ts
#recordFailure(): boolean {
  const now = (this.#options.now ?? Date.now)();

  const failed = this.#crashes.length >= this.#options.restartLimit;
  if (failed) this.#problem = {
```
