```ts
    message: `${this.plugin.id} failed ${this.#crashes.length} times and stays stopped until an explicit reset. Last problem: ${this.#problem?.message ?? "Process failed."}`,

}
```

Replace `#stopBoundMs` and `#stop` with the following. `exitTimeoutMs` now bounds the entire stop, rather than being added after `stopTimeoutMs`; its default stays 4,000. Tests using small deadlines must set `exitTimeoutMs` to the desired total. Preserve the R150 channel-retirement call before publication in `#exited`; do not replace it with a synthetic exit on timeout.

```ts
get #stopBoundMs(): number { return this.#options.exitTimeoutMs; }
async #stop(): Promise<void> {
  const now = this.#options.now ?? Date.now;
  const deadline = now() + this.#stopBoundMs;
  this.#stopping = true;
  let killTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  let removeExit: (() => void) | undefined;
  try {
    if (!this.#process && this.#launching &&
        !(await this.#within(this.#launching, Math.max(0, deadline - now())))) {
      this.#abandonLaunch?.();
      throw new PluginError("PLUGIN_E_TIMEOUT", "Plugin launch has not reported a disposition.");
    }
    const child = this.#process;
    const peer = this.#peer;
    if (!child || !peer) return;
    const handshaking = this.#state === "starting";
    this.#setState("stopping");
    const exited = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { removeExit = child.onExit(() => resolve()); });
    const remaining = Math.max(0, deadline - now());
    killTimer = setTimeout(() => child.kill(), Math.min(this.#options.stopTimeoutMs, remaining));
    if (handshaking) child.kill();
    else void peer.request("shutdown", {}, {
      timeoutMs: Math.min(this.#options.stopTimeoutMs, remaining),
    }).then(() => peer.notify("exit", {})).catch(() => child.kill());
    if (!(await this.#within(exited, remaining))) {
      child.forceKill();
      this.#stoppedPeers.add(peer);
      this.#problem = { code: "PLUGIN_E_TIMEOUT", message: "Plugin exit is not confirmed." };
      peer.close(new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.connectionClosed, this.#problem.message));
      throw new PluginError(this.#problem.code, this.#problem.message);
    }
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(killTimer); removeExit?.();
    // A child without an exit report remains stopping and cannot be replaced.
    this.#stopping = this.#process !== undefined;
    this.#forced = false;
  }
}
```

```ts
#ensureStarted(): Promise<RpcPeer> {
  if (this.#terminatingChannel)
    return Promise.reject(new PluginError("PLUGIN_E_DISABLED", "Previous process resources are retiring."));
  if (this.#stopping || (this.#process && !this.#peer))

}
```

Before constructing ChannelActivation, the supervisor registers the signal with its original initialize deadline using these host-only helpers in ui-lifecycle.ts. Call `registerActivationDeadline(signal, originalDeadlineMonotonicMs, now)` immediately after creating the existing handshake signal, before initialize; call the returned disposer in the existing startup finally block after readiness/failure. `originalDeadlineMonotonicMs` is captured before initialize as `now() + initializeTimeoutMs`, never at negotiate/ready. Export these two named helpers in T3's index.ts commit; neither allocates a timer.

```ts
const activationDeadlines = new WeakMap<AbortSignal, { deadline: number; now(): number }>();
export function registerActivationDeadline(signal: AbortSignal, deadline: number, now: () => number): () => void {
  if (activationDeadlines.has(signal)) throw new Error("Activation deadline already registered.");
  activationDeadlines.set(signal, { deadline, now });
  return () => { activationDeadlines.delete(signal); };
}
export function remainingActivationMs(signal: AbortSignal): number {
  signal.throwIfAborted();
  const entry = activationDeadlines.get(signal);
  if (!entry) throw new Error("Missing supervisor activation deadline.");
  const remaining = entry.deadline - entry.now();
  if (remaining <= 0) throw new Error("Activation deadline expired.");
  return remaining;
}
```

Add this internal phase helper in `ui-lifecycle.ts`; it does not add members to `Stage3RuntimePorts` or alter initialize. It wraps each `Stage3ChannelBinding` returned by the real host:

```ts
function phaseDeferred<T>() {
  let resolve!: (value: T) => void;
  let reject!: (reason: unknown) => void;
  const promise = new Promise<T>((yes, no) => { resolve = yes; reject = no; });
  void promise.catch(() => undefined);
  return { promise, resolve, reject };
}
export class ChannelActivation {
  readonly #initialized = phaseDeferred<Stage3ChannelContext>();
  readonly #ready = phaseDeferred<void>();
  readonly initialized = this.#initialized.promise;
  readonly ready = this.#ready.promise;
  #run: Promise<void> | undefined;
  #disposed = false;
  constructor(readonly context: Stage3ChannelContext, private readonly binding: Stage3ChannelBinding,
    private readonly signal: AbortSignal, private readonly current: () => boolean) {
    signal.addEventListener("abort", this.#abort, { once: true });
    if (signal.aborted) this.#abort();
  }
  #abort = () => {
    const reason = this.signal.reason ?? new Error("Channel activation aborted.");
    this.#initialized.reject(reason); this.#ready.reject(reason);
  };
  #check(): void {
    this.signal.throwIfAborted();
    if (this.#disposed || !this.current() || this.context.peer.closed)
      throw new Error("Channel owner is no longer current.");
  }
  async #wait(work: Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
    let abort!: () => void;
    const cancelled = new Promise<never>((_resolve, reject) => {
      abort = () => reject(this.signal.reason ?? new Error("Channel activation aborted."));
      this.signal.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
      if (this.signal.aborted) abort();
    });
    try { await Promise.race([work, cancelled]); this.#check(); }
    finally { this.signal.removeEventListener("abort", abort); }
  }
  afterInitialize(): Promise<void> {
    this.#run ??= this.#advance();
    return this.#run;
  }
  async #advance(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.#check();
      this.#initialized.resolve(this.context);
      await this.#wait(this.binding.initialized(this.signal));
      this.#check();
      await this.#wait(this.binding.ready(this.signal));
      this.#ready.resolve();
    } catch (error) {
      this.#initialized.reject(error); this.#ready.reject(error); throw error;
    }
  }
  dispose(): void {
    if (this.#disposed) return;
    this.#disposed = true;
    this.signal.removeEventListener("abort", this.#abort);
    const error = new Error("Channel disposed.");
    this.#initialized.reject(error); this.#ready.reject(error);
    this.binding.dispose();
  }
}
```

```ts
uiCatalogSources(): readonly UiCatalogSource[] {
  const hostEpoch = this.options.stage3Host?.hostEpoch;
  if (!hostEpoch) return [];
  return this.#entries.flatMap(({ source, plugin, generation }) => {
    const manifest = plugin.manifest;
    if (plugin.status !== "enabled" || !manifest) return [];
    const resources: UiCatalogSource["resources"] = source.kind === "builtin"
      ? { kind: "builtin", files: source.resources }

    return [{ owner: { sourceKey: plugin.sourceKey, pluginId: plugin.id, generation,
      hostEpoch, processEpoch: hostEpoch }, eligible: true, resources,
      commands: (manifest.contributes?.commands ?? []).filter(command => command.invocation === "context-v1"),
      panels: manifest.contributes?.panels ?? [], status: manifest.contributes?.status ?? [] }];
  });
}
```

```ts
async invoke(invocation: CommandInvocation, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Result<CommandValue>> {
  if (!this.plugin.commands.includes(invocation.command))
    throw new PluginError("PLUGIN_E_UNKNOWN_COMMAND", "The source does not contribute this command.");

}
```

Fill the F `builtin-launch.ts` runtime module with the declarations in **Interfaces**, retaining its existing type-only exports. T3 owns the runtime barrel export. Create `apps/desktop/src/main/plugins/builtin-launch.ts`:

```ts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { lstat, open, realpath } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { constants } from "node:fs";
import { z } from "zod";
import { diagnosticHelpDeclSchema, pluginManifestSchema, type PluginManifest } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import { PluginError, type BuiltinLaunchDescriptor, type BuiltinResourceIndex } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";

type Id = string;
export const BUILTIN_PROCESS_IDS = Object.freeze({
  "motor-test": "kobrixa.motor-test", "sensor-lab": "kobrixa.sensor-lab", "device-ev3": "kobrixa.device-ev3",
});
const indexSchema = z.strictObject({
  version: z.literal(1), pluginId: z.string(),
  files: z.array(z.strictObject({
    path: z.string().max(600), bytes: z.number().int().min(0).max(16 * 1024 * 1024),
    sha256: z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/),
  })).min(2).max(32),
});
const fail = (): never => { throw new PluginError("PLUGIN_E_ENTRY", "Shipped plugin payload is unavailable or invalid."); };
const utf8 = (bytes: Uint8Array) => new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(bytes);
export function parseBuiltinResourceIndex(value: unknown): BuiltinResourceIndex { return indexSchema.parse(value); }
export function declaredJsonPaths(manifest: PluginManifest): string[] {
  const declarations: Array<{ path: string; version: number }> = [];
  const contributes = manifest.contributes;
  for (const item of contributes?.panels ?? []) declarations.push(item.resource);
  for (const item of contributes?.status ?? []) declarations.push(item.resource);
  for (const item of contributes?.languages ?? []) declarations.push(item.tokenizer, item.configuration);
  if (contributes?.diagnosticHelp) declarations.push(contributes.diagnosticHelp);
  const paths = new Set<string>();
  for (const declaration of declarations) {
    if (declaration.version !== 1 || !diagnosticHelpDeclSchema.shape.path.safeParse(declaration.path).success) fail();
    if (["kobrixa-plugin.json", "resource-index.json"].includes(declaration.path)) fail();
    paths.add(declaration.path);
  }
  return [...paths].sort();
}
export async function regularBytes(root: string, relative: string, limit: number): Promise<Buffer> {
  if (relative !== "main.cjs" && relative !== "resource-index.json" &&
      !diagnosticHelpDeclSchema.shape.path.safeParse(relative).success) fail();
  const parts = relative.split("/");
  let current = root;
  for (let index = 0; index < parts.length; index++) {
    current = path.join(current, parts[index]!);
    const stat = await lstat(current);
    if (stat.isSymbolicLink() || (index + 1 === parts.length ? !stat.isFile() : !stat.isDirectory())) fail();
  }
  const resolved = await realpath(current);
  const inside = path.relative(root, resolved);
  if (inside === ".." || inside.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) || path.isAbsolute(inside)) fail();
  const handle = await open(resolved, constants.O_RDONLY | (constants.O_NOFOLLOW ?? 0));
  try {
    const before = await handle.stat();
    if (!before.isFile() || before.size > limit) fail();
    // Bounded allocation; readFile could allocate an unbounded file grown after stat.
    const bytes = Buffer.alloc(limit + 1);
    let size = 0;
    while (size <= limit) {
      const { bytesRead } = await handle.read(bytes, size, bytes.length - size, size);
      if (bytesRead === 0) break;
      size += bytesRead;
    }
    const after = await handle.stat();
    if (size > limit || size !== before.size || before.size !== after.size ||
        before.mtimeMs !== after.mtimeMs || before.ino !== after.ino) fail();
    return bytes.subarray(0, size);
  } finally { await handle.close(); }
}
export async function validateBuiltinLeaf(packageRoot: string, pluginId: Id): Promise<{
  root: string; manifest: PluginManifest; index: BuiltinResourceIndex; resources: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
}> {
  try {
    if (!path.isAbsolute(packageRoot)) fail();
    const leaf = await lstat(packageRoot);
    if (!leaf.isDirectory() || leaf.isSymbolicLink()) fail();
    const root = await realpath(packageRoot);
    const index = parseBuiltinResourceIndex(JSON.parse(utf8(await regularBytes(root, "resource-index.json", 16 * 1024))));
    if (index.pluginId !== pluginId) fail();
    const names = index.files.map((file) => file.path);
    if (new Set(names).size !== names.length || JSON.stringify(names) !== JSON.stringify([...names].sort())) fail();
    const manifestBytes = await regularBytes(root, "kobrixa-plugin.json", 64 * 1024);
    const manifest = pluginManifestSchema.parse(JSON.parse(new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(manifestBytes)));
    if (manifest.id !== pluginId || manifest.runtime.kind !== "node" || manifest.runtime.entry !== "main.cjs") fail();
    const expected = ["main.cjs", "kobrixa-plugin.json", ...declaredJsonPaths(manifest)].sort();
    if (JSON.stringify(names) !== JSON.stringify(expected)) fail();
    const resources: Record<string, string> = Object.create(null) as Record<string, string>;
    for (const file of index.files) {
      const data = file.path === "kobrixa-plugin.json" ? manifestBytes
        : await regularBytes(root, file.path, file.path === "main.cjs" ? 16 * 1024 * 1024 : 1024 * 1024);
      if (data.length !== file.bytes || createHash("sha256").update(data).digest("hex") !== file.sha256) fail();
      if (file.path.endsWith(".json") && file.path !== "kobrixa-plugin.json") resources[file.path] = utf8(data);
    }
    return { root, manifest, index, resources };
  } catch { return fail(); }
}
export async function resolveBuiltinLaunch(input: {
  sourceKey: string; pluginId: Id; slug: string; packaged: boolean; appPath: string; buildRoot: string;
}): Promise<BuiltinLaunchDescriptor> {
  if (!Object.hasOwn(BUILTIN_PROCESS_IDS, input.slug) ||
      BUILTIN_PROCESS_IDS[input.slug as keyof typeof BUILTIN_PROCESS_IDS] !== input.pluginId ||
      input.sourceKey !== `builtin:${input.pluginId}`) fail();
  if (input.packaged && path.basename(input.appPath) !== "app.asar") fail();
  const root = input.packaged
    ? path.join(path.dirname(input.appPath), "app.asar.unpacked", ".vite", "build", "plugins", input.slug)
    : path.join(input.buildRoot, "plugins", input.slug);
  try {
    const parent = input.packaged ? path.join(path.dirname(input.appPath), "app.asar.unpacked") : input.buildRoot;
    if (!path.isAbsolute(parent)) fail();
    const parentReal = await realpath(parent);
    const rootReal = await realpath(root);
    const relative = path.relative(parentReal, rootReal);
    if (relative === ".." || relative.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) || path.isAbsolute(relative)) fail();
    let current = parent;
    for (const segment of path.relative(parent, root).split(path.sep)) {
      current = path.join(current, segment);
      const entry = await lstat(current);
      if (!entry.isDirectory() || entry.isSymbolicLink()) fail();
    }
  } catch { return fail(); }
  const validated = await validateBuiltinLeaf(root, input.pluginId);
  return { sourceKey: input.sourceKey, pluginId: input.pluginId, policy: "optional", runtime: "node",
    packageRoot: validated.root, entry: "main.cjs", manifest: "kobrixa-plugin.json", resourceIndex: "resource-index.json" };
}
```

The validator accepts explicit trusted fixture IDs only when called directly by the test host. `resolveBuiltinLaunch` remains the production allowlist entry point. No flag in a renderer request can broaden it. The build validator reads original bytes; T2 still applies the per-resource UI schema/budget before catalog publication.

Create `apps/desktop/plugin-resource-index.ts`:

```ts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { mkdir, realpath, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { pluginManifestSchema } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { BuiltinResourceIndex } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import { declaredJsonPaths, regularBytes, validateBuiltinLeaf } from "./src/main/plugins/builtin-launch.js";

export async function emitResourceIndex(sourceRoot: string, outputRoot: string, pluginId: string): Promise<BuiltinResourceIndex> {
  const source = await realpath(sourceRoot);
  const output = await realpath(outputRoot);
  const manifestBytes = await regularBytes(source, "kobrixa-plugin.json", 64 * 1024);
  const manifest = pluginManifestSchema.parse(JSON.parse(new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(manifestBytes)));
  if (manifest.id !== pluginId || manifest.runtime.kind !== "node" || manifest.runtime.entry !== "main.cjs")
    throw new Error("Invalid builtin process manifest.");
  const names = ["kobrixa-plugin.json", "main.cjs", ...declaredJsonPaths(manifest)].sort();
  if (names.length > 32) throw new Error("Builtin resource index exceeds 32 files.");
  const files: BuiltinResourceIndex["files"] = [];
  for (const name of names) {
    const bytes = name === "main.cjs" ? await regularBytes(output, name, 16 * 1024 * 1024)
      : name === "kobrixa-plugin.json" ? manifestBytes : await regularBytes(source, name, 1024 * 1024);
    if (name !== "main.cjs") {
      await mkdir(path.dirname(path.join(output, name)), { recursive: true });
      await writeFile(path.join(output, name), bytes);
    }
    files.push({ path: name, bytes: bytes.length, sha256: createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex") });
  }
  const index: BuiltinResourceIndex = { version: 1, pluginId, files };
  const encoded = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(index));
  if (encoded.length > 16 * 1024) throw new Error("Builtin resource index exceeds 16 KiB.");
  await writeFile(path.join(output, "resource-index.json"), encoded);
  await validateBuiltinLeaf(output, pluginId);
  return index;
}
```

```ts
import path from "node:path";

import type { UserConfig } from "vite";

const desktopRoot = fileURLToPath(new URL(".", import.meta.url));
export function builtinPluginConfig(input: {
  slug: string; pluginId: string; sourceRoot: string; buildRoot?: string;
}): UserConfig {
  if (!/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$/.test(input.slug)) throw new Error("Invalid builtin slug.");
  const output = path.join(input.buildRoot ?? path.join(desktopRoot, ".vite/build"), "plugins", input.slug);
  let resolvedOutput = output;
  return {
    build: {
      outDir: output, emptyOutDir: true, sourcemap: true, target: "node24",
      rollupOptions: {
        input: path.join(input.sourceRoot, "src/main.ts"), external: [],
        output: { format: "cjs", entryFileNames: "main.cjs", inlineDynamicImports: true },
      },
    },
    plugins: [{ name: "kobrixa-builtin-resource-index", enforce: "post",
      configResolved(config) { resolvedOutput = path.resolve(config.root, config.build.outDir); },
      async writeBundle() { await emitResourceIndex(input.sourceRoot, resolvedOutput, input.pluginId); } }],
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Replace the Node utility launcher while preserving Python behavior.**

Replace `launchNode` in `apps/desktop/src/main/plugins/launchers.ts` and add the environment helper below. Retain the existing imports, console output adapter, `createDesktopLauncher` signature, and Python branch.

```ts
export function builtinProcessEnvironment(source: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): NodeJS.ProcessEnv {
  const environment = { ...source };
  for (const name of Object.keys(environment)) {
    const key = name.toUpperCase();
    if (key === "KOBRIXA_RESOURCE_OWNER" || key === "NODE_OPTIONS" || key === "NODE_PATH" || key === "ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE") delete environment[name];
  }
  return environment;
}
async function launchNode(
  plugin: LaunchablePlugin,
  onOutput: (line: string) => void,
  spawnTimeoutMs: number,
): Promise<PluginProcess> {
  const child = utilityProcess.fork(plugin.entry, [], {
    cwd: plugin.directory, serviceName: `Kobrixa plugin ${plugin.id}`, stdio: "pipe",
    env: { ...builtinProcessEnvironment(process.env),
      ...(plugin.channelOwner ? { KOBRIXA_RESOURCE_OWNER: JSON.stringify(plugin.channelOwner) } : {}) },
  });
  let killSent = false;
  const signal = (value: "SIGTERM" | "SIGKILL") => {
    if (value === "SIGKILL") killSent = true;
    try { if (child.pid !== undefined) process.kill(child.pid, value); else child.kill(); }
    catch { /* An already-exited process has no signal target. */ }
  };
  const exits = new ExitSignal();
  const tail = new OutputTail(onOutput);
  let ended = false;
  let abandoned = false;
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  let ports: InstanceType<typeof MessageChannelMain> | undefined;
  let rejectStart: ((error: Error) => void) | undefined;
  child.stdout?.on("data", (chunk: Buffer) => tail.push(chunk, "stdout"));
  child.stderr?.on("data", (chunk: Buffer) => tail.push(chunk, "stderr"));
  const closePorts = () => { ports?.port1.close(); ports?.port2.close(); };
  child.once("exit", (code) => {
    ended = true; clearTimeout(timer); closePorts(); tail.end(); exits.emit({ code });
    rejectStart?.(new PluginError("PLUGIN_E_LAUNCH", "Plugin exited during launch."));
  });
  try {
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      rejectStart = reject;
      timer = setTimeout(() => {
        abandoned = true; signal("SIGKILL");
        reject(new PluginError("PLUGIN_E_LAUNCH", `The plugin process did not start within ${spawnTimeoutMs} ms.`));
      }, spawnTimeoutMs);
      child.once("spawn", () => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        if (abandoned || ended) { signal("SIGKILL"); return; }
        resolve();
      });
    });
    rejectStart = undefined;
    if (ended || abandoned) throw new Error("Plugin exited before channel handoff.");
    ports = new MessageChannelMain();
    child.postMessage({ type: "kobrixa-plugin-port" }, [ports.port2]);
    ports.port1.start();
    if (ended) throw new Error("Plugin exited during channel handoff.");
    const channel = ports.port1;
    const kill = escalatingKill(exits, signal);
    return {
      send: (message) => { if (ended) throw new Error("Plugin process exited."); channel.postMessage(message); },
      onMessage: (listener) => {
        const receive = (event: Electron.MessageEvent) => {
          if (typeof event.data === "string") listener(event.data);
        };
        channel.on("message", receive);
        return () => channel.off("message", receive);
      },
      onExit: (listener) => exits.subscribe(listener),
      ...kill, stderrTail: () => tail.text(),
    };
  } catch (error) {
    abandoned = true; closePorts();
    if (!ended && !killSent) signal("SIGKILL");
    throw error instanceof PluginError ? error : new PluginError("PLUGIN_E_LAUNCH", "Plugin channel could not be started.");
  } finally { clearTimeout(timer); rejectStart = undefined; }
}
```

The timeout records its SIGKILL, so the catch does not send a duplicate. The late-spawn listener deliberately sends a fresh kill because a previously pid-less child may only then have obtained a PID. All lifetime listeners are installed before awaiting spawn, closing the old listener gap.

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { ResourceOwner } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import { UserPersistenceActions } from "./user-persistence-actions.js";

const owner: ResourceOwner = { sourceKey: "dev:0123456789abcdef", pluginId: "acme.ui",
  generation: 1, hostEpoch: "host", processEpoch: "process" };
const scope = { hostEpoch: "host", workbenchInstance: "window-1" };
function fixture() {
  let now = 0; let live = true;
  const ledger = new UserPersistenceActions(() => now, () => live);
  const mint = () => ledger.mint(owner, scope, 3);
  return { ledger, mint, time: (value: number) => { now = value; }, retire: () => { live = false; } };
}
describe("one user gesture, one feature persistence claim", () => {
  it("denies invocation/option IDs and consumes export/copy across purposes", () => {
    const h = fixture(); const ref = h.mint();
    expect(h.ledger.claim({ owner, actionRef: "invocation-id" }, "storage.export").ok).toBe(false);
    expect(h.ledger.claim({ owner, actionRef: "core-option-id" }, "storage.export").ok).toBe(false);
    expect(h.ledger.claim({ owner, actionRef: ref }, "ui.clipboard")).toEqual({ ok: true, value: { action: ref } });
    expect(h.ledger.claim({ owner, actionRef: ref }, "storage.export").ok).toBe(false);
  });
  it("expires exactly at 5,000 ms without extending on a denied request", () => {
    const h = fixture(); const ref = h.mint(); h.time(5_000);
    expect(h.ledger.claim({ owner, actionRef: ref }, "storage.export")).toMatchObject({
      ok: false, error: { code: "PLUGIN_E_PERMISSION_DENIED", detail: { kind: "permission", reason: "user-action-required" } },
    });
  });
  it.each(["sourceKey", "pluginId", "hostEpoch", "processEpoch"] as const)("binds %s", (field) => {
    const h = fixture(); const ref = h.mint();
    expect(h.ledger.claim({ owner: { ...owner, [field]: "foreign" }, actionRef: ref }, "storage.export").ok).toBe(false);
    expect(h.ledger.claim({ owner, actionRef: ref }, "storage.export").ok).toBe(true);
  });
  it("checks generation and current UI/window lifetime at claim time", () => {
    const h = fixture(); const ref = h.mint();
    expect(h.ledger.claim({ owner: { ...owner, generation: 2 }, actionRef: ref }, "ui.clipboard").ok).toBe(false);
    h.retire(); expect(h.ledger.claim({ owner, actionRef: ref }, "ui.clipboard").ok).toBe(false);
  });
  it("revokes all refs on workbench replacement", () => {
    const h = fixture(); const ref = h.mint(); h.ledger.revokeWindow(scope);
    expect(h.ledger.claim({ owner, actionRef: ref }, "storage.export").ok).toBe(false);
  });
  it("does not create an unbounded ledger when a renderer keeps clicking", () => {

    expect(() => h.mint()).toThrow(); h.time(5_000); expect(() => h.mint()).not.toThrow();
  });
});
```

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import type { ResourceOwner } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import {
  PluginError, type CoreWindowScope, type UserPersistenceActionContext, type UserPersistenceActionPort,
} from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";

const ownerKey = (o: ResourceOwner) => JSON.stringify([o.sourceKey, o.pluginId, o.generation, o.hostEpoch, o.processEpoch]);

type Entry = { owner: ResourceOwner; scope: CoreWindowScope; uiResourceGeneration: number; expires: number };
export class UserPersistenceActions implements UserPersistenceActionPort {
  readonly #entries = new Map<string, Entry>();
  constructor(private readonly now: () => number,
    private readonly current: (owner: ResourceOwner, scope: CoreWindowScope, uiResourceGeneration: number) => boolean) {}
  mint(owner: ResourceOwner, scope: CoreWindowScope, uiResourceGeneration: number): string {
    for (const [key, value] of this.#entries) if (value.expires <= this.now()) this.#entries.delete(key);
    if (!this.current(owner, scope, uiResourceGeneration) || this.#entries.size >= 256)
      throw new PluginError("PLUGIN_E_PERMISSION_DENIED", "A current user action is required.");
    const ref = randomUUID();
    this.#entries.set(ref, { owner: { ...owner }, scope: { ...scope }, uiResourceGeneration, expires: this.now() + 5_000 });
    return ref;
  }
  claim(context: UserPersistenceActionContext, _purpose: "storage.export" | "ui.clipboard"):
    ReturnType<UserPersistenceActionPort["claim"]> {
    const entry = this.#entries.get(context.actionRef);
    if (!entry || entry.expires <= this.now() || ownerKey(entry.owner) !== ownerKey(context.owner) ||
        !this.current(entry.owner, entry.scope, entry.uiResourceGeneration)) return {
      ok: false, error: { code: "PLUGIN_E_PERMISSION_DENIED", message: "A current user action is required.",
        detail: { kind: "permission", reason: "user-action-required" } },
    };
    this.#entries.delete(context.actionRef);
    return { ok: true, value: { action: context.actionRef } };
  }
  revokeWindow(scope: CoreWindowScope): void {
    for (const [key, entry] of this.#entries)
      if (entry.scope.hostEpoch === scope.hostEpoch && entry.scope.workbenchInstance === scope.workbenchInstance)
        this.#entries.delete(key);
  }
  revokeOwner(owner: ResourceOwner): void {
    for (const [key, entry] of this.#entries) if (ownerKey(entry.owner) === ownerKey(owner)) this.#entries.delete(key);
  }
}
```

Only `ui-bridge.ts` calls `mint`, after validating an activate or hold-begin event. Timers, readiness, patches, heartbeat, hold-end and management refresh do not call it. An `invocationId` is minted separately even when the same click also yields an actionRef.

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import type { UiBinding, ResourceOwner } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { DeviceIntentPort } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import { UiIntent } from "./ui-intent.js";
const binding: UiBinding = { contributionId: "acme.ui.panel", panelInstance: "panel", kind: "panel",
  uiResourceGeneration: 2, generation: 1, hostEpoch: "host", processEpoch: "process" };
const owner: ResourceOwner = { sourceKey: "dev:0123456789abcdef", pluginId: "acme.ui",
  generation: 1, hostEpoch: "host", processEpoch: "process" };
beforeEach(() => vi.useFakeTimers()); afterEach(() => vi.useRealTimers());
function harness() {
  const challenges: string[] = [];
  const device: DeviceIntentPort = {
    bindMotionScope: vi.fn(() => "scope"), pulsePanel: vi.fn(), beginGesture: vi.fn(() => "gesture"),
    pulseGesture: vi.fn(), endGesture: vi.fn(), revokeScope: vi.fn(),
  };
  const intent = new UiIntent(device, () => performance.now(), (event) => {
    if (event.type === "pulse") challenges.push(event.challenge);
  });
  intent.bind(binding, { owner, contextRef: "context", panelInstance: binding.panelInstance,
    uiResourceGeneration: binding.uiResourceGeneration, workbenchInstance: "window" });
  return { device, intent, challenges };
}
it("requires a fresh pulse before motion and emits at 100 ms cadence", async () => {
  const h = harness(); expect(h.intent.begin(binding, "input")).toBeNull();
  expect(h.intent.pulse(binding, h.challenges[0]!, null, null)).toBe(true);
  expect(h.intent.begin(binding, "input")).toBe("gesture");
  await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(100); expect(h.challenges).toHaveLength(2);
  expect(h.intent.pulse(binding, h.challenges[1]!, "gesture", "input")).toBe(true);
  expect(h.device.pulseGesture).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1); h.intent.dispose();
});
it("expires at issue+350, not receipt+350, and never accepts a challenge twice", async () => {
  const h = harness(); const first = h.challenges[0]!;
  await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(300);
  expect(h.intent.pulse(binding, first, null, null)).toBe(true);
  expect(h.intent.pulse(binding, first, null, null)).toBe(false);
  await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(49); expect(h.device.revokeScope).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1); expect(h.device.revokeScope).toHaveBeenCalled();
  expect(h.intent.begin(binding, "late")).toBeNull(); h.intent.dispose();
});
it("release before a delayed command response tombstones the input token synchronously", () => {
  const h = harness(); h.intent.pulse(binding, h.challenges[0]!, null, null);
  expect(h.intent.begin(binding, "pressed")).toBe("gesture");
  h.intent.end(binding, "pressed", "end");
  expect(h.device.endGesture).toHaveBeenCalledWith("gesture", "released");
  expect(h.intent.begin(binding, "pressed")).toBeNull();

});
it("a cancel received before begin prevents the late begin", () => {
  const h = harness(); h.intent.pulse(binding, h.challenges[0]!, null, null);
  h.intent.end(binding, "out-of-order", "cancel");

  expect(h.device.beginGesture).not.toHaveBeenCalled(); h.intent.dispose();
});
it.each(["hidden", "closed", "window-lost", "resource-retired"] as const)(

it("keeps token tombstones across hide/show and releases them when the binding closes", () => {
```

Expected red: missing `UiIntent`. Create `apps/desktop/src/main/plugins/ui-intent.ts`:

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import type { UiBinding } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { DeviceIntentPort, MotionScopeBinding, UiBridgeEvent } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";

type Session = {
  binding: UiBinding; ownerSource: string; scope: string; alive: boolean; pulsed: boolean;
  expires: number; lastIssue: number; challenges: Map<string, number>; tokens: Set<string>;
  active: { token: string; gesture: string } | null;
  cadence?: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>; expiry?: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
};
function key(binding: UiBinding): string {
  return JSON.stringify([binding.contributionId, binding.panelInstance, binding.kind, binding.uiResourceGeneration,
    binding.generation, binding.hostEpoch, binding.processEpoch]);
}
export class UiIntent {
  readonly #sessions = new Map<string, Session>();
  readonly #tombstones = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  #sequence = 0;
  constructor(private readonly device: DeviceIntentPort, private readonly now: () => number,
    private readonly publish: (event: UiBridgeEvent) => void) {}
  bind(binding: UiBinding, input: MotionScopeBinding): void {
    this.revoke(binding, "resource-retired");
    const tokens = this.#tombstones.get(key(binding)) ?? new Set<string>();
    this.#tombstones.set(key(binding), tokens);
    const session: Session = { binding, ownerSource: input.owner.sourceKey,
      scope: this.device.bindMotionScope(input), alive: true, pulsed: false,
      expires: this.now() + 350, lastIssue: -Infinity, challenges: new Map(), tokens, active: null };
    this.#sessions.set(key(binding), session);
    this.#issue(session); session.cadence = setInterval(() => this.#issue(session), 100); this.#expire(session);
  }
  #issue(session: Session): void {
    if (!session.alive) return;
    if (session.challenges.size >= 4 || this.now() >= session.expires) {
      this.revoke(session.binding, "resource-retired"); return;
    }
    const challenge = randomUUID(); session.challenges.set(challenge, this.now());
    this.publish({ type: "pulse", binding: session.binding, challenge });
  }
  #expire(session: Session): void {
    clearTimeout(session.expiry);
    session.expiry = setTimeout(() => {
      if (session.alive && this.now() >= session.expires) this.revoke(session.binding, "resource-retired");
    }, Math.max(0, session.expires - this.now()));
  }
  pulse(binding: UiBinding, challenge: string, gesture: string | null, inputToken: string | null): boolean {
    const session = this.#sessions.get(key(binding));
    const issued = session?.challenges.get(challenge);
    if (!session?.alive || issued === undefined || issued <= session.lastIssue || this.now() >= issued + 350 ||
        this.now() >= session.expires || gesture !== (session.active?.gesture ?? null) ||
        inputToken !== (session.active?.token ?? null)) return false;
    session.challenges.delete(challenge);
    for (const [id, time] of session.challenges) if (time <= issued) session.challenges.delete(id);
    session.lastIssue = issued; session.pulsed = true; session.expires = issued + 350;
    try {
      this.device.pulsePanel(session.scope, ++this.#sequence);
      if (session.active) this.device.pulseGesture(session.active.gesture, ++this.#sequence);
    } catch { this.revoke(binding, "resource-retired"); return false; }
    this.#expire(session); return true;
  }
  scope(binding: UiBinding): string | undefined {
    const session = this.#sessions.get(key(binding));
    return session?.alive && session.pulsed && this.now() < session.expires ? session.scope : undefined;
  }
  begin(binding: UiBinding, inputToken: string): string | null {
    const session = this.#sessions.get(key(binding));
    if (!session?.alive || !this.scope(binding) || session.tokens.has(inputToken) || session.active ||
        [...this.#sessions.values()].some((item) => item.ownerSource === session.ownerSource && item.active)) return null;
    if (session.tokens.size >= 256) { this.revoke(binding, "resource-retired"); return null; }
    session.tokens.add(inputToken);
    try {
      const gesture = this.device.beginGesture(session.scope, ++this.#sequence);
      session.active = { token: inputToken, gesture }; return gesture;
    } catch { this.revoke(binding, "resource-retired"); return null; }
  }
  end(binding: UiBinding, inputToken: string, phase: "end" | "cancel"): void {
    const session = this.#sessions.get(key(binding));
    if (!session) return;
    if (session.tokens.size >= 256 && !session.tokens.has(inputToken)) { this.revoke(binding, "resource-retired"); return; }
    session.tokens.add(inputToken);
    if (session.active?.token !== inputToken) return;
    const gesture = session.active.gesture; session.active = null;
    this.device.endGesture(gesture, phase === "end" ? "released" : "cancelled");
  }
  cancelHold(binding: UiBinding): void {
    const session = this.#sessions.get(key(binding));
    if (session?.active) this.end(binding, session.active.token, "cancel");
  }
  liveGesture(binding: UiBinding, inputToken: string, gesture: string): boolean {
    const session = this.#sessions.get(key(binding));
    return !!session?.alive && !!this.scope(binding) && session.active?.token === inputToken && session.active.gesture === gesture;
  }
  revoke(binding: UiBinding, reason: Parameters<DeviceIntentPort["revokeScope"]>[1]): void {
    const sessionKey = key(binding);
    if (reason === "closed" || reason === "window-lost") this.#tombstones.delete(sessionKey);
    const session = this.#sessions.get(sessionKey); if (!session) return;
    session.alive = false; clearInterval(session.cadence); clearTimeout(session.expiry);
    const gesture = session.active?.gesture;
    session.active = null; session.challenges.clear(); this.#sessions.delete(sessionKey);
    try { if (gesture) this.device.endGesture(gesture, "cancelled"); }
    finally { this.device.revokeScope(session.scope, reason); }
  }
  forget(binding: UiBinding): void { this.revoke(binding, "resource-retired"); this.#tombstones.delete(key(binding)); }
  dispose(): void {
    for (const session of [...this.#sessions.values()]) this.revoke(session.binding, "window-lost");
    this.#tombstones.clear();
  }
}
```

```ts
export type RetirementReport = { owner: ResourceOwner; device: DeviceDisposition;
  storage: DrainReport; processStopped: boolean; blocker: boolean };
export type CloseReport = { blocker: boolean; timedOut: boolean; legacySaved: boolean;
  device: DeviceDisposition; owners: RetirementReport[] };
type EndWork = { event: ReservationEnded; offer: DrainOffer | null; promise: Promise<DrainReport>;
  resolve(report: DrainReport): void; terminal: boolean; report?: DrainReport };
type RetirementWork = { owner: ResourceOwner; device: Promise<DeviceDisposition>;
  storage: Promise<DrainReport>; done: Promise<void>; settled: boolean;
  report?: RetirementReport };
const unknownDevice = (): DeviceDisposition => ({ stopConfirmed: false, journalCommitted: false, faultIds: [] });
```

In the existing `#ended` completion, assign `work.report = report` immediately before `work.terminal = ...`; retain the original `promise`, resolver, deadline and deferred dispatch. Replace `retire` with this implementation, which still delegates to the unchanged R150 primitive:

```ts
retire(owner: ResourceOwner, reason: OwnerRetirement, deadlineMonotonicMs?: number): Promise<void> {
  const key = ownerKey(owner), existing = this.#retiring.get(key);
  if (existing) return existing.done;
  const t0 = this.input.now();
  let resolve!: () => void;
  const done = new Promise<void>(yes => { resolve = yes; });
  let accept!: (value: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof retireStage3Owner>>) => void;
  let fail!: (error: unknown) => void;
  const receipt = new Promise<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof retireStage3Owner>>>((yes, no) => { accept = yes; fail = no; });
  const device = this.#bounded(receipt.then(value => value.device), t0 + 20_000,
    "Device stop/journal deadline expired.");
  const storage = receipt.then(value => value.persistence);
  const row: RetirementWork = { owner: { ...owner }, device, storage, done, settled: false };
  this.#retiring.set(key, row); // Publish before synchronous onEnded/reentrant retirement.
  try {
    void retireStage3Owner(this.input.ports, owner, this.input.alive(owner) ? reason : "crashed",
      this.input.now, this.input.dispatch, deadlineMonotonicMs).then(accept, fail);
  } catch (error) { fail(error); }
  void Promise.all([device, storage]).then(([d, report]) => {
    row.settled = true;
    row.report = { owner: row.owner, device: d, storage: report, processStopped: this.#closed, blocker: true };
    this.#refresh(row);
    resolve(); // Resource disposition completed; close separately checks the authoritative report.
  }).catch((error: unknown) => {
    row.settled = true;
    row.report ??= { owner: row.owner, device: unknownDevice(), storage: uncertain("Retirement unconfirmed."),
      processStopped: false, blocker: true };
    resolve(); this.input.report(error);
  });
  void done.catch(() => undefined);
  return done;
}
#refresh(row: RetirementWork): void {
  if (!row.report) return;
  try { this.#assert(row.report.device, [row.report.storage]); row.report.blocker = !row.report.processStopped; }
  catch { row.report.blocker = true; }
}
reports(): RetirementReport[] {
  return structuredClone([...this.#retiring.values()].flatMap(row => row.report ? [row.report] : []));
}
reconcile(owner: ResourceOwner, device: DeviceDisposition, storage: DrainReport): boolean {
  const row = this.#retiring.get(ownerKey(owner));
  if (!row?.settled || !row.report) return false;
  // Callers pass actual core recovery results, never a UI-supplied processStopped boolean.
  row.report = { ...row.report, device: structuredClone(device), storage: structuredClone(storage) };
  for (const work of this.#ends.values()) if (ownerKey(work.event.owner) === ownerKey(owner)) {
    work.report = structuredClone(storage);
    work.terminal = !storage.blocker && storage.state === "saved";
  }
  this.#refresh(row); return true;
}
reconcileRecovery(recovery: Handle, report: DrainReport): void {
  for (const work of this.#ends.values()) if (work.report?.recovery === recovery) {
    work.report = structuredClone(report); work.terminal = !report.blocker && report.state === "saved";
  }
  for (const row of this.#retiring.values()) if (row.settled && row.report?.storage.recovery === recovery) {
    row.report.storage = structuredClone(report); this.#refresh(row);
  }
}
async pendingSession(sessionId: Handle): Promise<DrainReport[]> {
  return this.#sessionReports(sessionId);
}
async #retirementDisposition(owner: ResourceOwner, reason: OwnerRetirement, deadline: number): Promise<void> {
  const pending = this.retire(owner, reason, deadline);
  const row = this.#retiring.get(ownerKey(owner))!;
  if (!row.settled) await pending.catch(() => undefined);
  if (!row.report) throw new CleanupBlocked(null, []);
  this.#assert(row.report.device, [row.report.storage]);
}
allowCloseRetry(): void {
  // close already clears only its settled attempt. Keep #closeStarted, all work promises and grants.
}
```

```ts
    .map(async work => { const original = await work.promise; return work.report ?? original; }));
}
```

`input.shutdown()` is the actual manager supervisor shutdown receipt. It must reject until original children emit actual exit; timeout/kill-request/state publication is not exit. No reconcile method changes this bit. Keep D150 Disconnect/suspend authority and legacy blockers. For suspended recovery replace the stored rejected suspension with a recheck of the original captured quiescence and current session reports only after that suspension settles; use this concrete `suspend` body:

```ts
suspend(sessionId: Handle): Promise<void> {
  const existing = this.#suspending.get(sessionId); if (existing) return existing;
  const t0 = this.input.now();
  const q = this.input.sessions.quiesce(sessionId, { reason: "suspended" });
  for (const event of q.ended) this.#ended(event);
  const device = this.#bounded(q.settled, t0 + 20_000, "Suspend stop/journal deadline expired.");
  const legacy = this.input.legacyFlush("suspend");
  const work = Promise.all([device, this.#sessionReports(sessionId), legacy])
    .then(([d, reports]) => this.#assert(d, reports));
  this.#suspending.set(sessionId, work);
  void work.catch((error: unknown) => this.input.report(error));
  // Capture original device/legacy promises; no second quiesce or storage dispatch on wake.
  this.#resumeChecks.set(sessionId, async () => {
    await work.catch(() => undefined);
    const [d] = await Promise.all([device, legacy]);
    this.#assert(d, await this.#sessionReports(sessionId));
  });
  return work;
}
async resume(sessionId: Handle): Promise<void> {
  const check = this.#resumeChecks.get(sessionId); if (!check) return;
  await check(); this.input.sessions.resume(sessionId);
  this.#suspending.delete(sessionId); this.#resumeChecks.delete(sessionId);
}
```

Add `readonly #resumeChecks = new Map<Handle, () => Promise<void>>();` to the same class. It contains observation closures only. It cannot dispatch a drain. Keep Disconnect's original claimed-action path; a retry requires a fresh trusted action and reads reconciled session reports.

Create shutdown-coordinator.ts as this facade (no subscriptions, maps or timers):

```ts
import type { ResourceOwner } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { CoreActionReference, OwnerRetirement, DrainReport } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import { LifecycleCoordinator, type CloseReport } from "../device-broker/lifecycle-coordinator.js";
export type { CloseReport } from "../device-broker/lifecycle-coordinator.js";
export class ShutdownCoordinator {
  constructor(private readonly lifecycle: LifecycleCoordinator) {}
  retire(owner: ResourceOwner, reason: OwnerRetirement, deadline?: number) {
    return this.lifecycle.retire(owner, reason, deadline);
  }
  disconnect(session: string, action: CoreActionReference) { return this.lifecycle.disconnect(session, action); }
  suspend(session: string) { return this.lifecycle.suspend(session); }
  resume(session: string) { return this.lifecycle.resume(session); }
  pendingSession(session: string) { return this.lifecycle.pendingSession(session); }
  reconcileRecovery(recovery: string, report: DrainReport) { this.lifecycle.reconcileRecovery(recovery, report); }
  allowCloseRetry() { this.lifecycle.allowCloseRetry(); }
  async close(reason: "shutdown" | "update"): Promise<CloseReport> {
    try {
      await this.lifecycle.close(reason === "shutdown" ? "close" : "update");
      return { blocker: false, timedOut: false, legacySaved: true,
        device: { stopConfirmed: true, journalCommitted: true, faultIds: [] }, owners: this.lifecycle.reports() };
    } catch {
      return { blocker: true, timedOut: false, legacySaved: false,
        device: { stopConfirmed: false, journalCommitted: false, faultIds: [] }, owners: this.lifecycle.reports() };
    }
  }
  dispose(): void { /* Lifetime belongs to composeDesktopMain. */ }
}
```

Extend `apps/desktop/src/main/plugins/core-recovery.ts`, retaining D150's `CoreActionLedger` and `createCoreActionLedger` implementation unchanged. Merge the imports below and add only the recovery projection:

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import type {
  CoreActionReference, CoreActionTarget, CoreActionValidationPort, CoreRecoveryItem,
  CoreRecoveryPort, CoreRecoverySnapshot, CoreWindowScope,
} from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";

const scopeKey = (scope: CoreWindowScope) => JSON.stringify([scope.hostEpoch, scope.workbenchInstance]);
export type RecoveryEntry = {
  item: CoreRecoveryItem;
  options: ReadonlyMap<string, { target: CoreActionTarget; execute(action: CoreActionReference): Promise<void> }>;
};
const stale = () => ({ ok: false as const, error: { code: "PLUGIN_E_STALE_RESOURCE" as const,
  message: "Recovery selection is no longer current.", detail: { kind: "resource" as const, reason: "stale" as const, resource: "rpc" as const } } });
export class CoreRecovery implements CoreRecoveryPort {
  readonly #listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  readonly #cursors = new Map<string, { offset: number; revision: number; scope: string; expires: number }>();
  #revision = 0;
  constructor(private readonly input: {
    scope(): CoreWindowScope; entries(): readonly RecoveryEntry[]; actions: CoreActionLedger; now(): number;
    openDetail(input: {itemId: string}, scope: CoreWindowScope): void;
  }) {}
  changed(): void { this.#revision++; this.#cursors.clear(); for (const listener of this.#listeners) listener(); }
  onChanged(listener: () => void): () => void { this.#listeners.add(listener); return () => this.#listeners.delete(listener); }
  async snapshot(input: { cursor?: string }): ReturnType<CoreRecoveryPort["snapshot"]> {
    const scope = this.input.scope(); let offset = 0;
    if (input.cursor !== undefined) {
      const cursor = this.#cursors.get(input.cursor);
      if (!cursor || cursor.revision !== this.#revision || cursor.scope !== scopeKey(scope) || cursor.expires <= this.input.now()) return stale();
      offset = cursor.offset;
    }
    const priority = (item: CoreRecoveryItem) =>
      ["stopping", "unconfirmed"].includes(item.state) ? 0 : item.kind === "storage" ? 1 : item.kind === "process" ? 2 : 3;
    const entries = [...this.input.entries()].sort((a, b) => priority(a.item) - priority(b.item) || a.item.id.localeCompare(b.item.id, "en", { numeric: true }));
    const snapshot: CoreRecoverySnapshot = { hostEpoch: scope.hostEpoch, revision: this.#revision, items: [], nextCursor: null };
    let next = offset;
    while (next < entries.length && snapshot.items.length < 16) {
      const item = entries[next]!.item;
      const trial = { ...snapshot, items: [...snapshot.items, item], nextCursor: "0".repeat(36) };
      if (Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(trial), "utf8") > 256 * 1024) {
        if (snapshot.items.length === 0) return stale();
        break;
      }
      snapshot.items.push(structuredClone(item)); next++;
    }
    if (next < entries.length) {
      for (const [key, cursor] of this.#cursors) if (cursor.expires <= this.input.now()) this.#cursors.delete(key);
      if (this.#cursors.size >= 64) this.#cursors.delete(this.#cursors.keys().next().value!);
      const cursor = randomUUID(); this.#cursors.set(cursor, { offset: next, revision: this.#revision,
        scope: scopeKey(scope), expires: this.input.now() + 30_000 }); snapshot.nextCursor = cursor;
    }
    return { ok: true, value: snapshot };
  }
  async act(input: { itemId: string; actionId: string }): ReturnType<CoreRecoveryPort["act"]> {
    const entry = this.input.entries().find((candidate) => candidate.item.id === input.itemId);
    const option = entry?.options.get(input.actionId);
    if (!entry || !option || !entry.item.actions.some((item) => item.id === input.actionId)) return stale();
    if (entry.item.actions.find((item) => item.id === input.actionId)?.kind === "manage") {
      this.input.openDetail({ itemId: entry.item.id }, this.input.scope());
      return this.snapshot({});
    }
    let action: CoreActionReference;
    try { action = this.input.actions.mint(this.input.scope(), option.target); } catch { return stale(); }
    try { await option.execute(action); }
    catch { return stale(); }
    finally { this.input.actions.complete(action); }
    this.changed(); return this.snapshot({});
  }
}
```

The recovery assembler builds `RecoveryEntry.options` from current host recovery descriptors. For `manage`, validate the item and original workbench, notify its dedicated detail bridge with `onOpen({itemId})`, and return `this.snapshot({})` as the unchanged `CoreRecoveryPort.act` result. Manage navigation does not mint a retry/export/discard action. D170 detail options perform fresh trusted minting only after their own scope/revision checks. It never interprets renderer method names, session IDs, record content, or physical identity. B2 `retry/export/discard` are projected as the frozen `retry-save` or `manage` options; the `CoreRecoveryItem.actions[].kind` union is not widened. A device UI crash must not erase provider faults. In D170, explicit retry/discard updates the coordinator with the **actual** returned report; retry does not launch the disabled feature or renew retained payload TTL.

Attach both real instances in D160; all scalar/state/resource types below are imported from their actual owners.

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { z } from "zod";
import { namespacedIdSchema, validateCommandValue } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import { sourceKeySchema } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type {
  CommandInvocation, CommandValue, Condition, ContextCommandDeclaration, PanelResourceV1,
  ResourceOwner, Result, StatusResourceV1, UiBinding, UiStateSnapshot, UiScalar as Scalar, ValueSpec,
} from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { CoreWindowScope, PluginUiBridge, UiCatalogPort } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { IpcHandle } from "../ipc.js";
import type { UiIntent } from "./ui-intent.js";
import type { UserPersistenceActions } from "./user-persistence-actions.js";

export type ResolvedUi = {
  owner: ResourceOwner; resource: PanelResourceV1 | StatusResourceV1; state: UiStateSnapshot;
  workbenchInstance: string; contextRef: string | null;
  commands: ReadonlyMap<string, ContextCommandDeclaration>;
};
export interface UiExecutionAdapter {
  open: PluginUiBridge["open"];
  close: PluginUiBridge["close"];
  visibility: PluginUiBridge["visibility"];
  snapshot: PluginUiBridge["snapshot"];
  reportFailure: PluginUiBridge["reportFailure"];
  resolve(binding: UiBinding): ResolvedUi | null;
  acceptForm(binding: UiBinding, revision: number, values: Record<string, Scalar>): boolean;
  invoke(owner: ResourceOwner, invocation: CommandInvocation, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<Result<CommandValue>>;
  core(resolved: ResolvedUi, nodeId: string): Promise<Result<CommandValue>>;
  dispose(): void;
}
const stale = <T>(): Result<T> => ({ ok: false, error: { code: "PLUGIN_E_STALE_RESOURCE", message: "UI action is no longer current.",
  detail: { kind: "resource", reason: "stale", resource: "ui-binding" } } });
function accepts(spec: ValueSpec, value: Scalar): boolean {
  if (value === null) return spec.nullable;
  switch (spec.type) {
    case "string": return typeof value === "string" && Array.from(value).length <= spec.maxLength;
    case "number": return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= spec.min && value <= spec.max && (!spec.integer || Number.isInteger(value));
    case "boolean": return typeof value === "boolean";
    case "enum": return typeof value === "string" && spec.values.includes(value);
  }
}
function condition(value: Condition | undefined, data: Record<string, Scalar>, form: Record<string, Scalar>): boolean {
  if (!value) return true;
  switch (value.op) {
    case "all": return value.items.every((item) => condition(item, data, form));
    case "any": return value.items.some((item) => condition(item, data, form));
    case "not": return !condition(value.item, data, form);
    default: {
      const left = (value.left.scope === "data" ? data : form)[value.left.key];
      switch (value.op) {
        case "eq": return left === value.right;
        case "ne": return left !== value.right;
        case "lt": return typeof left === "number" && left < value.right;
        case "lte": return typeof left === "number" && left <= value.right;
        case "gt": return typeof left === "number" && left > value.right;
        case "gte": return typeof left === "number" && left >= value.right;
      }
    }
  }
}
export function buildInvocation(
  resolved: ResolvedUi, nodeId: string, formRevision: number, form: Record<string, Scalar>,
  trigger: CommandInvocation["context"]["trigger"], actionRef?: string, motionScopeRef?: string,
): Result<CommandInvocation> {
  const { owner, state, resource } = resolved;
  const binding = state.binding;
  const cleanup = trigger.kind === "hold" && trigger.phase !== "begin";
  if (resource.kind !== "panel" || !state.visible || formRevision !== state.formRevision + (cleanup ? 0 : 1) ||
      binding.generation !== owner.generation || binding.hostEpoch !== owner.hostEpoch || binding.processEpoch !== owner.processEpoch ||
      Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(form), "utf8") > 16 * 1024) return stale();
  const keys = Object.keys(resource.fields);
  if (Object.keys(form).length !== keys.length || keys.some((key) => !Object.hasOwn(form, key))) return stale();
  const nodes = new Map(resource.nodes.map((node) => [node.id, node]));
  const enabled = new Set<string>();
  const visit = (id: string, active: boolean) => {
    const node = nodes.get(id); if (!node) return;
    const current = active && condition(node.visibleWhen, state.data, form) && condition(node.enabledWhen, state.data, form);
    if (current) enabled.add(id);
    if (node.type === "group") for (const child of node.children) visit(child, current);
  };
  visit(resource.root, true);
  const masked = { ...form };
  for (const node of resource.nodes) if ("field" in node) {
    const field = resource.fields[node.field]!;
    if (!enabled.has(node.id)) masked[node.field] = null;
    else if (!accepts(field.schema, masked[node.field]!) ||
      ((field.required || (field.requiredWhen !== undefined && condition(field.requiredWhen, state.data, form))) &&
        (masked[node.field] === null || masked[node.field] === ""))) return stale();
  }
  const node = nodes.get(nodeId); if (!node || !enabled.has(nodeId)) return stale();
  const action = node.type === "holdAction" ? { command: node.command, arguments: node.arguments }
    : node.type === "action" && node.action.kind === "command" ? node.action : undefined;
  if (!action || !action.command.startsWith(`${owner.pluginId}.`)) return stale();
  if ((node.type === "holdAction") !== (trigger.kind === "hold")) return stale();
  const declaration = resolved.commands.get(action.command); if (!declaration) return stale();
  const args: Record<string, Scalar> = Object.create(null) as Record<string, Scalar>;
  for (const [name, binding] of Object.entries(action.arguments)) {
    const value = "literal" in binding ? binding.literal : (binding.ref.scope === "data" ? state.data : masked)[binding.ref.key];
    if (value === undefined) return stale(); args[name] = value;
  }
  if (Object.keys(args).length !== Object.keys(declaration.arguments).length ||
      Object.entries(declaration.arguments).some(([name, spec]) => !Object.hasOwn(args, name) || !accepts(spec, args[name]!)) ||
      Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(args), "utf8") > 16 * 1024) return stale();
  const invocation: CommandInvocation = { version: 1, invocationId: randomUUID(), command: action.command, arguments: args,
    context: { contextRef: resolved.contextRef, origin: "panel", locale: state.locale, binding,
      form: { revision: formRevision, values: masked }, trigger,
      ...(actionRef === undefined ? {} : { actionRef }), ...(motionScopeRef === undefined ? {} : { motionScopeRef }) } };
  return Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(invocation), "utf8") <= 64 * 1024 ? { ok: true, value: invocation } : stale();
}
export function trustedWorkbench(
  event: { sender: { id: number }; senderFrame: unknown }, trusted: { id: number; mainFrame: unknown },
): boolean { return event.sender.id === trusted.id && event.senderFrame === trusted.mainFrame; }
export function createPluginUiBridge(input: {
  catalog: UiCatalogPort; execution: UiExecutionAdapter; intent: UiIntent; actions: UserPersistenceActions;
  scope(): CoreWindowScope;
}): PluginUiBridge {
  const { execution, intent } = input;
  const inflight = new Map<string, Set<AbortController>>();
  const holds = new Map<string, { invocation: CommandInvocation; owner: ResourceOwner; gesture: string }>();
  const bindKey = (binding: UiBinding) => JSON.stringify([binding.contributionId, binding.panelInstance,
    binding.kind, binding.uiResourceGeneration, binding.generation, binding.hostEpoch, binding.processEpoch]);
  const holdKey = (binding: UiBinding, token: string) => JSON.stringify([bindKey(binding), token]);
  const resolve = (binding: UiBinding) => {
    const value = execution.resolve(binding); const scope = input.scope();
    return value && value.workbenchInstance === scope.workbenchInstance && value.owner.hostEpoch === scope.hostEpoch ? value : null;
  };
  const abort = (binding: UiBinding) => {
    const key = bindKey(binding);
    for (const control of inflight.get(key) ?? []) control.abort();
    for (const [token, held] of holds)
      if (held.invocation.context.binding && bindKey(held.invocation.context.binding) === key) holds.delete(token);
  };
  const dispatch = async (resolved: ResolvedUi, invocation: CommandInvocation): Promise<Result<CommandValue>> => {
    const key = bindKey(resolved.state.binding); const control = new AbortController();
    const requests = inflight.get(key) ?? new Set<AbortController>(); requests.add(control); inflight.set(key, requests);
    try {
      const result = await execution.invoke(resolved.owner, invocation, control.signal);
      if (control.signal.aborted || !resolve(resolved.state.binding)) return stale();
      if (Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(result), "utf8") > 16 * 1024) return stale();
      if (!result.ok) return result;
      return validateCommandValue(result.value, invocation);
    } catch { return stale(); }
    finally { requests.delete(control); if (requests.size === 0) inflight.delete(key); }
  };
  return {
    catalog: (value) => input.catalog.catalog(value), resource: (value) => input.catalog.resource(value),
    open: async (value) => {
      const result = await execution.open(value); if (!result.ok) return result;
      const resolved = resolve(result.value.binding); if (!resolved) return stale();
      if (result.value.visible && resolved.contextRef !== null && result.value.binding.kind === "panel") intent.bind(result.value.binding, {
        owner: resolved.owner, contextRef: resolved.contextRef, panelInstance: result.value.binding.panelInstance,
        uiResourceGeneration: result.value.binding.uiResourceGeneration, workbenchInstance: resolved.workbenchInstance,
      });
      return result;
    },
    close: (value) => { intent.revoke(value.binding, "closed"); abort(value.binding); return execution.close(value); },
    visibility: async (value) => {
      if (!value.visible) { intent.revoke(value.binding, "hidden"); abort(value.binding); }
      const result = await execution.visibility(value); if (!result.ok || !value.visible) return result;
      const resolved = resolve(value.binding);
      if (resolved?.contextRef && value.binding.kind === "panel") intent.bind(value.binding, {
        owner: resolved.owner, contextRef: resolved.contextRef, panelInstance: value.binding.panelInstance,
        uiResourceGeneration: value.binding.uiResourceGeneration, workbenchInstance: resolved.workbenchInstance,
      });
      return result;
    },
    invoke: async (value) => {
      const resolved = resolve(value.binding); if (!resolved) return stale();
      const node = resolved.resource.kind === "panel" ? resolved.resource.nodes.find((item) => item.id === value.nodeId) : undefined;
      // Core safety routes do not depend on feature form validity or enabledWhen.
      if (node?.type === "action" && node.action.kind === "core") return execution.core(resolved, node.id);
      const built = buildInvocation(resolved, value.nodeId, value.formRevision, value.form, { kind: "activate" }, undefined, intent.scope(value.binding));
      if (!built.ok || !execution.acceptForm(value.binding, value.formRevision, built.value.context.form!.values)) return stale();
      try { built.value.context.actionRef = input.actions.mint(resolved.owner, input.scope(), value.binding.uiResourceGeneration); }
      catch { return stale(); }
      return dispatch(resolved, built.value);
    },
    hold: async (value) => {
      const key = holdKey(value.binding, value.inputToken);
      if (value.phase !== "begin") {
        // Always stop before validating a changed form, awaiting launch, or invoking plugin code.
        const held = holds.get(key); intent.end(value.binding, value.inputToken, value.phase); holds.delete(key);
        if (held) {
          const resolved = resolve(value.binding);
          if (resolved) {
            const { actionRef: _actionRef, ...context } = held.invocation.context;
            const ending: CommandInvocation = { ...held.invocation, invocationId: randomUUID(),
              context: { ...context, trigger: { kind: "hold", phase: value.phase, gestureRef: held.gesture } } };
            void dispatch(resolved, ending);
          }
        }
        return { ok: true, value: { gesture: null } };
      }
      const resolved = resolve(value.binding); if (!resolved) return stale();
      const built = buildInvocation(resolved, value.nodeId, value.formRevision, value.form,
        { kind: "hold", phase: "begin", gestureRef: randomUUID() }, undefined, intent.scope(value.binding));
      if (!built.ok || !execution.acceptForm(value.binding, value.formRevision, built.value.context.form!.values)) return stale();
      const gesture = intent.begin(value.binding, value.inputToken); if (!gesture) return stale();
      built.value.context.trigger = { kind: "hold", phase: "begin", gestureRef: gesture };
      try { built.value.context.actionRef = input.actions.mint(resolved.owner, input.scope(), value.binding.uiResourceGeneration); }
      catch { intent.end(value.binding, value.inputToken, "cancel"); return stale(); }
      holds.set(key, { owner: resolved.owner, invocation: built.value, gesture });
      const result = await dispatch(resolved, built.value);
      if (!result.ok) { intent.end(value.binding, value.inputToken, "cancel"); holds.delete(key); return result; }
      return { ok: true, value: { gesture: intent.liveGesture(value.binding, value.inputToken, gesture) ? gesture : null } };
    },
    pulse: async (value) => intent.pulse(value.binding, value.challenge, value.gesture, value.inputToken)
      ? { ok: true, value: { accepted: true } } : stale(),
    snapshot: (value) => execution.snapshot(value), reportFailure: (value) => execution.reportFailure(value),
    onEvent: (listener) => input.catalog.onEvent(listener),
  };
}

const handleSchema = z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/);
const counter = z.number().int().min(0).max(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
const local = z.string().regex(/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$/);
const bindingSchema = z.strictObject({ contributionId: namespacedIdSchema, panelInstance: handleSchema,
  kind: z.enum(["panel", "status"]), uiResourceGeneration: counter, generation: counter,
  hostEpoch: handleSchema, processEpoch: handleSchema });
const scalar = z.union([z.string().max(8000).refine((value) => Array.from(value).length <= 4000 &&
  !/\u0000|[\uD800-\uDBFF](?![\uDC00-\uDFFF])|(?<![\uD800-\uDBFF])[\uDC00-\uDFFF]/u.test(value)),
  z.number().finite(), z.boolean(), z.null()]);
const formSchema = z.record(local, scalar).refine((value) => Object.keys(value).length <= 32 && Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(value)) <= 16 * 1024);
const actionInput = { binding: bindingSchema, nodeId: local, formRevision: counter, form: formSchema };
export function registerUiIpc(input: {
  handle: IpcHandle; bridge: PluginUiBridge;
  trusted(event: { sender: { id: number }; senderFrame: unknown }): boolean;
}): void {
  const register = <T>(channel: string, schema: z.ZodType<T>, action: (value: T) => unknown) => {
    input.handle(channel, (event, value: unknown) => {
      if (!input.trusted(event)) return stale();
      const parsed = schema.safeParse(value); return parsed.success ? action(parsed.data) : stale();
    });
  };
  register("plugins:ui:catalog", z.strictObject({ cursor: handleSchema.optional() }), (value) => input.bridge.catalog(value));
  register("plugins:ui:resource", z.strictObject({ sourceKey: sourceKeySchema, id: namespacedIdSchema, uiResourceGeneration: counter,
    resourceDigest: z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/) }), (value) => input.bridge.resource(value));
  register("plugins:ui:open", z.strictObject({ sourceKey: sourceKeySchema, id: namespacedIdSchema, uiResourceGeneration: counter }), (value) => input.bridge.open(value));
  register("plugins:ui:close", z.strictObject({ binding: bindingSchema }), (value) => input.bridge.close(value));
  register("plugins:ui:visibility", z.strictObject({ binding: bindingSchema, visible: z.boolean(),
    reason: z.enum(["tab", "sidebar", "collapse", "document", "window"]) }), (value) => input.bridge.visibility(value));
  register("plugins:ui:invoke", z.strictObject(actionInput), (value) => input.bridge.invoke(value));
  register("plugins:ui:hold", z.strictObject({ ...actionInput, phase: z.enum(["begin", "end", "cancel"]), inputToken: handleSchema }), (value) => input.bridge.hold(value));
  register("plugins:ui:pulse", z.strictObject({ binding: bindingSchema, challenge: handleSchema,
    gesture: handleSchema.nullable(), inputToken: handleSchema.nullable() }), (value) => input.bridge.pulse(value));
  register("plugins:ui:snapshot", z.strictObject({ binding: bindingSchema }), (value) => input.bridge.snapshot(value));
  register("plugins:ui:report-failure", z.strictObject({ sourceKey: sourceKeySchema, id: namespacedIdSchema,
    uiResourceGeneration: counter, catalogRevision: counter, reason: z.enum(["validation", "renderer"]),
    fieldPath: z.string().max(512).optional() }), (value) => input.bridge.reportFailure(value));
}
```

T2's adapter must validate the complete owner, binding, revision and current permissions at `resolve`/`acceptForm`, install accepted form state atomically, and route `invoke` only through the original R150-bound channel. `open` must await the one initialize/negotiate/ready deadline before returning the instance. The bridge never holds a device lock while awaiting a plugin. A retired adapter returns stale; it does not silently open a replacement generation for a late invocation. Core `stop`/`disconnect` adapters resolve operation/session from the host-owned node data and the current source authority; a feature cannot point a string at another owner's operation to gain core authority.

```ts
markThirdPartyUiContributions(): void {
  const marker = this.#marker;
  if (!marker || this.#finished) throw new PluginError("PLUGIN_E_STATE_SAVE", "PLUGIN_E_STATE_SAVE: No live plugin recovery session.");
  if (marker.thirdPartyUiContributions) return;

  this.#marker = next;
}
```

Declare `let uiListenerCount = 0` in preload module scope. Insert these complete members inside the existing `api.plugins` object; keep all legacy members unchanged:

```ts
ui: {
  catalog: (input) => ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:ui:catalog", input),
  resource: (input) => ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:ui:resource", input),
  open: (input) => ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:ui:open", input),
  close: (input) => ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:ui:close", input),
  visibility: (input) => ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:ui:visibility", input),
  invoke: (input) => ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:ui:invoke", input),
  hold: (input) => ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:ui:hold", input),
  pulse: (input) => ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:ui:pulse", input),
  snapshot: (input) => ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:ui:snapshot", input),
  reportFailure: (input) => ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:ui:report-failure", input),
  onEvent: (listener) => {
    const receive = (_event: Electron.IpcRendererEvent, value: UiBridgeEvent) => listener(value);
    ipcRenderer.on("plugins:ui:event", receive);
    if (++uiListenerCount === 1) void ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:ui:subscribe");
    let active = true;
    return () => {
      if (!active) return; active = false; ipcRenderer.removeListener("plugins:ui:event", receive);
      if (--uiListenerCount === 0) void ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:ui:unsubscribe");
    };
  },
},
recovery: {
  snapshot: (input) => ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:recovery:snapshot", input),
  act: (input) => ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:recovery:act", input),
  onChanged: (listener) => {
    const receive = () => listener(); ipcRenderer.on("plugins:recovery:changed", receive);
    return () => ipcRenderer.removeListener("plugins:recovery:changed", receive);
  },
},
```

```ts
export function registerCoreRecoveryIpc(handle: IpcHandle, recovery: CoreRecoveryPort, changed: () => void): () => void {
  const reference = z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/);
  handle("plugins:recovery:snapshot", (_event, value: unknown) =>
    recovery.snapshot(z.strictObject({ cursor: reference.optional() }).parse(value)));
  handle("plugins:recovery:act", (_event, value: unknown) =>
    recovery.act(z.strictObject({ itemId: reference, actionId: reference }).parse(value)));
  return recovery.onChanged(changed);
}
```

Replace `apps/desktop/src/main/plugins/quit.ts` with:

```ts
export const PLUGIN_QUIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 25_000;
export interface QuitHost {
  on(event: "will-quit", listener: (event: { preventDefault(): void }) => void): unknown;
  quit(): void;
}
export function installPluginQuitCleanup(
  app: QuitHost,
  cleanup: { shutdown(): Promise<void> },
  options: { onBlocked?(error: unknown): void } = {},
): void {
  let state: "idle" | "cleaning" | "done" = "idle";
  app.on("will-quit", (event) => {
    if (state === "done") return;
    event.preventDefault(); if (state === "cleaning") return;
    state = "cleaning"; let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
    const timeout = new Promise<never>((_resolve, reject) => {
      timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error("Cleanup is not confirmed; keep Kobrixa open.")), PLUGIN_QUIT_TIMEOUT_MS);
    });
    void Promise.race([Promise.resolve().then(() => cleanup.shutdown()), timeout]).then(() => {
      clearTimeout(timer); state = "done"; app.quit();
    }, (error: unknown) => {
      clearTimeout(timer); state = "idle"; options.onBlocked?.(error);
    });
  });
}
```
