Implement the complete original-channel adapter in ui-bridge.ts, merging these imports. The published RpcPeer validates params/results on every request; explicit result parsing below also protects direct host phase calls. No plugin-to-host ready/negotiate handler is installed.

```ts
import { RpcError, RPC_ERRORS, uiRequestSchemas, type RequestContext } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import { sameResourceOwner, remainingActivationMs, type Stage3ChannelContext,
  type Stage3ChannelBinding, type DeviceChannelAttachment } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
export function createUiChannelBinding(context: Stage3ChannelContext, input: {
  states: UiStateRegistry; subscriptions: UiSubscriptions; catalog: UiCatalog;
  runtime: UiRuntimeAttachment; attachment: DeviceChannelAttachment;
}): Stage3ChannelBinding {
  let disposed = false, negotiated = false, initialized = false, ready = false;
  const lifetime = new AbortController();
  const checkOwner = () => {
    const principal = context.principal();
    if (disposed || context.peer.closed || principal.kind !== "plugin" ||
        !sameResourceOwner(principal.owner, context.owner) || !sameResourceOwner(input.attachment.owner, context.owner) ||
        !input.runtime.current(context.owner))
      throw new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.invalidParams, "Stale UI channel owner.");
  };
  const check = (request: RequestContext) => {
    request.signal.throwIfAborted(); checkOwner();
    if (!negotiated) throw new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.invalidParams, "UI domain is not negotiated.");
  };
  context.peer.handle("ui/instances", (params, request) => {
    check(request); uiRequestSchemas["ui/instances"].params.parse(params);
    return uiRequestSchemas["ui/instances"].result.parse({ ok: true,
      value: { instances: input.states.instances(context.owner) } });
  });
  context.peer.handle("ui/state", (params, request) => {
    check(request); const parsed = uiRequestSchemas["ui/state"].params.parse(params);
    return uiRequestSchemas["ui/state"].result.parse(input.states.state(context.owner, parsed.binding));
  });
  context.peer.handle("ui/patch", (params, request) => {
    check(request); const parsed = uiRequestSchemas["ui/patch"].params.parse(params);
    return uiRequestSchemas["ui/patch"].result.parse(input.states.patch(context.owner, parsed));
  });
  context.peer.handle("ui/snapshot", (params, request) => {
    check(request); const parsed = uiRequestSchemas["ui/snapshot"].params.parse(params);
    return uiRequestSchemas["ui/snapshot"].result.parse(input.subscriptions.snapshot(context.owner, parsed.subscriptionId));
  });
  context.peer.handle("ui/subscribe", (params, request) => {
    check(request); const parsed = uiRequestSchemas["ui/subscribe"].params.parse(params);
    const result = input.subscriptions.subscribe(context.owner, parsed);
    if (result.ok) {
      const id = result.value.subscriptionId;
      // Register abandon before validation/send; failed serialization and cancellation share it.
      request.afterReply(() => {
        try { check(request); input.attachment.activate(id); }
        catch { input.attachment.abandon(id); }
      }, () => input.attachment.abandon(id));
    }
    return uiRequestSchemas["ui/subscribe"].result.parse(result);
  });
  return {
    async initialized(signal) {
      checkOwner(); signal.throwIfAborted();
      if (initialized) throw new Error("UI initialized twice.");
      initialized = true;
      if (!input.catalog.declaresUi(context.owner)) return;
      const combined = AbortSignal.any([signal, lifetime.signal]);
      const initialBindings = input.states.initialBindingsReady(context.owner, combined);
      void initialBindings.catch(() => undefined);
      const result = uiRequestSchemas["ui/negotiate"].result.parse(await context.peer.request("ui/negotiate",
        { commandEnvelopeVersions: [1], uiResourceVersions: [1] },
        { signal: combined, timeoutMs: remainingActivationMs(signal) }));
      checkOwner(); combined.throwIfAborted();
      if (!result.ok || !result.value.commandEnvelopeVersions.includes(1) || !result.value.uiResourceVersions.includes(1))
        throw new Error("Declared UI is unsupported by the negotiated SDK.");
      input.attachment.negotiated("ui", 1); negotiated = true;
      await initialBindings;
      checkOwner();
    },
    async ready(signal) {
      checkOwner(); signal.throwIfAborted();
      if (!initialized || ready) throw new Error("Invalid UI ready phase.");
      ready = true;
      if (!input.catalog.declaresUi(context.owner)) return;
      if (!negotiated) throw new Error("UI negotiation is incomplete.");
      const combined = AbortSignal.any([signal, lifetime.signal]);
      const result = uiRequestSchemas["ui/ready"].result.parse(await context.peer.request("ui/ready", {},
        { signal: combined, timeoutMs: remainingActivationMs(signal) }));
      checkOwner(); combined.throwIfAborted();
      if (!result.ok) throw new Error("Plugin UI ready failed.");
    },
    dispose() {
      if (disposed) return;
      disposed = true; negotiated = false; lifetime.abort(new Error("UI channel disposed."));
      input.states.cancelInitialBindings(context.owner);
      input.states.retireExecution(context.owner, "process-gone");
      input.subscriptions.retire(context.owner);
      // Existing void-returning handle API: replace with inert handlers, never remove shared routes.
      for (const method of ["ui/instances", "ui/state", "ui/patch", "ui/snapshot", "ui/subscribe"] as const)
        context.peer.handle(method, () => { throw new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.methodNotFound, "UI channel disposed."); });
    },
  };
}
```

T3's supervisor owns the original deadline registration in Step 10. RPC timers receive only the remaining budget; the adapter creates no ten-second timeout and never calls runtime.ready. The original shared attachment is disposed only by A's router disposer.

A-T7's unchanged `attachDeviceRpc` returns a disposer, so capture its single attachment at that existing factory call. Add this concrete helper to controller.ts; the proxy forwards every other broker access unchanged and never attaches a second channel:

```ts
import type { DeviceChannelAttachment, Stage3ChannelContext, Stage3ChannelBinding } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { DeviceBrokerPort } from "../device-broker/broker-port.js";
function bindDesktopChannel(context: Stage3ChannelContext, broker: DeviceBrokerPort,
  input: Omit<Parameters<typeof createUiChannelBinding>[1], "attachment">,
  originalChannels: Map<string, Stage3ChannelContext>): Stage3ChannelBinding {
  const principal = context.principal();
  const key = (owner: typeof context.owner) => JSON.stringify([owner.sourceKey, owner.pluginId,
    owner.generation, owner.hostEpoch, owner.processEpoch]);
  if (principal.kind !== "plugin" || key(principal.owner) !== key(context.owner))
    throw new Error("Channel owner mismatch.");
  let attachment: DeviceChannelAttachment | undefined;
  const routedBroker = new Proxy(broker, { get(target, key, receiver) {
    if (key === "attachChannel") return (args: Parameters<DeviceBrokerPort["attachChannel"]>[0]) => {
      if (attachment) throw new Error("Second channel attachment.");
      attachment = target.attachChannel(args); return attachment;
    };
    return Reflect.get(target, key, receiver);
  } });
  const offDevice = attachDeviceRpc({ peer: context.peer, principal: context.principal, broker: routedBroker });
  if (!attachment) { offDevice(); throw new Error("Device router did not attach the original channel."); }
  try {
    const ui = createUiChannelBinding(context, { ...input, attachment });
    originalChannels.set(key(context.owner), context);
    let disposed = false;
    return { initialized: signal => ui.initialized(signal), ready: signal => ui.ready(signal),
      dispose() {
        if (disposed) return; disposed = true;
        try { ui.dispose(); offDevice(); }
        finally { originalChannels.delete(key(context.owner)); }
      } };
  } catch (error) { offDevice(); throw error; }
}
```

The T2 state API is used directly; main must not create another data/form store. Add this complete adapter to `ui-bridge.ts`, with `UiCatalog`, `UiStateRegistry`, `currentStatusBindings`, type `UiRuntimeAttachment`, and `sameUiBinding` imports from `@kobrixa/plugin-runtime`:

```ts
export function createUiExecutionAdapter(input: {
  catalog: UiCatalog; states: UiStateRegistry; scope(): CoreWindowScope;
  runtime: UiRuntimeAttachment;
  core: UiExecutionAdapter["core"];
}): UiExecutionAdapter {
  const openings = new Set<AbortController>();
  let disposed = false;
  // Only binding metadata lives here. All data/form/visibility/revisions stay in T2's registry.
  const metadata = new Map<string, Omit<ResolvedUi, "state"> & { binding: UiBinding }>();
  const offMetadata = input.states.onEvent((_owner, event) => {
    if (event.kind === "ui.revoked") metadata.delete(event.data.binding.panelInstance);
  });
  const resolve = (binding: UiBinding): ResolvedUi | null => {
    const entry = metadata.get(binding.panelInstance); const scope = input.scope();
    if (!entry || !sameUiBinding(entry.binding, binding) || !input.runtime.current(entry.owner) ||
        entry.workbenchInstance !== scope.workbenchInstance || entry.owner.hostEpoch !== scope.hostEpoch) return null;
    const snapshot = input.states.state(entry.owner, binding); if (!snapshot.ok) return null;
    return { owner: entry.owner, resource: entry.resource, workbenchInstance: entry.workbenchInstance,
      contextRef: input.runtime.context(entry.owner, scope)?.ref ?? null, commands: new Map(input.runtime.commands(entry.owner.sourceKey).map((command) => [command.id, command])), state: snapshot.value };
  };
  return {
    resolve, invoke: (owner, invocation, signal) => input.runtime.invoke(owner, invocation, signal), core: input.core,
    dispose: () => { disposed = true; for (const opening of openings) opening.abort(); openings.clear(); offMetadata(); metadata.clear(); },
    open: async (value) => {
      if (disposed) return stale();
      const opening = new AbortController(); openings.add(opening);
      try {
      let cursor: string | undefined;
      for (;;) {
        const page = await input.catalog.catalog(cursor === undefined ? {} : { cursor }); if (!page.ok) return page;
        const descriptor = page.value.entries.find((entry) => entry.sourceKey === value.sourceKey && entry.id === value.id &&
          entry.uiResourceGeneration === value.uiResourceGeneration);
        if (descriptor) {
          const resource = await input.catalog.resource({ ...value, resourceDigest: descriptor.resourceDigest });
          if (!resource.ok) return resource;
          const scope = input.scope();
          const state = await input.states.open({ owner: resource.value.owner, id: value.id, scope, resource: resource.value.resource,
            signal: opening.signal,
            activateInitialized: (sourceKey, signal) => input.runtime.activateInitialized(sourceKey, signal) });
          if (!state.ok) return state;
          const owner = input.states.executionOwner(state.value.binding);
          const currentScope = input.scope();
          if (disposed || opening.signal.aborted || !owner || !input.runtime.current(owner) || scope.hostEpoch !== currentScope.hostEpoch ||
              scope.workbenchInstance !== currentScope.workbenchInstance) return stale();
          metadata.set(state.value.binding.panelInstance, { owner, binding: state.value.binding, resource: resource.value.resource,
            workbenchInstance: scope.workbenchInstance, contextRef: input.runtime.context(owner, scope)?.ref ?? null,
            commands: new Map(input.runtime.commands(owner.sourceKey).map((command) => [command.id, command])) });
          await input.runtime.ready(owner, opening.signal);
          if (disposed || opening.signal.aborted || !input.runtime.current(owner) ||
              scope.hostEpoch !== input.scope().hostEpoch || scope.workbenchInstance !== input.scope().workbenchInstance) return stale();
          return state;
        }
        if (page.value.nextCursor === null) return stale(); cursor = page.value.nextCursor;
      }
      } catch { return stale(); } finally { openings.delete(opening); }
    },
    close: async ({ binding }) => {
      const value = resolve(binding); if (!value) return stale();
      const result = input.states.close(value.owner, binding); metadata.delete(binding.panelInstance); return result;
    },
    visibility: async ({ binding, visible }) => {
      const value = resolve(binding); return value ? input.states.visibility(value.owner, binding, visible) : stale();
    },
    snapshot: async ({ binding }) => {
      const value = resolve(binding); if (value) return { ok: true, value: value.state };
      const status = currentStatusBindings(input.states, input.scope()).find((entry) => sameUiBinding(entry.binding, binding));
      if (!status) return stale();
      for (const owner of input.runtime.owners()) {
        if (!input.runtime.current(owner) || owner.hostEpoch !== binding.hostEpoch ||
            owner.processEpoch !== binding.processEpoch || owner.generation !== binding.generation) continue;
        const result = input.states.state(owner, binding); if (result.ok) return result;
      }
      return stale();
    },
    acceptForm: (binding, revision, values) => {
      const value = resolve(binding); if (!value) return false;
      return input.states.setForm(value.owner, binding, revision, values, true).ok;
    },
    reportFailure: (value) => input.catalog.reportFailure(value),
  };
}
```

The `resource` bridge forwards T2's admitted success DTO unchanged, including `validationContext: UiValidationContext` and `rawBytes: number` from that same resource read. Do not reconstruct commands from renderer JSON or discard these fields in preload. T7 calls `validateUiResource(resource, validationContext, Math.max(rawBytes, new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(resource)).length))`; invalid resources quarantine the whole contribution. The fields never enter plugin resource JSON or RPC schemas. Consume H-P's browser-safe validator and shared strict `declarative-ui-v1/{valid,invalid,maximum}.json` fixtures at P160.

The form revision admission rule matches T2: each new activate/hold-begin action supplies exactly `current + 1`; reject gaps, backwards values and replay of the last accepted revision. Ordinary keystrokes stay renderer-local. A changed accepted form cancels a previous hold before a new gesture begins; its old node/arguments cannot survive the edit. Hold-end cleanup uses its saved original invocation without admitting another form or minting another actionRef.

Add to `ui-bridge.ts` a bridge-event hub; subscribe T2 catalog and state events once and use it for both `PluginUiBridge.onEvent` and the main IPC publisher. `UiIntent` sends pulse events into the same hub:

```ts
export class UiBridgeEvents {
  readonly #listeners = new Set<(event: import("@kobrixa/plugin-runtime").UiBridgeEvent) => void>();
  constructor(private readonly replay: () => readonly import("@kobrixa/plugin-runtime").UiBridgeEvent[]) {}
  publish = (event: import("@kobrixa/plugin-runtime").UiBridgeEvent): void => {
    for (const listener of this.#listeners) { try { listener(event); } catch { /* observers cannot retain authority */ } }
  };
  subscribe = (listener: (event: import("@kobrixa/plugin-runtime").UiBridgeEvent) => void): (() => void) => {
    const pending: import("@kobrixa/plugin-runtime").UiBridgeEvent[] = [];
    let replaying = true;
    const receive = (event: import("@kobrixa/plugin-runtime").UiBridgeEvent) => {
      if (replaying) pending.push(event); else listener(event);
    };
    this.#listeners.add(receive);
    try {
      const initial = this.replay();
      for (const event of initial) listener(event);
      for (let i = 0; i < pending.length; i++) listener(pending[i]!);
      replaying = false;
    } catch (error) { this.#listeners.delete(receive); throw error; }
    return () => { this.#listeners.delete(receive); };
  };
}
```

Add `events: UiBridgeEvents` to `createPluginUiBridge`'s host-only input and replace its `onEvent` implementation with `input.events.subscribe`. Construct the hub with a synchronous callback returning the current catalog invalidation (maintained from the authoritative catalog's revision/owner projection), followed by `currentStatusBindings(states, scope()).map(({binding, revision}) => ({type: "state" as const, binding, revision}))`. This reads the main-derived scope in the registration turn, includes every live status binding for that workbench, and never creates bindings. The registry's existing per-source/host limits bound replay. No await occurs between listener installation and replay capture. Reentrant invalidations queue behind the captured replay.

In preload `onEvent`, install the renderer listener before invoking `plugins:ui:subscribe`; main's trusted handler attaches `bridge.onEvent` for that validated sender/window then replays. Replace the early global main subscription with this per-window attachment. `plugins:ui:unsubscribe` removes it when the last renderer listener leaves; remount/reconnect invokes subscribe again and captures fresh state. Both handlers use the existing trusted main-frame wrapper and reject old windows. Use a preload listener count so a second listener does not replace the first subscription; renderer stores subscribe before catalog fetch and reconcile binding/generation/revision so an old catalog response cannot delete newer status state. Native and T2 state events perform synchronous intent revocation before publishing their hints:

```ts
const offCatalog = catalog.onEvent(events.publish);
const offState = states.onEvent((_owner, event) => {
  if (event.kind === "ui.revoked") {
    intent.forget(event.data.binding);
    events.publish({ type: "revoked", binding: event.data.binding, reason: event.data.reason });
  } else if (event.kind === "ui.state") {
    events.publish({ type: "state", binding: event.data.binding, revision: event.data.revision });
  } else if (event.kind === "ui.visibility" && !event.data.visible) {
    intent.revoke(event.data.binding, "hidden");
  } else if (event.kind === "ui.form") {
    intent.cancelHold(event.data.binding);
  }
});
```

Keep these subscriptions and `execution.dispose` in the runtime/window disposal list and call each disposer exactly once. Metadata rows are removed on `ui.revoked` alongside state retirement; they contain no second authoritative state. The shared event service (`UiSubscriptions`) attaches to the original process channel and uses the existing A `events/*` envelope/ack queue; no second event transport is introduced.

The D160 registry constructor in `ui-bridge.ts` is the sole production catalog/state/subscription allocation. Merge these imports with the file's existing imports:

```ts
import { UiCatalog, UiStateRegistry, UiSubscriptions, type UiEventLedgerPort,
  type CommonEventLedgerPort } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { Handle, ResourceOwner, UiBinding } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import { uiEventLedgerPort } from "../device-broker/broker-port.js";
export function createUiRegistry(input: {
  hostEpoch: Handle;
  broker: { readonly events: CommonEventLedgerPort };
  now(): number;
  beforeDelivery(sourceKey: string): void;
  revokeIntent(owner: ResourceOwner, binding?: UiBinding): void;
}): { catalog: UiCatalog; states: UiStateRegistry; subscriptions: UiSubscriptions } {
  const catalog = new UiCatalog(input.hostEpoch, { now: input.now, beforeDelivery: input.beforeDelivery });
  const states = new UiStateRegistry({ now: input.now, current: owner => catalog.isCurrent(owner),
    eventCounters: () => input.broker.events.diagnostics() });
  const ledger: UiEventLedgerPort = uiEventLedgerPort(input.broker.events);
  const subscriptions = new UiSubscriptions(states, ledger, input.revokeIntent);
  return { catalog, states, subscriptions };
}
```

In controller.ts's shared `composeDesktopMain`, use this allocation in place of the standalone catalog/state/subscription constructors. `broker` and `profile` are the existing foundation inputs, `now` is the monotonic foundation clock, and `plugins` is the controller assigned by `startPlugins`. The callbacks close over those existing objects; no delivery occurs before startup returns:

```ts
const { catalog, states, subscriptions } = createUiRegistry({
  hostEpoch: profile.hostEpoch, broker, now,
  beforeDelivery: sourceKey => {
    if (!plugins) throw new Error("Plugin controller is not attached.");
    plugins.markThirdPartyUiContributions(sourceKey);
  },
  revokeIntent: (owner, binding) => {
    if (binding) intent.forget(binding);
    else for (const current of states.instances(owner)) intent.forget(current);
  },
});
```

The real-registry fixture above uses this same constructor. It verifies the production counter injection, current resource-generation predicate and checked delivery callback rather than test-only counter defaults. Only T2's diagnostics report the whole common ledger; T3 reports owners/timers. The callback is not exposed through RPC/preload, and diagnostics never sweep the ledger.

1. Reuse D150's `createCoreActionLedger` result, broker, authority, operation gate and primary `ProfileWriterLock` instance. D150 already created the workbench scope before broker construction. D160 and D170 extend those same objects; no second ledger, lock or broker. Keep the existing trusted provider allowlist and safe-mode registration guard.

The original peer remains retained through disposition and actual exit.

Its resource() method is the sole checked delivery gate, including cached fetches before open. A failed checked marker prevents the resource from reaching the renderer. Optional builtins do not set the third-party flag.
5. Register UI and recovery IPC through the same trusted handler and publish only to the current renderer. The new main registrations are (also dispose `offUi` on window loss; `handle` validates sender before every call):

```ts

} });
```

```ts

  onBlocked: () => coreRecovery.changed(),
```

The coordinator's `legacy` callback remains the real `motors.flush()` plus `sensorLab.flush("close")` until 3D migrates the old Lab store. Its `beginShutdown` invokes the A resource participant. Pass `flushDeviceWork` to `createWindow`, `MainProcessCloseGuard`, and the final `registerIpc` callback. Use `beforeUpdateInstall` for the existing update callback. Remove the old `.catch(() => undefined)` success paths around ordinary close; failures go to core recovery and keep the app open.

7. On blur/hide/minimize: synchronously `intent.dispose()`; leave healthy recording processes alive. On renderer crash/navigation replacement/window destroyed: synchronously revoke both action ledgers and intent for the old workbench, retire every owner bound to it using `renderer-crash` / `window-destroyed`, then advance the workbench UUID. A new explicit open/command may create fresh owner/bindings; focus/reload availability does not replay work. Unresponsive additionally calls `plugins.markRendererUnresponsive()`; ordinary process-gone does not automatically set this lock.
8. Replace the P150 suspend callback's session action with `coordinator.suspend(sessionId)` for every current broker session. Wake awaits original dispositions and calls `coordinator.resume(sessionId)` only for its suspend records. Keep the existing legacy Lab suspend save until 3D; do not leave a second public-recording dispatcher. P150 owns session enumeration and single-instance plumbing; this slice does not reopen native transports or maintain another provider map.

The above construction consumes P150 factories and the T2 implementation classes; it is not an instruction to execute optional work before eligibility. No Electron call is added to runtime modules. Core recovery stays available when every optional source is disabled. Provider retirement remains source-policy driven; renderer/consumer process death never disposes a healthy provider.

Append to `shutdown-coordinator.ts`:

```ts
export interface NativeLifecycleEmitter {
  on(event: string, listener: (...args: unknown[]) => void): unknown;
  off(event: string, listener: (...args: unknown[]) => void): unknown;
}
export function attachNativeLifecycle(input: {
  window: NativeLifecycleEmitter;
  contents: NativeLifecycleEmitter;
  power: NativeLifecycleEmitter;
  scope(): import("@kobrixa/plugin-runtime").CoreWindowScope;
  owners(): readonly ResourceOwner[]; sessions(): readonly string[];
  revokeIntent(): void; revokeActions(scope: import("@kobrixa/plugin-runtime").CoreWindowScope): void;
  replaceWorkbench(): void; markUnresponsive(): void;
  retire(owner: ResourceOwner, reason: "renderer-crash" | "window-destroyed"): Promise<unknown>;
  suspend(sessionId: string): Promise<unknown>; resume(sessionId: string): Promise<unknown>;
  failed(error: unknown): void;
}): () => void {
  const disposers: Array<() => void> = [];
  const on = (target: NativeLifecycleEmitter, event: string, listener: (...args: unknown[]) => void) => {
    target.on(event, listener); disposers.push(() => { target.off(event, listener); });
  };
  for (const event of ["blur", "hide", "minimize"]) on(input.window, event, input.revokeIntent);
  const lose = (reason: "renderer-crash" | "window-destroyed") => {
    const scope = input.scope(); const owners = [...input.owners()];
    input.revokeIntent(); input.revokeActions(scope);
    for (const owner of owners) void input.retire(owner, reason).catch(input.failed);
    input.replaceWorkbench();
  };
  on(input.window, "unresponsive", () => { input.markUnresponsive(); lose("renderer-crash"); });
  on(input.contents, "render-process-gone", (_event, value) => {
    if (typeof value === "object" && value !== null && "reason" in value && value.reason === "clean-exit") return;
    lose("renderer-crash");
  });
  on(input.contents, "destroyed", () => lose("window-destroyed"));
  on(input.contents, "did-start-navigation", (_event, _url, _inPlace, mainFrame) => {
    if (mainFrame === true) lose("renderer-crash");
  });
  on(input.power, "suspend", () => {
    input.revokeIntent(); for (const session of input.sessions()) void input.suspend(session).catch(input.failed);
  });
  on(input.power, "resume", () => {
    for (const session of input.sessions()) void input.resume(session).catch(input.failed);
  });
  return () => { for (const dispose of disposers.splice(0)) dispose(); };
}
```

Use this helper for the main-window lifetime and the app's sole power-hook attachment described in Step 19. Retain its returned disposer and call it on window destruction before attaching a replacement window. On macOS window recreation, do not install a second power listener: the app-level `power` adapter forwards the current window runtime and remains installed once. Retire callbacks call `coordinator.retire`; suspend/resume callbacks call its session methods. `revokeActions` calls `coreActions.retire(oldScope)` and `actions.revokeWindow(oldScope)` on the existing ledgers, and `replaceWorkbench` changes the UUID and invalidates old bindings without creating new ones. `failed` notifies core recovery; it never calls quit or install.

Add the following diagnostic registration implementation only in `ui-bridge.ts` (T3 Step 11 exclusively implements `ui-lifecycle.ts` diagnostics), importing `FoundationDiagnostics`, `FoundationCounters`, `FoundationDiagnosticEvent` from runtime `ui-host-ports.ts` (desktop imports the package types). These maps contain only observer closures; they are not persistence or runtime attachment maps:

```ts
const foundationDiagnostics = new WeakMap<object, FoundationDiagnostics>();
function registerFoundationDiagnostics(instance: object, read: () => FoundationCounters) {
  const listeners = new Set<(event: FoundationDiagnosticEvent) => void>();
  foundationDiagnostics.set(instance, {
    snapshot: () => Object.freeze({ ...read() }),
    onEvent: (listener) => { listeners.add(listener); return () => { listeners.delete(listener); }; },
  });
  return {
    emit(event: FoundationDiagnosticEvent) {
      for (const listener of listeners) { try { listener(event); } catch { /* observation only */ } }
    },
    dispose() { listeners.clear(); },
  };
}
export function diagnosticsFor(instance: object): FoundationDiagnostics {
  const value = foundationDiagnostics.get(instance);
  if (!value) throw new Error("Unknown foundation instance.");
  return value;
}
```

```ts
import { createUiLifetimePort, currentStatusBindings, resourceFreePersistence150,
  UiCatalog, UiStateRegistry, UiSubscriptions, type PluginUiBridge, type UiCatalogSource, type Stage3RuntimePorts,
  type Stage3HostAttachment, type UiRuntimeAttachment } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import { handleSchema, resourceFailure, type CommandValue, type Result } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import { LifecycleCoordinator } from "../device-broker/lifecycle-coordinator.js";
import type { DesktopMainCompositionInput, DesktopMainComposition } from "../device-broker/lifecycle-coordinator.js";
import { attachDeviceRpc } from "../device-broker/rpc-router.js";
import { createUiRegistry, createUiChannelBinding, createUiExecutionAdapter, createPluginUiBridge,
  UiBridgeEvents, type UiExecutionAdapter } from "./ui-bridge.js";
import { UiIntent } from "./ui-intent.js";
import { UserPersistenceActions } from "./user-persistence-actions.js";
import { ShutdownCoordinator } from "./shutdown-coordinator.js";
type DesktopUi = { bridge: PluginUiBridge; catalog: UiCatalog; states: UiStateRegistry;
  subscriptions: UiSubscriptions; intent: UiIntent; actions: UserPersistenceActions;
  coordinator: ShutdownCoordinator; setRecoveryNavigation(navigate: () => void): void };
const desktopUis = new WeakMap<DesktopMainComposition, DesktopUi>();
export function desktopUi(composition: DesktopMainComposition): DesktopUi {
  const ui = desktopUis.get(composition); if (!ui) throw new Error("Unknown desktop UI composition."); return ui;
}
export async function composeDesktopMain(input: DesktopMainCompositionInput): Promise<DesktopMainComposition> {
  const { profile, now, coreActions } = input.foundationOptions;
  profile.assertHeld();
  const foundation = await input.createFoundation(input.foundationOptions);
  const broker = foundation.broker;
  let runtimeAttachment: UiRuntimeAttachment | undefined;
  const originalChannels = new Map<string, Stage3ChannelContext>();
  const ownerKey = (owner: import("@kobrixa/plugin-protocol").ResourceOwner) => JSON.stringify([
    owner.sourceKey, owner.pluginId, owner.generation, owner.hostEpoch, owner.processEpoch]);
  let plugins: PluginController | undefined;
  const runtime = (): UiRuntimeAttachment => {
    if (!runtimeAttachment) throw new Error("Stage 3 runtime not attached."); return runtimeAttachment;
  };
  // The forwarding port is inert until the callback assigns the actual manager attachment.
  const runtimePort: UiRuntimeAttachment = {
    activateInitialized: (source, signal) => runtime().activateInitialized(source, signal),
    ready: (owner, signal) => runtime().ready(owner, signal), current: owner => runtime().current(owner),
    owners: () => runtime().owners(), context: (owner, scope) => input.currentScope(scope) ? runtime().context(owner, scope) : null,
    commands: source => runtime().commands(source), invoke: (owner, invocation, signal) => runtime().invoke(owner, invocation, signal),
    dispatchDrain: (owner, request, signal) => runtime().dispatchDrain(owner, request, signal),
  };
  const events = new UiBridgeEvents(() => currentStatusBindings(states, input.scope())
    .map(({ binding, revision }) => ({ type: "state" as const, binding, revision })));
  const intent = new UiIntent(broker.intent, now, events.publish);
  const actions = new UserPersistenceActions(now, (owner, scope, uiResourceGeneration) =>
    input.currentScope(scope) && runtime().current(owner) && catalog.isCurrent({
      sourceKey: owner.sourceKey, pluginId: owner.pluginId, uiResourceGeneration }));
  const { catalog, states, subscriptions } = createUiRegistry({ hostEpoch: profile.hostEpoch, broker, now,
    beforeDelivery(sourceKey) {
      if (!plugins) throw new Error("Plugin controller not attached.");
      plugins.markThirdPartyUiContributions(sourceKey);
    },
    revokeIntent(owner, binding) {
      if (binding) intent.forget(binding);
      else for (const current of states.instances(owner)) intent.forget(current);
    },
  });
  const stage3: Stage3RuntimePorts = { device: broker.resources, persistence: resourceFreePersistence150(),
    ui: createUiLifetimePort({ catalog, states, subscriptions, revoke: (_owner, binding) => intent.forget(binding) }) };
  const lifecycle = new LifecycleCoordinator({ ports: stage3, resources: broker.resources,
    sessions: broker.sessions, reservations: broker.reservations, persistence: stage3.persistence,
    now, alive: owner => { const channel = originalChannels.get(ownerKey(owner)); return !!channel && !channel.peer.closed; },
    owners: () => runtime().owners(),
    dispatch: (owner, request, signal) => runtime().dispatchDrain(owner, request, signal),
    shutdown: async () => { if (plugins) await plugins.shutdown(); },
    legacyFlush: input.legacyFlush, report: input.report });
  const coordinator = new ShutdownCoordinator(lifecycle);
  let navigateRecovery = () => { throw new Error("Recovery navigation is not attached."); };
  const execution: UiExecutionAdapter = createUiExecutionAdapter({ catalog, states, runtime: runtimePort, scope: input.scope,
    async core(resolved, nodeId): Promise<Result<CommandValue>> {
      const node = resolved.resource.kind === "panel" ? resolved.resource.nodes.find(value => value.id === nodeId) : undefined;
      if (!node || node.type !== "action" || node.action.kind !== "core" || !runtime().current(resolved.owner))
        return resourceFailure("stale");
      const action = node.action;
      if (action.action === "openRecovery") { navigateRecovery(); return { ok: true, value: { output: {}, fieldErrors: [] } }; }
      if (action.action === "openPanel") {
        let cursor: string | undefined;
        do {
          const page = await catalog.catalog(cursor ? { cursor } : {}); if (!page.ok) return page;
          const entry = page.value.entries.find(value => value.sourceKey === resolved.owner.sourceKey && value.id === action.panelId);
          if (entry) {
            const result = await execution.open({ sourceKey: entry.sourceKey, id: entry.id, uiResourceGeneration: entry.uiResourceGeneration });
            return result.ok ? { ok: true, value: { output: {}, fieldErrors: [] } } : result;
          }
          cursor = page.value.nextCursor ?? undefined;
        } while (cursor);
        return resourceFailure("stale");
      }
      if (action.action === "stop") {
        const operationId = handleSchema.parse(resolved.state.data[action.operation.key]);
        const result = await broker.request(input.principal(resolved.owner), "devices/motion/stop", { operationId }, new AbortController().signal);
        return result.ok ? { ok: true, value: { output: {}, fieldErrors: [] } } : result;
      }
      const sessionId = handleSchema.parse(resolved.state.data[action.session.key]);
      const scope = input.scope(); if (!input.currentScope(scope)) return resourceFailure("stale");
      const token = coreActions.mint(scope, { kind: "device-disconnect", sessionId });
      try { await lifecycle.disconnect(sessionId, token); return { ok: true, value: { output: {}, fieldErrors: [] } }; }
      finally { coreActions.complete(token); }
    },
  });
  const bridge = createPluginUiBridge({ catalog, execution, intent, actions, events, scope: input.scope });
  const offCatalog = catalog.onEvent(events.publish);
  const offState = states.onEvent((_owner, event) => {
    if (event.kind === "ui.revoked") {
      intent.forget(event.data.binding); events.publish({ type: "revoked", binding: event.data.binding, reason: event.data.reason });
    } else if (event.kind === "ui.state") events.publish({ type: "state", binding: event.data.binding, revision: event.data.revision });
    else if (event.kind === "ui.visibility" && !event.data.visible) intent.revoke(event.data.binding, "hidden");
    else if (event.kind === "ui.form") intent.cancelHold(event.data.binding);
  });
  const stage3Host: Stage3HostAttachment = {
    hostEpoch: profile.hostEpoch, principal: input.principal,
    hasPermission: (owner, permission) => input.foundationOptions.hasPermission(input.principal(owner), permission),
    requirements(owner) {
      const declarations = input.foundationOptions.requirements(owner);
      return declarations === null ? null : Object.freeze(declarations.map(value => Object.freeze({ ...value })));
    },
    bindChannel: context => bindDesktopChannel(context, broker,
      { catalog, states, subscriptions, runtime: runtimePort }, originalChannels),
    retireResources: (owner, reason) => lifecycle.retire(owner, reason),
  };
  let offSources: (() => void) | undefined;
  let refresh = Promise.resolve();
  let inventory = "";
  const refreshCatalog = () => {
    refresh = refresh.catch(input.report).then(async () => {
      const sources = plugins!.uiCatalogSources(); const key = JSON.stringify(sources);
      if (key === inventory) return;
      await catalog.replace(sources); inventory = key;
    });
    void refresh.catch(input.report); return refresh;
  };
  const disposeUi = () => { offSources?.(); offState(); offCatalog(); execution.dispose(); intent.dispose();
    actions.revokeWindow(input.scope()); subscriptions.dispose(); };
  try {
    plugins = await startPlugins({ ...input.plugins, stage3, stage3Host,
      onStage3Runtime(attachment, providers) {
        if (runtimeAttachment) throw new Error("Runtime already attached.");
        runtimeAttachment = attachment;
        foundation.attachProvider(providers);
        offSources = providers.onEvent(event => { if (event.type === "state" && plugins) void refreshCatalog(); });
      },
    });
    if (!runtimeAttachment) throw new Error("Missing runtime attachment.");
    await refreshCatalog();
    let disposed = false;
    const composition: DesktopMainComposition = { foundation, plugins, stage3, stage3Host,
      async dispose() {
        if (disposed) return;
        await lifecycle.close("close"); await refresh.catch(input.report);
        disposeUi(); await foundation.dispose(); lifecycle.dispose(); disposed = true;
      },
    };
    lifecycles.set(composition, lifecycle);
    desktopUis.set(composition, { bridge, catalog, states, subscriptions, intent, actions, coordinator,
      setRecoveryNavigation(navigate) { navigateRecovery = navigate; } });
    return composition;
  } catch (error) {
    disposeUi();
    try { if (plugins) await plugins.shutdown(); await foundation.dispose(); lifecycle.dispose(); }
    catch (cleanup) { input.report(cleanup); throw cleanup; }
    throw error;
  }
}
```

```ts
interface PluginUiBridge {
  catalog(input: { cursor?: Handle }): Promise<Result<UiCatalogPage>>;
  resource(input: { sourceKey: string; id: Id; uiResourceGeneration: Counter; resourceDigest: string }): Promise<Result<{ owner: UiOwner; id: Id; version: 1; resource: PanelResourceV1 | StatusResourceV1; validationContext: UiValidationContext; rawBytes: number }>>;
  open(input: { sourceKey: string; id: Id; uiResourceGeneration: Counter }): Promise<Result<UiStateSnapshot>>;
  close(input: { binding: UiBinding }): Promise<Result<{ closed: true }>>;
  visibility(input: { binding: UiBinding; visible: boolean; reason: "tab" | "sidebar" | "collapse" | "document" | "window" }): Promise<Result<{ accepted: true }>>;
  invoke(input: { binding: UiBinding; nodeId: LocalId; formRevision: Counter; form: Record<LocalId, UiScalar> }): Promise<Result<CommandValue>>;
  hold(input: { binding: UiBinding; nodeId: LocalId; phase: "begin" | "end" | "cancel"; inputToken: Handle; formRevision: Counter; form: Record<LocalId, UiScalar> }): Promise<Result<{ gesture: Handle | null }>>;
  pulse(input: { binding: UiBinding; challenge: Handle; gesture: Handle | null; inputToken: Handle | null }): Promise<Result<{ accepted: true }>>;
  snapshot(input: { binding: UiBinding }): Promise<Result<UiStateSnapshot>>;
  reportFailure(input: { sourceKey: string; id: Id; uiResourceGeneration: Counter; catalogRevision: Counter; reason: "validation" | "renderer"; fieldPath?: string }): Promise<Result<{ accepted: boolean }>>;
  onEvent(listener: (event: UiBridgeEvent) => void): () => void;
}
interface CoreRecoveryPort {
  snapshot(input: { cursor?: Handle }): Promise<Result<CoreRecoverySnapshot>>;
  act(input: { itemId: Handle; actionId: Handle }): Promise<Result<CoreRecoverySnapshot>>;
  onChanged(listener: () => void): () => void;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the complete catalog store**

Create `apps/desktop/src/renderer/plugin-ui/catalog-store.ts`:

```ts
import type { PluginUiBridge, UiBridgeEvent, FoundationDiagnostics } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { UiCatalogEntry, UiOwner, PanelResourceV1, StatusResourceV1 } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
export const contributionKey = (entry: Pick<UiCatalogEntry, "sourceKey" | "id">): string =>
  JSON.stringify([entry.sourceKey, entry.id]);
const ownerKey = (owner: UiOwner): string => JSON.stringify([
  owner.sourceKey, owner.pluginId, owner.uiResourceGeneration,
]);
const resourceKey = (entry: UiCatalogEntry): string => JSON.stringify([
  contributionKey(entry), ownerKey(entry), entry.resourceDigest,
]);
export function bounded<T>(work: Promise<T>, milliseconds = 5000): Promise<T> {
  return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error("UI response deadline")), milliseconds);
    work.then((value) => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(value); },
      (error: unknown) => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(error); });
  });
}
export function send(work: () => Promise<unknown>): void {
  try { void work().catch(() => {}); } catch { /* synchronous adapter failure cannot interrupt revocation */ }
}
type Resource = Extract<Awaited<ReturnType<PluginUiBridge["resource"]>>, { ok: true }>["value"];
const catalogs = new WeakSet<object>();
export function catalogDiagnostics(instance: object): FoundationDiagnostics | undefined {
  if (!catalogs.has(instance)) return undefined;
  const catalog = instance as UiCatalogStore;
  return Object.freeze({ snapshot: () => Object.freeze({ owners: 0, bindings: 0, subscriptions: 0,
    queuedEvents: 0, queuedBytes: 0, timers: catalog.timerCount(), pendingInvocations: 0,
    actionTokens: 0, resourceReaders: 0, workerJobs: 0 }), onEvent: (_listener: Parameters<FoundationDiagnostics["onEvent"]>[0]) => () => {} });
}
export class UiCatalogStore {
  private cancellations = new Set<() => void>();
  timerCount(): number { return this.cancellations.size; }
  wait<T>(work: Promise<T>, milliseconds = 5000): Promise<T> {
    if (this.dead) return Promise.reject(new Error("Catalog disposed"));
    return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
      const finish = () => { clearTimeout(timer); this.cancellations.delete(cancel); };
      const cancel = () => { finish(); reject(new Error("UI response deadline/disposal")); };
      const timer = setTimeout(cancel, milliseconds); this.cancellations.add(cancel);
      work.then((value) => { finish(); resolve(value); }, (error: unknown) => { finish(); reject(error); });
    });
  }
  private view: { phase: "loading" | "ready" | "failed"; epoch: string | null; revision: number; entries: readonly UiCatalogEntry[] } = {
    phase: "loading", epoch: null, revision: -1, entries: [],
  };
  private listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  private resources = new Map<string, Promise<Resource | null>>();
  private owners: Set<string> | null = null;
  private target = -1;
  private retiredEpochs = new Set<string>();
  private serial = 0;
  private dead = false;
  private off: (() => void) | undefined;
  private flight: Promise<void> | undefined;
  private again = false;
  constructor(
    private api: Pick<PluginUiBridge, "catalog" | "resource" | "onEvent">,
    private immediate: (event: UiBridgeEvent) => void,
  ) { catalogs.add(this); }
  getSnapshot = () => this.view;
  subscribe = (listener: () => void): (() => void) => {
    this.listeners.add(listener); return () => { this.listeners.delete(listener); };
  };
  private publish() { for (const listener of this.listeners) listener(); }
  retainedReaders(): number { return this.resources.size; }
  current(entry: UiCatalogEntry): boolean {
    return !this.dead && this.view.entries.some((item) => resourceKey(item) === resourceKey(entry));
  }
  start(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.dead) return Promise.resolve();
    if (!this.off) this.off = this.api.onEvent((event) => {
      if (this.dead) return;
      if (event.type === "catalog") {
        if (this.retiredEpochs.has(event.hostEpoch)) return;
        if (event.hostEpoch === this.view.epoch && event.revision < this.target) return;
        if (event.hostEpoch !== this.view.epoch) {
          if (this.view.epoch) this.retiredEpochs.add(this.view.epoch);
          this.target = -1; this.resources.clear();
        }
        this.target = Math.max(this.target, event.revision);
        this.owners = new Set(event.owners.map(ownerKey));
        this.serial++;
        const entries = event.hostEpoch === this.view.epoch
          ? this.view.entries.filter((entry) => this.owners!.has(ownerKey(entry))) : [];
        const keep = new Set(entries.map(resourceKey));
        for (const key of this.resources.keys()) if (!keep.has(key)) this.resources.delete(key);
        this.view = { ...this.view, phase: "loading", epoch: event.hostEpoch, entries };
        this.immediate(event); this.publish(); void this.refresh();
      } else this.immediate(event);
    });
    return this.refresh();
  }
  refresh(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.dead) return Promise.resolve();
    if (this.flight) { this.again = true; return this.flight; }
    this.flight = (async () => {
      do {
        this.again = false;
        const serial = this.serial;
        try {
          let cursor: string | undefined; let epoch: string | undefined; let revision = -1;
          const entries: UiCatalogEntry[] = []; const cursors = new Set<string>();
          const ids = new Set<string>(); let bytes = 0;
          do {
            const result = await this.wait(this.api.catalog(cursor === undefined ? {} : { cursor }));
            if (this.dead || serial !== this.serial) break;
            if (!result.ok) throw new Error(result.error.code);
            const value = result.value;
            if (value.entries.length > 16 || new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(value)).length > 262144)
              throw new Error("Catalog page limit");
            if (epoch !== undefined && (epoch !== value.hostEpoch || revision !== value.revision))
              throw new Error("Catalog changed during paging");
            epoch = value.hostEpoch; revision = value.revision;
            if (this.view.epoch !== null && (epoch !== this.view.epoch || revision < this.target))
              throw new Error("Stale catalog");
            for (const entry of value.entries) {
              if (ids.has(contributionKey(entry))) throw new Error("Duplicate contribution");
              ids.add(contributionKey(entry)); entries.push(entry); bytes += entry.resourceBytes;
            }
            if (entries.filter((entry) => entry.kind === "panel").length > 16 || entries.filter((entry) => entry.kind === "status").length > 16 || bytes > 8388608) throw new Error("Catalog limit");
            for (const sourceKey of new Set(entries.map((entry) => entry.sourceKey))) {
              const own = entries.filter((entry) => entry.sourceKey === sourceKey);
              if (own.filter((entry) => entry.kind === "panel").length > 4 || own.filter((entry) => entry.kind === "status").length > 2 || own.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.resourceBytes, 0) > 1048576) throw new Error("Source catalog limit");
            }
            cursor = value.nextCursor ?? undefined;
            if (cursor) {
              if (cursors.has(cursor)) throw new Error("Cursor cycle"); cursors.add(cursor);
            }
          } while (cursor !== undefined);
          if (this.dead || serial !== this.serial) continue;
          if (epoch === undefined) throw new Error("Empty catalog response");
          if (this.owners && entries.some((entry) => !this.owners!.has(ownerKey(entry))))
            throw new Error("Retired owner");
          this.target = revision;
          this.view = { phase: "ready", epoch, revision, entries };
          this.publish();
        } catch {
          if (!this.dead && serial === this.serial) {
            this.view = { ...this.view, phase: "failed" }; this.publish();
          }
        }
      } while (this.again && !this.dead);
    })().finally(() => { this.flight = undefined; });
    return this.flight;
  }
  resource(entry: UiCatalogEntry): Promise<Resource | null> {
    if (!this.current(entry) || entry.availability !== "available") return Promise.resolve(null);
    const key = resourceKey(entry); const cached = this.resources.get(key); if (cached) return cached;
    const epoch = this.view.epoch;
    const work = this.wait(Promise.resolve().then(() => this.api.resource({ sourceKey: entry.sourceKey, id: entry.id,
      uiResourceGeneration: entry.uiResourceGeneration, resourceDigest: entry.resourceDigest })))
      .then((result) => {
        if (!this.current(entry) || epoch !== this.view.epoch || !result.ok) return null;
        const value = result.value;
        if (new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(value)).length > 524288 || value.version !== 1 || value.id !== entry.id || ownerKey(value.owner) !== ownerKey(entry)
          || value.resource.kind !== entry.kind) return null;
        return value;
      }, () => null);
    this.resources.set(key, work); return work;
  }
  dispose(): void {
    if (this.dead) return; this.dead = true; this.serial++;
    this.off?.(); this.off = undefined;
    for (const cancel of [...this.cancellations]) cancel();
    this.resources.clear(); this.listeners.clear();
  }
}
```

```ts
  retry: "Retry", export: "Export", discard: "Discard", checkpoint: "Checkpoint only", holdHint: "Hold to run; release to stop. Maximum 10 seconds.",
  actions: { stop: "Stop", reconcile: "Reconcile", "clear-resolved": "Clear resolved", "retry-save": "Retry save", manage: "Manage" },

    { id: "enabled", type: "boolean", field: "enabled", label: { en: "Enabled" } },

    { id: "hold", type: "holdAction", label: { en: "Hold" }, command: "acme.ui.hold", arguments: {} },

  resourceBytes: 1000, uiResourceGeneration: 1, availability: "available",
};

  };
  const recovery = {
    snapshot: vi.fn<CoreRecoveryPort["snapshot"]>(async () => ({ ok: true, value: { hostEpoch: handle(1), revision: 1, items: [], nextCursor: null } })),
    act: vi.fn<CoreRecoveryPort["act"]>(async () => ({ ok: true, value: { hostEpoch: handle(1), revision: 2, items: [], nextCursor: null } })),
    onChanged: vi.fn<CoreRecoveryPort["onChanged"]>((listener) => { changed.add(listener); return () => { changed.delete(listener); }; }),
  };
  return { bridge, recovery, emit: (event: UiBridgeEvent) => listeners.forEach((listener) => listener(event)),
```

```ts
import { expect, it } from "vitest";
import { fixture, snapshot, panel, binding, deferred } from "./contract.test.js";
import { UiStateStore, scalarValid } from "./state-store.js";
it("U05 preserves invalid raw draft, focus identity and full form while reconciling one snapshot", async () => {
  const f = fixture(); const pending = deferred<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof f.bridge.snapshot>>>();
  f.bridge.snapshot.mockReturnValueOnce(pending.promise);
  const store = new UiStateStore(f.bridge, panel, snapshot());
  store.edit("speed", null, "-");
  const first = store.invalidate(1); void store.invalidate(2);
  expect(f.bridge.snapshot).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  pending.resolve({ ok: true, value: snapshot(2) }); await first;
  expect(store.getSnapshot().raw.speed).toBe("-");
  expect(store.form()).toMatchObject({ form: { speed: null, enabled: false }, formRevision: 1 });
  expect(store.valid()).toBe(false);
  expect(store.getSnapshot().snapshot.binding).toEqual(binding);
  expect(store.getSnapshot().snapshot.data.count).toBe(2);
});
it("U04/U07 ignores late errors and snapshots after edits or retirement; no replay", async () => {
  const f = fixture(); const call = deferred<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof f.bridge.invoke>>>();
  f.bridge.invoke.mockReturnValue(call.promise);
  const store = new UiStateStore(f.bridge, panel, snapshot());
  const invoke = store.invoke("go"); store.edit("speed", 1, "1");
  call.resolve({ ok: true, value: { output: {}, fieldErrors: [{ field: "speed", message: { en: "Old" } }] } });
  await invoke; expect(store.getSnapshot().errors).toEqual({});
  store.retire(); await store.invalidate(3); await store.invoke("go");
  expect(f.bridge.invoke).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  expect(f.bridge.snapshot).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
});
it("U01/U15 accepts false/zero, validates 1e-9 grid tolerance and validates active fields only", () => {
  expect(scalarValid(panel.fields.speed!.schema, 0)).toBe(true);
  const f = fixture(); const resource = structuredClone(panel);
  resource.nodes.find((node) => node.id === "speed")!.visibleWhen = { op: "eq", left: { scope: "form", key: "enabled" }, right: true };
  const store = new UiStateStore(f.bridge, resource, snapshot());
  store.edit("speed", null, "-"); expect(store.valid()).toBe(true);
  store.edit("enabled", true); expect(store.valid()).toBe(false);
  store.edit("speed", 0.30000000000000004); expect(store.valid()).toBe(true);
  store.edit("speed", 0.35); expect(store.valid()).toBe(false);
  expect(store.form().form.speed).toBe(0.35); // never mask the request in renderer
});
it("U04 retains retired state while a previously requested snapshot arrives late", async () => {
  const f = fixture(); const pending = deferred<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof f.bridge.snapshot>>>();
  f.bridge.snapshot.mockReturnValue(pending.promise);
  const state = new UiStateStore(f.bridge, panel, snapshot()); const work = state.invalidate(10);
  state.edit("speed", null, "-"); state.retire();
  pending.resolve({ ok: true, value: snapshot(10) }); await work;
  expect(state.getSnapshot().snapshot.revision).toBe(0);
  expect(state.getSnapshot().raw.speed).toBe("-"); expect(state.getSnapshot().active).toBe(false);
});
```

```ts
import { fixture, panel, snapshot, deferred, handle } from "./contract.test.js";
import { UiStateStore } from "./state-store.js";
import { UiIntentController } from "./intent-controller.js";
afterEach(() => vi.useRealTimers());
it("U09/RF2 sends release before a pending begin resolves and cannot revive it", async () => {
  const f = fixture(); const pending = deferred<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof f.bridge.hold>>>();
  f.bridge.hold.mockReturnValueOnce(pending.promise);
  const state = new UiStateStore(f.bridge, panel, snapshot());
  const intent = new UiIntentController(f.bridge, state);
  intent.begin("hold", { trusted: true, kind: "pointer", id: "1", primary: true, repeat: false });
  intent.release("pointer", "1", false);
  expect(f.bridge.hold.mock.calls.map(([input]) => input.phase)).toEqual(["begin", "end"]);
  pending.resolve({ ok: true, value: { gesture: handle(4) } }); await pending.promise;
  vi.useFakeTimers(); intent.challenge(handle(9)); await vi.runAllTimersAsync();
  expect(f.bridge.pulse.mock.calls[0]![0]).toMatchObject({ gesture: null, inputToken: null });
});
it.each(["pointercancel", "lostpointercapture", "contextmenu", "Escape", "blur", "form-change"])(
  "U09 cancellation %s is forced and cannot be downgraded by a late release", async () => {
    const f = fixture(); const state = new UiStateStore(f.bridge, panel, snapshot());
    const intent = new UiIntentController(f.bridge, state);
    intent.begin("hold", { trusted: true, kind: "key", id: " ", primary: true, repeat: false });
    intent.cancel(); intent.release("key", " ", false);
    expect(f.bridge.hold.mock.calls.map(([input]) => input.phase)).toEqual(["begin", "cancel"]);
  },
);
it("U09 rejects repeat, synthetic events and extra pointers; keyup targets original key", () => {
  const f = fixture(); const intent = new UiIntentController(f.bridge, new UiStateStore(f.bridge, panel, snapshot()));
  const input = { trusted: true, kind: "key" as const, id: "Enter", primary: true, repeat: true };
  expect(intent.begin("hold", input)).toBe(false);
  expect(intent.begin("hold", { ...input, trusted: false, repeat: false })).toBe(false);
  expect(intent.begin("hold", { ...input, repeat: false })).toBe(true);
  expect(intent.begin("hold", { ...input, kind: "pointer", id: "2", repeat: false })).toBe(false);
  intent.release("key", "x", false); expect(f.bridge.hold).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  intent.release("key", "Enter", false); expect(f.bridge.hold).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
});
it("U09/U10 sends only issued challenges next turn; hide is synchronous; exact 350ms is host denied", async () => {
  vi.useFakeTimers(); const f = fixture();
  let hostNow = 0; const issuedAt = 0;
  f.bridge.pulse.mockImplementation(async () => hostNow - issuedAt < 350
    ? { ok: true, value: { accepted: true } }
    : { ok: false, error: { code: "PLUGIN_E_STALE_RESOURCE", message: "Expired" } });
  const state = new UiStateStore(f.bridge, panel, snapshot()); const intent = new UiIntentController(f.bridge, state);
  intent.begin("hold", { trusted: true, kind: "pointer", id: "1", primary: true, repeat: false });
  await Promise.resolve(); intent.challenge(handle(7)); intent.challenge(handle(8));
  expect(f.bridge.pulse).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  hostNow = 350; await vi.runAllTimersAsync();
  expect(f.bridge.pulse).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1); // coalesced, no catch-up batch
  expect(f.bridge.hold.mock.calls.at(-1)![0].phase).toBe("cancel");
  intent.challenge(handle(8)); await vi.runAllTimersAsync();
  expect(f.bridge.pulse).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  intent.hide("collapse");
  expect(f.bridge.visibility.mock.calls.at(-1)![0].visible).toBe(false);
  intent.challenge(handle(10)); await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1000);
  expect(f.bridge.pulse).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
});
```

The last test models the host's issued-at clock; it does not claim a renderer-only test proves broker timing. Actual 100 ms cadence, four outstanding challenges, 350 ms `>=` expiry, coast→forced-brake upgrade and renderer freeze/crash remain T5/T9 and X-T1 transport/provider checks.

- [ ] **Step 7: Implement state reconciliation and draft validation**

Create `state-store.ts`:

```ts
import type { PluginUiBridge, FoundationDiagnostics, FoundationCounters, FoundationDiagnosticEvent, ResourceOwner } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { Condition, PanelResourceV1, UiStateSnapshot, UiScalar, ValueSpec, UiNodeV1, Text } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import { catalogDiagnostics } from "./catalog-store.js";
export const bindingKey = (binding: UiStateSnapshot["binding"]): string => JSON.stringify([
  binding.hostEpoch, binding.processEpoch, binding.generation, binding.uiResourceGeneration,
  binding.contributionId, binding.panelInstance, binding.kind,
]);
export function condition(value: Condition | undefined, data: Record<string, UiScalar>, form: Record<string, UiScalar>): boolean {
  if (!value) return true;
  if (value.op === "all") return value.items.every((item) => condition(item, data, form));
  if (value.op === "any") return value.items.some((item) => condition(item, data, form));
  if (value.op === "not") return !condition(value.item, data, form);
  if (!("left" in value)) return false;
  const left = (value.left.scope === "data" ? data : form)[value.left.key];
  if (value.op === "eq") return left === value.right;
  if (value.op === "ne") return left !== value.right;
  if (typeof left !== "number" || typeof value.right !== "number") return false;
  if (value.op === "lt") return left < value.right;
  if (value.op === "lte") return left <= value.right;
  if (value.op === "gt") return left > value.right;
  return left >= value.right;
}
export function scalarValid(schema: ValueSpec, value: UiScalar): boolean {
  if (value === null) return schema.nullable;
  switch (schema.type) {
    case "string": return typeof value === "string" && Array.from(value).length <= schema.maxLength;
    case "number": return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= schema.min && value <= schema.max && (!schema.integer || Number.isInteger(value));
    case "boolean": return typeof value === "boolean";
    case "enum": return typeof value === "string" && schema.values.includes(value);
  }
}
export function numericDraft(raw: string): number | null {
  return /^[-+]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\.\d+)(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?$/.test(raw.trim()) && Number.isFinite(Number(raw)) ? Number(raw) : null;
}
export type StateView = {
  snapshot: UiStateSnapshot; draft: Record<string, UiScalar>; raw: Record<string, string>;
  errors: Record<string, Text>; active: boolean; busy: boolean; problem: string | null; localRevision: number;
};
const stateDiagnostics = new WeakMap<object, FoundationDiagnostics>();
const zeroCounters = (): FoundationCounters => Object.freeze({ owners: 0, bindings: 0, subscriptions: 0,
  queuedEvents: 0, queuedBytes: 0, timers: 0, pendingInvocations: 0, actionTokens: 0, resourceReaders: 0, workerJobs: 0 });
export function diagnosticsFor(instance: object): FoundationDiagnostics {
  const diagnostics = stateDiagnostics.get(instance) ?? catalogDiagnostics(instance);
  if (!diagnostics) throw new Error("Unknown renderer state instance");
  return diagnostics;
}
export class UiStateStore {
  private deadlines = new Map<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>, () => void>();
  private retained = new Map<object, number>();
  private diagnosticListeners = new Set<(event: FoundationDiagnosticEvent) => void>();
  private diagnosticOwner: ResourceOwner | undefined;
  private committedRevision = -1;
  private inputTimers = new Set<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();
  private inputQueue: string | undefined;
  trackInputTimer(timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>): void { this.inputTimers.add(timer); }
  clearInputTimer(timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>): void { clearTimeout(timer); this.inputTimers.delete(timer); }
  queueChallenge(challenge: string | undefined): void { this.inputQueue = challenge; }
  setDiagnosticOwner(owner: ResourceOwner): void { this.diagnosticOwner = owner; }
  private observe(kind: "apply" | "revoke"): void {
    if (!this.diagnosticOwner) return;
    const event: FoundationDiagnosticEvent = { kind, owner: this.diagnosticOwner,
      binding: this.view.snapshot.binding, time: performance.timeOrigin + performance.now() };
    this.diagnosticListeners.forEach((listener) => listener(event));
  }
  renderCommitted(revision: number): void {
    if (!this.view.active || revision !== this.view.snapshot.revision || revision <= this.committedRevision) return;
    this.committedRevision = revision; this.retained.clear(); this.observe("apply");
  }
  intentRevoked(): void { this.observe("revoke"); }
  private deadline<T>(promise: Promise<T>, milliseconds = 5000): Promise<T> {
    return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
      const cancel = () => { clearTimeout(timer); this.deadlines.delete(timer); reject(new Error("Renderer request ended")); };
      const timer = setTimeout(cancel, milliseconds); this.deadlines.set(timer, cancel);
      promise.then((value) => { clearTimeout(timer); this.deadlines.delete(timer); resolve(value); },
        (error: unknown) => { clearTimeout(timer); this.deadlines.delete(timer); reject(error); });
    });
  }
  private view: StateView;
  private listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  private pending: Promise<void> | undefined;
  private target: number;
  private serial = 0;
  onEdit: () => void = () => {};
  onAccepted: (nodeId: string) => void = () => {};
  constructor(private bridge: Pick<PluginUiBridge, "snapshot" | "invoke">, readonly resource: PanelResourceV1, initial: UiStateSnapshot) {
    stateDiagnostics.set(this, Object.freeze({
      snapshot: () => Object.freeze({ ...zeroCounters(), timers: this.deadlines.size + this.inputTimers.size,
        queuedEvents: this.retained.size + (this.inputQueue ? 1 : 0), queuedBytes: [...this.retained.values()].reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) + (this.inputQueue ? new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(this.inputQueue)).length : 0) }),
      onEvent: (listener: (event: FoundationDiagnosticEvent) => void) => {
        this.diagnosticListeners.add(listener); return () => { this.diagnosticListeners.delete(listener); };
      },
    }));
    this.target = initial.revision;
    this.view = { snapshot: initial, draft: { ...initial.form }, raw: {}, errors: {}, active: true, busy: false, problem: null, localRevision: initial.formRevision };
  }
  getSnapshot = (): StateView => this.view;
  subscribe = (listener: () => void): (() => void) => { this.listeners.add(listener); return () => { this.listeners.delete(listener); }; };
  private publish(update: Partial<StateView>) { this.view = { ...this.view, ...update }; this.listeners.forEach((listener) => listener()); }
  edit(key: string, value: UiScalar, raw?: string): void {
    if (!this.view.active || !Object.hasOwn(this.resource.fields, key)) return;
    if (this.view.localRevision >= Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) { this.retire(); return; }
    this.onEdit(); const errors = { ...this.view.errors }; delete errors[key];
    const nextRaw = { ...this.view.raw }; if (raw === undefined) delete nextRaw[key]; else nextRaw[key] = raw;
    this.publish({ draft: { ...this.view.draft, [key]: value }, raw: nextRaw,
      localRevision: this.view.localRevision + 1, errors, problem: null });
  }
  presentation(): Map<string, { visible: boolean; enabled: boolean }> {
    const result = new Map<string, { visible: boolean; enabled: boolean }>();
    const nodes = new Map(this.resource.nodes.map((node) => [node.id, node]));
    const walk = (id: string, visible: boolean, enabled: boolean): void => {
      const node = nodes.get(id); if (!node || result.has(id)) return;
      const state = { visible: visible && condition(node.visibleWhen, this.view.snapshot.data, this.view.draft),
        enabled: enabled && condition(node.enabledWhen, this.view.snapshot.data, this.view.draft) };
      result.set(id, state); if (node.type === "group") node.children.forEach((child) => walk(child, state.visible, state.enabled));

    walk(this.resource.root, true, true); return result;
  }
  nodeEnabled(id: string): boolean { const state = this.presentation().get(id); return this.view.active && !!state?.visible && state.enabled; }
  fieldValid(node: UiNodeV1): boolean {
    if (!("field" in node)) return true;
    const field = this.resource.fields[node.field]; if (!field) return false;
    const value = this.view.draft[node.field] ?? null;
    const raw = this.view.raw[node.field];
    if (field.schema.type === "number" && raw !== undefined && raw.trim() !== "" && numericDraft(raw) === null) return false;
    const required = field.required || (field.requiredWhen !== undefined && condition(field.requiredWhen, this.view.snapshot.data, this.view.draft));
    if (required && (value === null || value === "")) return false;
    if (!scalarValid(field.schema, value)) return false;
    if ((node.type === "number" || node.type === "range") && typeof value === "number" && field.schema.type === "number") {
      const grid = (value - field.schema.min) / node.step;
      return Math.abs(grid - Math.round(grid)) <= 1e-9 * Math.max(1, Math.abs(grid));
    }
    return true;
  }
  valid(): boolean {
    const states = this.presentation();
    return this.view.active && new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(this.view.draft)).length <= 16384 && this.resource.nodes.every((node) => !states.get(node.id)?.visible || !states.get(node.id)?.enabled || this.fieldValid(node));
  }
  nextAction(): boolean { if (this.view.localRevision >= Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) { this.retire(); return false; } this.publish({ localRevision: this.view.localRevision + 1, errors: {}, problem: null }); return true; }
  form() { return { binding: this.view.snapshot.binding, formRevision: this.view.localRevision, form: { ...this.view.draft } }; }
  invalidate(revision: number): Promise<void> {
    this.target = Math.max(this.target, revision);
    if (!this.view.active || this.target <= this.view.snapshot.revision) return Promise.resolve();
    if (this.pending) return this.pending;
    const serial = this.serial;
    this.pending = (async () => {
      try {
        while (this.view.active && this.view.snapshot.revision < this.target) {
          const result = await this.deadline(this.bridge.snapshot({ binding: this.view.snapshot.binding }));
          if (!this.view.active || serial !== this.serial) return;
          if (!result.ok) throw new Error(result.error.code);
          if (bindingKey(result.value.binding) !== bindingKey(this.view.snapshot.binding) || result.value.revision <= this.view.snapshot.revision)
            throw new Error("Stale UI state");
          this.retained.clear();
          this.retained.set(result.value, new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(result.value)).length);
          this.publish({ snapshot: result.value, localRevision: Math.max(this.view.localRevision, result.value.formRevision) }); // preserve local draft/raw/error
        }
      } catch { if (this.view.active) this.publish({ problem: "snapshot" }); }
    })().finally(() => { this.pending = undefined; });
    return this.pending;
  }
  async invoke(nodeId: string): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.nodeEnabled(nodeId) || !this.valid() || this.view.busy || this.view.localRevision >= Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) return;
    const revision = this.view.localRevision + 1;
    this.publish({ localRevision: revision, busy: true, errors: {}, problem: null });
    try {
      const result = await this.deadline(this.bridge.invoke({ ...this.form(), nodeId }), 30000);
      if (!this.view.active || this.view.localRevision !== revision) return;
      if (!result.ok) this.publish({ problem: result.error.code });
      else {
        this.publish({ errors: Object.fromEntries(result.value.fieldErrors.filter((error) => Object.hasOwn(this.resource.fields, error.field)).map((error) => [error.field, error.message])) });
        if (result.value.fieldErrors.length === 0) this.onAccepted(nodeId);
      }
    } catch { if (this.view.active && this.view.localRevision === revision) this.publish({ problem: "command" }); }
    finally { if (this.view.active) this.publish({ busy: false }); }
  }
  retire(): void { if (!this.view.active) return; this.onEdit(); this.serial++; this.publish({ active: false, busy: false });
    for (const cancel of [...this.deadlines.values()]) cancel();
    for (const timer of this.inputTimers) clearTimeout(timer); this.inputTimers.clear(); this.inputQueue = undefined;
    this.retained.clear(); this.listeners.clear(); this.diagnosticListeners.clear();
  }
}
```

```ts
import type { PluginUiBridge } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import { UiStateStore } from "./state-store.js";
import { send } from "./catalog-store.js";
type Input = { trusted: boolean; kind: "pointer" | "key"; id: string; primary: boolean; repeat: boolean };
type Held = { nodeId: string; input: Input; token: string; gesture: string | null };
export class UiIntentController {
  private held: Held | undefined;
  private visible = true;
  private focused = true;
  private dead = false;
  private queued: string | undefined;
  private seen: string[] = [];
  private timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  private offState: () => void;
  constructor(private bridge: Pick<PluginUiBridge, "hold" | "pulse" | "visibility">, private state: UiStateStore) {
    state.onEdit = () => this.cancel();
    this.offState = state.subscribe(() => { if (this.held && (!state.nodeEnabled(this.held.nodeId) || !state.valid())) this.cancel(); });
  }
  begin(nodeId: string, input: Input): boolean {
    if (this.dead || this.held || !this.visible || !this.focused || !input.trusted || !input.primary || input.repeat
      || (input.kind === "key" && input.id !== " " && input.id !== "Enter") || !this.state.nodeEnabled(nodeId) || !this.state.valid()) return false;
    if (!this.state.nextAction()) return false;
    const held: Held = { nodeId, input, token: crypto.randomUUID(), gesture: null }; this.held = held;
    try { void this.bridge.hold({ ...this.state.form(), nodeId, phase: "begin", inputToken: held.token }).then((result) => {
      if (this.held !== held || this.dead) return;
      if (!result.ok) { this.cancel(); return; }
      held.gesture = result.value.gesture;
    }, () => { if (this.held === held) this.cancel(); }); }
    catch { if (this.held === held) this.cancel(); return false; }
    return true;
  }
  release(kind: Input["kind"], id: string, forced: boolean): void {
    const held = this.held; if (!held || held.input.kind !== kind || held.input.id !== id) return;
    this.held = undefined; this.state.intentRevoked(); // synchronously before any IPC promise settles
    send(() => this.bridge.hold({ ...this.state.form(), nodeId: held.nodeId, phase: forced ? "cancel" : "end", inputToken: held.token }));
  }
  cancel(): void { if (this.held) this.release(this.held.input.kind, this.held.input.id, true); }
  focus(focused: boolean): void { this.focused = focused; if (!focused) this.cancel(); }
  challenge(challenge: string): void {
    if (this.dead || !this.visible || !this.focused || !this.state.getSnapshot().active || this.seen.includes(challenge)) return;
    this.seen = [...this.seen.slice(-3), challenge]; this.queued = challenge; this.state.queueChallenge(challenge);
    if (this.timer !== undefined) return;
    this.timer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (this.timer !== undefined) this.state.clearInputTimer(this.timer);
      this.timer = undefined; const current = this.queued; this.queued = undefined; this.state.queueChallenge(undefined);
      if (!current || this.dead || !this.visible || !this.focused || !this.state.getSnapshot().active) return;
      if (this.held && (!this.state.valid() || !this.state.nodeEnabled(this.held.nodeId))) this.cancel();
      try { void this.bridge.pulse({ binding: this.state.form().binding, challenge: current,
        gesture: this.held?.gesture ?? null, inputToken: this.held?.token ?? null }).then((result) => {
        if (!result.ok) this.cancel();
      }, () => this.cancel()); } catch { this.cancel(); }
    }, 0);
    this.state.trackInputTimer(this.timer);
  }
  hide(reason: Parameters<PluginUiBridge["visibility"]>[0]["reason"]): Promise<void> { return this.visibility(false, reason); }
  async visibility(visible: boolean, reason: Parameters<PluginUiBridge["visibility"]>[0]["reason"]): Promise<void> {
    this.visible = visible;
    if (!visible) { this.cancel(); this.queued = undefined; this.state.queueChallenge(undefined); if (this.timer !== undefined) this.state.clearInputTimer(this.timer); this.timer = undefined; }
    try { const result = await this.bridge.visibility({ binding: this.state.form().binding, visible, reason }); if (!result.ok) this.cancel(); }
    catch { this.cancel(); }
  }
  dispose(): void { if (this.dead) return; this.cancel(); this.dead = true; this.offState(); if (this.timer !== undefined) this.state.clearInputTimer(this.timer); this.timer = undefined; this.queued = undefined; this.state.queueChallenge(undefined); }
}
```
