```ts
import type { PluginUiBridge, UiBridgeEvent } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { UiCatalogEntry, UiBinding, PanelResourceV1, StatusResourceV1 } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import { validateUiResource, type UiValidationContext } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import { bounded, contributionKey, send, UiCatalogStore } from "./catalog-store.js";
import { bindingKey, UiStateStore } from "./state-store.js";
import { UiIntentController } from "./intent-controller.js";
export type PanelRecord = { entry: UiCatalogEntry; resource: PanelResourceV1 | StatusResourceV1; state: UiStateStore; intent: UiIntentController };
type VisibilityReason = Parameters<PluginUiBridge["visibility"]>[0]["reason"];
const kinds = new Set(["group", "text", "help", "textInput", "number", "range", "choice", "boolean", "action", "holdAction", "status", "alert", "progress", "keyValue"]);
export function assertRenderable(resource: PanelResourceV1 | StatusResourceV1, validationContext: UiValidationContext, rawBytes: number): void {
  const measured = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(resource)).length;
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(rawBytes) || rawBytes < 0) throw new Error("Invalid admitted byte count");
  const validated = validateUiResource(resource, validationContext, Math.max(rawBytes, measured));
  if (!validated.ok) throw new Error(validated.error.code);
  if (new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(resource)).length > 262144) throw new Error("UI resource budget");
  if (resource.kind === "status") {
    if ("nodes" in resource || "action" in resource || "actions" in resource) throw new Error("Status cannot contain actions");
    return;
  }
  if (resource.kind !== "panel" || resource.nodes.length > 256 || Object.keys(resource.fields).length > 32 || Object.keys(resource.data).length > 64)
    throw new Error("UI tree budget");
  const nodes = new Map(resource.nodes.map((node) => [node.id, node])); const seen = new Set<string>();
  const visit = (id: string, depth: number): void => {
    const node = nodes.get(id);
    if (!node || !kinds.has(node.type) || seen.has(id) || depth > 8) throw new Error("Invalid UI tree");
    seen.add(id);
    if ("field" in node && !Object.hasOwn(resource.fields, node.field)) throw new Error("Invalid UI field");
    if (node.type === "group") node.children.forEach((child) => visit(child, depth + 1));
  };
  visit(resource.root, 1);
  if (seen.size !== resource.nodes.length) throw new Error("Orphan or duplicate UI node");
}
export class RendererSession {
  readonly catalog: UiCatalogStore;
  private records = new Map<string, PanelRecord>();
  private opening = new Map<string, Promise<void>>();
  private failures = new Set<string>();
  private unavailableStatus = new Set<string>();
  private statusPending = new Set<string>();
  private statusEvents = new Map<string, Extract<UiBridgeEvent, { type: "state" }>>();
  private offCatalog: () => void;
  private listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  private revision = 0;
  private ready: Promise<void> | undefined;
  private dead = false;
  private serial = 0;
  private pane = false;
  private selected: string | null = null;
  private recoveryRequest = 0;
  private documentVisible = true;
  private focused = true;
  constructor(readonly bridge: PluginUiBridge) {
    this.catalog = new UiCatalogStore(bridge, (event) => this.event(event));
    this.offCatalog = this.catalog.subscribe(() => {
      const catalog = this.catalog.getSnapshot();
      if (catalog.phase === "ready") for (const [key, event] of this.statusEvents) {
        if (!catalog.entries.some((item) => item.kind === "status" && item.id === event.binding.contributionId
          && item.uiResourceGeneration === event.binding.uiResourceGeneration)) this.statusEvents.delete(key);
      }
      for (const event of this.statusEvents.values()) void this.adoptStatus(event);
    });
  }
  subscribe = (listener: () => void): (() => void) => { this.listeners.add(listener); return () => { this.listeners.delete(listener); }; };
  getSnapshot = (): number => this.revision;
  private publish(): void { this.revision++; this.listeners.forEach((listener) => listener()); }
  record(entry: UiCatalogEntry): PanelRecord | undefined { return this.records.get(contributionKey(entry)); }
  selectedKey(): string | null { return this.selected; }
  getRecoveryRequest = (): number => this.recoveryRequest;
  statusUnavailable(entry: UiCatalogEntry): boolean { return this.unavailableStatus.has(contributionKey(entry)); }
  failed(entry: UiCatalogEntry): boolean { return this.failures.has(this.failureKey(entry)); }
  private failureKey(entry: UiCatalogEntry): string { return JSON.stringify([this.catalog.getSnapshot().epoch, contributionKey(entry), entry.uiResourceGeneration, entry.resourceDigest]); }
  start(): Promise<void> { return this.ready ??= this.catalog.start(); }
  showPane(visible: boolean, reason: VisibilityReason): void {
    this.pane = visible; if (!visible) this.serial++;
    for (const [key, record] of this.records) if (record.entry.kind === "panel") void record.intent.visibility(visible && this.documentVisible && this.focused && key === this.selected, reason);
    this.publish();
  }
  select(entry: UiCatalogEntry): void {
    this.serial++; this.selected = contributionKey(entry);
    for (const [key, record] of this.records) if (record.entry.kind === "panel") void record.intent.visibility(this.pane && this.documentVisible && this.focused && key === this.selected, "tab");
    this.publish();
  }
  environment(visible: boolean, focused: boolean, reason: "document" | "window"): void {
    this.documentVisible = visible; this.focused = focused;
    if (!visible || !focused) this.serial++;
    for (const [key, record] of this.records) {
      record.intent.focus(focused);
      void record.intent.visibility(visible && focused && (record.entry.kind === "status" || this.pane && key === this.selected), reason);
    }
  }
  async setVisibility(binding: UiBinding, visible: boolean, reason: VisibilityReason): Promise<void> {
    const record = [...this.records.values()].find((item) => bindingKey(item.state.form().binding) === bindingKey(binding));
    if (record) await record.intent.visibility(visible, reason);
  }
  open(entry: UiCatalogEntry): Promise<void> {
    const key = contributionKey(entry); const pending = this.opening.get(key); if (pending) return pending;
    if (this.dead || !this.pane || !this.focused || !this.documentVisible || this.failed(entry) || !this.catalog.current(entry) || entry.kind !== "panel") return Promise.resolve();
    this.select(entry);
    if (this.records.has(key)) return Promise.resolve();
    const serial = this.serial;
    const work = (async () => {
      const admitted = await this.catalog.resource(entry);
      const resource = admitted?.resource;
      if (this.dead || !this.catalog.current(entry) || serial !== this.serial) return;
      if (!resource) { this.failures.add(this.failureKey(entry)); this.publish(); return; }
      try { assertRenderable(resource, admitted!.validationContext, admitted!.rawBytes); } catch { this.quarantine(entry, "validation"); return; }
      try {
        const result = await this.bridge.open({ sourceKey: entry.sourceKey, id: entry.id, uiResourceGeneration: entry.uiResourceGeneration });
        if (!result.ok) { this.failures.add(this.failureKey(entry)); this.publish(); return; }
        if (this.dead || !this.pane || serial !== this.serial || !this.catalog.current(entry) || result.value.binding.contributionId !== entry.id || result.value.binding.kind !== "panel" || result.value.binding.uiResourceGeneration !== entry.uiResourceGeneration || result.value.binding.hostEpoch !== this.catalog.getSnapshot().epoch) { send(() => this.bridge.close({ binding: result.value.binding })); return; }
        const state = new UiStateStore(this.bridge, resource as PanelResourceV1, result.value);
        state.setDiagnosticOwner({ sourceKey: entry.sourceKey, pluginId: entry.pluginId, generation: result.value.binding.generation, hostEpoch: result.value.binding.hostEpoch, processEpoch: result.value.binding.processEpoch });
        const intent = new UiIntentController(this.bridge, state);
        state.onAccepted = (nodeId) => {
          if (resource.kind !== "panel") return;
          const node = resource.nodes.find((item) => item.id === nodeId);
          if (node?.type !== "action" || node.action.kind !== "core") return;
          if (node.action.action === "openRecovery") { this.recoveryRequest++; this.publish(); }
          else if (node.action.action === "openPanel") {
            const panelId = node.action.panelId;
            const target = this.catalog.getSnapshot().entries.find((item) => item.sourceKey === entry.sourceKey && item.id === panelId && item.kind === "panel");
            if (target) void this.open(target);
          }
        };
        this.records.set(key, { entry, resource, state, intent });
        void intent.visibility(true, "tab"); this.publish();
      } catch { this.failures.add(this.failureKey(entry)); this.publish(); }
    })().finally(() => { this.opening.delete(key); });
    this.opening.set(key, work); return work;
  }
  close(entry: UiCatalogEntry): void {
    this.serial++; const key = contributionKey(entry); const record = this.records.get(key); if (!record) return;
    record.intent.dispose(); record.state.retire(); this.records.delete(key); this.publish();
    send(() => this.bridge.close({ binding: record.state.form().binding }));
  }
  quarantine(entry: UiCatalogEntry, reason: "validation" | "renderer"): void {
    const key = this.failureKey(entry); if (this.failures.has(key)) return;
    this.failures.add(key); this.close(entry); this.publish();
    send(() => this.bridge.reportFailure({ sourceKey: entry.sourceKey, id: entry.id, uiResourceGeneration: entry.uiResourceGeneration,
      catalogRevision: Math.max(0, this.catalog.getSnapshot().revision), reason }));
  }
  private event(event: UiBridgeEvent): void {
    if (this.dead) return;
    if (event.type === "catalog") {
      this.serial++;
      for (const record of [...this.records.values()]) {
        if (record.state.form().binding.hostEpoch !== event.hostEpoch || !event.owners.some((owner) => owner.sourceKey === record.entry.sourceKey
          && owner.pluginId === record.entry.pluginId && owner.uiResourceGeneration === record.entry.uiResourceGeneration)) this.close(record.entry);
      }
      const keep = new Set(this.catalog.getSnapshot().entries.map((entry) => this.failureKey(entry)));
      for (const key of this.failures) if (!keep.has(key)) this.failures.delete(key);
      const current = this.catalog.getSnapshot().entries;
      for (const key of this.unavailableStatus) if (!current.some((entry) => contributionKey(entry) === key)) this.unavailableStatus.delete(key);
      for (const [key, pending] of this.statusEvents) if (pending.binding.hostEpoch !== event.hostEpoch) this.statusEvents.delete(key);
      return;
    }
    const record = [...this.records.values()].find((item) => bindingKey(item.state.form().binding) === bindingKey(event.binding));
    if (event.type === "revoked") {
      if (record) {
        const retired = ["closed", "generation-retired", "resource-replaced", "renderer-gone", "process-gone", "safe-mode", "shutdown"].includes(event.reason);
        if (retired) {
          if (record.entry.kind === "status") this.unavailableStatus.add(contributionKey(record.entry));
          this.close(record.entry);
        } else record.intent.cancel(); // release/hide/expiry withdraw intent, retaining the UI draft
      }
      this.statusEvents.delete(bindingKey(event.binding)); return;
    }
    if (record) {
      if (event.type === "state") void record.state.invalidate(event.revision);
      else record.intent.challenge(event.challenge);
    } else if (event.type === "state" && event.binding.kind === "status") {
      const key = bindingKey(event.binding);
      const previous = this.statusEvents.get(key);
      if ((!previous || event.revision > previous.revision) && (previous || this.statusEvents.size < 16)) this.statusEvents.set(key, event);
      void this.adoptStatus(event);
    }
  }
  private async adoptStatus(event: Extract<UiBridgeEvent, { type: "state" }>): Promise<void> {
    const bindingId = bindingKey(event.binding);
    const entry = this.catalog.getSnapshot().entries.find((item) => item.id === event.binding.contributionId && item.kind === "status"
      && item.uiResourceGeneration === event.binding.uiResourceGeneration);
    if (!entry || event.binding.hostEpoch !== this.catalog.getSnapshot().epoch || this.record(entry) || this.statusPending.has(bindingId)) return;
    this.statusPending.add(bindingId);
    try {
      const admitted = await this.catalog.resource(entry);
      const resource = admitted?.resource;
      if (!resource || resource.kind !== "status") return;
      try { assertRenderable(resource, admitted!.validationContext, admitted!.rawBytes); }
      catch { this.quarantine(entry, "validation"); return; }
      const result = await this.catalog.wait(this.bridge.snapshot({ binding: event.binding }));
      if (!result.ok || this.dead || !this.statusEvents.has(bindingId) || !!this.record(entry) || !this.catalog.current(entry) || bindingKey(result.value.binding) !== bindingId) return;
      const state = new UiStateStore(this.bridge, { kind: "panel", data: resource.data, fields: {}, root: "root", nodes: [{ id: "root", type: "group", layout: "stack", children: [] }] }, result.value);
      state.setDiagnosticOwner({ sourceKey: entry.sourceKey, pluginId: entry.pluginId, generation: result.value.binding.generation, hostEpoch: result.value.binding.hostEpoch, processEpoch: result.value.binding.processEpoch });
      this.records.set(contributionKey(entry), { entry, resource, state, intent: new UiIntentController(this.bridge, state) });
      this.unavailableStatus.delete(contributionKey(entry));
      const latest = this.statusEvents.get(bindingId); this.statusEvents.delete(bindingId);
      if (latest) void state.invalidate(latest.revision); this.publish();
    } catch { if (!this.dead && this.catalog.current(entry)) this.quarantine(entry, "renderer"); }
    finally { this.statusPending.delete(bindingId); }
  }
  dispose(): void {
    if (this.dead) return; this.dead = true; this.serial++;
    for (const record of [...this.records.values()]) this.close(record.entry);
    this.offCatalog(); this.catalog.dispose(); this.listeners.clear(); this.failures.clear(); this.statusPending.clear(); this.statusEvents.clear(); this.unavailableStatus.clear();
  }
}
export async function bootstrapPluginUi(session: RendererSession): Promise<void> {
  try { await session.catalog.wait(session.start()); } catch { /* editor restoration proceeds after the single 5s budget */ }
}
```

AM-19 carries the admitted `validationContext` and `rawBytes` with the resource DTO. `assertRenderable` calls the same browser-safe protocol validator first, using the larger of original and reserialized byte lengths, then its defensive tree guards. Validation failure quarantines the entire contribution. Core actions are sent via `invoke({binding,nodeId,...})`; after successful main acceptance, local openPanel/openRecovery navigation changes only the view. Stop/disconnect remain main-owned; renderer code never mints a capability. AM-17 requires atomic subscribe-before-fetch replay of the current catalog and every live status binding for this workbench. Queue those state invalidations even before the catalog resolves; reconcile by binding/generation and maximum revision. Remount/reconnect receives the same bounded replay without calling open or activating a process.

```ts
import type { CoreRecoveryPort, PluginUiBridge, SettingsFormBinding, ContributedSettingsForm, SettingsFieldMap, FoundationDiagnostics } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { UiBinding, SettingsSnapshot, SettingsResourceV1, SettingsScalar, SettingsText, SettingKey, Values } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import { RendererSession, bootstrapPluginUi } from "./bootstrap.js";
export interface PluginUiRendererHost {
  start(): Promise<void>;
  setVisibility(binding: UiBinding, visible: boolean, reason: Parameters<PluginUiBridge["visibility"]>[0]["reason"]): Promise<void>;
  dispose(): void;
}
export type SettingsDraftState = {
  baseline: SettingsSnapshot; draft: Values; busyKeys: SettingKey[];
  errors: Array<{ key: SettingKey; message: SettingsText }>;
};
export interface SettingsControlsPort {
  render(binding: SettingsFormBinding, resource: SettingsResourceV1, state: SettingsDraftState): void;
  onChange(listener: (binding: SettingsFormBinding, key: SettingKey, value: SettingsScalar, phase: "change" | "blur" | "enter" | "reset") => void): () => void;
  dispose(binding: SettingsFormBinding): void;
}
export type UiLabels = {
  tools: string; open: string; close: string; empty: string; unavailable: string; loading: string;
  invalid: string; recovery: string; refresh: string; reset: string; previous: string; next: string;
  retry: string; export: string; discard: string; checkpoint: string; holdHint: string;
  actions: Record<"stop" | "reconcile" | "clear-resolved" | "retry-save" | "manage", string>;
};
type SettingsAttachment = {
  retry: ContributedSettingsForm["retry"]; reload: ContributedSettingsForm["reload"];
  fieldMap: (resource: SettingsResourceV1) => SettingsFieldMap;
};
const attachments = new WeakMap<SettingsControlsPort, SettingsAttachment>();
export function attachSettingsControls(controls: SettingsControlsPort, input: SettingsAttachment): () => void {
  if (attachments.has(controls)) throw new Error("Settings controls already attached");
  attachments.set(controls, input);
  return () => { if (attachments.get(controls) === input) attachments.delete(controls); };
}
export function settingsAttachment(controls: SettingsControlsPort): SettingsAttachment | undefined {
  return attachments.get(controls);
}
const viewTimers = new WeakMap<object, () => number>();
export function registerRecoveryDiagnostics(instance: object, timers: () => number): void {
  viewTimers.set(instance, timers);
}
const sessions = new WeakMap<PluginUiRendererHost, RendererSession>();
export function diagnosticsFor(instance: object): FoundationDiagnostics {
  const session = sessions.get(instance as PluginUiRendererHost);
  const timers = viewTimers.get(instance);
  if (!session && !timers) throw new Error("Unknown renderer host instance");
  return Object.freeze({
    snapshot: () => Object.freeze({ owners: 0, bindings: 0, subscriptions: 0, queuedEvents: 0,
      queuedBytes: 0, timers: timers?.() ?? 0, pendingInvocations: 0, actionTokens: 0,
      resourceReaders: session?.catalog.retainedReaders() ?? 0, workerJobs: 0 }),
    onEvent: (_listener: Parameters<FoundationDiagnostics["onEvent"]>[0]) => () => {},
  });
}
export function rendererSession(host: PluginUiRendererHost): RendererSession {
  const session = sessions.get(host); if (!session) throw new Error("Unknown UI host"); return session;
}
export function createPluginUiRendererHost(input: { bridge: PluginUiBridge; recovery: CoreRecoveryPort }): PluginUiRendererHost {
  const session = new RendererSession(input.bridge);
  const host: PluginUiRendererHost = {
    start: () => bootstrapPluginUi(session),
    setVisibility: (binding, visible, reason) => session.setVisibility(binding, visible, reason),
    dispose: () => session.dispose(),
  };
  sessions.set(host, session); return host;
}
```

`recovery` remains the frozen required constructor input. Recovery mounting receives this same port directly; factory startup never waits for recovery or optional activation.

```tsx
import { Component, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, useSyncExternalStore, type ReactNode } from "react";
import type { DisplayText, DisplayValue, Text, UiNodeV1, UiScalar } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { UiLabels } from "./host-ports.js";
import { condition, numericDraft, UiStateStore } from "./state-store.js";
import type { UiIntentController } from "./intent-controller.js";
export const translated = (text: Text, locale: "en" | "zh-TW"): string => locale === "zh-TW" ? text["zh-TW"] ?? text.en : text.en;
export function displayText(value: DisplayText, data: Record<string, UiScalar>, locale: "en" | "zh-TW"): string {
  return "text" in value ? translated(value.text, locale) : String(data[value.ref.key] ?? "");
}
export function LiveText({ text, alert = false }: { text: string; alert?: boolean }) {
  const [announced, setAnnounced] = useState(text); const latest = useRef(text); latest.current = text;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (alert) { setAnnounced(text); return; }
    const timer = setInterval(() => setAnnounced(latest.current), 1000); return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [alert]);
  return <span role={alert ? "alert" : "status"} aria-live={alert ? "assertive" : "polite"} aria-atomic="true">{alert ? text : announced}</span>;
}
export class ContributionBoundary extends Component<{ children: ReactNode; onFailure: () => void; fallback: string }, { failed: boolean }> {
  state = { failed: false };
  static getDerivedStateFromError() { return { failed: true }; }
  componentDidCatch() { this.props.onFailure(); }
  render() { return this.state.failed ? <p role="alert">{this.props.fallback}</p> : this.props.children; }
}
export function PanelTree({ state, intent, locale, labels }: { state: UiStateStore; intent: UiIntentController; locale: "en" | "zh-TW"; labels: UiLabels }) {
  const view = useSyncExternalStore(state.subscribe, state.getSnapshot);
  useLayoutEffect(() => state.renderCommitted(view.snapshot.revision), [state, view.snapshot.revision]);
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null); const focus = useRef<{ element: HTMLElement; groups: string[] } | null>(null);
  const presentation = state.presentation(); const nodes = new Map(state.resource.nodes.map((node) => [node.id, node]));
  useEffect(() => {
    const up = (event: PointerEvent) => intent.release("pointer", String(event.pointerId), false);
    const key = (event: KeyboardEvent) => intent.release("key", event.key, false);
    const cancel = () => intent.cancel();
    window.addEventListener("pointerup", up); window.addEventListener("keyup", key); window.addEventListener("blur", cancel);
    return () => { cancel(); window.removeEventListener("pointerup", up); window.removeEventListener("keyup", key); window.removeEventListener("blur", cancel); };
  }, [intent]);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const remembered = focus.current;
    if (remembered && (!remembered.element.isConnected || remembered.element.closest("[hidden]") || remembered.element.matches(":disabled"))) {
      for (const id of remembered.groups) {
        const group = root.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-ui-group="${id}"]`);
        if (group && !group.closest("[hidden]")) { group.focus(); return; }
      }
      root.current?.focus();
    }
  }, [view]);
  const text = (value: Text) => translated(value, locale);
  const value = (input: DisplayValue): UiScalar => "literal" in input ? input.literal : (input.ref.scope === "data" ? view.snapshot.data : view.draft)[input.ref.key] ?? null;
  const render = (id: string): ReactNode => {
    const node = nodes.get(id); if (!node) throw new Error("Missing UI node");
    const available = presentation.get(id)!; const disabled = !available.enabled || !view.active;
    const domId = `ui-${view.snapshot.binding.panelInstance}-${id}`;
    const field = "field" in node ? node.field : undefined;
    const help = node.type === "holdAction" ? `${labels.holdHint}${node.help ? ` ${text(node.help)}` : ""}` : "help" in node && node.help ? text(node.help) : undefined;
    const error = field && view.errors[field] ? text(view.errors[field]!) : field && !state.fieldValid(node) ? labels.invalid : undefined;
    const description = [help && `${domId}-help`, error && `${domId}-error`].filter(Boolean).join(" ") || undefined;
    const descriptor = field ? state.resource.fields[field] : undefined;
    const required = !!descriptor && (descriptor.required || descriptor.requiredWhen !== undefined && condition(descriptor.requiredWhen, view.snapshot.data, view.draft));
    const common = { id: domId, disabled, "aria-describedby": description, "aria-invalid": !!error, "aria-required": required };
    const raw = (key: string): string => view.raw[key] ?? String(view.draft[key] ?? "");
    let content: ReactNode;
    switch (node.type) {
      case "group": content = <section data-ui-group={id} tabIndex={-1} aria-label={node.label ? text(node.label) : labels.tools} className={`plugin-ui-group plugin-ui-${node.layout}`}>
        {node.label && <h3>{text(node.label)}</h3>}{node.help && <p>{text(node.help)}</p>}{node.children.map(render)}</section>; break;
      case "text": content = node.emphasis === "strong" ? <strong>{displayText(node.value, view.snapshot.data, locale)}</strong> : <span>{displayText(node.value, view.snapshot.data, locale)}</span>; break;
      case "help": content = <p className="plugin-ui-help">{displayText(node.value, view.snapshot.data, locale)}</p>; break;
      case "textInput": content = <><label htmlFor={domId}>{text(node.label)}</label><input {...common} type="text" value={raw(node.field)} placeholder={node.placeholder && text(node.placeholder)} onChange={(event) => state.edit(node.field, event.target.value, event.target.value)} /></>; break;
      case "number": case "range": {
        const schema = state.resource.fields[node.field]!.schema;
        if (schema.type !== "number") throw new Error("Numeric field mismatch");
        content = <><label htmlFor={domId}>{text(node.label)}{node.unit && ` (${text(node.unit)})`}</label>
          <input {...common} type="text" inputMode="decimal" value={raw(node.field)} onChange={(event) => state.edit(node.field, numericDraft(event.target.value), event.target.value)} />
          {node.type === "range" && <input type="range" aria-label={text(node.label)} disabled={disabled} min={schema.min} max={schema.max} step={node.step}
            value={typeof view.draft[node.field] === "number" ? view.draft[node.field] as number : schema.min}
            onChange={(event) => state.edit(node.field, Number(event.target.value), event.target.value)} />}</>; break;
      }
      case "choice": content = node.presentation === "select" ? <><label htmlFor={domId}>{text(node.label)}</label><select {...common} value={String(view.draft[node.field] ?? "")} onChange={(event) => state.edit(node.field, event.target.value)}>{node.options.map((option) => <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>{text(option.label)}</option>)}</select></>
        : <fieldset disabled={disabled} role="radiogroup" aria-describedby={description}><legend>{text(node.label)}</legend>{node.options.map((option, index) => <label key={option.value}>
          <input type="radio" name={domId} checked={view.draft[node.field] === option.value} onChange={() => state.edit(node.field, option.value)}
            onKeyDown={(event) => { const delta = ["ArrowRight", "ArrowDown"].includes(event.key) ? 1 : ["ArrowLeft", "ArrowUp"].includes(event.key) ? -1 : 0;
              if (!delta) return; event.preventDefault(); const next = (index + delta + node.options.length) % node.options.length;
              state.edit(node.field, node.options[next]!.value); event.currentTarget.closest("fieldset")?.querySelectorAll<HTMLInputElement>("input")[next]?.focus(); }} />{text(option.label)}</label>)}</fieldset>; break;
      case "boolean": content = <label><input {...common} type="checkbox" checked={view.draft[node.field] === true} onChange={(event) => state.edit(node.field, event.target.checked)} />{text(node.label)}</label>; break;
      case "action": content = <button id={domId} disabled={disabled || view.busy || !state.valid()} data-variant={node.variant} onClick={() => void state.invoke(node.id)}>{text(node.label)}</button>; break;
      case "holdAction": content = <button {...common} disabled={disabled || !state.valid()}
        onPointerDown={(event) => { if (intent.begin(node.id, { trusted: event.nativeEvent.isTrusted, kind: "pointer", id: String(event.pointerId), primary: event.isPrimary && event.button === 0, repeat: false })) event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); }}
        onPointerUp={(event) => intent.release("pointer", String(event.pointerId), false)} onPointerCancel={() => intent.cancel()} onLostPointerCapture={() => intent.cancel()}
        onContextMenu={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); intent.cancel(); }} onBlur={() => intent.cancel()}
        onKeyDown={(event) => { if (event.key === "Escape") { intent.cancel(); return; } if (event.key === " " || event.key === "Enter") { event.preventDefault(); intent.begin(node.id, { trusted: event.nativeEvent.isTrusted, kind: "key", id: event.key, primary: true, repeat: event.repeat }); } }}
        onKeyUp={(event) => intent.release("key", event.key, false)}>{text(node.label)}</button>; break;
      case "status": content = <span data-tone={node.tone}><LiveText text={displayText(node.text, view.snapshot.data, locale)} /></span>; break;
      case "alert": content = <span data-tone={node.severity}><LiveText text={displayText(node.text, view.snapshot.data, locale)} alert /></span>; break;
      case "progress": { const amount = value(node.value); content = <label>{text(node.label)}<progress max={node.max} value={typeof amount === "number" ? amount : undefined} /></label>; break; }
      case "keyValue": content = <dl>{node.rows.map((row) => <div key={row.id}><dt>{text(row.label)}</dt><dd>{String(value(row.value) ?? "")}{row.unit && ` ${text(row.unit)}`}</dd></div>)}</dl>; break;
      default: throw new Error("Unsupported UI component");
    }
    return <div key={node.id} data-ui-node={node.id} hidden={!available.visible} className="plugin-ui-node">{content}
      {help && node.type !== "group" && <p id={`${domId}-help`} className="plugin-ui-help">{help}</p>}{error && <p id={`${domId}-error`} role="alert">{error}</p>}</div>;
  };

}
```

```tsx
import { useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import type { SettingsFormBinding } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { SettingsResourceV1, SettingsScalar } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import { settingsAttachment, type SettingsControlsPort, type SettingsDraftState, type UiLabels } from "./host-ports.js";
import { translated } from "./components.js";
import { numericDraft } from "./state-store.js";
type Field = SettingsResourceV1["fields"][number];
type Change = Parameters<SettingsControlsPort["onChange"]>[0];
type FormView = { binding: SettingsFormBinding; resource: SettingsResourceV1; state: SettingsDraftState; raw: Record<string, string>; invalid: string[] };
const keyOf = (binding: SettingsFormBinding) => JSON.stringify([binding.owner.sourceKey, binding.owner.pluginId, binding.owner.uiResourceGeneration, binding.scope.hostEpoch, binding.scope.workbenchInstance, binding.resourceDigest]);
export function settingValid(field: Field, value: SettingsScalar): boolean {
  switch (field.type) {
    case "boolean": return typeof value === "boolean";
    case "number": case "integer": return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= field.minimum && value <= field.maximum && (field.type !== "integer" || Number.isInteger(value));
    case "string": return typeof value === "string" && Array.from(value).length >= field.minLength && Array.from(value).length <= field.maxLength && new TextEncoder().encode(value).length <= field.maxBytes;
    case "enum": return field.options.some((option) => option.value === value);
  }
}
export class SettingsControls implements SettingsControlsPort {
  private view: FormView | null = null;
  private listeners = new Set<() => void>(); private changes = new Set<Change>();
  private sent = new Map<string, SettingsScalar>();
  getSnapshot = (): FormView | null => this.view;
  subscribe = (listener: () => void): (() => void) => { this.listeners.add(listener); return () => { this.listeners.delete(listener); }; };
  private publish(): void { this.listeners.forEach((listener) => listener()); }
  render(binding: SettingsFormBinding, resource: SettingsResourceV1, state: SettingsDraftState): void {
    if (resource.fields.length > 128) throw new Error("Settings field limit");
    const previous = this.view; const same = previous && keyOf(previous.binding) === keyOf(binding);
    const raw = same ? { ...previous.raw } : {};
    if (!same) this.sent.clear();
    for (const item of state.baseline.values) {
      if (this.sent.has(item.key) && this.sent.get(item.key) === item.value && !state.busyKeys.includes(item.key) && !state.errors.some((error) => error.key === item.key)) {
        const field = resource.fields.find((candidate) => candidate.key === item.key);
        const currentRaw = raw[item.key];
        const current = currentRaw === undefined ? item.value : field?.type === "number" || field?.type === "integer" ? numericDraft(currentRaw) : currentRaw;
        if (current === item.value) { delete raw[item.key]; this.sent.delete(item.key); }
      }
    }
    this.view = { binding, resource, state, raw, invalid: same ? previous.invalid : [] }; this.publish();
  }
  onChange(listener: Change): () => void { this.changes.add(listener); return () => { this.changes.delete(listener); }; }
  dispose(binding: SettingsFormBinding): void { if (this.view && keyOf(this.view.binding) === keyOf(binding)) { this.view = null; this.sent.clear(); this.publish(); } }
  retry(key: string): Promise<void> {
    const view = this.view; const attachment = settingsAttachment(this);
    return view && attachment ? attachment.retry(view.binding, key) : Promise.resolve();
  }
  async reload(): Promise<void> {
    const view = this.view; const attachment = settingsAttachment(this);
    if (!view || !attachment) return;
    await attachment.reload(view.binding);
    if (this.view && keyOf(this.view.binding) === keyOf(view.binding)) {
      this.view = { ...this.view, raw: {}, invalid: [] }; this.sent.clear(); this.publish();
    }
  }
  destroy(): void { this.view = null; this.sent.clear(); this.changes.clear(); this.listeners.clear(); }
  fields(page: number): Field[] { return this.view?.resource.fields.slice(page * 16, page * 16 + 16) ?? []; }
  raw(key: string, raw: string): void { if (!this.view) return; this.view = { ...this.view, raw: { ...this.view.raw, [key]: raw }, invalid: this.view.invalid.filter((item) => item !== key) }; this.publish(); }
  commit(key: string, phase: "change" | "blur" | "enter" | "reset", immediate?: SettingsScalar): void {
    const view = this.view; const field = view?.resource.fields.find((item) => item.key === key);
    if (!view || !field || view.state.busyKeys.includes(key)) return;
    const raw = view.raw[key]; const draft = view.state.draft.find((item) => item.key === key)?.value ?? field.default;
    const value = phase === "reset" ? field.default : immediate !== undefined ? immediate : raw === undefined ? draft
      : field.type === "number" || field.type === "integer" ? numericDraft(raw) : raw;
    if (value === null || !settingValid(field, value)) { this.view = { ...view, invalid: [...new Set([...view.invalid, key])] }; this.publish(); return; }
    if (phase === "blur" && this.sent.get(key) === value && !view.state.errors.some((error) => error.key === key)) return;
    this.sent.set(key, value);
    if (phase === "reset") { const next = { ...view.raw }; delete next[key]; this.view = { ...view, raw: next, invalid: view.invalid.filter((item) => item !== key) }; this.publish(); }
    this.changes.forEach((listener) => listener(view.binding, key, value, phase));

}
export function SettingsControlsView({ controls, locale, labels }: { controls: SettingsControls; locale: "en" | "zh-TW"; labels: UiLabels }) {
  const view = useSyncExternalStore(controls.subscribe, controls.getSnapshot); const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  if (!view) return null;
  const pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(view.resource.fields.length / 16)); const currentPage = Math.min(page, pages - 1);
  return <section className="plugin-ui" aria-label={translated(view.resource.title, locale)}>
    <h3>{translated(view.resource.title, locale)}</h3>
    <button disabled={!settingsAttachment(controls) || view.state.busyKeys.length > 0} onClick={() => { void controls.reload().catch(() => {}); }}>{labels.refresh}</button>
    {controls.fields(currentPage).map((field, offset) => {
      const index = currentPage * 16 + offset;
      const map = settingsAttachment(controls)?.fieldMap(view.resource);
      const fieldId = map?.field(field.key) ?? `field${index}`;
      const key = map ? map.key(fieldId) : field.key;
      const id = `setting-${view.binding.scope.workbenchInstance}-${fieldId}`;
      const value = view.state.draft.find((item) => item.key === field.key)?.value ?? field.default;
      const error = view.state.errors.find((item) => item.key === field.key);
      const invalid = view.invalid.includes(field.key); const disabled = view.state.busyKeys.includes(field.key);
      const description = [field.help && `${id}-help`, (error || invalid) && `${id}-error`].filter(Boolean).join(" ") || undefined;
      const commit = (phase: "blur" | "enter") => controls.commit(field.key, phase);
      return <div key={field.key} className="plugin-ui-node"><label htmlFor={id}>{translated(field.label, locale)}</label>
        {field.type === "boolean" ? <input id={id} type="checkbox" disabled={disabled} checked={value === true} aria-describedby={description} onChange={(event) => controls.commit(field.key, "change", event.target.checked)} />
          : field.type === "enum" ? <select id={id} disabled={disabled} aria-describedby={description} value={map ? map.option(key, value) : `option${field.options.findIndex((option) => option.value === value)}`}
            onChange={(event) => { const value = map ? map.value(key, event.target.value) : field.options[Number(event.target.value.slice(6))]?.value; if (value !== undefined) controls.commit(key, "change", value); }}>{field.options.map((option, optionIndex) => <option key={optionIndex} value={map ? map.option(key, option.value) : `option${optionIndex}`}>{translated(option.label, locale)}</option>)}</select>
            : <input id={id} type="text" inputMode={field.type === "string" ? "text" : "decimal"} disabled={disabled} aria-invalid={!!error || invalid} aria-describedby={description}
              value={view.raw[field.key] ?? String(value)} onChange={(event) => controls.raw(field.key, event.target.value)} onBlur={() => commit("blur")}
              onKeyDown={(event) => { if (event.key === "Enter") { event.preventDefault(); commit("enter"); } }} />}
        {field.help && <p id={`${id}-help`}>{translated(field.help, locale)}</p>}
        {(error || invalid) && <p id={`${id}-error`} role="alert">{error ? translated(error.message, locale) : labels.invalid}</p>}
        {error && <button disabled={disabled} onClick={() => { void controls.retry(key).catch(() => {}); }}>{labels.retry}</button>}
        <button disabled={disabled} onClick={() => controls.commit(field.key, "reset")}>{labels.reset}</button>
      </div>;
    })}
    {pages > 1 && <nav aria-label={translated(view.resource.title, locale)}><button disabled={currentPage === 0} onClick={() => setPage(currentPage - 1)}>{labels.previous}</button><span>{currentPage + 1} / {pages}</span><button disabled={currentPage + 1 === pages} onClick={() => setPage(currentPage + 1)}>{labels.next}</button></nav>}
  </section>;
}
```

AM-28 uses B2-T3 `createSettingsFieldMap` through the attachment: `field(key)`, `key(field)`, `option(key,value)`, `value(key,option)` preserve synthetic LocalIds and reject unknown keys/options. The pre-P170 standalone control fallback uses synthetic `fieldN`/`optionN` identities; option lookup preserves numeric/string enum values. Retry and reload invoke the retained ContributedSettingsForm explicitly; they do not invent a fifth change phase or re-submit the draft as an ordinary Enter event. Invalid number text stays local, never coerces to zero or enters `SettingsScalar`. B2-T3 retains the authoritative baseline/draft/CAS retry state, including conflicts and server errors; no Apply action is introduced.

```tsx
import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import type { StatusResourceV1, UiCatalogEntry } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import { assertRenderable, type RendererSession, type PanelRecord } from "./bootstrap.js";
import { contributionKey } from "./catalog-store.js";
import { condition } from "./state-store.js";
import { ContributionBoundary, LiveText, displayText, translated } from "./components.js";
import type { UiLabels } from "./host-ports.js";
function BoundStatus({ record, resource, locale, labels }: { record: PanelRecord; resource: StatusResourceV1; locale: "en" | "zh-TW"; labels: UiLabels }) {
  const view = useSyncExternalStore(record.state.subscribe, record.state.getSnapshot);
  useLayoutEffect(() => record.state.renderCommitted(view.snapshot.revision), [record.state, view.snapshot.revision]);
  if (!view.active || !condition(resource.visibleWhen, view.snapshot.data, {})) return null;
  if (view.problem) return <span role="alert">{labels.unavailable}</span>;
  return <span data-tone={resource.tone}><LiveText text={displayText(resource.text, view.snapshot.data, locale)} /></span>;
}
function StatusItem({ session, entry, locale, labels }: { session: RendererSession; entry: UiCatalogEntry; locale: "en" | "zh-TW"; labels: UiLabels }) {
  const [resource, setResource] = useState<StatusResourceV1 | null>(null);
  useSyncExternalStore(session.subscribe, session.getSnapshot);
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    void session.catalog.resource(entry).then((value) => {
      if (!live || !session.catalog.current(entry)) return;
      try { if (value?.resource.kind === "status") { assertRenderable(value.resource, value.validationContext, value.rawBytes); setResource(value.resource); } }
      catch { session.quarantine(entry, "validation"); }
    });
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [session, entry]);
  if (entry.availability === "unavailable" || session.failed(entry) || session.statusUnavailable(entry)) return <span role="status">{translated(entry.title, locale)}: {labels.unavailable}</span>;
  if (!resource) return null;
  const record = session.record(entry);
  return <ContributionBoundary onFailure={() => session.quarantine(entry, "renderer")} fallback={labels.unavailable}>
    <span title={translated(entry.title, locale)}>{record ? <BoundStatus record={record} resource={resource} locale={locale} labels={labels} />
      : <span role="status">{labels.loading}</span>}</span>
  </ContributionBoundary>;
}
export function PluginStatusHost({ session, locale, labels }: { session: RendererSession; locale: "en" | "zh-TW"; labels: UiLabels }) {
  const catalog = useSyncExternalStore(session.catalog.subscribe, session.catalog.getSnapshot);
  const entries = catalog.entries.filter((entry) => entry.kind === "status");
  return <div className="plugin-status-host">{entries.slice(0, 3).map((entry) => <StatusItem key={`${contributionKey(entry)}:${entry.uiResourceGeneration}`} session={session} entry={entry} locale={locale} labels={labels} />)}
    {entries.length > 3 && <details><summary>{labels.tools} (+{entries.length - 3})</summary><div className="plugin-status-overflow">{entries.slice(3).map((entry) => <StatusItem key={`${contributionKey(entry)}:${entry.uiResourceGeneration}`} session={session} entry={entry} locale={locale} labels={labels} />)}</div></details>}
  </div>;
}
```

Create `core-recovery.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import type { CoreRecoveryPort, CoreRecoverySnapshot } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import { translated } from "./components.js";
import { registerRecoveryDiagnostics, type UiLabels } from "./host-ports.js";
type RecoveryView = { hostEpoch: string | null; revision: number; items: CoreRecoverySnapshot["items"]; nextCursor: string | null; problem: boolean; busy: string[] };
export class CoreRecoveryStore {
  private view: RecoveryView = { hostEpoch: null, revision: -1, items: [], nextCursor: null, problem: false, busy: [] };
  private listeners = new Set<() => void>(); private off: (() => void) | undefined;
  private serial = 0; private flight: Promise<void> | undefined; private again = false;
  private cursor: string | undefined;
  private deadlines = new Set<() => void>();
  constructor(private port: CoreRecoveryPort) { registerRecoveryDiagnostics(this, () => this.deadlines.size); }
  private wait<T>(work: Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
      const finish = () => { clearTimeout(timer); this.deadlines.delete(cancel); };
      const cancel = () => { finish(); reject(new Error("Recovery deadline/disposal")); };
      const timer = setTimeout(cancel, 5000); this.deadlines.add(cancel);
      work.then((value) => { finish(); resolve(value); }, (error: unknown) => { finish(); reject(error); });
    });
  }
  getSnapshot = (): RecoveryView => this.view;
  subscribe = (listener: () => void): (() => void) => { this.listeners.add(listener); return () => { this.listeners.delete(listener); }; };
  private publish(update: Partial<RecoveryView>) { this.view = { ...this.view, ...update }; this.listeners.forEach((listener) => listener()); }
  start(): Promise<void> { if (!this.off) this.off = this.port.onChanged(() => { void this.refresh(); }); return this.refresh(); }
  refresh(): Promise<void> { this.cursor = undefined; this.serial++; return this.load(); }
  next(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.view.nextCursor) return Promise.resolve();
    this.cursor = this.view.nextCursor; this.serial++; return this.load();
  }
  private load(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.flight) { this.again = true; return this.flight; }
    this.flight = (async () => {
      do {
        this.again = false; const serial = this.serial; const cursor = this.cursor;
        const expected = { epoch: this.view.hostEpoch, revision: this.view.revision };
        try {
          const result = await this.wait(this.port.snapshot(cursor ? { cursor } : {}));
          if (serial !== this.serial) continue;
          if (!result.ok) throw new Error("Recovery unavailable");
          const page = result.value;
          if (page.items.length > 16 || new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(page)).length > 262144
            || new Set(page.items.map((item) => item.id)).size !== page.items.length
            || cursor && (page.hostEpoch !== expected.epoch || page.revision !== expected.revision || page.nextCursor === cursor)
            || !cursor && page.hostEpoch === expected.epoch && page.revision < expected.revision) throw new Error("Stale recovery page");
          this.publish({ hostEpoch: page.hostEpoch, revision: page.revision, items: page.items, nextCursor: page.nextCursor, problem: false });
        } catch { if (serial === this.serial) this.publish({ problem: true }); }
      } while (this.again);
    })().finally(() => { this.flight = undefined; }); return this.flight;
  }
  async act(itemId: string, actionId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    if (this.view.busy.includes(itemId) || !this.view.items.find((item) => item.id === itemId)?.actions.some((action) => action.id === actionId)) return false;
    this.publish({ busy: [...this.view.busy, itemId] });
    try {
      const result = await this.port.act({ itemId, actionId });
      if (!result.ok) { this.publish({ problem: true }); return false; }
      this.serial++; await this.refresh(); return true;
    } catch { this.publish({ problem: true }); return false; }
    finally { this.publish({ busy: this.view.busy.filter((id) => id !== itemId) }); }
  }
  stop(): void { this.serial++; this.off?.(); this.off = undefined; this.again = false; for (const cancel of [...this.deadlines]) cancel(); this.listeners.clear(); }
}
export function CoreRecoveryView({ port, locale, labels, request = 0 }: { port: CoreRecoveryPort; locale: "en" | "zh-TW"; labels: UiLabels; request?: number }) {
  const details = useRef<HTMLDetailsElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => { if (request > 0 && details.current) { details.current.open = true; details.current.querySelector("summary")?.focus(); } }, [request]);
  const store = useMemo(() => new CoreRecoveryStore(port), [port]);
  const view = useSyncExternalStore(store.subscribe, store.getSnapshot);
  useEffect(() => { void store.start(); return () => store.stop(); }, [store]);
  return <section className="core-recovery" aria-label={labels.recovery} data-core-recovery="true">
    <details ref={details} open={view.items.some((item) => ["unconfirmed", "save-failed", "interrupted", "process-failed"].includes(item.state))}>
      <summary>{labels.recovery} ({view.items.length})</summary>
      {view.problem && <p role="alert">{labels.unavailable}</p>}
      <button onClick={() => void store.refresh()}>{labels.refresh}</button>
      {view.nextCursor && <button onClick={() => void store.next()}>{labels.next}</button>}
      {view.items.map((item) => <article key={item.id} data-state={item.state} role={["unconfirmed", "save-failed", "interrupted", "process-failed"].includes(item.state) ? "alert" : undefined}><h3>{translated(item.title, locale)}</h3><p>{translated(item.detail, locale)}</p>
        {item.actions.map((action) => <button key={action.id} disabled={view.busy.includes(item.id)} onClick={() => {
          void store.act(item.id, action.id);
        }}>{labels.actions[action.kind]}</button>)}
      </article>)}
    </details>
  </section>;
}
```

Core state is never read from a feature status string. The view keeps one atomic 16-item/256 KiB page; Next uses its host cursor, Refresh returns to the first page, and no aggregate quota is invented for the combined device/storage/process ledgers. Paging failures retain the previous fault; no optimistic “stopped/saved” update follows a click. Requests contain only item/option IDs. Main owns `CoreActionReference`, identity confirmation, stop/reconcile admission and final retry eligibility.

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { PersistenceRecoveryBridge } from "../../shared/plugin-persistence.js";
import type { PersistenceRecoverySnapshot } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { UiLabels } from "./host-ports.js";
export type CorePersistenceDetailProps = {
  snapshot: PersistenceRecoverySnapshot; labels: UiLabels;
  onAction: (itemId: string, actionId: string) => Promise<void>;
};
export function CorePersistenceDetail({ snapshot, labels, onAction }: CorePersistenceDetailProps) {
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string[]>([]); const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  const active = useRef(new Set<string>());
  const mounted = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => { mounted.current = true; return () => { mounted.current = false; active.current.clear(); }; }, []);
  return <section className="core-persistence-detail" aria-label={labels.recovery}>
    {failed && <p role="alert">{labels.unavailable}</p>}
    {snapshot.items.map((item) => <article key={item.id}><h3>{item.pluginId}</h3>
      {item.payload !== "complete-staging" && <p>{labels.checkpoint}</p>}
      {item.actions.filter((action) => action.kind !== "retry" || item.state === "retryable" && item.payload === "complete-staging").map((action) => <button key={action.id} disabled={busy.includes(item.id)} onClick={() => {
        if (active.current.has(item.id)) return; active.current.add(item.id); setBusy((items) => [...items, item.id]); setFailed(false);
        void Promise.resolve().then(() => onAction(item.id, action.id)).catch(() => { if (mounted.current) setFailed(true); }).finally(() => {
          active.current.delete(item.id); if (mounted.current) setBusy((items) => items.filter((id) => id !== item.id));
        });
      }}>{labels[action.kind]}</button>)}
    </article>)}
  </section>;
}
```

Append to `core-persistence-detail.tsx`:

```tsx
export function CorePersistenceRecovery({ port, labels }: { port: PersistenceRecoveryBridge; labels: UiLabels }) {
  const [snapshot, setSnapshot] = useState<PersistenceRecoverySnapshot | null>(null);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  const selected = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const serial = useRef(0);
  const live = useRef(false);
  async function refresh(): Promise<void> {
    const itemId = selected.current; if (!live.current || !itemId) return;
    const request = ++serial.current;
    try {
      const result = await port.snapshot({ itemId });
      if (!live.current || request !== serial.current) return;
      if (!result.ok) { setFailed(true); return; }
      setSnapshot(result.value); setFailed(false);
    } catch { if (live.current && request === serial.current) setFailed(true); }
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    live.current = true;
    const offChanged = port.onChanged(() => { void refresh(); });
    const offOpen = port.onOpen(({ itemId }) => {
      selected.current = itemId; setSnapshot(null); void refresh();
    });
    return () => { live.current = false; serial.current++; selected.current = null; offOpen(); offChanged(); };
  }, [port]);
  return <>{failed && <p role="alert">{labels.unavailable}</p>}
    {snapshot && <CorePersistenceDetail snapshot={snapshot} labels={labels} onAction={async (_recoveryId, optionId) => {
      const itemId = selected.current; if (!itemId || !live.current) return;
      const result = await port.act({ itemId, optionId });
      await refresh();
      if (!result.ok) throw new Error(result.error.code);
    }} />}</>;
}
```

This is a trusted view attachment, not a new public port. V170/D170 must supply the snapshot and callback through the approved host recovery adapter; expiry and option validity are rechecked in main. Do not add `export`/`discard` to `CoreRecoveryItem.actions` or let the renderer fabricate `CoreActionReference`. AM-18 freezes `window.kobrixa.plugins.persistenceRecovery`; its `onOpen` event is the only trusted manage navigation trigger. The bridge wrapper below subscribes before fetching, dispatches option IDs and refreshes after each result.

```ts
  private transitions = new Set<(next: Settings) => void>();
  beforeChange = (listener: (next: Settings) => void): (() => void) => {
    this.transitions.add(listener);
    return () => { this.transitions.delete(listener); };
  };
```

Replace its complete `set` and `resetLayout` methods with:

```ts
  set<K extends keyof Settings>(key: K, value: Settings[K] | ((previous: Settings[K]) => Settings[K])): void {
    const next = typeof value === "function" ? value(this.state.values[key]) : value;
    if (next === this.state.values[key]) return;
    const values = { ...this.state.values, [key]: next };
    this.transitions.forEach((listener) => listener(values));
    this.state = { ...this.state, values };
    if (key === "rememberWifiAddress" && !next) this.wifiAddress = "";
    this.save();
  }
  resetLayout = (): void => {
    const values: Settings = { ...this.state.values, ...LAYOUT_DEFAULTS,
      toolTab: "connection", rightPanel: null, ev3Tab: "connection", bottomTab: "problems" };
    this.transitions.forEach((listener) => listener(values));
    this.state = { ...this.state, values }; this.save();
  };
```

```ts
import type { CoreRecoveryPort, PluginUiBridge } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import { createPluginUiRendererHost, rendererSession, type PluginUiRendererHost } from "../plugin-ui/host-ports.js";
import type { RendererSession } from "../plugin-ui/bootstrap.js";
import { contributionKey } from "../plugin-ui/catalog-store.js";
export interface PluginUiWindow {
  readonly host: PluginUiRendererHost;
  readonly session: RendererSession;
  readonly recovery: CoreRecoveryPort;
  readonly ready: Promise<void>;
  gate(name: "settings" | "modal", blocked: boolean): void;
  dispose(): void;
}
export function createPluginUiWindow(input: {
  bridge: PluginUiBridge; recovery: CoreRecoveryPort; settings: SettingsStore;
  storage: Pick<Storage, "getItem" | "setItem">;
}): PluginUiWindow {
  const host = createPluginUiRendererHost(input); const session = rendererSession(host);
  const gates = new Set<string>(); let disposed = false;
  const sync = (next = input.settings.getSnapshot().values) => session.showPane(next.rightPanel === "plugins" && gates.size === 0, next.rightPanel === null ? "collapse" : "sidebar");
  const offTransition = input.settings.beforeChange(sync);
  const offSelection = session.subscribe(() => {
    const key = session.selectedKey(); if (!key) return;
    try { input.storage.setItem("kobrixa.layout.pluginPanel", key); } catch { /* layout is optional; no command is persisted */ }
  });
  const ready = host.start().then(() => {
    if (disposed) return;
    try {
      const raw = input.storage.getItem("kobrixa.layout.pluginPanel");
      if (raw && raw.length <= 1024) {
        const identity: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (Array.isArray(identity) && identity.length === 2 && identity.every((part) => typeof part === "string")) {
          const entry = session.catalog.getSnapshot().entries.find((item) => item.kind === "panel" && item.availability === "available" && contributionKey(item) === JSON.stringify(identity));
          if (entry) session.select(entry);
        }
      }
    } catch { /* corrupt layout cannot activate a source */ }
    sync();
  });
  return { host, session, recovery: input.recovery, ready,
    gate(name, blocked) { const old = gates.has(name); if (blocked) gates.add(name); else gates.delete(name); if (old !== blocked) sync(); },
    dispose() { if (disposed) return; disposed = true; offTransition(); offSelection(); host.dispose(); },
  };
}
let uiWindow: PluginUiWindow | undefined;
export function pluginUiWindow(): PluginUiWindow {
  if (uiWindow) return uiWindow;
  const owner = createPluginUiWindow({ bridge: window.kobrixa.plugins.ui, recovery: window.kobrixa.plugins.recovery, settings: settingsStore,
    storage: { getItem: (key) => window.localStorage.getItem(key), setItem: (key, value) => window.localStorage.setItem(key, value) } });
  uiWindow = owner;
  const environment = (reason: "document" | "window") => owner.session.environment(!document.hidden, document.hasFocus(), reason);
  const visibility = () => environment("document"); const focus = () => environment("window");
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", visibility); window.addEventListener("focus", focus); window.addEventListener("blur", focus);
  environment("document");
  window.addEventListener("pagehide", () => {
    owner.dispose(); document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", visibility);
    window.removeEventListener("focus", focus); window.removeEventListener("blur", focus);
  }, { once: true });
  return owner;
}
```

```ts
      resource: PanelResourceV1 | StatusResourceV1;
      validationContext: UiValidationContext;
      rawBytes: number;
    }>
  >;
  open(input: {
    sourceKey: string;
    id: Id;
    uiResourceGeneration: Counter;
  }): Promise<Result<UiStateSnapshot>>;
  close(input: { binding: UiBinding }): Promise<Result<{ closed: true }>>;
  visibility(input: {
    binding: UiBinding;
    visible: boolean;
    reason: "tab" | "sidebar" | "collapse" | "document" | "window";
  }): Promise<Result<{ accepted: true }>>;
  invoke(input: {
    binding: UiBinding;
    nodeId: LocalId;
    formRevision: Counter;
    form: Record<LocalId, Scalar>;
  }): Promise<Result<CommandValue>>;
  hold(input: {
    binding: UiBinding;
    nodeId: LocalId;
    phase: "begin" | "end" | "cancel";
    inputToken: Handle;
    formRevision: Counter;
    form: Record<LocalId, Scalar>;
  }): Promise<Result<{ gesture: Handle | null }>>;
  pulse(input: {
    binding: UiBinding;
    challenge: Handle;
    gesture: Handle | null;
    inputToken: Handle | null;
  }): Promise<Result<{ accepted: true }>>;
  snapshot(input: { binding: UiBinding }): Promise<Result<UiStateSnapshot>>;
  reportFailure(input: {
    sourceKey: string;
    id: Id;
    uiResourceGeneration: Counter;
    catalogRevision: Counter;
    reason: "validation" | "renderer";
    fieldPath?: string;
  }): Promise<Result<{ accepted: boolean }>>;
  onEvent(listener: (event: UiBridgeEvent) => void): () => void;
}
// Host trust is bound by construction; none of these references come from plugin arguments.
interface CoreRecoveryPort {
  snapshot(input: { cursor?: Handle }): Promise<Result<CoreRecoverySnapshot>>;
  act(input: { itemId: Handle; actionId: Handle }): Promise<Result<CoreRecoverySnapshot>>;
  onChanged(listener: () => void): () => void;
}
```

The SDK and launcher signatures consumed by the executable fixtures are (import `ValueSpec` from protocol and `ContextCommandHandler` from the JS SDK). Python uses `context_command(id, arguments)` with the identical speed/mode schema. Run both actual consumers through U05–U07 and hold→broker U10 below; the SDK remains unchanged:

```ts
// Existing SDK registration remains available for saved legacy consumers.
declare const commands: {
  register(id: string, handler: CommandHandler): void;
// T1's three-argument registration returns raw CommandValue through ContextCommandHandler.
  registerContext(id: string, argumentsSchema: Record<string, ValueSpec>, handler: ContextCommandHandler): void;
};
// The canonical public wire signatures, also consumed by the SDK helpers:
declare const ui: {
  instances(input: ParamsOf<"ui/instances">): Promise<ResultOf<"ui/instances">>;
  state(input: ParamsOf<"ui/state">): Promise<ResultOf<"ui/state">>;
  patch(input: ParamsOf<"ui/patch">): Promise<ResultOf<"ui/patch">>;
};
// Existing native launcher; no feature imports Electron.
declare function createDesktopLauncher(options: {
  python?: () => PythonCommand | undefined;
  spawnTimeoutMs?: number;
  onOutput?: (plugin: LaunchablePlugin, line: string) => void;
}): PluginLauncher;
// Canonical K160 installed resolver.
declare function resolveBuiltinLaunch(input: {
  sourceKey: string;
  pluginId: Id;
  slug: string;
  packaged: boolean;
  appPath: string;
  buildRoot: string;
}): Promise<BuiltinLaunchDescriptor>;
```

AM-31 freezes the actual SDK factory at P160; import it from JS `index.ts`, and `create_invocation_context(base, invocation)` from Python `_plugin.py`:

```ts
declare function createInvocationContext(
  base: PluginContext, invocation: CommandInvocation, signal: AbortSignal,
): PluginContext & { readonly invocation: CommandInvocation; readonly signal: AbortSignal };
```

Concurrent invocations must retain their own invocation and signal without mutating `base`. The future P170 invocation-local `ctx.actions.actionRef` getter reads only `invocation.context.actionRef`, leaving missing values absent; P160 does not publish storage clients. The common valid/invalid/maximum fixtures use AM-31's strict `ContractFixtureFile` (`formatVersion:1`, family `declarative-ui-v1`, `cases` with closed `schema`, `phase`, `input`, `valid` and all six nullable expected fields). JS/Python/Zod/exported JSON Schema consume identical serialized cases; lifecycle and persisted hash expectations require real host execution.

The bridge calls below consume the exact `PluginUiBridge` signatures in Interfaces Summary C-B1; there is no arbitrary RPC tunnel or feature-authored action token. The real browser mounts `apps/desktop/src/renderer/index.tsx`, which mounts the T8 composition and T7 components. It does not create a competing `PluginUiRendererHost` or substitute a fake renderer.

Produces these **test-local** exports, not new product ports:

```ts
declare function readFixtures(): Promise<{ manifest: object; panel: object; status: object }>;
declare function maximumPanel(panel: object): object;
declare function materialize(root: string, options?: { sources?: number; maximum?: boolean; language?: "js" | "python" }): Promise<string[]>;
declare function summary(values: number[]): { n: number; p50: number; p95: number; max: number };
declare function assertMeasurements(report: MeasurementReport): void;
declare function verifyLeaf(root: string, pluginId: string): Promise<BuiltinResourceIndex>;
```

Preconditions: author fixture data after F; compile/run against completed T1–T8 and P150. H-P supplies saved **actual 1.4.0** JS/Python SDK fixtures; do not relabel a new SDK by changing its version string. T9 may prepare fixtures in W1. Only T10 runs the final P160 acceptance. Every Electron, localhost, native packaging, CDP, suspend, clean installation and hardware step below is **controller runs outside sandbox**. Pure Node helper tests can run in the implementation sandbox. No dependency installation, main-source patch, optional product stub or worker registration is owned here.

```js
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { test } from "node:test";
import { mkdtemp, readFile, rm } from "node:fs/promises";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { readFixtures, materialize, maximumPanel, mutations } from "./declarative-ui-harness.mjs";

const types = ["group", "text", "help", "textInput", "number", "range", "choice",
  "boolean", "action", "holdAction", "status", "alert", "progress", "keyValue"];

test("U01/U15: fixture uses every v1 component and real number/choice/hold arguments", async () => {
  const { manifest, panel, status } = await readFixtures();
  assert.equal(manifest.apiVersion, "^1.6.0");
  assert.deepEqual([...new Set(panel.nodes.map(n => n.type))].sort(), types.sort());
  assert.equal(panel.fields.speed.schema.type, "number");
  assert.equal(panel.fields.mode.schema.type, "enum");
  assert.deepEqual(panel.nodes.find(n => n.type === "holdAction").arguments, {
    speed: { ref: { scope: "form", key: "speed" } },
    mode: { ref: { scope: "form", key: "mode" } },
  });
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(status).sort(), ["data", "kind", "text", "tone"]);
  assert.equal(panel.nodes.find(n => n.id === "text").value.text.en, "<b>literal, not HTML</b>");
});

test("U02/U03: independent malformed fixtures cannot mutate the valid baseline", async () => {
  const { panel } = await readFixtures();
  const before = JSON.stringify(panel);
  const cases = mutations(panel);
  assert.deepEqual(cases.map(c => c.id), ["unknown-node", "extra-field", "missing-en",
    "cycle", "orphan", "duplicate", "missing-reference", "condition", "prototype"]);
  assert.equal(new Set(cases.map(c => JSON.stringify(c.resource))).size, cases.length);
  assert.equal(JSON.stringify(panel), before);
  const maximum = maximumPanel(panel);
  assert.equal(maximum.nodes.length, 256);
  const byId = new Map(maximum.nodes.map(n => [n.id, n]));
  const seen = new Set();
  function walk(id, depth) {
    assert.ok(depth <= 8);
    assert.ok(!seen.has(id));
    seen.add(id);
    const node = byId.get(id);
    assert.ok(node);
    if (node.type === "group") {
      assert.ok(node.children.length >= 1 && node.children.length <= 32);
      return Math.max(depth, ...node.children.map(child => walk(child, depth + 1)));
    }
    return depth;
  }
  assert.equal(walk(maximum.root, 1), 8);
  assert.equal(seen.size, 256);
});

test("U03: capacity fixture has 16 panels, 16 statuses, exactly 8 MiB UTF-8 resources", async () => {
  const directory = await mkdtemp(path.join(tmpdir(), "ui-capacity-test-"));
  try {
    const paths = await materialize(directory, { sources: 8, maximum: true });
    let panels = 0, statuses = 0, total = 0;
    for (const directory of paths) {
      const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(directory, "kobrixa-plugin.json"), "utf8"));
      panels += manifest.contributes.panels.length;
      statuses += manifest.contributes.status.length;
      let sourceBytes = 0;
      for (const item of [...manifest.contributes.panels, ...manifest.contributes.status]) {
        const raw = await readFile(path.join(directory, item.resource.path));
        assert.equal(raw.length, 256 * 1024);
        JSON.parse(raw.toString("utf8"));
        sourceBytes += raw.length;
      }
      assert.equal(sourceBytes, 1024 * 1024);
      total += sourceBytes;
    }
    assert.deepEqual({ panels, statuses, total }, { panels: 16, statuses: 16, total: 8 * 1024 * 1024 });
  } finally { await rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});

test("Python browser fixture clones manifest and registered command identity together", async () => {
  const directory = await mkdtemp(path.join(tmpdir(), "ui-python-identity-"));
  try {
    const [leaf] = await materialize(directory, { language: "python" });
    const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(leaf, "kobrixa-plugin.json"), "utf8"));
    const consumer = await readFile(path.join(leaf, "consumer.py"), "utf8");
    assert.deepEqual(manifest.runtime, { kind: "python", entry: "consumer.py" });
    for (const command of manifest.contributes.commands) assert.ok(consumer.includes(`"${command.id}"`));
    assert.equal(consumer.includes('"acceptance.ui.activate"'), false);
  } finally { await rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});
```

Create `tests/desktop/declarative-ui-harness.mjs`:

```js
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { readFile, writeFile, mkdir } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

export const root = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../", import.meta.url));
export const fixture = new URL("./fixtures/declarative-ui/", import.meta.url);
export async function readFixtures() {
  const [manifest, panel, status] = await Promise.all(
    ["kobrixa-plugin.json", "panel.json", "status.json"].map(async name =>
      JSON.parse(await readFile(new URL(name, fixture), "utf8"))));
  return { manifest, panel, status };
}
export function maximumPanel(input) {
  const panel = structuredClone(input);
  // The original root is depth 8; seven new ancestors make depth observable.
  let child = panel.root;
  for (let n = 6; n >= 0; n--) {
    const id = `ancestor-${n}`;
    panel.nodes.push({ id, type: "group", layout: "stack", children: [child] });
    child = id;
  }
  panel.root = child;
  // Move the original root's leaves to depth 8, not 9.
  const oldRoot = panel.nodes.find(n => n.id === input.root);
  const deepest = panel.nodes.find(n => n.id === "ancestor-6");
  deepest.children = oldRoot.children;
  panel.nodes = panel.nodes.filter(n => n.id !== oldRoot.id);
  let number = 0;
  for (const group of panel.nodes.filter(n => n.type === "group")) {
    while (group.children.length < 32 && panel.nodes.length < 256) {
      const id = `fill-${number++}`;
      group.children.push(id);
      panel.nodes.push({ id, type: "text", emphasis: "normal", value: { text: { en: "🙂界".repeat(32) } } });
    }
  }
  // Seven ancestors have room for 7*31 extra leaves; add shallow groups for the rest.
  const outer = panel.nodes.find(n => n.id === panel.root);
  while (panel.nodes.length < 256) {
    const displaced = outer.children.pop();
    const id = `bucket-${number++}`;
    outer.children.push(id);
    const group = { id, type: "group", layout: "stack", children: [displaced] };
    panel.nodes.push(group);
    while (group.children.length < 32 && panel.nodes.length < 256) {
      const leaf = `fill-${number++}`;
      group.children.push(leaf);
      panel.nodes.push({ id: leaf, type: "text", emphasis: "normal", value: { text: { en: "界🙂".repeat(32) } } });
    }
  }
  return panel;
}
export function mutations(panel) {
  const make = (id, change) => {
    const resource = structuredClone(panel); change(resource); return { id, resource };
  };
  return [
    make("unknown-node", r => { r.nodes[1].type = "webview"; }),
    make("extra-field", r => { r.nodes[1].html = "<script>throw 1</script>"; }),
    make("missing-en", r => { r.nodes[1].value.text = { "zh-TW": "缺少英文" }; }),
    make("cycle", r => { r.nodes[0].children.push(r.root); }),
    make("orphan", r => { r.nodes.push({ id: "orphan", type: "help", value: { text: { en: "orphan" } } }); }),
    make("duplicate", r => { r.nodes[2].id = r.nodes[1].id; }),
    make("missing-reference", r => { r.nodes[1].value = { ref: { scope: "data", key: "absent" } }; }),
    make("condition", r => { r.nodes[1].visibleWhen = { op: "all", items: [] }; }),
    make("prototype", r => { Object.defineProperty(r.data, "__proto__", { value: { schema: { type: "boolean", nullable: false }, initial: true }, enumerable: true }); }),
  ];
}
export function padJson(value, size) {
  const text = JSON.stringify(value);
  const remaining = size - Buffer.byteLength(text, "utf8");
  assert.ok(remaining >= 0, "fixture itself exceeds the resource byte budget");
  return text + " ".repeat(remaining);
}
export async function materialize(directory, { sources = 1, maximum = false, language = "js" } = {}) {
  assert.ok(Number.isInteger(sources) && sources >= 1 && sources <= 8);
  const original = await readFixtures();
  const directories = [];
  for (let n = 0; n < sources; n++) {
    const id = `acceptance.ui-${n}`;
    const leaf = path.join(directory, `ui-${n}`);
    await mkdir(leaf, { recursive: true });
    const replace = value => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value).replaceAll("acceptance.ui", id));
    const manifest = replace(original.manifest);
    if (language === "python") manifest.runtime = { kind: "python", entry: "consumer.py" };
    const panel = replace(maximum ? maximumPanel(original.panel) : original.panel);
    const status = replace(original.status);
    manifest.contributes.panels = [0, 1].map(i => ({ id: `${id}.panel-${i}`, title: { en: `UI acceptance ${n}/${i}`, "zh-TW": `UI 驗收 ${n}/${i}` }, location: "right", resource: { version: 1, path: `panel-${i}.json` } }));
    manifest.contributes.status = [0, 1].map(i => ({ id: `${id}.status-${i}`, title: { en: `UI status ${n}/${i}` }, resource: { version: 1, path: `status-${i}.json` } }));
    for (const [kind, resource] of [["panel", panel], ["status", status]]) {
      for (const i of [0, 1]) await writeFile(path.join(leaf, `${kind}-${i}.json`),
        maximum ? padJson(resource, 256 * 1024) : JSON.stringify(resource));
    }
    await writeFile(path.join(leaf, "kobrixa-plugin.json"), JSON.stringify(manifest));
    const python = await readFile(new URL("consumer.py", fixture), "utf8");
    await writeFile(path.join(leaf, "consumer.py"), python.replaceAll("acceptance.ui", id));
    directories.push(leaf);
  }
  return directories;
}
export function summary(values) {
  assert.ok(Array.isArray(values) && values.length > 0);
  assert.ok(values.every(n => Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0));
  const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const percentile = fraction => sorted[Math.ceil(sorted.length * fraction) - 1];
  return { n: sorted.length, p50: percentile(0.5), p95: percentile(0.95), max: sorted.at(-1) };
}
export function assertMeasurements(report) {
  assert.equal(report.kind, "real-ui-measurement");
  assert.equal(report.source, "controller-observed");
  for (const name of ["artifact", "os", "arch", "cpu", "filesystem", "node", "electron", "locale"])
    assert.ok(typeof report[name] === "string" && report[name].length > 0, name);
  assert.ok(report.ramBytes > 0);
  assert.match(report.gc, /collectGarbage.*main GC/);
  assert.ok(report.proof.length >= 3);
  assert.equal(report.memoryMetric, "post-GC retained heap");
  assert.equal(report.clock.method, "performance.timeOrigin + performance.now");
  assert.ok(report.clock.samples >= 30);
  assert.ok(Number.isFinite(report.clock.uncertaintyMs) && report.clock.uncertaintyMs >= 0);
  assert.deepEqual(report.diagnosticOwners, ["T2", "T3", "T5", "T6", "T7"]);
  for (const kind of ["apply", "revoke", "stop-dispatch"])
    assert.ok(Number.isInteger(report.observations[kind]) && report.observations[kind] > 0, kind);
  assert.deepEqual(report.fixture, { panels: 16, statuses: 16, nodesPerPanel: 256, depth: 8,
    resourceBytes: 8 * 1024 * 1024, patchHz: 10 });
  assert.ok(report.repeats.length >= 3);
  for (const run of report.repeats) {
    assert.ok(run.warmupMs >= 5000 && run.durationMs >= 60000 && run.patches >= 600);
    assert.ok(Number.isFinite(run.clockUncertaintyMs) && run.clockUncertaintyMs >= report.clock.uncertaintyMs);
    const upper = values => values.map(value => value + run.clockUncertaintyMs);
    assert.ok(summary(upper(run.applyMs)).p95 <= 16 && summary(upper(run.applyMs)).max <= 50);
    summary(run.stopDispatchMs); // Required observation, no invented stop latency budget.
    assert.ok(summary(upper(run.inputMs)).p95 <= 100);
    assert.ok(summary(upper(run.revokeMs)).p95 <= 50 && summary(upper(run.revokeMs)).max <= 100);
    assert.ok(Number.isFinite(run.mainHeapDelta) && Number.isFinite(run.rendererHeapDelta));
    assert.ok(run.mainHeapDelta + run.rendererHeapDelta <= 64 * 1024 * 1024);
  }
  assert.equal(report.cycles, 1000);
  assert.deepEqual(report.live, { owners: 0, bindings: 0, subscriptions: 0, queuedEvents: 0, queuedBytes: 0, timers: 0, pendingInvocations: 0, actionTokens: 0, resourceReaders: 0, workerJobs: 0 });
  assert.ok(Number.isFinite(report.retainedAfterCycles) && report.retainedAfterCycles <= 2 * 1024 * 1024);
  assert.equal(report.normalClose, true);
  assert.ok(report.orphanCheckMs >= 5000);
  assert.deepEqual(report.remainingPids, []);
}
```
