```ts
import { definePlugin, runPlugin } from "@kobrixa/plugin-sdk";

let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
let stopped = false;
let calls = 0;
let ticks = 0;
runPlugin(definePlugin({
  activate(ctx) {
    ctx.commands.register(`${ctx.pluginId}.legacy`, async () => {});
    ctx.commands.registerContext(`${ctx.pluginId}.activate`, {
      speed: {type: "number", min: -100, max: 100, integer: true, nullable: false},
      mode: {type: "enum", values: ["coast", "brake"], nullable: false},
    }, async invocation => {
      if (invocation.arguments.speed === -99) throw new Error("fixture callback failed");
      if (invocation.arguments.speed === -98) {
        await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
          const abort = () => { clearTimeout(wait); reject(new Error("cancelled")); };
          const wait = setTimeout(() => {
            invocation.signal.removeEventListener("abort", abort); resolve();
          }, 60_000);
          invocation.signal.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
          if (invocation.signal.aborted) abort();
        });
      }
      calls++;
      return { output: {
        calls, speed: invocation.arguments.speed!, mode: invocation.arguments.mode!,
        origin: invocation.context.origin, hasBinding: Boolean(invocation.context.binding),
        hasMotion: Boolean(invocation.context.motionScopeRef), unicode: "🙂界",
      }, fieldErrors: [] };
    });
    ctx.commands.registerContext(`${ctx.pluginId}.hold`, {
      speed: {type: "number", min: -100, max: 100, integer: true, nullable: false},
      mode: {type: "enum", values: ["coast", "brake"], nullable: false},
    }, async invocation => ({
      output: {
        speed: invocation.arguments.speed!, mode: invocation.arguments.mode!,
        phase: invocation.context.trigger.kind === "hold" ? invocation.context.trigger.phase : "invalid",
      }, fieldErrors: [],
    }));
  },
  async ready(ctx) {
    // Serialize the producer. Slow UI never creates unbounded overlapping patch promises.
    const tick = async () => {
      const listed = await ctx.ui.instances({});
      if (!listed.ok) throw new Error(listed.error.code);
      ticks++;
      for (const binding of listed.value.instances) {
        const state = await ctx.ui.state({ binding });
        if (!state.ok) continue;
        await ctx.ui.patch({ binding, baseRevision: state.value.revision,
          set: { ticks: `tick:${ticks}` } });
      }
    };
    const loop = async () => {
      if (stopped) return;
      const started = performance.now();
      try { await tick(); }
      catch (error) { console.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); }
      if (!stopped) timer = setTimeout(() => { void loop(); }, Math.max(0, 100 - (performance.now() - started)));
    };
    await tick();
    timer = setTimeout(() => { void loop(); }, 100);
  },
  deactivate() { stopped = true; clearTimeout(timer); },
}));
```

```py
import asyncio
from kobrixa import Plugin

plugin = Plugin()
calls = 0
ticks = 0
producer = None

@plugin.command("acceptance.ui.legacy")
async def legacy(ctx):
    return None

@plugin.context_command("acceptance.ui.activate", {
    "speed": {"type": "number", "min": -100, "max": 100, "integer": True, "nullable": False},
    "mode": {"type": "enum", "values": ["coast", "brake"], "nullable": False},
})
async def activate(ctx):
    global calls
    if ctx.arguments["speed"] == -99:
        raise RuntimeError("fixture callback failed")
    if ctx.arguments["speed"] == -98:
        await asyncio.sleep(60)
    calls += 1
    return {"output": {
        "calls": calls, "speed": ctx.arguments["speed"], "mode": ctx.arguments["mode"],
        "origin": ctx.context["origin"], "hasBinding": "binding" in ctx.context,
        "hasMotion": "motionScopeRef" in ctx.context, "unicode": "🙂界"
    }, "fieldErrors": []}

@plugin.context_command("acceptance.ui.hold", {
    "speed": {"type": "number", "min": -100, "max": 100, "integer": True, "nullable": False},
    "mode": {"type": "enum", "values": ["coast", "brake"], "nullable": False},
})
async def hold(ctx):
    return {"output": {
        "speed": ctx.arguments["speed"], "mode": ctx.arguments["mode"],
        "phase": ctx.context["trigger"].get("phase", "invalid")
    }, "fieldErrors": []}

@plugin.ready
async def ready(ctx):
    global producer
    async def tick():
        global ticks
        listed = await ctx.ui.instances({})
        if not listed["ok"]:
            raise RuntimeError(listed["error"]["code"])
        ticks += 1
        for binding in listed["value"]["instances"]:
            state = await ctx.ui.state({"binding": binding})
            if state["ok"]:
                await ctx.ui.patch({"binding": binding, "baseRevision": state["value"]["revision"],
                                    "set": {"ticks": "tick:" + str(ticks)}})
    async def loop():
        while True:
            started = asyncio.get_running_loop().time()
            await tick()
            await asyncio.sleep(max(0, 0.1 - (asyncio.get_running_loop().time() - started)))
    await tick()
    producer = asyncio.create_task(loop())

@plugin.deactivate
async def deactivate(*_args):
    if producer is not None:
        producer.cancel()
        try:
            await producer
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass

plugin.run()
```

Create `tests/desktop/declarative-ui-main.ts`:

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { readFile, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { app } from "electron";
import { RpcPeer, type CommandInvocation } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import { createDesktopLauncher } from "../../apps/desktop/src/main/plugins/launchers.js";
import { resolveBuiltinLaunch } from "../../apps/desktop/src/main/plugins/builtin-launch.js";

const mode = app.commandLine.getSwitchValue("ui-acceptance-mode");
const output = app.commandLine.getSwitchValue("ui-acceptance-output");
const inputFile = app.commandLine.getSwitchValue("ui-acceptance-input");
const failure = (error: unknown) => { console.error(error); app.exit(1); };
process.on("uncaughtException", failure);
process.on("unhandledRejection", failure);
setTimeout(() => failure(new Error("UI acceptance exceeded 10 minutes")), 600_000).unref();
const pause = (ms: number) => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

async function transport(directory: string, language: "js" | "python", installed = false) {
  const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(directory, "kobrixa-plugin.json"), "utf8"));
  let entry = path.join(directory, language === "js" ? "main.cjs" : "consumer.py");
  if (installed) {
    const descriptor = await resolveBuiltinLaunch({
      sourceKey: `builtin:${manifest.id}`, pluginId: manifest.id, slug: "acceptance-builtin",
      packaged: true, appPath: app.getAppPath(), buildRoot: "intentionally-unavailable",
    });
    assert.equal(descriptor.policy, "optional");
    assert.equal(descriptor.runtime, "node");
    assert.equal(descriptor.entry, "main.cjs");
    assert.equal(path.resolve(descriptor.packageRoot), path.resolve(directory));
    entry = path.join(descriptor.packageRoot, descriptor.entry);
  }
  let pid = 0;
  const launcher = createDesktopLauncher({
    python: () => ({ executable: process.env.KOBRIXA_TEST_PYTHON || "python3", args: [] }),
    onOutput: (_plugin, line) => {
      if (/^UI_PID:\d+$/.test(line)) pid = Number(line.slice(7));
      else console.error(line);
    },
  });
  const child = await launcher({ id: manifest.id, sourceKey: `development:${directory}`,
    directory, entry, runtime: language === "js" ? "node" : "python",
    permissions: manifest.permissions,
    commands: manifest.contributes.commands.map((command: { id: string }) => command.id),
  });
  let exited = false;
  const disposeExit = child.onExit(() => { exited = true; });
  const peer = new RpcPeer(child);
  peer.handle("ui/instances", () => ({ ok: true, value: { instances: [] } }));
  try {
    const initialize = { pluginId: manifest.id, apiVersion: "1.6.0", locale: "en" as const,
      grantedPermissions: manifest.permissions as Array<"ui.panels" | "ui.status"> };
    const hello = await peer.request("initialize", { ...initialize,
      grantedPermissions: [...initialize.grantedPermissions] });
    assert.equal(hello.apiVersion, "1.6.0");
    const negotiated = await peer.request("ui/negotiate", {
      commandEnvelopeVersions: [1], uiResourceVersions: [1],
    });
    assert.ok(negotiated.ok);
    assert.deepEqual(await peer.request("ui/ready", {}), { ok: true, value: {} });
    const legacy = await peer.request("command/execute", { command: `${manifest.id}.legacy` });
    assert.equal(legacy, null);
    const invocation: CommandInvocation = {
      version: 1, invocationId: randomUUID(), command: `${manifest.id}.activate`,
      arguments: { speed: 20, mode: "brake" },
      context: { contextRef: null, origin: "management", locale: "en", trigger: { kind: "activate" } },
    };
    const first = await peer.request("command/invoke", invocation);
    assert.ok(first.ok);
    const duplicate = await peer.request("command/invoke", invocation);
    assert.deepEqual(duplicate, first);
    const failed = await peer.request("command/invoke", { ...invocation,
      invocationId: randomUUID(), arguments: { speed: -99, mode: "brake" } });
    assert.equal(failed.ok, false);
    if (failed.ok) throw new Error("callback exception was swallowed");
    assert.equal(failed.error.code, "PLUGIN_E_COMMAND_FAILED");
    assert.equal(JSON.stringify(failed).includes(directory), false);
    const cancel = new AbortController();
    const pending = peer.request("command/invoke", { ...invocation,
      invocationId: randomUUID(), arguments: { speed: -98, mode: "brake" } }, { signal: cancel.signal });
    setTimeout(() => cancel.abort(), 50);
    await assert.rejects(pending);
    const after = await peer.request("command/invoke", { ...invocation, invocationId: randomUUID() });
    assert.ok(after.ok);
    assert.equal(after.value.output.calls, 2);
    assert.equal(await peer.request("shutdown", {}, { timeoutMs: 2000 }), null);
    peer.notify("exit", {});
    const deadline = performance.now() + 5000;
    while (!exited && performance.now() < deadline) await pause(20);
    assert.equal(exited, true, "transport child did not exit");
    assert.ok(pid > 0, "fixture did not expose its test PID on the log channel");
    assert.throws(() => process.kill(pid, 0), { code: "ESRCH" });
    return { language, initializeKeys: Object.keys(initialize).sort(), apiVersion: hello.apiVersion,
      legacy, negotiated: negotiated.value, duplicateCalls: first.value.output.calls,
      managementHasBinding: first.value.output.hasBinding, managementHasMotion: first.value.output.hasMotion,
      unicode: first.value.output.unicode, callbackError: failed.error.code,
      cancelled: true, afterCancellationCalls: after.value.output.calls, exited, pid };
  } finally {
    peer.close(); disposeExit();
    if (!exited) child.forceKill();
  }
}

async function run() {
  if (mode === "transport" || mode === "installed") {
    await app.whenReady();
    const input = JSON.parse(await readFile(inputFile, "utf8"));
    const results = [];
    if (mode === "installed") {
      assert.equal(app.isPackaged, true);
      const directory = path.join(`${app.getAppPath()}.unpacked`, ".vite/build/plugins/acceptance-builtin");
      if (input.expectRejected) {
        await assert.rejects(transport(directory, "js", true));
        await writeFile(output, JSON.stringify({ kind: "installed-rejection", rejected: true }));
      } else {
        results.push(await transport(directory, "js", true));
        await writeFile(output, JSON.stringify({ kind: "installed-builtin", packaged: app.isPackaged,
          cwd: process.cwd(), appPath: app.getAppPath(), results, resolvedFromInstalledRoot: true, remainingPids: [] }));
      }
    } else {
      results.push(await transport(input.js, "js"));
      results.push(await transport(input.python, "python"));
      await writeFile(output, JSON.stringify({ kind: "ui-transport", mockHost: true, results }));
    }
    app.quit();
    return;
  }
  // The actual application installs its real lock, broker, lifecycle, IPC and renderer.
  // This observer does not install another IPC service or fake device authority.
  app.on("browser-window-created", (_event, win) => {
    win.webContents.once("did-finish-load", () => {
      void (async () => {
        for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 300; attempt++) {
          if (await win.webContents.executeJavaScript("Boolean(window.declarativeAcceptance)")) break;
          await pause(100);
        }
        if (mode === "measure") {
          await writeFile(output, JSON.stringify({ kind: "ui-measurement-session", pid: process.pid,
            rendererPid: win.webContents.getOSProcessId(), versions: process.versions }));
          console.log(`UI_MEASUREMENT_READY main=${process.pid} renderer=${win.webContents.getOSProcessId()}`);
          return; // Controller closes the real window after trace/heap collection.
        }
        const report = await win.webContents.executeJavaScript("window.declarativeAcceptance.run()");
        assert.equal(report.kind, "ui-browser");
        const bounds = await win.webContents.executeJavaScript("window.declarativeAcceptance.bounds('Note')");
        win.focus();
        win.webContents.sendInputEvent({ type: "mouseDown", button: "left", x: bounds.x, y: bounds.y, clickCount: 1 });
        win.webContents.sendInputEvent({ type: "mouseUp", button: "left", x: bounds.x, y: bounds.y, clickCount: 1 });
        win.webContents.sendInputEvent({ type: "keyDown", keyCode: "A" });
        win.webContents.sendInputEvent({ type: "char", keyCode: "a" });
        win.webContents.sendInputEvent({ type: "keyUp", keyCode: "A" });
        report.nativeInput = await win.webContents.executeJavaScript("window.declarativeAcceptance.checkFocus('Note')");
        assert.equal(report.nativeInput, true);
        await writeFile(output, JSON.stringify({ ...report, productionMain: true, productionRenderer: true,
          // The outer runner appends the observed post-close OS PID result.
          childPids: [...new Set([...report.pluginPids, ...app.getAppMetrics().filter(metric => metric.pid !== process.pid).map(metric => metric.pid)])],
          versions: process.versions,
        }, null, 2));
        win.close(); // Normal product close/drain path; do not app.exit(0).
      })().catch(failure);
    });
  });
  await startAcceptanceWindow();
}
void run().catch(failure);
```

```ts
import { validateUiResource, type UiBinding, type UiCatalogEntry, type UiStateSnapshot } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { PluginUiBridge } from "../../packages/plugin-runtime/src/ui-host-ports.js";

const check: (condition: unknown, message: string) => asserts condition = (condition, message) => {
  if (!condition) throw new Error(message);
};
const pause = (ms: number) => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
const frame = () => new Promise<void>(resolve => requestAnimationFrame(() => resolve()));
const bridge: PluginUiBridge = window.kobrixa.plugins.ui;
const value = <T>(result: { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: { code: string } }): T => {
  if (!result.ok) throw new Error(result.error.code);
  return result.value;
};
async function rejected(operation: () => Promise<unknown>, code?: string) {
  try {
    const result = await operation() as { ok: boolean; error?: { code: string; detail?: { kind: string; reason: string } } };
    check(result.ok === false, "unexpected success");
    if (code) check(result.error?.code === code, `expected ${code}`);
    if (code === "PLUGIN_E_STALE_RESOURCE") {
      check(result.error?.detail?.kind === "resource", "stale must use resource detail");
      check(result.error?.detail?.reason === "stale", "stale reason missing");
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // Transport/schema rejection only counts where no business code was requested.
    if (code || (error instanceof Error && error.message === "unexpected success")) throw error;
  }
}
async function catalog() {
  const entries: UiCatalogEntry[] = [];
  let cursor: string | undefined;
  let revision: number | undefined;
  let epoch: string | undefined;
  do {
    const page = value(await bridge.catalog(cursor ? { cursor } : {}));
    if (revision !== undefined) check(page.revision === revision && page.hostEpoch === epoch, "mixed catalog pages");
    revision = page.revision; epoch = page.hostEpoch;
    entries.push(...page.entries);
    cursor = page.nextCursor ?? undefined;
  } while (cursor);
  return entries.filter(entry => entry.pluginId.startsWith("acceptance.ui-"));
}
function findLabel(label: string) {
  const labels = [...document.querySelectorAll("label")];
  const candidates = label === "Note" ? ["Note", "備註"] : [label];
  const match = labels.find(element => candidates.some(candidate => element.textContent?.trim().startsWith(candidate)));
  const target = match?.control ?? match?.querySelector("input,select,textarea");
  check(target instanceof HTMLElement, `missing actual host control: ${label}`);
  return target;
}
const api = {
  bounds(label: string) {
    const bounds = findLabel(label).getBoundingClientRect();
    check(bounds.width > 0 && bounds.height > 0, "control is not visible");
    return { x: Math.round(bounds.x + bounds.width / 2), y: Math.round(bounds.y + bounds.height / 2) };
  },
  checkFocus(label: string) { return document.activeElement === findLabel(label); },
  async run() {
    // Subscribe before the first catalog request. No delayed response may resurrect a revoked binding.
    const revoked: UiBinding[] = [];
    const off = bridge.onEvent(event => { if (event.type === "revoked") revoked.push(event.binding); });
    const live: UiStateSnapshot[] = [];
    try {
      const entries = await catalog();
      const panels = entries.filter(entry => entry.kind === "panel" && entry.availability === "available");
      check(panels.length >= 2, "expected actual validated panel contributions");
      for (const entry of panels) {
        const fetched = value(await bridge.resource({ sourceKey: entry.sourceKey, id: entry.id,
          uiResourceGeneration: entry.uiResourceGeneration, resourceDigest: entry.resourceDigest }));
        check(fetched.version === 1 && fetched.owner.uiResourceGeneration === entry.uiResourceGeneration, "resource owner mismatch");
        const dtoBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(fetched.resource)).length;
        const validated = validateUiResource(fetched.resource, fetched.validationContext,
          Math.max(dtoBytes, fetched.rawBytes));
        check(validated.ok, "shared browser validation failed");
        live.push(value(await bridge.open({ sourceKey: entry.sourceKey, id: entry.id,
          uiResourceGeneration: entry.uiResourceGeneration })));
      }
      // AM-17 status bindings already exist before this renderer subscribes.
      const discoverStatus = async () => {
        const seen = new Map<string, number>();
        const unsubscribe = bridge.onEvent(event => {
          if (event.type !== "state") return;
          const key = JSON.stringify(event.binding);
          seen.set(key, Math.max(seen.get(key) ?? -1, event.revision));
        });
        try {
          const catalogPending = catalog();
          await catalogPending;
          await frame();
          check(seen.size >= entries.filter(entry => entry.kind === "status").length,
            "status replay missing after subscribe/reconnect");
          for (const [key, revision] of seen) {
            const snapshot = value(await bridge.snapshot({ binding: JSON.parse(key) }));
            check(snapshot.revision >= revision, "catalog replaced newer status revision");
          }
          return [...seen.keys()].sort();
        } finally { unsubscribe(); }
      };
      const firstStatus = await discoverStatus();
      const remountedStatus = await discoverStatus();
      check(JSON.stringify(firstStatus) === JSON.stringify(remountedStatus), "remount duplicated status bindings");
      const initial = live[0]!;
      const input = { binding: initial.binding, nodeId: "activate", formRevision: initial.formRevision, form: initial.form };
      const invoked = value(await bridge.invoke(input));
      check(invoked.output.unicode === "🙂界", "SDK response corrupted Unicode");
      await rejected(() => bridge.invoke({ ...input, formRevision: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER }), "PLUGIN_E_STALE_RESOURCE");
      await rejected(() => bridge.invoke({ ...input, binding: { ...initial.binding, processEpoch: crypto.randomUUID() } }), "PLUGIN_E_STALE_RESOURCE");
      await rejected(() => bridge.pulse({ binding: initial.binding, challenge: crypto.randomUUID(), gesture: null, inputToken: null }));
      const before = value(await bridge.snapshot({ binding: initial.binding }));
      await pause(350);
      const after = value(await bridge.snapshot({ binding: initial.binding }));
      check(after.revision > before.revision && after.data.ticks !== before.data.ticks, "real SDK patches did not reach host");
      for (const reason of ["tab", "sidebar", "collapse", "document", "window"] as const) {
        value(await bridge.visibility({ binding: initial.binding, visible: false, reason }));
        const token = crypto.randomUUID();
        await rejected(() => bridge.hold({ binding: initial.binding, nodeId: "hold", phase: "begin",
          inputToken: token, formRevision: after.formRevision, form: after.form }));
        value(await bridge.visibility({ binding: initial.binding, visible: true, reason }));
      }
      const entry = panels[0]!;
      for (const state of live) value(await bridge.close({ binding: state.binding }));
      value(await bridge.close({ binding: initial.binding }));
      await rejected(() => bridge.snapshot({ binding: initial.binding }), "PLUGIN_E_STALE_RESOURCE");
      for (let n = 0; n < 1000; n++) {
        const opened = value(await bridge.open({ sourceKey: entry.sourceKey, id: entry.id,
          uiResourceGeneration: entry.uiResourceGeneration }));
        const unsubscribe = bridge.onEvent(() => {});
        value(await bridge.close({ binding: opened.binding })); unsubscribe();
      }
      // Exercise the shipped tab and controls, not a hand-built fixture component.
      const tab = [...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("button,[role=tab]")]
        .find(element => [entry.title.en, entry.title["zh-TW"]].includes(element.textContent?.trim() ?? ""));
      check(tab, "real plugin tools tab is missing");
      tab.click();
      for (let n = 0; n < 100 && !document.body.textContent?.includes("<b>literal, not HTML</b>"); n++) await pause(50);
      check(document.body.textContent?.includes("<b>literal, not HTML</b>"), "text was not rendered literally");
      check(![...document.querySelectorAll("b")].some(element => element.textContent === "literal, not HTML"), "HTML executed");
      findLabel("Note").focus(); await frame(); await frame();
      check(api.checkFocus("Note"), "focus did not stay in host text input");
      const pluginPids: number[] = [];
      for (const sourceKey of new Set(entries.map(entry => entry.sourceKey))) {
        const log = await window.kobrixa.plugins.readLog(sourceKey);
        const recorded = log.lines.flatMap(line => {
          const match = /UI_PID:(\d+)/.exec(line.text);
          return match ? [Number(match[1])] : [];
        });
        check(recorded.length > 0, "launched source has no test PID in its actual output log");
        pluginPids.push(...recorded);
      }
      return { kind: "ui-browser", pluginPids, opened: live.length, unicode: invoked.output.unicode,
        literalHtml: true, oldBindingRejected: true, staleFormRejected: true,
        foreignBindingRejected: true, oldChallengeRejected: true, patchObserved: true,
        duplicateCloseIdempotent: true, cycles: 1000, revokedEvents: revoked.length };
    } finally { off(); }
  },
};
Object.assign(window, { declarativeAcceptance: api });
```

The browser probe is a real-browser baseline, not the whole U matrix. Native hold/keyboard timing, stale response injection and formal broker motion are gated separately in Step 11. In particular, a fulfilled `visibility(false)` RPC measures completion and cannot be substituted for main's revoke-registration timestamp.

- [ ] **Step 5a: Wire the AM-21 real-composition U10 runner in `declarative-ui-main.ts`.**

Use the same `createDesktopFoundation` call that D160 uses, passing the real profile, authority, journal, coreActions, now, hasPermission, requirements, connectionPolicy and operationGate unchanged. In the test bundle only, route that call through `acceptanceFoundation` below. The returned foundation is passed to the existing D160 runtime/bridge composition; never construct a second broker after importing production main. Keep the override in the main test bundle, with no environment variable, manifest flag or preload API selecting a provider. Installed/ordinary product smoke uses the unmodified production call.

Append these imports and functions to `declarative-ui-main.ts`. `ProviderStep` and `FakeProviderPoint` are imported from their actual defining modules, not redefined as prepare/start strings. Prepare has no provider exchange: pause its real RPC response at the process channel and assert no new provider trace. Pause start's reply separately from the first `preflight` exchange; `helper-arm` and `motion-pulse` are the exact arm/pulse steps.

```ts
import type { BrowserWindow } from "electron";
import { createDesktopFoundation, type DesktopFoundationOptions }
  from "../../apps/desktop/src/main/device-broker/lifecycle-coordinator.js";
import { createFakeDeviceProvider, type FakeProviderControl, type FakeProviderPoint }
  from "../../apps/desktop/src/main/device-broker/fake-provider.js";
import type { ProviderStep } from "../../apps/desktop/src/main/device-broker/provider.js";
import type { FoundationDiagnostics, FoundationDiagnosticEvent }
  from "../../packages/plugin-runtime/src/ui-host-ports.js";

let fakeControl: FakeProviderControl | undefined;
export async function acceptanceFoundation(options: DesktopFoundationOptions) {
  assert.equal(options.providerFactory, undefined);
  return createDesktopFoundation({ ...options, providerFactory(catalog) {
    assert.equal(fakeControl, undefined, "one foundation/provider per test process");
    const fake = createFakeDeviceProvider({ catalog, now: options.now });
    fakeControl = fake.control;
    return fake.provider;
  } });
}
// This is the same typed production composition, with the sole permitted factory override.
import { composeDesktopMain, desktopUi, desktopLifecycle }
  from "../../apps/desktop/src/main/plugins/controller.js";
import type { DesktopMainCompositionInput } from "../../apps/desktop/src/main/plugins/controller.js";
export function acceptanceComposition(input: DesktopMainCompositionInput) {
  return composeDesktopMain({ ...input, createFoundation: acceptanceFoundation });
}
const wallTime = () => performance.timeOrigin + performance.now();
async function bounded<T>(promise: Promise<T>, label: string): Promise<T> {
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  try {
    return await Promise.race([promise, new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
      timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(`missing observation: ${label}`)), 20_000);
    })]);
  } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
}
// These are test-local operations bound to the existing real channel/window, not host ports.
// Each fault is executed by the controller in the same process as this runner.
type MotionRace = {
  boundary: "prepare" | "start" | "arm" | "pulse";
  point: FakeProviderPoint;
  step: ProviderStep;
  window: BrowserWindow;
  diagnostics: FoundationDiagnostics;
  // For prepare/start, channel barrier holds the actual reply, never fabricates one.
  replyBarrier?: { reached(): Promise<void>; release(): void };
  fault: "hide" | "authority-loss" | "cancel" | "renderer-freeze" | "renderer-crash" | "plugin-kill";
  inject(): Promise<void>;
  settled(): Promise<void>;
  recovery(): Promise<unknown>;
};
export async function runMotionRace(test: MotionRace) {
  assert.ok(fakeControl, "actual foundation did not install formal fake provider");
  const control = fakeControl;
  const observations: FoundationDiagnosticEvent[] = [];
  let sawRevoke!: () => void;
  const revoked = new Promise<void>(resolve => { sawRevoke = resolve; });
  const off = test.diagnostics.onEvent(event => {
    observations.push(event);
    if (event.kind === "revoke") sawRevoke();
  });
  const before = control.trace().length;
  control.block(test.point, test.step);
  try {
    // Native input reaches the existing holdAction, intent controller, IPC and broker.
    const bounds = await test.window.webContents.executeJavaScript(
      "window.declarativeAcceptance.holdBounds()");
    test.window.focus();
    test.window.webContents.sendInputEvent({ type: "mouseDown", button: "left",
      x: bounds.x, y: bounds.y, clickCount: 1 });
    if (test.replyBarrier) {
      await bounded(test.replyBarrier.reached(), `${test.boundary} reply`);
      if (test.boundary === "prepare") assert.equal(control.trace().length, before);
    } else {
      await bounded(control.reached(test.point, test.step), `${test.point}/${test.step}`);
    }
    const faultAt = wallTime();
    await test.inject();
    await bounded(revoked, "synchronous admission revoke");
    const traceAtRevoke = control.trace().length;
    test.replyBarrier?.release();
    control.release(test.point, test.step);
    await bounded(test.settled(), "original operation stop/readback disposition");
    const trace = control.trace().slice(before);
    const late = control.trace().slice(traceAtRevoke);
    const sideEffects = new Set<ProviderStep>(["helper-upload", "helper-run", "helper-arm", "motion-pulse"]);
    assert.equal(late.filter(event => sideEffects.has(event.step) && event.dispatch !== "not-sent").length, 0);
    // Already-sent work remains in the trace and must receive safety stop/readback.
    if (trace.some(event => sideEffects.has(event.step) && event.dispatch !== "not-sent")) {
      assert.ok(trace.some(event => event.step === "stop"));
      assert.ok(trace.some(event => event.step === "readback"));
      assert.ok(observations.some(event => event.kind === "stop-dispatch"));
    }
    assert.ok(observations.some(event => event.kind === "revoke"));
    return { boundary: test.boundary, point: test.point, step: test.step,
      fault: test.fault, faultAt, observations, trace, recovery: await test.recovery() };
  } finally {
    test.replyBarrier?.release(); control.release(test.point, test.step); off();
  }
}
```

Replace the product-mode dynamic main import in Step 5 with `await startAcceptanceWindow()` and add this native test-shell function to declarative-ui-main.ts. The shell creates the real authority/profile/native input boundary, passes those objects unchanged into the shared composition, and loads the existing production renderer test entry. It never injects intent/router/state factories. Merge duplicate imports (BrowserWindow must be a value import):

```ts
import { BrowserWindow, ipcMain } from "electron";
import { startPrimary } from "../../apps/desktop/src/main/plugins/profile-writer-lock.js";
import { AuthorityContexts } from "../../apps/desktop/src/main/device-broker/authority-context.js";
import { createCoreActionLedger, CoreRecovery } from "../../apps/desktop/src/main/plugins/core-recovery.js";
import { registerCoreRecoveryIpc } from "../../apps/desktop/src/main/plugins/ipc.js";
import { createJournal } from "../../apps/desktop/src/main/device-broker/journal.js";
import { createJournalFilesystem } from "../../apps/desktop/src/main/device-broker/journal-filesystem.js";
import { BUILTIN_PLUGIN_SOURCES } from "../../apps/desktop/src/main/plugins/builtin.js";
import { registerUiIpc } from "../../apps/desktop/src/main/plugins/ui-bridge.js";
import type { IpcHandle } from "../../apps/desktop/src/main/ipc.js";
import { readSource } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
let acceptanceMain: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof acceptanceComposition>> | undefined;
async function startAcceptanceWindow(): Promise<void> {
  let window: BrowserWindow | undefined;
  const primary = startPrimary(app, async profile => {
    const now = () => performance.now();
    const authority = new AuthorityContexts(profile.hostEpoch);
    window = new BrowserWindow({ width: 1024, height: 768, show: true,
      webPreferences: { preload: path.join(path.dirname(process.argv[1]!), "preload.cjs"),
        contextIsolation: true, nodeIntegration: false, sandbox: true } });
    const win = window;
    const document = authority.open(win.webContents.id);
    authority.report(win.webContents.id, { document, sequence: 1, state: "local", roomId: null,
      connected: true, synced: true, role: null, isHolder: true });
    const scope = () => {
      const principal = authority.core(win.webContents.id, "recovery");
      return { hostEpoch: principal.hostEpoch, workbenchInstance: principal.workbenchInstance };
    };
    const currentScope: DesktopMainCompositionInput["currentScope"] = candidate => {
      if (win.isDestroyed()) return false;
      const current = scope(); return candidate.hostEpoch === current.hostEpoch && candidate.workbenchInstance === current.workbenchInstance;
    };
    const directories = (process.argv.find(value => value.startsWith("--plugin-dev-dir="))?.slice("--plugin-dev-dir=".length) ?? "")
      .split(path.delimiter).filter(Boolean);
    const admitted = await Promise.all(directories.map(directory => readSource({ kind: "development", directory }, { safeMode: false })));
    const coreActions = createCoreActionLedger({ now, current: currentScope });
    const composition = await acceptanceComposition({ createFoundation: createDesktopFoundation,
      foundationOptions: { profile, now, authority,
        journal: createJournal(createJournalFilesystem(app.getPath("userData")), profile), coreActions,
        hasPermission: (principal, permission) => principal.kind === "plugin" &&
          !!admitted.find(source => source.sourceKey === principal.owner.sourceKey)?.manifest?.permissions.includes(permission),
        requirements: owner => admitted.find(source => source.sourceKey === owner.sourceKey)?.manifest?.requires?.devices ?? [],
        connectionPolicy: () => ({ wifiConnectTimeoutMs: 10000, wifiHandshakeTimeoutMs: 5000,
          usbAutoReconnect: false, usbRetryInterval: 2000, usbRetryLimit: 3 }),
        operationGate: () => ({ ok: true, value: null }) },
      plugins: { userData: app.getPath("userData"), builtins: BUILTIN_PLUGIN_SOURCES, locale: "en",
        commandLine: { developmentDirectories: directories, safeMode: false },
        dialogs: { confirmDeveloperMode: async () => true, chooseFolder: async () => undefined,
          confirmLink: async () => true, confirmUnlink: async () => true, choosePython: async () => undefined } },
      principal: owner => authority.plugin(win.webContents.id, owner), scope, currentScope,
      legacyFlush: async () => {}, report: failure,
    });
    acceptanceMain = composition;
    const ui = desktopUi(composition);
    const trusted = (event: { sender: { id: number }; senderFrame: unknown }) =>
      !win.isDestroyed() && event.sender.id === win.webContents.id && event.senderFrame === win.webContents.mainFrame;
    const handle: IpcHandle = (name, action) => ipcMain.handle(name, (event, ...args) => {
      if (!trusted(event)) throw new Error("Untrusted acceptance sender."); return action(event, ...args);
    });
    registerUiIpc({ handle, bridge: ui.bridge, trusted });
    const recovery = new CoreRecovery({ scope, now, actions: coreActions,
      entries: () => composition.foundation.broker.recovery.snapshot().blockers.map(id => ({
        item: { id, sourceKey: "core:device", kind: "device", state: "unconfirmed",
          title: { en: "Device recovery", "zh-TW": "裝置復原" },
          detail: { en: "Stop or journal disposition is unconfirmed.", "zh-TW": "停止或日誌結果尚未確認。" }, actions: [] },
        options: new Map(),
      })),
      openDetail() { throw new Error("No persistence detail in this P160 acceptance shell."); } });
    const offRecovery = registerCoreRecoveryIpc(handle, recovery, () => {
      if (!win.isDestroyed()) win.webContents.send("plugins:recovery:changed");
    });
    const offDeviceRecovery = composition.foundation.broker.recovery.subscribe(() => recovery.changed());
    ui.setRecoveryNavigation(() => { if (!win.isDestroyed()) win.webContents.send("plugins:recovery:changed"); });
    let off: (() => void) | undefined;
    handle("plugins:ui:subscribe", () => {
      off?.(); off = ui.bridge.onEvent(event => { if (!win.isDestroyed()) win.webContents.send("plugins:ui:event", event); });
    });
    handle("plugins:ui:unsubscribe", () => { off?.(); off = undefined; });
    win.on("blur", () => ui.intent.dispose());
    win.on("hide", () => ui.intent.dispose());
    win.webContents.on("render-process-gone", () => {
      ui.intent.dispose(); coreActions.retire(scope()); ui.actions.revokeWindow(scope());
      void desktopLifecycle(composition).close("close").catch(failure);
    });
    let closed = false, closing = false;
    win.on("close", event => {
      if (closed) return; event.preventDefault(); if (closing) return; closing = true;
      void composition.dispose().then(() => { closed = true; off?.(); offRecovery(); offDeviceRecovery(); win.close(); app.quit(); }, error => {
        closing = false; failure(error);
      });
    });
    await win.loadURL(MAIN_WINDOW_VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL);
  }, () => { if (!window || window.isDestroyed()) return false; window.focus(); return true; });
  if (!primary) throw new Error("Acceptance profile is already held.");
  await primary.ready;
}
```

The acceptance shell has no legacy Lab resources, hence its empty legacyFlush; production retains the real D150 callback. Keep native sender checks and the same broker authority implementation. Retain acceptanceMain for diagnostics and race assertions; a missing fakeControl or missing actual provider trace fails U10. This test shell does not certify production native-window/legacy-Lab behavior, which remains covered by the retained D160 main IPC/lifetime integration and packaged smoke gates.

Import `diagnosticsFor` directly from runtime `ui-state.ts` (T2), `ui-lifecycle.ts` (T3), main `ui-bridge.ts` (T5), renderer `state-store.ts` (T6) and `host-ports.ts` (T7). Append this collector to `declarative-ui-main.ts`; Step 5c supplies the dynamic BM-26 browser collector:

```ts
import type { FoundationCounters } from "../../packages/plugin-runtime/src/ui-host-ports.js";
function collectDiagnostics(entries: readonly { instance: object; diagnostics: FoundationDiagnostics }[]) {
  assert.equal(new Set(entries.map(entry => entry.instance)).size, entries.length);
  const events: FoundationDiagnosticEvent[] = [];
  const off = entries.map(entry => entry.diagnostics.onEvent(event => events.push(event)));
  const snapshot = (): FoundationCounters => {
    const sum = { owners: 0, bindings: 0, subscriptions: 0, queuedEvents: 0, queuedBytes: 0,
      timers: 0, pendingInvocations: 0, actionTokens: 0, resourceReaders: 0, workerJobs: 0 };
    for (const { diagnostics } of entries) {
      const counters = diagnostics.snapshot();
      for (const key of Object.keys(sum) as (keyof FoundationCounters)[]) {
        assert.ok(Number.isSafeInteger(counters[key]) && counters[key] >= 0, key);
        sum[key] += counters[key];
      }
    }
    return sum;
  };
  return { snapshot, events, clock: { origin: performance.timeOrigin, sampledAt: performance.now() },
    dispose() { for (const unsubscribe of off) unsubscribe(); } };
}
```

B2-T2 worker jobs remain zero until the P170 extension. Sum disjoint instances across processes only after teardown of the measured owners; record baseline and final raw snapshots as well as totals.

- [ ] **Step 5c: Bind BM-26 browser diagnostics to the production singleton.**

In `declarative-ui-browser.ts`, use this complete browser collector instead of copying Step 5b's fixed-entry main collector. Merge the type imports. Install it before publishing `api` or running any measured action. Resolve the imports through the same renderer module graph as `index.tsx`, so factory and diagnostics WeakMaps are the same module instances.

```ts
import { pluginUiWindow } from "../../apps/desktop/src/renderer/settings/settings-state.js";
import { diagnosticsFor as hostDiagnostics } from "../../apps/desktop/src/renderer/plugin-ui/host-ports.js";
import { diagnosticsFor as stateDiagnostics } from "../../apps/desktop/src/renderer/plugin-ui/state-store.js";
import type { FoundationCounters, FoundationDiagnostics, FoundationDiagnosticEvent }
  from "../../packages/plugin-runtime/src/ui-host-ports.js";

const foundationOwner = pluginUiWindow();
const foundationInstances = new Map<object, FoundationDiagnostics>();
const foundationEvents: FoundationDiagnosticEvent[] = [];
const foundationUnsubscribe: (() => void)[] = [];
const foundationRaw: { clock: { origin: number; sampledAt: number };
  instances: readonly { id: number; snapshot: FoundationCounters }[] }[] = [];
function retainFoundation(instance: object, lookup: (instance: object) => FoundationDiagnostics): void {
  if (foundationInstances.has(instance)) return;
  const diagnostics = lookup(instance); // Unknown instances fail; never substitute zeros.
  foundationInstances.set(instance, diagnostics);
  foundationUnsubscribe.push(diagnostics.onEvent(event => foundationEvents.push(Object.freeze({
    ...event, owner: Object.freeze({ ...event.owner }),
    ...(event.binding ? { binding: Object.freeze({ ...event.binding }) } : {}),
  }))));
}
function observeFoundationRecords(): void {
  for (const entry of foundationOwner.session.catalog.getSnapshot().entries) {
    const record = foundationOwner.session.record(entry);
    if (record) retainFoundation(record.state, stateDiagnostics);
  }
}
retainFoundation(foundationOwner.host, hostDiagnostics);
retainFoundation(foundationOwner.session.catalog, stateDiagnostics);
foundationUnsubscribe.push(foundationOwner.session.subscribe(observeFoundationRecords));
foundationUnsubscribe.push(foundationOwner.session.catalog.subscribe(observeFoundationRecords));
observeFoundationRecords();
// Retired records stay in this map, with their event subscriptions, through final observation.
function foundationDiagnostics(): {
  snapshot: FoundationCounters; events: readonly FoundationDiagnosticEvent[];
  clock: { origin: number; sampledAt: number };
} {
  const clock = Object.freeze({ origin: performance.timeOrigin, sampledAt: performance.now() });
  const sum = { owners: 0, bindings: 0, subscriptions: 0, queuedEvents: 0, queuedBytes: 0,
    timers: 0, pendingInvocations: 0, actionTokens: 0, resourceReaders: 0, workerJobs: 0 };
  const instances = [...foundationInstances.values()].map((diagnostics, id) => {
    const snapshot = Object.freeze({ ...diagnostics.snapshot() });
    for (const key of Object.keys(sum) as (keyof FoundationCounters)[]) {
      check(Number.isSafeInteger(snapshot[key]) && snapshot[key] >= 0, `invalid ${key}`);
      sum[key] += snapshot[key];
      check(Number.isSafeInteger(sum[key]), `overflow ${key}`);
    }
    return Object.freeze({ id, snapshot });
  });
  foundationRaw.push({ clock, instances: Object.freeze(instances) });
  return Object.freeze({ snapshot: Object.freeze(sum),
    events: Object.freeze([...foundationEvents]), clock });
}
function stopFoundationObservation(): void {
  for (const off of foundationUnsubscribe.splice(0)) off();
}
window.addEventListener("pagehide", stopFoundationObservation, { once: true });
```

Add this executable test in the same browser file and call it at the start of `api.run()`, before its existing operations. It uses the production session, tests discovery/removal and checks raw disjoint instance sums; no extra host or store is constructed.

```ts
async function testFoundationCollector(): Promise<void> {
  await foundationOwner.ready;
  check(pluginUiWindow() === foundationOwner, "different production singleton");
  for (const lookup of [hostDiagnostics, stateDiagnostics]) {
    let threw = false;
    try { lookup({}); } catch { threw = true; }
    check(threw, "unknown diagnostics instance accepted");
  }
  const entry = foundationOwner.session.catalog.getSnapshot().entries.find(
    entry => entry.kind === "panel" && entry.availability === "available");
  check(entry, "missing admitted panel");
  foundationOwner.session.showPane(true, "sidebar");
  await foundationOwner.session.open(entry);
  const record = foundationOwner.session.record(entry);
  check(record && foundationInstances.has(record.state), "session subscription missed state");
  const count = foundationInstances.size;
  observeFoundationRecords(); observeFoundationRecords();
  check(foundationInstances.size === count, "duplicate instance registration");
  const before = foundationDiagnostics();
  const raw = foundationRaw.at(-1)!;
  for (const key of Object.keys(before.snapshot) as (keyof FoundationCounters)[]) {
    check(before.snapshot[key] === raw.instances.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.snapshot[key], 0),
      `incorrect disjoint sum: ${key}`);
  }
  foundationOwner.session.close(entry);
  check(!foundationOwner.session.record(entry), "record did not close");
  check(foundationInstances.has(record.state), "retired diagnostics lost");
  foundationDiagnostics();
  check(foundationRaw.at(-1)!.instances.length >= count, "final raw observations lost");
}
```

Use the following complete test helper in `declarative-ui-main.ts`. The call-site block below reads diagnostics before and after measured actions. In the normal close path, after `composition.dispose()` resolves but before removing observers or closing/destroying the window, await `testFoundationRendererDisposal(win)`. Preserve its returned before/after data with the acceptance report. Keep observation alive until that final read; do not treat a crashed renderer's missing snapshot as zeros.

```ts
type BrowserFoundation = { snapshot: FoundationCounters; events: readonly FoundationDiagnosticEvent[];
  clock: { origin: number; sampledAt: number } };
async function foundationPage<T>(win: BrowserWindow, expression: string): Promise<T> {
  const debuggerApi = win.webContents.debugger;
  const attachedHere = !debuggerApi.isAttached();
  if (attachedHere) debuggerApi.attach("1.3");
  try {
    const result = await debuggerApi.sendCommand("Runtime.evaluate", {
      expression, returnByValue: true, awaitPromise: true,
    });
    assert.equal(result.exceptionDetails, undefined, "foundation test-page action failed");
    return result.result.value as T;
  } finally { if (attachedHere) debuggerApi.detach(); }
}
async function readFoundationDiagnostics(win: BrowserWindow): Promise<BrowserFoundation> {
  const result = await foundationPage<BrowserFoundation>(win,
    "window.declarativeAcceptance.foundationDiagnostics()");
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(result).sort(), ["clock", "events", "snapshot"]);
  assert.ok(Number.isFinite(result.clock.origin) && Number.isFinite(result.clock.sampledAt));
  for (const value of Object.values(result.snapshot)) assert.ok(Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0);
  return result;
}
async function testFoundationRendererDisposal(win: BrowserWindow) {
  const before = await readFoundationDiagnostics(win);
  assert.equal(await foundationPage<boolean>(win, `(() => {
    const api = window.declarativeAcceptance;
    const result = api.foundationDiagnostics();
    if (!Object.isFrozen(result.snapshot) || !Object.isFrozen(result.events)) return false;
    return api.disposeFoundationRenderer() === undefined;
  })()`), true);
  const after = await readFoundationDiagnostics(win);
  assert.ok(after.events.length >= before.events.length, "disposal events lost");
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(after.snapshot)) assert.equal(value, 0, key);
  await foundationPage<void>(win, "window.declarativeAcceptance.disposeFoundationRenderer()");
  assert.deepEqual((await readFoundationDiagnostics(win)).snapshot, after.snapshot);
  return { before, after };
}
```

Create `tests/desktop/declarative-ui-run.mjs`:

```js
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
import { cp, mkdtemp, readFile, symlink, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { setTimeout as pause } from "node:timers/promises";
import { build } from "esbuild";
import { createServer } from "vite";
import { rawResourcePlugin } from "./raw-resource-plugin.mjs";
import { materialize, fixture, root } from "./declarative-ui-harness.mjs";

const require = createRequire(path.join(root, "apps/desktop/package.json"));
const electron = require("electron");
const directory = await mkdtemp(path.join(tmpdir(), "kobrixa-ui-acceptance-"));
let passed = false;
let server;
async function run(executable, args, env, timeoutMs = 600_000) {
  const child = spawn(executable, args, { cwd: directory, env, stdio: "inherit" });
  const timer = setTimeout(() => child.kill("SIGKILL"), timeoutMs);
  try {
    const result = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      child.once("error", reject);
      child.once("exit", (code, signal) => resolve({ code, signal }));
    });
    assert.equal(result.code, 0, `${executable}: ${result.signal}`);
  } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
}
try {
  // Builds are prerequisites, not dependency installation. Carry real worker bundles along.
  await cp(path.join(root, "apps/desktop/.vite/build"), path.join(directory, "build"), { recursive: true });
  await symlink(path.join(root, "apps/desktop/node_modules"), path.join(directory, "node_modules"), "junction");
  const paths = process.argv.includes("--empty") ? [] : await materialize(path.join(directory, "plugins"), {
    sources: process.argv.includes("--maximum") ? 8 : 1,
    maximum: process.argv.includes("--maximum"),
  });
  const pythonPaths = process.argv.includes("--measure") ? [] : await materialize(path.join(directory, "python-plugins"), {
    sources: process.argv.includes("--maximum") ? 8 : 1,
    maximum: process.argv.includes("--maximum"), language: "python",
  });
  const js = path.join(directory, "interop-js");
  const python = path.join(directory, "interop-python");
  for (const leaf of [js, python]) await cp(fileURLToPath(fixture), leaf, { recursive: true });
  const bundled = path.join(js, "main.cjs");
  await build({ entryPoints: [fileURLToPath(new URL("consumer.ts", fixture))], outfile: bundled,
    bundle: true, platform: "node", format: "cjs", sourcemap: true });
  for (const leaf of paths) await cp(bundled, path.join(leaf, "main.cjs"));
  server = await createServer({ root: path.join(root, "apps/desktop"),
    configFile: path.join(root, "apps/desktop/vite.renderer.config.ts"),
    server: { host: "127.0.0.1", port: 0, watch: null, hmr: false } });
  await server.listen();
  const address = server.httpServer.address();
  assert.ok(address && typeof address !== "string");
  const renderer = `http://127.0.0.1:${address.port}/@fs/${path.join(root, "tests/desktop/declarative-ui-browser.html")}`;
  const main = path.join(directory, "build/main.cjs");
  await build({ entryPoints: [path.join(root, "tests/desktop/declarative-ui-main.ts")], outfile: main,
    bundle: true, platform: "node", format: "cjs", sourcemap: true,
    external: ["electron", "node-hid", "electron-updater"], plugins: [rawResourcePlugin()],
    define: { MAIN_WINDOW_VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL: JSON.stringify(renderer), MAIN_WINDOW_VITE_NAME: '"main_window"' } });
  await build({ entryPoints: [path.join(root, "apps/desktop/src/preload/index.ts")],
    outfile: path.join(directory, "build/preload.cjs"), bundle: true,
    platform: "node", format: "cjs", external: ["electron"] });
  const input = path.join(directory, "input.json");
  const transportReport = path.join(directory, "transport.json");
  await writeFile(input, JSON.stringify({ js, python }));
  const env = { ...process.env, PYTHONPATH: path.join(root, "sdks/python"),
    PYTHONUTF8: "1", PYTHONIOENCODING: "utf-8", PYTHONUNBUFFERED: "1" };
  await run(electron, [main, "--ui-acceptance-mode=transport", `--ui-acceptance-input=${input}`,
    `--ui-acceptance-output=${transportReport}`, `--user-data-dir=${path.join(directory, "transport-profile")}`], env);
  const browserRuns = process.argv.includes("--measure") ? [["js", paths]] : [["js", paths], ["python", pythonPaths]];
  for (const [language, activePaths] of browserRuns) {
    const browserReport = path.join(directory, `browser-${language}.json`);
    await run(electron, [main, process.argv.includes("--measure") ? "--ui-acceptance-mode=measure" : "--ui-acceptance-mode=product",
      `--ui-acceptance-output=${browserReport}`, `--user-data-dir=${path.join(directory, `product-profile-${language}`)}`,
      `--plugin-dev-dir=${activePaths.join(path.delimiter)}`, `--plugin-python=${env.KOBRIXA_TEST_PYTHON || "python3"}`], env);
    const report = JSON.parse(await readFile(browserReport, "utf8"));
    if (process.argv.includes("--measure")) {
      assert.equal(report.kind, "ui-measurement-session");
      console.log("Measurement session closed; raw observations still require the load-test evidence gate.");
    } else {
      await pause(5000);
      report.remainingPids = report.childPids.filter(pid => {
        try { process.kill(pid, 0); return true; }
        catch (error) { if (error.code === "ESRCH") return false; throw error; }
      });
      assert.deepEqual(report.remainingPids, [], "OS still observes app children after normal close");
      report.language = language;
      await writeFile(browserReport, JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
      await run(process.execPath, ["--test", path.join(root, "tests/desktop/declarative-ui-interop.test.mjs")], {
        ...env, KOBRIXA_UI_REPORT: transportReport, KOBRIXA_UI_BROWSER_REPORT: browserReport,
      });
    }
  }
  passed = true;
  console.log(`UI acceptance receipts: ${directory}`);
} finally {
  await server?.close();
  // Receipts are intentionally retained for the acceptance ledger on success and failure.
  console.log(`${passed ? "PASS baseline" : "FAIL"}; evidence directory ${directory}`);
}
```

```js
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { test } from "node:test";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { mkdtemp, mkdir, readFile, rm, symlink, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { verifyLeaf } from "./builtin-process-installed.mjs";

async function makeLeaf(directory) {
  const manifest = { id: "acceptance.ui", runtime: { kind: "node", entry: "main.cjs" },
    contributes: { panels: [{ resource: { version: 1, path: "panel.json" } }] } };
  const files = { "main.cjs": "process.exit(0);", "kobrixa-plugin.json": JSON.stringify(manifest),
    "panel.json": '{"kind":"panel"}' };
  await mkdir(directory, { recursive: true });
  const index = { version: 1, pluginId: manifest.id, files: [] };
  for (const name of Object.keys(files).sort()) {
    const contents = files[name];
    await writeFile(path.join(directory, name), contents);
    index.files.push({ path: name, bytes: Buffer.byteLength(contents),
      sha256: createHash("sha256").update(contents).digest("hex") });
  }
  await writeFile(path.join(directory, "resource-index.json"), JSON.stringify(index));
  return index;
}
test("U14/B1-RF5: missing/corrupt/foreign/traversing payloads fail closed", async () => {
  const temporary = await mkdtemp(path.join(tmpdir(), "ui-payload-audit-"));
  try {
    const leaf = path.join(temporary, "leaf");
    let index = await makeLeaf(leaf);
    assert.deepEqual(await verifyLeaf(leaf, "acceptance.ui"), index);
    await rm(path.join(leaf, "main.cjs"));
    await assert.rejects(verifyLeaf(leaf, "acceptance.ui"));
    index = await makeLeaf(leaf);
    await writeFile(path.join(leaf, "main.cjs"), "corruption");
    await assert.rejects(verifyLeaf(leaf, "acceptance.ui"));
    await makeLeaf(leaf);
    await assert.rejects(verifyLeaf(leaf, "another.plugin"));
    for (const change of [
      i => { i.files.push(i.files[0]); },
      i => { i.files[0].path = "../escape.json"; },
      i => { i.files[0].sha256 = i.files[0].sha256.toUpperCase(); },
      i => { i.files.reverse(); },
      i => { i.files.push({ path: "resource-index.json", bytes: 1, sha256: "a".repeat(64) }); },
      i => { i.files[0].bytes++; },
      i => { i.extra = true; },
      i => { i.files[0].extra = true; },
    ]) {
      index = await makeLeaf(leaf); change(index);
      await writeFile(path.join(leaf, "resource-index.json"), JSON.stringify(index));
      await assert.rejects(verifyLeaf(leaf, "acceptance.ui"));
    }
    await makeLeaf(leaf);
    await writeFile(path.join(leaf, "resource-index.json"), " ".repeat(16385));
    await assert.rejects(verifyLeaf(leaf, "acceptance.ui"));
    if (process.platform !== "win32") {
      await makeLeaf(leaf);
      const outside = path.join(temporary, "outside.cjs");
      await writeFile(outside, "process.exit(0);");
      await rm(path.join(leaf, "main.cjs"));
      await symlink(outside, path.join(leaf, "main.cjs"));
      await assert.rejects(verifyLeaf(leaf, "acceptance.ui"));
    }
  } finally { await rm(temporary, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});
```

Create `tests/desktop/builtin-process-installed.mjs`:

```js
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import { cp, lstat, mkdir, mkdtemp, readFile, realpath, rm, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import { build as viteBuild } from "vite";
import { build } from "esbuild";
import { createPackageWithOptions, listPackage, statFile } from "@electron/asar";
import { rawResourcePlugin } from "./raw-resource-plugin.mjs";

const root = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../", import.meta.url));
export async function verifyLeaf(directory, pluginId) {
  const rootReal = await realpath(directory);
  const indexPath = path.join(directory, "resource-index.json");
  assert.ok((await lstat(indexPath)).isFile());
  const raw = await readFile(indexPath);
  assert.ok(raw.length <= 16 * 1024);
  const index = JSON.parse(raw.toString("utf8"));
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(index).sort(), ["files", "pluginId", "version"]);
  assert.equal(index.version, 1); assert.equal(index.pluginId, pluginId);
  assert.ok(index.files.length >= 2 && index.files.length <= 32);
  const paths = index.files.map(file => file.path);
  assert.deepEqual(paths, [...new Set(paths)].sort());
  assert.ok(paths.includes("main.cjs") && paths.includes("kobrixa-plugin.json"));
  assert.equal(paths.includes("resource-index.json"), false);
  for (const file of index.files) {
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(file).sort(), ["bytes", "path", "sha256"]);
    assert.ok(file.path === "main.cjs" || /^(?:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*\/)*[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*\.json$/.test(file.path));
    assert.match(file.sha256, /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
    assert.ok(Number.isSafeInteger(file.bytes) && file.bytes >= 0);
    const absolute = path.join(directory, file.path);
    const resolved = await realpath(absolute);
    const relative = path.relative(rootReal, resolved);
    assert.ok(relative && !relative.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) && relative !== ".." && !path.isAbsolute(relative));
    assert.ok((await lstat(absolute)).isFile()); // rejects a leaf symlink even if its target is inside
    const contents = await readFile(absolute);
    assert.equal(contents.length, file.bytes);
    assert.equal(createHash("sha256").update(contents).digest("hex"), file.sha256);
    if (file.path === "main.cjs") assert.ok(file.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024);
  }
  const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(directory, "kobrixa-plugin.json"), "utf8"));
  assert.equal(manifest.id, pluginId);
  assert.deepEqual(manifest.runtime, { kind: "node", entry: "main.cjs" });
  const resources = [...(manifest.contributes.panels ?? []), ...(manifest.contributes.status ?? [])]
    .map(item => { assert.equal(item.resource.version, 1); return item.resource.path; });
  assert.deepEqual(paths, [...new Set(["main.cjs", "kobrixa-plugin.json", ...resources])].sort());
  return index;
}
async function run(executable, args, options) {
  const child = spawn(executable, args, { ...options, stdio: "inherit" });
  const timer = setTimeout(() => child.kill("SIGKILL"), 60_000);
  try {
    const result = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      child.once("error", reject); child.once("exit", (code, signal) => resolve({ code, signal }));
    });
    assert.equal(result.code, 0, `installed test failed: ${result.signal}`);
  } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
}
async function main() {
  const directory = await mkdtemp(path.join(tmpdir(), "kobrixa-installed-ui-"));
  const installed = path.join(directory, "installed");
  // This is a SYNTHETIC packaged host. The production packaged smoke remains a separate gate.
  await cp(path.join(root, `apps/desktop/out/Kobrixa-${process.platform}-${process.arch}`), installed,
    { recursive: true, verbatimSymlinks: true });
  const resources = path.join(installed, process.platform === "darwin" ? "Kobrixa.app/Contents/Resources" : "resources");
  const executable = path.join(installed, process.platform === "darwin" ? "Kobrixa.app/Contents/MacOS/kobrixa"
    : process.platform === "win32" ? "kobrixa.exe" : "kobrixa");
  const source = path.join(directory, "asar-source");
  const leaf = path.join(source, ".vite/build/plugins/acceptance-builtin");
  await mkdir(source, { recursive: true });
  // The K160 fixture config consumes T9's fixture paths, using the real shared builder/indexer.
  await viteBuild({ root: path.join(root, "apps/desktop"),
    configFile: path.join(root, "apps/desktop/vite.plugin-fixture.config.ts"),
    build: { outDir: leaf, emptyOutDir: true } });
  const builtIndex = await verifyLeaf(leaf, "acceptance.ui");
  assert.ok(builtIndex.files.some(file => file.path === "panel.json"));
  for (const name of ["main.cjs", "kobrixa-plugin.json", "resource-index.json", "panel.json"])
    assert.ok((await lstat(path.join(leaf, name))).isFile(), name);
  const registry = await readFile(path.join(root, "apps/desktop/src/main/plugins/builtin.ts"), "utf8");
  assert.equal(registry.includes("acceptance-builtin"), false);
  assert.equal(registry.includes("acceptance.ui"), false);
  await writeFile(path.join(source, "package.json"), JSON.stringify({ name: "kobrixa-ui-installed-test", version: "0.0.0", main: "main.cjs" }));
  await build({ entryPoints: [path.join(root, "tests/desktop/declarative-ui-main.ts")],
    outfile: path.join(source, "main.cjs"), bundle: true, platform: "node", format: "cjs",
    external: ["electron", "node-hid", "electron-updater"], plugins: [rawResourcePlugin()],
    define: { MAIN_WINDOW_VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL: "undefined", MAIN_WINDOW_VITE_NAME: '"main_window"' } });
  const archive = path.join(resources, "app.asar");
  await rm(archive, { force: true });
  await rm(`${archive}.unpacked`, { recursive: true, force: true });
  await createPackageWithOptions(source, archive, { unpack: "{**/*.node,**/.vite/build/plugins/**}" });
  const packagedLeaf = path.join(`${archive}.unpacked`, ".vite/build/plugins/acceptance-builtin");
  const index = await verifyLeaf(packagedLeaf, "acceptance.ui");
  const archived = listPackage(archive).map(name => name.replaceAll("\\", "/"));
  for (const file of [...index.files.map(item => item.path), "resource-index.json"]) {
    const name = `.vite/build/plugins/acceptance-builtin/${file}`;
    assert.ok(archived.includes(`/${name}`));
    assert.equal(statFile(archive, name).unpacked, true);
  }
  const cwd = path.join(directory, "unrelated-cwd"); await mkdir(cwd);
  const emptyPath = path.join(directory, "empty-path"); await mkdir(emptyPath);
  const env = { ...process.env, PATH: emptyPath };
  for (const key of ["NODE_PATH", "NODE_OPTIONS", "ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE", "PYTHONPATH"])
    delete env[key];
  const input = path.join(directory, "input.json");
  const output = path.join(directory, "installed.json");
  const launch = async (expectRejected, suffix) => {
    await writeFile(input, JSON.stringify({ expectRejected }));
    await run(executable, ["--ui-acceptance-mode=installed", `--ui-acceptance-input=${input}`,
      `--ui-acceptance-output=${output}`, `--user-data-dir=${path.join(directory, suffix)}`], { cwd, env });
    return JSON.parse(await readFile(output, "utf8"));
  };
  const result = await launch(false, "healthy-profile");
  const entry = path.join(packagedLeaf, "main.cjs");
  const original = await readFile(entry);
  await rm(entry);
  const missing = await launch(true, "missing-profile");
  await writeFile(entry, Buffer.concat([original, Buffer.from("\n// changed hash\n")]));
  const corrupt = await launch(true, "corrupt-profile");
  await writeFile(entry, original);
  Object.assign(result, { noPathNode: env.PATH === emptyPath, noNodePath: !env.NODE_PATH,
    arbitraryCwd: cwd !== root, productionFixtureRegistered: false, missingRejected: missing.rejected, corruptRejected: corrupt.rejected });
  await writeFile(output, JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  await run(process.execPath, ["--test", path.join(root, "tests/desktop/builtin-process-packaging.test.mjs")],
    { cwd, env: { ...process.env, KOBRIXA_BUILTIN_REPORT: output } });
  console.log(`Synthetic installed evidence: ${output}`);
  console.log("Clean installation/offline/no-checkout access remains a controller environment gate.");
}
if (process.argv[1] && pathToFileURL(path.resolve(process.argv[1])).href === import.meta.url)
  await main();
```

`verifyLeaf` is an independent audit of the artifact, not a substitute for the production `resolveBuiltinLaunch` checks; the installed main executes both the healthy production resolver/launcher and missing/hash-corrupt rejection. It must fail before launch on negative payloads. AM-20 freezes K160's default `UserConfigExport`: input `tests/desktop/fixtures/builtin-process`, ID `acceptance.ui`, slug `acceptance-builtin`, and the single Vite-resolved `build.outDir` for bundle, manifest, index and resources. Its default is `apps/desktop/.vite/build/plugins/acceptance-builtin`, resolved from the desktop project root; this test overrides it with the temporary absolute `leaf`. The shared `builtinPluginConfig` and resource indexer perform the build; `verifyLeaf` only audits their output. No stub product entry is added to Forge.

```markdown
# Declarative plugin UI v1

API 1.6.0 introduces data-only panels and status contributions. Plugins are trusted local programs: a utility process is crash isolation, not an OS security sandbox. UI resources cannot contain HTML, JavaScript, CSS, SVG, URLs, webviews or remote content. All controls are rendered by the host.

Use `apiVersion: "^1.6.0"`, declare `ui.panels`/`ui.status` only when needed, and place a version-1 JSON resource beside the executable bundle. Contribution IDs start with your manifest ID and a dot. Panel declarations use `location: "right"`; status v1 contains only text, tone, data and optional visibility. A static-runtime plugin cannot declare either contribution, including empty arrays.

The executable fixtures in `tests/desktop/fixtures/declarative-ui` show the complete manifest, all 14 component kinds and JS/Python consumers. `group`, `text`, `help`, `textInput`, `number`, `range`, `choice`, `boolean`, `action`, `holdAction`, `status`, `alert`, `progress` and `keyValue` are the entire v1 vocabulary. Each input field belongs to exactly one node; every non-root node has one parent, every node is reachable and cycles are invalid. English `en` text is required; `zh-TW` is optional. Text is literal, not markup. Local IDs match `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$`.

A resource has at most 256 nodes and depth 8, at most 256 KiB of actual UTF-8 bytes, at most 1 MiB per source and 8 MiB per host. There are at most four panel declarations and two statuses per source, 16 panels and 16 statuses per host. Serialize first when checking bytes: Unicode code points and UTF-8 bytes are different limits. Do not truncate an oversized resource; validation rejects it before activation.

A command used by a panel declares `invocation: "context-v1"` and its finite scalar argument schema. Register it with JS `commands.registerContext` or Python `@plugin.context_command`; return `{ok:true,value:{output:{},fieldErrors:[]}}` or the documented business failure. Existing `commands.register`/`@plugin.command` still use `command/execute` and return null on the wire. Initialize's four fields remain unchanged. The host negotiates envelope/resource versions separately, creates bindings, then sends `ui/ready`; initialize, negotiation and ready share one 10-second deadline. Register callbacks during activation and use ready for initial UI queries. Do not wait for ready-dependent calls inside activation.

`ui.instances`, `ui.state` and `ui.patch` operate only on the caller's live bindings. A patch changes declared data slots atomically with an exact `baseRevision`. It never changes the tree, labels, commands or form draft. One panel accepts at most 10 patches per second; the renderer queue is at most four updates/64 KiB. Read a snapshot after a stale result or event gap and decide explicitly what to do next; do not replay mutations. Subscription delivery is bounded, callbacks are serial, ack follows validated bounded enqueue, and `events/unsubscribe` returns removed true then false. It is also the only unsubscribe wire method for later settings watchers.

The host creates command context, invocationId, actionRef, binding and motion references. Arguments with similarly named fields do not gain authority. invocationId deduplicates an invocation; actionRef is a separate one-use, five-second user-action reference. Export/copy arrive with persistence in 1.7.0, and must never use invocationId as authorization. A management invocation has no panel binding or motion scope. A timer, ready callback or heartbeat cannot create a user action.

Hold input is owned by the trusted renderer/main bridge. A 100 ms challenge cadence and 350 ms expiry bound liveness; plugins cannot send their own renewals. Release, cancel, lost capture, form/mode change, hide, tab/sidebar switch, collapse, blur or minimize revoke view intent. Delayed start/reply cannot revive it. A stop request and a physically confirmed stop are different states; core recovery retains uncertainty. Recordings are not a v1 UI feature: hiding a future Lab view does not stop its background work, while 3D and real persistence define its checkpoints.

`uiResourceGeneration` identifies resource lifetime, separately from process generation/processEpoch and hostEpoch. A replacement or retirement removes old bindings and gestures immediately. Process restart is lazy after explicit user action; commands and motion are not replayed. Three failures in five minutes stop activation until explicit reload or disable→enable. Required builtins cannot be disabled. Delivered optional builtins default enabled and can be independently toggled without developer mode; user choices survive restart. Optional-only unclean exit does not by itself lock safe mode. Third-party/development risk and renderer unresponsiveness do. Cold safe mode starts no optional process/provider; core management and recovery remain available.

Plugin tools uses sibling tabs, exclusive with other right-side panes. The actual motor tab moves out of the monitor card with 3C. Generic contributed settings reuse host controls: booleans/choices apply on change, valid text/numbers on blur or Enter, and reset saves one field. There is no Apply button. Invalid drafts and save errors stay visible; an external revision conflict requires reload or explicit retry. The real settings/storage service is delivered in 1.7.0; the v1 host adapter alone does not prove persistence.

Installed node features use `app.asar.unpacked/.vite/build/plugins/<slug>/main.cjs`, `kobrixa-plugin.json`, `resource-index.json` and declared JSON resources. Each entry bundles its SDK/protocol dependencies and launches using Electron utilityProcess and MessagePort. There is no PATH Node, runtime download, source-checkout or workspace-node_modules fallback. The sorted index has at most 32 files and 16 KiB, with SHA-256 and byte lengths; the entry is at most 16 MiB. Hash validation detects corruption, not authenticity. Product entries arrive with 3C motor, 3D Lab and 3E device; synthetic acceptance fixtures do not claim these products shipped.

The desktop uses one profile writer. A second launch focuses/restores the first window and starts no second workbench/provider/plugin runtime. Normal close waits for device stop/readback/journal and persistence disposition before process teardown: storage 10 seconds in parallel with stop 15 seconds plus journal 5 seconds, then manager 4 seconds; 24-second cleanup and 25-second outer safety net are not permission to force-close. Save/stop uncertainty keeps a core blocker. Healthy consumers survive release, Disconnect, suspend and provider loss; renderer/window destruction retires them. Resume does not replay motion or recording. Real Lab save/retry/checkpoint acceptance remains open until X-T1 and 3D.

Run the Node helpers, real UI smoke, synthetic installed test and production packaged smoke separately. Record artifact/platform, commands/exits, raw traces and unresolved gates. Accessibility at both themes/locales, 320 px, 125% scale, real USB/Wi-Fi safety and clean installed environments require controller acceptance. Do not convert skipped Python, mock ports or the stage-2 V01–V04 exceptions into passing integration results.
```

Create `docs/zh-TW/plugin-declarative-ui.md` with this content:

```markdown
# 宣告式插件 UI v1

API 1.6.0 提供純資料的 panel／status。插件是受信任的本機程式；utility process 提供程序隔離，不是 OS 安全沙箱。UI resource 不接受 HTML、JavaScript、CSS、SVG、URL、webview 或遠端內容，控制項由 host 統一繪製。

manifest 使用 `apiVersion: "^1.6.0"`，按需要宣告 `ui.panels`／`ui.status`；version 1 JSON 與 bundle 一起交付。contribution ID 以 manifest ID 加句點開頭，panel 的 location 固定為 right。status v1 只有 text、tone、data 與可選 visibility。static runtime 不可宣告 panel／status，空陣列也不例外。

完整可執行範例在 `tests/desktop/fixtures/declarative-ui`，包含 manifest、JS／Python consumer 與全部 14 種元件：group、text、help、textInput、number、range、choice、boolean、action、holdAction、status、alert、progress、keyValue。每個 field 恰由一個 input node 使用；除 root 外每個 node 恰有一個 parent，全部可達，不可循環。Text 必須有 en，zh-TW 可省略；文字不解析 markup。LocalId 格式為 `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$`。

每份 resource 最多 256 nodes、depth 8、256 KiB 實際 UTF-8 bytes；每 source 最多 1 MiB、host 最多 8 MiB。每 source 最多四個 panel 宣告與兩個 status，host 最多 16 panels／16 status。Unicode code points 與 bytes 分別驗證；請先序列化計算 bytes。超限整份拒絕，不截斷安全提示或控制項。

panel action 引用的 command 宣告 `invocation: "context-v1"` 及有限 scalar arguments schema。JS 使用 commands.registerContext，Python 使用 @plugin.context_command，明確回傳 `{ok:true,value:{output:{},fieldErrors:[]}}` 或正式 business failure。舊 commands.register／@plugin.command 保持 command/execute 與 null result。initialize 原有四欄不變，host 另外協商版本、建立 bindings，再送 ui/ready；三者共用十秒期限。activation 只註冊 callback，不等待需要 ready 的呼叫；初始查詢放在 ready。

ui.instances／ui.state／ui.patch 只操作同 process 的 live bindings。patch 以精確 baseRevision 原子更新已宣告 data，不更動樹、標籤、commands 或輸入中的 draft。每 panel 最多每秒十次，renderer queue 最多四筆／64 KiB。stale 或事件 gap 後先讀 snapshot，由作者決定下一步，不自動重送 mutation。subscription 有界、callback 串行，驗證並成功進有界 queue 後才 ack。events/unsubscribe 首次 removed=true、重送 false；後續 settings watchers 也沿用此唯一 wire method。

context、binding、motion reference、invocationId、actionRef 都由 host 建立，同名 arguments 不會取得權限。invocationId 僅供去重；actionRef 是五秒內一次性的真實使用者動作。1.7.0 才提供 persistence export／copy，不可把 invocationId 當授權。management command 沒有 panel binding／motion scope；timer、ready、heartbeat 不會產生 user action。

hold 由可信 renderer／main bridge 管理，以 100 ms challenge 與 350 ms expiry 限制存活。插件沒有續租 API。release、cancel、lost capture、欄位／模式改變、hide、tab／sidebar 切換、collapse、blur／minimize 都撤銷 view intent；晚到 start／reply 不得復活。要求停止不代表實際停止已確認，core recovery 保留 uncertainty。v1 UI 不提供錄製產品；未來 Lab 隱藏視圖繼續背景工作，由 3D 與正式 persistence 定義 checkpoint。

uiResourceGeneration 與 execution generation／processEpoch、hostEpoch 分離。resource 替換或退休立即撤舊 bindings／gestures。process 只在後續明確操作時 lazy restart，不重播 commands／motion；五分鐘三次失敗後須 reload 或 disable→enable 重設。required builtin 不可停用。已交付 optional builtin 預設 enabled，一般模式即可獨立開關並保存選擇，無須 developer mode。僅 optional 的非正常退出不自行鎖 safe mode；第三方／development 風險與 renderer unresponsive 才鎖。cold safe mode 不啟動 optional process／provider，core management／recovery 仍可使用。

Plugin tools 是同級 tabs，與其他右側 panes 互斥；真正 motor 移出 monitor card 屬於 3C。通用插件設定重用 host 控制項：boolean／choice change 立即套用，text／number 有效輸入在 blur／Enter 提交，reset 只保存該欄，沒有 Apply 按鈕。invalid draft／save error 保留可見；外部 revision 衝突須重新載入或明確 retry。正式 settings／storage 在 1.7.0 交付，僅完成 v1 controls adapter 不代表保存已驗收。

安裝版 layout 固定為 `app.asar.unpacked/.vite/build/plugins/<slug>/main.cjs`、kobrixa-plugin.json、resource-index.json 與宣告的 JSON。SDK／protocol 相依編入 entry，以 Electron utilityProcess／MessagePort 執行，不使用 PATH Node、runtime download、checkout 或 workspace node_modules fallback。index 路徑排序、最多 32 files／16 KiB，記 SHA-256／bytes，entry 最多 16 MiB。hash 用於缺件／損壞驗證，不是數位簽章。3C motor、3D Lab、3E device 依序交付產品；synthetic fixture 不代表三份產品已上線。

desktop 只有一個 profile writer；第二次啟動還原／聚焦第一個視窗，不新增工作台、provider 或 plugin runtime。正常關閉先取得 stop/readback／journal 與 storage disposition，再關閉程序：storage 十秒與 stop 十五秒加 journal 五秒平行，之後 manager 四秒；24 秒 cleanup、25 秒 safety net 不代表自動 force exit。保存／停止未知保留 core blocker。健康 consumer 在 release、Disconnect、suspend、provider loss 後存續；renderer／window destroyed 才 retirement。wake 不自動續 motion／錄製。Lab save／retry／checkpoint 的正式驗收留到 X-T1 與 3D。

Node helpers、真 UI smoke、synthetic installed 與 production packaged smoke 分開記錄，報 artifact／平台、命令 exit、raw traces 與未完成項。兩主題／兩語系、320 px／125%、screen reader、真 USB／Wi-Fi 與乾淨安裝環境由 controller 驗收。Python SKIP、mock ports 或 stage-2 V01–V04 例外都不能改記為整合通過。
```

```ts
type Stage3RuntimePorts = {
  device: DeviceResourceParticipant;
  persistence: PersistenceParticipant;
  ui: UiCatalogPort;
};
// Existing options retain their other fields.
interface PluginManagerOptions {
  stage3?: Stage3RuntimePorts;
}
interface DeviceResourceParticipant {
  retire(owner: ResourceOwner, reason: RetirementReason): {
    drain: DeviceDrainGrant | null;
    settled: Promise<DeviceDisposition>;
  };
  retireProvider(providerId: string, providerGeneration: Counter): Promise<DeviceDisposition>;
  beginShutdown(): Promise<DeviceDisposition>;
}
interface PersistenceParticipant {
  endReservation(event: ReservationEnded, deadline: number): DrainOffer | null;
  freeze(owner: PersistenceOwner, reason: DrainReason, deadline: number, deviceDrain?: DeviceDrainGrant): DrainOffer;
  drain(offer: DrainOffer, dispatch: DrainDispatcher): Promise<DrainReport>;
  ownerLost(owner: PersistenceOwner): Promise<DrainReport>;
  recoverySnapshot(): PersistenceRecoverySnapshot;
  retry(recovery: Handle, action: CoreActionReference): Promise<DrainReport>;

}
```
