Run the verification section below in dependency order. H-P alone runs the first authorized 1.6.0 schema generation from **P150-aware** sources and reviews the API/schema version/permissions/event/code delta. T10 does not hand-edit generated JSON or drop A's device methods to make a schema diff clean. Regenerate after the reviewed batch and compare both copies. Reuse unchanged successful scoped results; do not rerun every broad suite after editing only prose.

For actual T9 receipt checks, set the controller environment variables `KOBRIXA_UI_REPORT`, `KOBRIXA_UI_BROWSER_REPORT`, `KOBRIXA_UI_MATRIX`, `KOBRIXA_UI_MEASUREMENTS` and `KOBRIXA_BUILTIN_REPORT` to their real retained files. Run the owned Node suites again and require the corresponding actual tests to execute without SKIP. Python SKIP remains unrun. The Node helper pass, a matrix file, or CI test count alone is insufficient without the referenced raw evidence.

- [ ] **Step 4: Record the exact P160 handoff facts and unresolved gates.**

Use this complete receipt appender after the reviewed implementation/test commit. The controller supplies actual values as environment variables; every required value is checked. `P160_TEST_LOG` names a real UTF-8 log, `P160_ARTIFACT` a real packaged artifact, `P160_MATRIX`/`P160_MEASUREMENTS` the observed files, and `P150_COMMIT` the actual user-merged P150 commit from the freeze receipt. `P160_REVIEWED_COMMIT` is the tested implementation commit; the later report-only commit does not recursively claim its own SHA.

```bash
export pnpm_config_pm_on_fail=ignore pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false; node --input-type=module <<'JS'
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { readFile, appendFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import os from "node:os";
import { assertMeasurements } from "./tests/desktop/declarative-ui-harness.mjs";
const required = name => {
  const value = process.env[name]; assert.ok(value && value.trim(), name); return value;
};
const p150 = required("P150_COMMIT");
const reviewed = required("P160_REVIEWED_COMMIT");
for (const sha of [p150, reviewed]) assert.match(sha, /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/);
execFileSync("git", ["merge-base", "--is-ancestor", p150, reviewed]);
assert.equal(execFileSync("git", ["rev-parse", "HEAD"], { encoding: "utf8" }).trim(), reviewed);
const commonReceipt = required("P150_COMMON_RECEIPT");
const commonReceiptBytes = await readFile(commonReceipt);
assert.ok(commonReceiptBytes.length > 0);
const commonReceiptHash = createHash("sha256").update(commonReceiptBytes).digest("hex");
const artifact = required("P160_ARTIFACT");
const artifactHash = createHash("sha256").update(await readFile(artifact)).digest("hex");
const log = required("P160_TEST_LOG");
assert.ok((await readFile(log, "utf8")).length > 0);
const matrixFile = required("P160_MATRIX");
const measurementFile = required("P160_MEASUREMENTS");
const matrix = JSON.parse(await readFile(matrixFile, "utf8"));
assert.equal(matrix.U12.status, "pending-real-persistence");
assert.equal(matrix.U12.realPassed, false);
assertMeasurements(JSON.parse(await readFile(measurementFile, "utf8")));
const rows = [
  "", "## Controller-observed P160 receipt", "",
  `- Recorded: ${new Date().toISOString()}`,
  `- P150 ancestor: ${p150}`,
  `- P150 H-P stopped-owner common-file receipt: ${commonReceipt}; SHA-256 ${commonReceiptHash}`,
  `- Reviewed/tested implementation: ${reviewed}`,
  `- Artifact: ${artifact}`,
  `- Artifact SHA-256: ${artifactHash}`,
  `- Platform: ${os.platform()}/${os.arch()} ${os.release()}`,
  `- CPU/RAM: ${os.cpus()[0]?.model ?? "unreported"}; ${os.totalmem()} bytes`,
  `- Commands and exit codes: ${log}`,
  `- Matrix raw-evidence index: ${matrixFile}`,
  `- Measurements: ${measurementFile}`,
  "- U12: pending-real-persistence; only X-T1 after P170 can close real storage acceptance.",
  "- Product/hardware/clean-install rows retain their individually recorded statuses; no blanket sign-off.",
  "",
];
await appendFile("docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-17-plugin-system-3b1-acceptance.md", rows.join("\n"));
JS
```

The appender is not a test runner: Step 3's Node matrix test must already have validated every row and its actual provenance. Record every command's exit code in the named log, including failures subsequently corrected and rerun. Populate OS/filesystem/versions and manual results in the evidence records as prescribed; actual outstanding gates block acceptance, except the expressly permitted real-persistence and future-product/hardware dependencies. All AM-15–22/31 owner suites and the concrete U10/diagnostics probes below must pass before claiming P160 acceptance.

Record the printed publication SHA in the controller's freeze/publication receipt under its existing ownership. The user merges P160 `--no-ff` into stage3. B2 then synchronizes with that merged baseline before R170/D170/V170/K170; X-T1 alone closes the real-persistence ledger. Keep the retained legacy Lab store/close path, stage-2 V01–V04 exceptions and future 3C/3D/3E acceptance intact.

Headless Linux inserts `xvfb-run -a` before Electron-running pnpm/node commands, after the same export prefix. Windows/macOS clean installed adapters and USB/Wi-Fi hardware results are separate rows. Reuse unchanged successful results; `test:desktop` already includes bytecode/release/Python/static-language checks and `check` includes ESLint. Never run root `format` to rewrite another owner's files.

Every report records command/exit code, commit/artifact, OS/architecture, CPU/RAM/filesystem, Node/Electron, fixture bytes/records/limits, warm/cold, sample count, p50/p95/max, memory metric/method and manual/unrun reason. B1 measurements are 5 s warmup, 60 s samples, at least three repeats. Resource-free mocks do not establish storage success, motor public-route proof, Lab v2, three delivered product payloads or clean-installed hardware acceptance.
